model.name: Power and Utilities
model.description: I am an electric and gas utility with energy generation, transmission, and distribution to serve residential and commercial customers
model.core_business_processes: Energy Generation (fossil fuel; nuclear; renewable sources), Power Transmission and Grid Operations, Electricity Distribution to End Customers, Natural Gas Procurement and Distribution, Customer Enrollment and Account Management, Metering and Meter Data Management, Billing and Revenue Management, Demand Response and Load Management, Asset Maintenance and Infrastructure Management, Regulatory Compliance and Rate Case Filing
model.data_domains: Customer, Metering, Billing, Generation, Transmission, Distribution, Asset Management, Workforce, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Energy Trading, Grid Operations, Finance, Safety and Compliance
model.common_business_jargons: kWh (Kilowatt-Hour), MW (Megawatt), MWh (Megawatt-Hour), MCF (Thousand Cubic Feet), Therm (Unit of Heat Energy), AMI (Advanced Metering Infrastructure), SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition), OMS (Outage Management System), DMS (Distribution Management System), EMS (Energy Management System), GIS (Geographic Information System), CIS (Customer Information System), SAIDI (System Average Interruption Duration Index), SAIFI (System Average Interruption Frequency Index), CAIDI (Customer Average Interruption Duration Index), PUC (Public Utility Commission), FERC (Federal Energy Regulatory Commission), NERC (North American Electric Reliability Corporation), RTO (Regional Transmission Organization), ISO (Independent System Operator), IRP (Integrated Resource Plan), PPA (Power Purchase Agreement), REC (Renewable Energy Certificate), T&D (Transmission and Distribution), O&M (Operations and Maintenance), CPCN (Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity), EIA (Energy Information Administration), LCOE (Levelized Cost of Energy), DR (Demand Response), DER (Distributed Energy Resources), NEM (Net Energy Metering), TOU (Time-of-Use), CPP (Critical Peak Pricing), RTP (Real-Time Pricing), GRC (General Rate Case), ROE (Return on Equity), RAB (Regulatory Asset Base), CAPEX (Capital Expenditure), OPEX (Operating Expenditure), EBITDA (Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization), ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning), CRM (Customer Relationship Management), MDM (Meter Data Management), DERMS (Distributed Energy Resource Management System), VPP (Virtual Power Plant), LMP (Locational Marginal Price), DAM (Day-Ahead Market), RTM (Real-Time Market), BES (Bulk Electric System), CIP (Critical Infrastructure Protection), OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration), PSC (Public Service Commission)
model.operational_systems_of_records: SAP ERP (FI/CO; MM; PM; HR), Oracle Customer Care and Billing (CC&B) for CIS, OSIsoft PI Historian for real-time operational data, GE PowerOn Advanced DMS/OMS, Esri ArcGIS for geospatial asset management, Oracle Utilities Meter Data Management (MDM), Maximo for Enterprise Asset Management (EAM), Allegro for Energy Trading and Risk Management (ETRM), ClickSoftware for Workforce Management (WFM), Salesforce for Commercial Customer Engagement
model.industry_governing_body: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC), North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC), State Public Utility Commissions (PUCs), U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA), Department of Energy (DOE), Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA), National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Smart Grid Framework, International Organization for Standardization (ISO 55000 - Asset Management), Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB - ASC 980 Regulated Operations)

domains.name: generation
domains.description: Owns all data related to electric power generation assets and operations across fossil fuel plants, nuclear facilities, and renewable energy sources (solar, wind, hydro). Tracks generation capacity (MW), energy output (MWh), unit performance, fuel consumption, heat rates, emissions, capacity factors, and plant availability. Supports IRP, LCOE analysis, and REC tracking. Integrates with OSIsoft PI Historian for real-time telemetry.
domains.references: NERC Reliability Standards, EIA Form 923, EPA, FERC

products.name: plant
products.description: Master record for each electric power generation facility operated by the utility, including fossil fuel (coal, natural gas, oil), nuclear, and renewable (solar, wind, hydro) plants. Captures plant name, NERC plant code, EIA plant ID, plant type, fuel category, installed capacity (MW), commercial operation date, retirement date, regulatory jurisdiction, ISO/RTO interconnection, geographic coordinates, FERC license number, and operational status. Serves as the SSOT for generation plant identity and is the anchor entity for all generation domain products.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Primary key for plant

attributes.name: asset_registry_id

attributes.name: balancing_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gridops.balancing_area. Business justification: Required for the Balancing Area Settlement Report that allocates each plant's generation to its BA for LMP calculation and regulatory compliance (FERC, NERC).

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Required for Plant Operations Management reports that identify the employee responsible for each plant's compliance and performance.

attributes.name: parcel_id

attributes.name: product_rate_schedule_id

attributes.name: scada_system_id

attributes.name: transmission_line_id

attributes.name: transmission_substation_id

attributes.name: capacity_factor_percent

products.name: generating_unit
products.description: Master record for each individual generating unit (boiler-turbine set, reactor unit, wind turbine, solar inverter block, hydro turbine) within a plant. Tracks unit name, EIA unit code, NERC unit ID, prime mover type (ST, GT, CC, HY, PV, WT, NUC), nameplate capacity (MW), summer/winter capacity ratings, heat rate (BTU/kWh), fuel type, unit status (operating, mothballed, retired), synchronization date, and associated plant. Enables unit-level performance tracking, IRP modeling, and LCOE analysis.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the generating unit. Primary key for the generating unit master record.

attributes.name: asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.registry. Business justification: Unit‑level asset tracking is needed for condition assessments, work orders, and regulatory reporting; linking unit to asset registry provides that relationship.

attributes.name: balancing_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gridops.balancing_area. Business justification: Needed for Unit Dispatch and AGC process where each generating unit receives setpoints within a specific balancing area for real‑time dispatch and frequency regulation.

attributes.name: bus_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to transmission.bus. Business justification: Dispatch and power‑flow models require each unit's bus mapping; reflected in Real‑Time Energy Management System.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Allows budgeting and expense tracking per generating unit, required for the Unit Cost Allocation process.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Supports unit-level depreciation and O&M expense posting, used in the Unit Depreciation Schedule report.

attributes.name: it_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.it_asset. Business justification: Links Unit’s IT servers to IT Asset inventory for cost allocation, lifecycle management, and cybersecurity compliance.

attributes.name: ot_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.ot_asset. Business justification: Maps each Generating Unit to its OT control asset for outage management, dispatch instructions, and maintenance planning.

attributes.name: responsible_crew_id

attributes.name: site_id

attributes.name: unit_meter_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to metering.meter. Business justification: Unit‑level metering provides SCADA verification of each generating unit's output for dispatch and performance reporting.

attributes.name: balancing_authority

attributes.name: capacity_factor_target_pct

attributes.name: capacity_market_participation_flag

attributes.name: carbon_capture_equipped_flag

attributes.name: cooling_system_type

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: eia_unit_code
attributes.description: Official unit identifier assigned by the U.S. Energy Information Administration for regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: emissions_control_equipment

attributes.name: energy_storage_capacity_mwh

attributes.name: fuel_type_primary
attributes.description: Primary fuel source used by the generating unit for energy production. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: coal|natural_gas|nuclear|hydro|wind|solar|oil|biomass|geothermal|other — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: heat_rate_btu_per_kwh

attributes.description: Thermal efficiency measure representing the amount of fuel energy (BTU) required to produce one kilowatt-hour of electricity. Lower values indicate higher efficiency.

attributes.name: interconnection_voltage_kv

attributes.name: last_major_overhaul_date

attributes.name: manufacturer

attributes.name: minimum_load_mw

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer model number or designation of the generating equipment.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this generating unit record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: must_run_designation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the unit has been designated as a must-run or reliability-must-run (RMR) unit by the RTO/ISO for grid reliability.

attributes.name: nameplate_capacity_mw
attributes.description: Maximum rated output capacity of the generating unit under ideal conditions, measured in megawatts.

attributes.name: nerc_unit_code

attributes.description: Unit identifier registered with NERC for reliability compliance and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_outage_date

attributes.name: pi_historian_tag_prefix
attributes.description: Tag prefix used in OSIsoft PI Historian system for real-time telemetry data points associated with this generating unit.

attributes.name: planned_uprate_capacity_mw

attributes.name: ramp_rate_mw_per_min
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ramp Rate in Megawatts per Minute (MW/min)
attributes.description: Maximum rate at which the unit can increase or decrease output, measured in megawatts per minute.

attributes.name: regulatory_asset_base_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the generating unit is included in the regulatory asset base for rate recovery purposes.

attributes.name: renewable_energy_certificate_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the generating unit is eligible to generate Renewable Energy Certificates under applicable renewable portfolio standards.

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date when the generating unit was or is planned to be retired from service.

attributes.name: rto_iso_region
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) or Independent System Operator (ISO) Region
attributes.description: The RTO or ISO market region in which the generating unit participates (e.g., PJM, CAISO, ERCOT, MISO, NYISO, ISO-NE, SPP).

attributes.name: scada_integration_flag

attributes.name: serial_number

attributes.name: summer_capacity_mw
attributes.description: Net dependable capacity of the unit during summer peak conditions, accounting for ambient temperature and auxiliary load, measured in megawatts.

attributes.name: synchronization_date

attributes.name: technology_type
attributes.description: Detailed technology classification of the generating unit (e.g., 'Pulverized Coal', 'Combined Cycle Gas Turbine', 'Onshore Wind', 'Utility-Scale Solar PV').

attributes.name: unit_code
attributes.description: Internal business code or identifier for the generating unit used in operational systems and reporting.

attributes.name: unit_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or designation of the generating unit (e.g., 'Unit 1', 'Turbine A', 'Solar Block 3').

attributes.name: unit_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the generating unit in its lifecycle.

attributes.name: water_source
attributes.description: Primary water source used for cooling or steam generation (e.g., river, lake, ocean, municipal, groundwater).

attributes.name: winter_capacity_mw
attributes.description: Net dependable capacity of the unit during winter peak conditions, accounting for ambient temperature and auxiliary load, measured in megawatts.

products.name: energy_output
products.description: Hourly and sub-hourly generation output records for each generating unit sourced from OSIsoft PI Historian telemetry. Captures gross generation (MWh), net generation (MWh), auxiliary consumption (MWh), reactive power (MVAr), power factor, frequency, timestamp, data quality flag, and PI tag reference. Supports periodic aggregation for capacity factor calculation, FERC EQR submissions, RTO/ISO settlement reconciliation, and all generation performance KPI derivation including heat rate when combined with fuel consumption records.
products.reference: NERC GADS Energy Output / EIA Form 923

attributes.name: energy_output_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the energy output record. Primary key for this table.

attributes.name: bill_line_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.bill_line_item. Business justification: Net‑metering credits customer bills per measured generation; linking energy_output to bill_line_item enables the net‑metering credit line‑item generation.

attributes.name: ems_dispatch_instruction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the EMS dispatch instruction that commanded this generation output level. Links generation output to grid operations dispatch decisions.

attributes.name: generating_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific generating unit (turbine, generator, or renewable asset) that produced this energy output.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the generation facility or plant where this energy was produced.

attributes.name: rate_schedule_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.rate_schedule_version. Business justification: Energy output records reference the specific rate schedule version applied during settlement, needed for audit trails and regulatory filing.

attributes.name: scada_system_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.scada_system. Business justification: Provides data provenance linking Energy Output records to the SCADA system that generated them for EIA reporting and audit trails.

attributes.name: ambient_temperature_c
attributes.description: Ambient air temperature at the generation site in degrees Celsius at the time of measurement. Impacts thermal plant efficiency and renewable output (solar, wind).

attributes.name: auxiliary_consumption_mwh
attributes.description: Electrical energy consumed by station auxiliary equipment (pumps, fans, controls, lighting) during the generation process, measured in Megawatt-hours (MWh).

attributes.name: capacity_factor_percent
attributes.description: Ratio of actual energy output to maximum possible output over the measurement interval, expressed as a percentage. Key performance indicator for generation asset utilization.

attributes.name: curtailment_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this generation output was curtailed (reduced below available capacity) due to grid constraints, economic dispatch, or renewable integration limits.

attributes.name: curtailment_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for generation curtailment if curtailment_flag is true. Indicates whether curtailment was due to transmission limits, economic dispatch, or other operational factors.

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Quality indicator for this measurement record. Good indicates validated telemetry; suspect/bad indicate potential sensor or communication issues; estimated/manual indicate non-telemetry sources.

attributes.name: emissions_co2_tons
attributes.description: Estimated carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions in tons resulting from this energy generation. Calculated based on fuel consumption and emission factors. Used for environmental reporting and carbon accounting.
attributes.references: EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program (40 CFR Part 98)

attributes.name: frequency_hz
attributes.description: Electrical frequency of the generated power in Hertz (Hz). Standard grid frequency is 60 Hz in North America. Deviations indicate grid stability issues.

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Primary fuel or energy source used by the generating unit to produce this energy output. Critical for emissions tracking, cost allocation, and renewable energy certificate (REC) generation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: coal|natural_gas|nuclear|hydro|wind|solar|biomass|oil|diesel — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: gross_generation_mwh
attributes.description: Total electrical energy generated by the unit before any station auxiliary consumption, measured in Megawatt-hours (MWh). This is the raw output at the generator terminals.

attributes.name: interval_duration_minutes
attributes.description: The duration of the measurement interval in minutes. Common values include 5, 15, 60 for sub-hourly, quarter-hourly, and hourly intervals.

attributes.name: interval_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The ending timestamp of the measurement interval for this energy output record. Used for interval-based aggregation and settlement.

attributes.name: interval_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The beginning timestamp of the measurement interval for this energy output record. Used for interval-based aggregation and settlement.

attributes.name: is_renewable
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this energy output qualifies as renewable energy under applicable regulatory definitions. Used for REC tracking and renewable portfolio standard (RPS) compliance.
attributes.references: EPA Renewable Energy Tracking System, State RPS Regulations

attributes.name: lmp_energy_price
attributes.description: Locational Marginal Price (LMP) energy component in dollars per MWh at the settlement point for this interval. Used for revenue calculation and market settlement.
attributes.references: RTO/ISO Day-Ahead and Real-Time Market Pricing

attributes.name: market_type
attributes.description: Type of energy market in which this generation was dispatched or settled. Day-ahead market (DAM) vs real-time market (RTM) vs bilateral contract vs self-scheduled.

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when this energy output measurement was recorded by the telemetry system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Time Series Standard

attributes.name: nameplate_capacity_mw
attributes.description: Maximum rated continuous output capacity of the generating unit in Megawatts (MW) as specified by the manufacturer. Used for capacity factor and performance calculations.

attributes.name: net_generation_mwh
attributes.description: Net electrical energy delivered to the grid after subtracting auxiliary consumption, measured in Megawatt-hours (MWh). This is the energy available for sale or transmission.

attributes.name: output_variance_mw
attributes.description: Difference between actual net generation and scheduled output in Megawatts (MW). Positive values indicate over-generation; negative values indicate under-generation.

attributes.name: pi_point_tag
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the PI point in the OSIsoft PI Historian system. Used for direct lookup and integration with real-time operational systems.

attributes.name: pi_tag_name
attributes.description: The OSIsoft PI Historian tag name that is the source of this telemetry measurement. Used for traceability back to the real-time operational data system.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Tag Naming Convention

attributes.name: power_factor
attributes.description: Ratio of real power (MW) to apparent power (MVA), indicating the efficiency of power delivery. Values range from 0 to 1, with higher values indicating more efficient power delivery.

attributes.name: reactive_power_mvar
attributes.description: Reactive power output measured in Megavolt-Amperes Reactive (MVAr). Used for voltage support and grid stability, not sold as energy but critical for transmission operations.

attributes.name: rec_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this energy output is eligible for Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) generation under applicable state or federal programs.
attributes.references: State RPS Programs, EPA Green Power Partnership

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this energy output record was first created in the data management system. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this energy output record was last modified in the data management system. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: rto_iso_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) / Independent System Operator (ISO) Code
attributes.description: Code identifying the RTO or ISO market in which this generation occurred. Used for settlement reconciliation and market reporting (e.g., PJM, CAISO, ERCOT, MISO, NYISO, ISO-NE, SPP).

attributes.name: scheduled_output_mw

attributes.name: settlement_point_name
attributes.description: Name of the settlement or pricing node where this generation is injected into the grid. Used for locational marginal price (LMP) matching and financial settlement.

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: unit_status

attributes.name: voltage_kv
attributes.description: Output voltage at the generator terminals measured in kilovolts (kV). Critical for monitoring equipment performance and grid interconnection compliance.

products.name: fuel_consumption
products.description: Transactional record of fuel consumed by each generating unit per operating period. Captures fuel type, quantity consumed (MCF, tons, MMBtu, gallons), heat content (BTU/unit), total heat input (MMBtu), fuel cost per unit, total fuel cost, delivery receipt reference, and reporting period. Supports EIA Form 923 fuel consumption reporting, heat rate calculations, LCOE analysis, and emissions inventory.

attributes.name: fuel_consumption_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fuel consumption transaction record.

attributes.name: fuel_receipt_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fuel delivery receipt or shipment that supplied this consumed fuel.

attributes.name: generating_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific generating unit that consumed the fuel.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the power generation plant where fuel was consumed.

attributes.name: procurement_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fuel supply contract under which this fuel was procured and consumed.

attributes.name: supplier_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor that provided the consumed fuel.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor that provided the consumed fuel.

attributes.name: ash_content_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of ash content in the consumed fuel (primarily applicable to coal), used for operational efficiency and waste management.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, data quality issues, or explanations of unusual consumption patterns or adjustments.

attributes.name: consumption_date
attributes.description: The date on which the fuel was consumed by the generating unit.

attributes.name: consumption_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the fuel consumption record represents actual metered consumption, estimated consumption, adjusted values, or preliminary data pending final reconciliation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fuel consumption record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this fuel consumption record originated (e.g., OSIsoft PI Historian, SAP MM, Maximo).

attributes.name: eia_generator_code
attributes.description: The unique generator identification code assigned by the EIA for regulatory reporting purposes.

attributes.name: eia_plant_code
attributes.description: The unique plant identification code assigned by the EIA for regulatory reporting purposes.

attributes.name: eia_reporting_month
attributes.description: The month for which this fuel consumption is reported to the EIA on Form 923, in YYYY-MM format.

attributes.name: emissions_co2_tons
attributes.description: Total carbon dioxide emissions resulting from the combustion of this fuel quantity, measured in tons. Calculated using EPA emission factors.

attributes.name: emissions_nox_tons
attributes.description: Total nitrogen oxides emissions resulting from the combustion of this fuel quantity, measured in tons. Used for air quality compliance reporting.

attributes.name: emissions_particulate_tons
attributes.description: Total particulate matter emissions resulting from the combustion of this fuel quantity, measured in tons. Used for air quality compliance.

attributes.name: emissions_so2_tons
attributes.description: Total sulfur dioxide emissions resulting from the combustion of this fuel quantity, measured in tons. Used for acid rain program compliance.

attributes.name: energy_output_mwh
attributes.description: Total electrical energy output generated by the unit during the period in which this fuel was consumed, measured in Megawatt-hours (MWh). Used for heat rate calculations.

attributes.name: fuel_cost_per_mmbtu
attributes.description: Cost per million British Thermal Units of heat input, measured in USD per MMBtu. Used for LCOE analysis and fuel cost benchmarking.

attributes.name: fuel_cost_per_unit
attributes.description: Cost per physical unit of fuel consumed, measured in USD per unit (e.g., USD per ton, USD per MCF, USD per gallon).

attributes.name: fuel_origin_state
attributes.description: The U.S. state or country from which the consumed fuel originated or was extracted.

attributes.name: fuel_subtype
attributes.description: Detailed subtype or grade of fuel consumed (e.g., bituminous coal, anthracite, pipeline natural gas, liquefied natural gas).

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Type of fuel consumed by the generating unit during the reporting period.

attributes.name: heat_content_per_unit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Heat Content Per Unit (BTU per Unit)
attributes.description: Average heat content of the fuel per physical unit consumed, measured in BTU per unit (e.g., BTU per ton, BTU per MCF).

attributes.name: heat_rate
attributes.description: Thermal efficiency of the generating unit, measured in BTU per kilowatt-hour (kWh). Calculated as total_heat_input_mmbtu divided by energy_output_mwh. Lower values indicate higher efficiency.

attributes.name: inventory_adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consumption record includes an adjustment for fuel inventory reconciliation (true) or represents direct consumption only (false).

attributes.name: meter_reading_source
attributes.description: Source system or method used to capture the fuel consumption measurement (e.g., OSIsoft PI Historian, manual meter reading, fuel flow meter, inventory reconciliation).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fuel consumption record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: moisture_content_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of moisture content in the consumed fuel, affecting combustion efficiency and heat rate calculations.

attributes.name: nerc_region
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Region
attributes.description: The NERC regional entity in which the generating unit consuming this fuel is located (e.g., WECC, ERCOT, SERC, MRO, NPCC, RFC, SPP, TRE).

attributes.name: operating_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the generating unit operated during the reporting period in which this fuel was consumed.

attributes.name: quantity_consumed
attributes.description: Physical quantity of fuel consumed during the reporting period, measured in the unit specified by quantity_unit.

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity of fuel consumed (tons for coal, MCF for natural gas, gallons for oil, MMBtu for heat content).

attributes.name: reporting_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the reporting period for which fuel consumption is aggregated.

attributes.name: reporting_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the reporting period for which fuel consumption is aggregated.

attributes.name: sulfur_content_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of sulfur content in the consumed fuel, used for emissions calculations and environmental compliance reporting.

attributes.name: total_fuel_cost
attributes.description: Total cost of fuel consumed during the reporting period, measured in USD. Calculated as quantity_consumed multiplied by fuel_cost_per_unit.

attributes.name: total_heat_input_mmbtu
attributes.description: Total heat input from fuel consumed during the reporting period, measured in million British Thermal Units (MMBtu). Calculated as quantity_consumed multiplied by heat_content_per_unit.

attributes.name: transportation_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transportation used to deliver the fuel to the generation plant.

products.name: unit_availability

Captures NERC GADS event codes, outage cause codes, start/end timestamps, and responsible system (EMS/SCADA). Enables SAIDI/SAIFI-equivalent generation reliability metrics, NERC GADS reporting, and capacity planning.

attributes.name: generating_unit_id

attributes.name: plant_id

attributes.name: transmission_outage_id

attributes.name: work_order_id

attributes.name: ambient_temperature_f
attributes.description: The ambient air temperature in Fahrenheit at the time of the availability record, relevant for temperature-dependent capacity deratings.

attributes.name: availability_date
attributes.description: The calendar date for which this availability record applies.

attributes.name: availability_hour

attributes.name: availability_status

attributes.name: available_capacity_mw
attributes.description: The generating capacity in megawatts that is available for dispatch during the period.

attributes.name: capacity_factor_percent

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of the quality and reliability of the availability data (verified, estimated, suspect, missing).

attributes.name: data_source

attributes.name: derating_flag

attributes.name: environmental_constraint_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether environmental permit limits (emissions, water discharge, noise) are constraining unit availability or capacity.

attributes.name: equivalent_availability_factor_percent
attributes.description: NERC GADS metric representing the percentage of time the unit was available to generate at full capacity, accounting for partial outages and deratings.

attributes.name: equivalent_forced_outage_rate_percent

attributes.name: event_end_timestamp

attributes.description: The capacity in megawatts unavailable due to unplanned forced outages caused by equipment failure or emergency conditions.

attributes.name: fuel_availability_status

attributes.name: planned_outage_capacity_mw

attributes.name: planned_outage_flag

attributes.name: record_created_by

products.name: generation_outage
products.description: Single source of truth for all generating unit outages, deratings, and availability states. Captures planned, forced, and maintenance outages as well as daily/hourly availability status records including available capacity (MW), unavailable capacity by cause category (planned, forced, maintenance), and derating events with partial capacity loss. Records outage type, NERC GADS cause code and event code, affected capacity (MW), outage start/end timestamps, return-to-service time, responsible crew, and work order reference. Calculates equivalent availability factor (EAF), forced outage rate (FOR), planned outage factor (POF), and service factor. Serves as the single source of truth for NERC GADS reporting (IEEE 762), generation reliability metrics, capacity planning, and all unit availability tracking.

attributes.name: generation_outage_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the generation outage event record.

attributes.name: balancing_area_id

attributes.name: plant_id

attributes.name: site_id
