attributes.name: particulate_matter_emissions_lbs
attributes.description: Total particulate matter emissions measured in pounds for the reporting period. Includes PM2.5 and PM10 for air quality compliance.
attributes.references: EPA National Ambient Air Quality Standards (NAAQS)

attributes.name: permit_limit_nox_tons
attributes.business_glossary_term: Permit Limit for Nitrogen Oxides (NOx) in Tons
attributes.description: Maximum allowable nitrogen oxides emissions in tons as specified in the air quality permit for the reporting period. Used to assess compliance status.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act Permit Requirements

attributes.name: permit_limit_so2_tons
attributes.business_glossary_term: Permit Limit for Sulfur Dioxide (SO2) in Tons
attributes.description: Maximum allowable sulfur dioxide emissions in tons as specified in the air quality permit for the reporting period. Used to assess compliance status.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act Permit Requirements

attributes.name: reporting_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The regulatory jurisdiction (EPA region, state, or local air quality district) to which this emissions data must be reported. Determines applicable reporting requirements.

attributes.name: reporting_period_end
attributes.description: The end date and time of the emissions reporting period. Represents the conclusion of the measurement window for this emissions data.
attributes.references: EPA Continuous Emissions Monitoring System (CEMS) Requirements

attributes.name: reporting_period_start
attributes.description: The start date and time of the emissions reporting period. Represents the beginning of the measurement window for this emissions data.
attributes.references: EPA Continuous Emissions Monitoring System (CEMS) Requirements

attributes.name: so2_emissions_tons
attributes.description: Total sulfur dioxide emissions measured in tons for the reporting period. Critical for EPA Clean Air Act compliance and acid rain program reporting.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act Title IV - Acid Rain Program

attributes.name: so2_rate_per_mmbtu
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sulfur Dioxide (SO2) Emissions Rate per MMBtu
attributes.description: Sulfur dioxide emissions rate expressed as pounds per million British thermal units of heat input. Key compliance metric for EPA emission standards.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act Title IV - Acid Rain Program

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the operational system that originated this emissions record, typically OSIsoft PI Historian or EPA CEMS reporting system.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date when this emissions record was submitted to the regulatory authority for compliance reporting. Used to track reporting timeliness.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act Reporting Deadlines

products.name: rec_certificate
products.description: Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) records tracking each MWh of renewable generation eligible for REC issuance. Captures REC serial number, generating unit, generation period, fuel source (solar, wind, hydro, biomass), vintage year, tracking system (WREGIS, NEPOOL GIS, PJM GATS), certificate status (issued, retired, transferred, expired), retirement purpose (RPS compliance, voluntary), and associated energy output record. Supports state RPS compliance and voluntary renewable energy programs.

attributes.name: rec_certificate_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Generation Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) Certificate ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the renewable energy certificate record. Primary key for the generation REC certificate product.

attributes.name: bill_line_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.bill_line_item. Business justification: REC transactions are billed as line items on customer invoices; the FK supports the REC billing report required for compliance and revenue tracking.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: REC allocation program assigns each generation certificate to a specific customer account for green‑power reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: energy_output_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying generation output record in the generation domain that documents the MWh production for which this REC was issued.

attributes.name: generating_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific generating unit (solar array, wind turbine, hydro facility, biomass plant) that produced the renewable energy for which this REC was issued.

attributes.name: generation_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent generation facility or plant where the renewable energy was produced.

attributes.name: generation_record_energy_output_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying generation output record in the generation domain that documents the MWh production for which this REC was issued.

attributes.name: meter_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the revenue-quality meter that measured the generation for which this REC was issued. Used for audit and verification purposes.
attributes.references: NERC Standards, Tracking System Verification Requirements

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent generation facility or plant where the renewable energy was produced.

attributes.name: ppa_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PPA contract under which the renewable energy was procured, if applicable. Links REC to contractual obligations.

attributes.name: certificate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the REC. Issued: newly created; Active: available for trading; Retired: used for compliance or voluntary claim; Transferred: moved to another account; Expired: past eligibility window; Cancelled: invalidated.
attributes.references: WREGIS, NEPOOL GIS, PJM GATS Operating Rules

attributes.name: compliance_jurisdiction
attributes.description: State or regulatory jurisdiction for which this REC is eligible for RPS compliance (e.g., California, Massachusetts, New York). Some RECs may be eligible in multiple jurisdictions.

attributes.name: compliance_year
attributes.description: Year for which this REC was or will be used to meet RPS compliance obligations. May differ from vintage year due to banking provisions.

attributes.name: counterparty_name
attributes.description: Name of the party with whom the REC was traded (buyer or seller). Used for transaction tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this REC certificate record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: eligibility_flags
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of special eligibility designations for this REC (e.g., Tier 1, Tier 2, Solar Carve-Out, Offshore Wind, In-State, New Vintage). Used to determine which RPS requirements the REC can satisfy.

attributes.name: energy_output_mwh
attributes.description: Quantity of renewable electricity generated in megawatt-hours (MWh) for which this REC was issued. Typically one REC represents one MWh of renewable generation.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which the REC is no longer eligible for use in compliance programs. Many RPS programs have vintage limits (e.g., RECs must be used within 3 years of generation).
attributes.references: State RPS Statutes, Tracking System Operating Rules

attributes.name: facility_capacity_mw
attributes.description: Nameplate generation capacity of the facility in megawatts. Some RPS programs have size limits or tiers based on facility capacity.

attributes.name: facility_commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the generating facility first began commercial operation. Some RPS programs have vintage requirements based on facility age.

attributes.name: facility_location_country
attributes.description: Country where the generating facility is located. Most U.S. RPS programs only accept RECs from facilities in the U.S. or specific Canadian provinces.

attributes.name: facility_location_state
attributes.description: U.S. state or Canadian province where the generating facility is located. Geographic location affects RPS eligibility in many jurisdictions.

attributes.name: fuel_source
attributes.description: Type of renewable energy source used to generate the electricity for which this REC was issued. Determines eligibility for various RPS compliance programs.

attributes.name: fuel_source_subcategory
attributes.description: More granular classification of the renewable fuel source (e.g., photovoltaic solar, concentrated solar, onshore wind, offshore wind, run-of-river hydro, pumped storage hydro, wood biomass, agricultural biomass).

attributes.name: generation_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the generation period during which the renewable energy was produced.
attributes.references: WREGIS, NEPOOL GIS, PJM GATS Operating Rules

attributes.name: generation_month
attributes.description: Month (1-12) in which the renewable energy was generated. Used for reporting and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: generation_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the generation period during which the renewable energy was produced. RECs are typically issued for monthly or quarterly generation periods.
attributes.references: WREGIS, NEPOOL GIS, PJM GATS Operating Rules

attributes.name: generation_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the renewable energy was generated.

attributes.name: issuance_date
attributes.description: Date on which the REC was officially issued by the tracking system registry after verification of generation data.
attributes.references: WREGIS, NEPOOL GIS, PJM GATS Operating Rules

attributes.name: market_value_usd
attributes.description: Estimated or actual market value of the REC in U.S. dollars at the time of issuance or transaction. Used for financial reporting and asset valuation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980, Internal Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional information about the REC, such as special eligibility conditions, transaction details, or compliance notes.

attributes.name: rec_quantity
attributes.description: Number of RECs represented by this certificate record. Typically 1 REC equals 1 MWh, but some jurisdictions may use different ratios or fractional RECs.
attributes.references: WREGIS, NEPOOL GIS, PJM GATS Operating Rules

attributes.name: rec_serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number assigned by the tracking system registry to identify this specific REC. This is the externally-recognized business identifier for the certificate.
attributes.references: WREGIS, NEPOOL GIS, PJM GATS, M-RETS Registry Standards

attributes.name: retirement_account
attributes.description: Tracking system account into which the REC was retired. Used to identify the beneficiary of the renewable energy claim.
attributes.references: WREGIS, NEPOOL GIS, PJM GATS Operating Rules

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the REC was retired (permanently removed from circulation) for compliance or voluntary purposes. Null if not yet retired.
attributes.references: WREGIS, NEPOOL GIS, PJM GATS Operating Rules

attributes.name: retirement_purpose
attributes.description: Reason for which the REC was retired. RPS Compliance: used to meet state renewable portfolio standard requirements; Voluntary: used for voluntary green power programs or corporate sustainability claims.
attributes.references: State RPS Statutes, EPA Green Power Partnership

attributes.name: tracking_system
attributes.description: Regional or state tracking system registry that issued and tracks this REC (e.g., WREGIS for Western states, NEPOOL GIS for New England, PJM GATS for Mid-Atlantic, M-RETS for Midwest). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WREGIS|NEPOOL_GIS|PJM_GATS|M_RETS|NAR|ERCOT|MIRECS — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Regional REC Tracking System Operating Rules

attributes.name: tracking_system_account_number
attributes.description: Account identifier in the tracking system registry under which this REC is held or was issued.
attributes.references: WREGIS, NEPOOL GIS, PJM GATS Account Management

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: Date on which a sale or purchase transaction involving this REC was executed. Null if REC was not traded.

attributes.name: transaction_price_usd
attributes.description: Actual price paid or received for the REC in a sale or purchase transaction, in U.S. dollars. Null if REC was not traded.

attributes.name: transfer_date
attributes.description: Date on which the REC was transferred from one tracking system account to another. Null if never transferred.
attributes.references: WREGIS, NEPOOL GIS, PJM GATS Operating Rules

attributes.name: transfer_recipient_account
attributes.description: Tracking system account identifier of the party to whom the REC was transferred.
attributes.references: WREGIS, NEPOOL GIS, PJM GATS Operating Rules

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this REC certificate record.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this REC certificate record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the tracking system completed verification of the generation data and approved issuance of the REC.
attributes.references: WREGIS, NEPOOL GIS, PJM GATS Operating Rules

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the tracking system verification process for the generation data underlying this REC. Verified RECs have passed all data quality and eligibility checks.
attributes.references: WREGIS, NEPOOL GIS, PJM GATS Operating Rules

attributes.name: vintage_year
attributes.description: Year in which the renewable energy was generated, used for REC vintage classification. Some RPS programs require specific vintage years for compliance.
attributes.references: State RPS Statutes, Voluntary Market Standards

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this REC certificate record.

products.name: ppa_delivery
products.description: Transactional records of actual energy deliveries under each PPA contract on a daily or monthly basis. Captures scheduled delivery (MWh), actual delivery (MWh), curtailment (MWh), curtailment reason, settlement price, total payment amount, delivery period, and variance from contracted volume. Supports PPA performance monitoring, invoice reconciliation with trading/billing domains, and FERC EQR reporting.

attributes.name: ppa_delivery_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each PPA delivery transaction record.

attributes.name: balancing_area_id
attributes.description: Reference to the balancing authority area in which this delivery occurred, relevant for grid operations and settlement.
attributes.references: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Standards

attributes.name: balancing_authority_balancing_area_id
attributes.description: Reference to the balancing authority area in which this delivery occurred, relevant for grid operations and settlement.
attributes.references: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Standards

attributes.name: bill_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.bill. Business justification: PPA settlement creates an invoice for the off‑taker; linking ppa_delivery to bill enables the PPA billing process required by contract terms.

attributes.name: ci_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engagement.ci_account. Business justification: PPA delivery records must be tied to the customer account receiving the power, supporting invoicing, settlement, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: ems_dispatch_instruction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Energy Management System (EMS) dispatch instruction that authorized or scheduled this delivery.
attributes.references: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Standards

attributes.name: generating_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific generation unit within the facility that produced the delivered energy.
attributes.references: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Standards

attributes.name: generation_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the generation facility or plant that produced the energy delivered under this PPA transaction.
attributes.references: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Standards

attributes.name: meter_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the revenue-grade meter or SCADA point used to measure actual energy delivery for this transaction.
attributes.references: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Standards

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the generation facility or plant that produced the energy delivered under this PPA transaction.
attributes.references: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Standards

attributes.name: ppa_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent PPA contract under which this delivery occurred.

attributes.name: transmission_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to transmission.line. Business justification: PPA delivery points are physically tied to a transmission line; needed for settlement and congestion revenue calculations.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_mwh
attributes.description: The actual amount of energy in megawatt-hours (MWh) that was delivered during this period, as measured by metering systems.

attributes.name: ancillary_services_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount charged for ancillary services such as frequency regulation, voltage support, and operating reserves associated with this delivery.

attributes.name: capacity_payment_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount paid for capacity availability during this delivery period, separate from energy payment, if the PPA includes capacity charges.

attributes.name: contracted_price_per_mwh
attributes.description: The base price per megawatt-hour (MWh) specified in the PPA contract for this delivery period.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this delivery transaction record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this transaction. Power and Utilities operates exclusively in USD.

attributes.name: curtailment_mwh
attributes.description: The amount of energy in megawatt-hours (MWh) that was curtailed or not delivered due to grid constraints, economic dispatch, or other operational reasons.
attributes.references: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Standards

attributes.name: curtailment_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the primary reason for any curtailment of scheduled delivery.
attributes.references: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Standards

attributes.name: curtailment_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the circumstances that led to curtailment of the scheduled delivery.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Calculated score (0-100) representing the completeness and accuracy of this delivery record based on validation rules.

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the energy delivery occurred, used for daily aggregation and reporting.

attributes.name: delivery_period_end
attributes.description: The timestamp when the delivery period ended, representing the conclusion of energy flow under this transaction.

attributes.name: delivery_period_start
attributes.description: The timestamp when the delivery period began, representing the start of energy flow under this transaction.

attributes.name: delivery_point_code
attributes.description: Reference to the physical or virtual delivery point where energy was transferred to the buyer under the PPA.

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the delivery transaction in the settlement workflow.

attributes.name: delivery_transaction_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique transaction identifier for this delivery event, used for settlement and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Energy Trading and Risk Management (ETRM) Standards

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this delivery transaction is currently under dispute between buyer and seller regarding quantity, price, or other terms.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the reason for dispute if dispute_flag is True.

attributes.name: energy_payment_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount paid specifically for energy delivered (MWh), calculated as actual delivery multiplied by energy price component.

attributes.name: force_majeure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this delivery was affected by a force majeure event as defined in the PPA contract, which may excuse non-performance.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The invoice number associated with billing for this delivery transaction, used for reconciliation with accounts receivable or payable.
attributes.references: Internal Billing and Revenue Management Standard

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this delivery transaction record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: market_type
attributes.description: The energy market context in which this delivery was scheduled and settled.

attributes.name: meter_reading_source
attributes.description: Indicates the source system or method used to determine actual delivery MWh values.
attributes.references: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional comments, operational notes, or context regarding this delivery transaction.

attributes.name: price_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount of adjustments applied to the base contracted price, including penalties, bonuses, indexation, or other contractual modifications.

attributes.name: rec_quantity
attributes.description: The number of Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) associated with this delivery, typically equal to actual delivery MWh for renewable generation sources.
attributes.references: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Renewable Energy Standards

attributes.name: rec_transfer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether RECs were transferred to the buyer as part of this delivery transaction (True) or retained by the seller (False).
attributes.references: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Renewable Energy Standards

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of the reconciliation process between scheduled and actual delivery, and between trading and billing systems.

attributes.name: scheduled_delivery_mwh
attributes.description: The contracted or scheduled amount of energy in megawatt-hours (MWh) that was planned for delivery during this period.

attributes.name: scheduling_coordinator
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the entity responsible for scheduling this delivery with the Independent System Operator (ISO) or Regional Transmission Organization (RTO).

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which financial settlement for this delivery transaction was completed or is scheduled to be completed.

attributes.name: settlement_price_per_mwh
attributes.description: The price per megawatt-hour (MWh) applied to this delivery for settlement purposes, which may differ from the contracted price due to adjustments, penalties, or market conditions.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this delivery transaction data originated.

attributes.name: time_of_use_period
attributes.description: The time-of-use pricing period classification for this delivery, affecting settlement price and capacity value.

attributes.name: total_payment_amount
attributes.description: The total dollar amount payable for this delivery transaction, calculated as actual delivery multiplied by settlement price plus any adjustments.

attributes.name: transmission_charge_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of transmission and delivery charges associated with moving the energy from generation point to delivery point.

attributes.name: variance_mwh
attributes.description: The difference between scheduled and actual delivery in megawatt-hours (MWh), calculated as actual minus scheduled, used for performance monitoring and settlement adjustments.

products.name: forecast
products.description: Forward-looking generation output forecasts for each plant or unit across multiple time horizons (day-ahead, week-ahead, monthly, annual). Captures forecast period, forecast horizon type, forecasted gross generation (MWh), forecasted net generation (MWh), forecasted capacity factor, forecast model version, weather input assumptions, and confidence interval. Supports DAM bidding, load forecasting integration, and IRP planning. Distinct from analytics — these are operational planning records used in EMS dispatch.

attributes.name: forecast_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the generation forecast record. Primary key.

attributes.name: generating_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific generation unit within the plant. Nullable if forecast applies to entire plant.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the generation plant or facility for which this forecast applies.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.site. Business justification: Weather‑adjusted generation forecasts require site‑specific meteorological data; linking forecast to site enables accurate market bidding and grid dispatch planning.

attributes.name: ambient_temperature_f
attributes.description: Forecasted ambient air temperature in Fahrenheit used as input assumption. Impacts thermal plant efficiency and renewable output.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the supervisor or system that approved this forecast for operational use. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this forecast was approved for operational use or market submission. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: confidence_interval_lower_mwh
attributes.description: Lower bound of the statistical confidence interval for forecasted net generation, typically representing the 10th or 5th percentile outcome. Used for risk assessment and reserve planning.

attributes.name: confidence_interval_upper_mwh
attributes.description: Upper bound of the statistical confidence interval for forecasted net generation, typically representing the 90th or 95th percentile outcome. Used for risk assessment and reserve planning.

attributes.name: confidence_level_percent
attributes.description: Statistical confidence level associated with the forecast interval bounds, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 90%, 95%). Indicates the probability that actual generation will fall within the specified interval.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this forecast record was initially created in the system. Audit trail for forecast generation timing.

attributes.name: error_mwh
attributes.description: Calculated difference between forecasted and actual generation for historical records. Populated post-facto for model performance tracking and continuous improvement. Null for future forecasts.

attributes.name: error_percent
attributes.description: Percentage error between forecasted and actual generation for historical records. Populated post-facto for model accuracy assessment. Null for future forecasts.

attributes.name: forced_outage_probability
attributes.description: Estimated probability of an unplanned forced outage occurring during the forecast period, expressed as a decimal (0.0 to 1.0). Used for reliability planning.

attributes.name: forecast_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the generation forecast, used for external reference and tracking in Energy Management System (EMS) and Day-Ahead Market (DAM) submissions.

attributes.name: forecast_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the generation forecast record.

attributes.name: forecasted_capacity_factor_percent
attributes.description: Predicted ratio of actual generation output to maximum possible output over the forecast period, expressed as a percentage. Key metric for renewable energy sources and Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) analysis.
attributes.references: DOE Energy Efficiency and Renewable Energy Standards

attributes.name: forecasted_capacity_mw
attributes.description: Predicted instantaneous generation capacity available during the forecast period, measured in Megawatts (MW). Represents the maximum power output the unit or plant can deliver.

attributes.name: forecasted_emissions_co2_tons
attributes.description: Predicted carbon dioxide emissions in tons for the forecast period. Used for environmental compliance and Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) tracking.

attributes.name: forecasted_emissions_nox_lbs
attributes.description: Predicted nitrogen oxides emissions in pounds for the forecast period. Required for EPA air quality compliance reporting.

attributes.name: forecasted_emissions_so2_lbs
attributes.description: Predicted sulfur dioxide emissions in pounds for the forecast period. Required for EPA air quality compliance reporting.

attributes.name: forecasted_fuel_consumption
attributes.description: Predicted fuel consumption quantity for the forecast period. Unit of measure varies by fuel type (tons for coal, MCF for natural gas, gallons for oil).

attributes.name: forecasted_gross_generation_mwh
attributes.description: Predicted total electrical energy output at the generator terminals before accounting for auxiliary load or station service, measured in Megawatt-Hours (MWh).

attributes.name: forecasted_heat_rate_btu_per_kwh
attributes.business_glossary_term: Forecasted Heat Rate British Thermal Units (BTU) Per Kilowatt-Hour (kWh)
attributes.description: Predicted thermal efficiency of the generation unit, measured as BTU of fuel input per kWh of electrical output. Lower values indicate higher efficiency. Key metric for fossil fuel and nuclear plants.

attributes.name: forecasted_net_generation_mwh
attributes.description: Predicted electrical energy output available for delivery to the grid after subtracting auxiliary load and station service, measured in Megawatt-Hours (MWh). This is the energy available for sale or dispatch.

attributes.name: fuel_consumption_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for forecasted fuel consumption. MCF = Thousand Cubic Feet (natural gas), MMBTU = Million British Thermal Units.

attributes.name: horizon_type
attributes.description: Classification of the forecast time horizon, indicating how far in advance the forecast is made relative to the operational period. Used for Day-Ahead Market (DAM) vs Real-Time Market (RTM) planning.

attributes.name: market_bid_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this forecast was used as the basis for a Day-Ahead Market (DAM) or Real-Time Market (RTM) bid submission to the Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) or Independent System Operator (ISO).

attributes.name: model_type
attributes.description: Classification of the forecasting methodology used (statistical time series, machine learning, physical simulation, hybrid approach, or expert judgment).

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: Identifier for the forecasting algorithm or model version used to generate this forecast. Enables traceability and model performance analysis.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, assumptions, or special conditions affecting this forecast (e.g., unusual weather patterns, equipment limitations, regulatory constraints).

attributes.name: period_end
attributes.description: The ending timestamp of the period for which generation output is forecasted. Represents the real-world operational time window end.

attributes.name: period_start
attributes.description: The beginning timestamp of the period for which generation output is forecasted. Represents the real-world operational time window start.

attributes.name: planned_outage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a planned maintenance outage is scheduled during the forecast period, impacting available capacity.

attributes.name: rto_iso_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) or Independent System Operator (ISO) Code
attributes.description: Code identifying the RTO or ISO market jurisdiction where this forecast applies and may be submitted for dispatch. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PJM|MISO|CAISO|ERCOT|NYISO|ISO-NE|SPP — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: solar_irradiance_w_per_m2
attributes.business_glossary_term: Solar Irradiance Watts Per Square Meter
attributes.description: Forecasted solar irradiance in watts per square meter, used for solar photovoltaic generation forecasting.

attributes.name: submitted_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the analyst or system that created and submitted this forecast. Audit trail for accountability.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this forecast record was last modified. Tracks revisions and superseding forecasts.

attributes.name: weather_scenario_code
attributes.description: Reference to the weather input scenario or forecast used as input to the generation forecast model. Critical for renewable generation forecasting (solar, wind).

attributes.name: wind_speed_mph
attributes.description: Forecasted wind speed in miles per hour at hub height, used for wind generation forecasting.

products.name: nuclear_fuel_cycle
products.description: Master records tracking the nuclear fuel lifecycle for each reactor unit including fuel assembly batch ID, enrichment level (% U-235), initial uranium load (MTU), burnup level (MWd/MTU), cycle start/end dates, refueling outage reference, spent fuel storage location, NRC license reference, and fuel vendor. Supports NRC regulatory reporting, nuclear fuel cost accounting under FASB ASC 980, and long-term fuel planning.
products.reference: NRC Fuel Cycle Record / EIA Form 858

attributes.name: nuclear_fuel_cycle_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the nuclear fuel cycle record. Primary key for tracking fuel lifecycle from initial load through burnup to spent fuel storage.
attributes.references: NRC 10 CFR Part 50 - Domestic Licensing of Production and Utilization Facilities

attributes.name: fuel_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the nuclear fuel vendor who manufactured and supplied the fuel assemblies for this cycle.
attributes.references: NRC 10 CFR Part 50 - Fuel Vendor Qualification

attributes.name: generating_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific nuclear reactor unit where this fuel cycle is deployed. Links to the generation asset master for the reactor.
attributes.references: NRC 10 CFR Part 50 - Reactor Unit Identification

attributes.name: generation_outage_id
attributes.description: Reference to the planned refueling outage event during which this fuel cycle was loaded or unloaded. Links to maintenance and outage management systems.
attributes.references: NRC 10 CFR Part 50 Appendix B - Quality Assurance for Refueling

attributes.name: average_discharge_burnup_mwd_mtu
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Discharge Burnup in Megawatt-Days per Metric Ton Uranium (MWd/MTU)
attributes.description: Average burnup of fuel assemblies discharged from the core at the end of this cycle. Key metric for fuel performance and economic optimization.
attributes.references: NRC Regulatory Guide 1.77 - Assumptions Used for Evaluating a Control Rod Ejection Accident

attributes.name: burnup_level_mwd_mtu
attributes.business_glossary_term: Burnup Level in Megawatt-Days per Metric Ton Uranium (MWd/MTU)
attributes.description: Measure of fuel depletion representing the thermal energy extracted per unit mass of uranium. Higher burnup indicates more efficient fuel utilization. Typical discharge burnup is 40,000-60,000 MWd/MTU.
attributes.references: NRC Regulatory Guide 1.77 - Assumptions Used for Evaluating a Control Rod Ejection Accident

attributes.name: capacity_factor_percent
attributes.description: Ratio of actual energy generated to maximum possible energy generation during the cycle, expressed as percentage. Industry-leading nuclear units achieve 90%+ capacity factors.

attributes.name: core_thermal_power_mwt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Core Thermal Power in Megawatts Thermal (MWt)
attributes.description: Licensed thermal power rating of the reactor core. Represents the maximum heat generation rate from nuclear fission. Typical values range from 2,000 to 4,000 MWt.
attributes.references: NRC 10 CFR Part 50 Appendix A - General Design Criteria for Nuclear Power Plants

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fuel cycle record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: cycle_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the reactor was shut down for refueling outage, ending this fuel cycle. Used to calculate cycle length and capacity factor.
attributes.references: NRC 10 CFR Part 50.59 - Changes, Tests, and Experiments

attributes.name: cycle_length_days
attributes.description: Duration of the fuel cycle from startup to shutdown, measured in days. Typical cycle lengths range from 18 to 24 months. Used for fuel planning and economic analysis.

attributes.name: cycle_number
attributes.description: Sequential cycle number for the reactor unit. Increments with each refueling outage. Used for lifecycle tracking and performance trending.
attributes.references: NRC Regulatory Guide 1.68 - Initial Test Programs for Water-Cooled Nuclear Power Plants

attributes.name: cycle_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the reactor achieved initial criticality and began power operations for this fuel cycle. Marks the beginning of the fuel burnup period.
attributes.references: NRC 10 CFR Part 50.59 - Changes, Tests, and Experiments

attributes.name: cycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fuel cycle. Planned=future cycle in IRP, Active=currently operating, Completed=cycle ended awaiting final data, Archived=historical record finalized.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system of record that originated this fuel cycle data. Typically OSIsoft PI Historian, SAP PM, or nuclear fuel management system.

attributes.name: energy_generated_mwh
attributes.description: Total electrical energy generated during this fuel cycle, measured in megawatt-hours. Used for fuel cost allocation and performance analysis.
attributes.references: EIA Form 923 - Power Plant Operations Report

attributes.name: enrichment_level_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of fissile uranium-235 isotope in the fuel assembly. Typical commercial reactor enrichment ranges from 3% to 5%. Critical for criticality safety and burnup calculations.
attributes.references: NRC 10 CFR Part 70 - Domestic Licensing of Special Nuclear Material

attributes.name: fresh_fuel_assembly_count
attributes.description: Number of new (unirradiated) fuel assemblies loaded during the refueling outage. Typically one-third to one-half of the core is replaced each cycle.
attributes.references: NRC 10 CFR Part 50 Appendix A - General Design Criteria for Nuclear Power Plants

attributes.name: fuel_assembly_batch_number
attributes.description: Unique batch identifier assigned by the fuel vendor to the fuel assembly group. Used for tracking and regulatory reporting to NRC.
attributes.references: NRC 10 CFR Part 50 Appendix B - Quality Assurance Criteria

attributes.name: fuel_assembly_count
attributes.description: Total number of fuel assemblies loaded in the reactor core for this cycle. Typical PWR cores contain 150-200 assemblies; BWR cores contain 600-800 assemblies.
attributes.references: NRC Regulatory Guide 1.68 - Initial Test Programs for Water-Cooled Nuclear Power Plants

attributes.name: fuel_cost_per_mwh_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fuel Cost per Megawatt-Hour (MWh) in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Unit fuel cost calculated as total fuel cost divided by energy generated during the cycle. Key metric for Levelized Cost of Energy (LCOE) analysis and rate case filings.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980-340 - Regulated Operations - Other Assets and Deferred Costs

attributes.name: fuel_cost_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fuel Cost in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Total cost of nuclear fuel for this cycle including uranium procurement, conversion, enrichment, and fabrication. Capitalized and amortized under FASB ASC 980 for regulated utilities.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980-340 - Regulated Operations - Other Assets and Deferred Costs

attributes.name: fuel_design_code
attributes.description: Vendor-specific fuel assembly design designation. Examples include Westinghouse 17x17 PERFORMANCE+, GE GE14, or Framatome AFA-3G. Used for technical specifications and licensing.
attributes.references: NRC Standard Review Plan NUREG-0800 Section 4.2 - Fuel System Design

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Type of nuclear fuel assembly design corresponding to reactor technology. PWR=Pressurized Water Reactor, BWR=Boiling Water Reactor, CANDU=Canadian Deuterium Uranium, AGR=Advanced Gas-cooled Reactor, VVER=Russian PWR variant.
attributes.references: IAEA Nuclear Energy Series NF-T-3.8 - Fuel Cycle Information System

attributes.name: initial_uranium_load_mtu
attributes.business_glossary_term: Initial Uranium Load in Metric Tons Uranium (MTU)
attributes.description: Total mass of uranium loaded into the reactor core at the start of the fuel cycle, measured in metric tons of uranium. Used for fuel cost accounting and inventory management.
attributes.references: NRC 10 CFR Part 72 - Licensing Requirements for the Independent Storage of Spent Nuclear Fuel

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this fuel cycle record. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: nrc_license_number
attributes.description: NRC operating license number authorizing operation of the reactor unit. Format is NPF (Nuclear Power Facility) or DPR (Demonstration Power Reactor) followed by numeric identifier.
attributes.references: NRC 10 CFR Part 50 - Domestic Licensing of Production and Utilization Facilities

attributes.name: peak_rod_burnup_mwd_mtu
attributes.business_glossary_term: Peak Rod Burnup in Megawatt-Days per Metric Ton Uranium (MWd/MTU)
attributes.description: Maximum burnup achieved by any individual fuel rod in the core during this cycle. Must remain below regulatory limits to ensure fuel integrity.
attributes.references: NRC Regulatory Guide 1.77 - Assumptions Used for Evaluating a Control Rod Ejection Accident

attributes.name: rec_generated_count
attributes.description: Number of Renewable Energy Certificates generated for this cycle. Some jurisdictions classify nuclear as eligible for REC programs or similar clean energy credits.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_period
attributes.description: Reporting period for NRC and FERC filings associated with this fuel cycle. Format is YYYY-QN for quarterly or YYYY-MM for monthly reporting.
attributes.references: NRC 10 CFR Part 50.72 - Immediate Notification Requirements

attributes.name: spent_fuel_storage_location
attributes.description: Physical location identifier for spent fuel storage, either in spent fuel pool or dry cask storage. Format includes pool/cask identifier and position coordinates.
attributes.references: NRC 10 CFR Part 72 - Licensing Requirements for the Independent Storage of Spent Nuclear Fuel

attributes.name: thermal_efficiency_percent
attributes.description: Ratio of electrical energy output to thermal energy input from nuclear fission, expressed as percentage. Typical nuclear plant thermal efficiency is 33-37%.
attributes.references: ASME Performance Test Code PTC 46 - Overall Plant Performance

products.name: renewable_resource
products.description: Master records for renewable generation resource characteristics specific to solar, wind, and hydro units. Captures resource type (solar PV, solar thermal, wind onshore, wind offshore, run-of-river hydro, pumped storage), panel/turbine model, installed capacity (MW-DC/MW-AC for solar), hub height (wind), rotor diameter (wind), water head (hydro), resource zone, interconnection agreement number, NEM eligibility flag, and DERMS integration flag. Supports IRP renewable portfolio planning and REC tracking.

attributes.name: renewable_resource_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the renewable generation resource. Primary key for the renewable resource master record.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Community‑solar or renewable subscription links a renewable resource record to the subscribing customer account for allocation and reporting.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to generation.plant. Business justification: Renewable resources are owned by a specific plant; linking provides plant-level aggregation and removes the siloed status of renewable_resource.

attributes.name: product_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_program. Business justification: Renewable Incentive Program enrollment tracks each renewable resource's participation in state RPS or incentive programs, needed for compliance reporting.

attributes.name: resource_meter_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to metering.meter. Business justification: Renewable resource (e.g., solar farm) must be linked to a meter for REC tracking and net‑metering calculations.

attributes.name: transmission_interconnection_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to transmission.interconnection_agreement. Business justification: Renewable projects must be linked to their Interconnection Agreement for compliance and market eligibility.

attributes.name: capacity_factor_design_pct
attributes.description: Design or expected capacity factor as a percentage, representing the ratio of actual energy output to theoretical maximum output over a year. Used for Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) modeling and Levelized Cost of Energy (LCOE) analysis. Typical values: solar 15-25%, wind 30-45%, hydro 40-60%.
attributes.references: IRP Modeling Standards; NREL Annual Technology Baseline

attributes.name: commercial_operation_date
attributes.description: Date when the renewable resource achieved commercial operation and began delivering energy under commercial terms. May differ from interconnection date due to testing and commissioning periods. Critical for Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) milestone tracking and Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) eligibility.
attributes.references: EIA Form 860 - Generator Data; PPA Contract Terms

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this renewable resource record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this renewable resource record originated (e.g., 'Maximo', 'GIS', 'PI Historian', 'Manual Entry'). Used for data lineage and integration troubleshooting.

attributes.name: derms_integration_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Distributed Energy Resource Management System (DERMS) Integration Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the renewable resource is integrated with the utility's Distributed Energy Resource Management System for real-time monitoring, forecasting, and dispatch control. True if integrated, False otherwise. Supports Virtual Power Plant (VPP) operations and grid flexibility.
attributes.references: IEEE 2030.5 - Smart Energy Profile; DERMS Functional Requirements

attributes.name: eam_asset_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier linking this renewable resource to its asset record in the Enterprise Asset Management system (Maximo). Used for maintenance planning, work order management, and asset lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: estimated_useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected operational lifespan of the renewable resource in years, used for depreciation calculations and long-term resource planning. Typical values: solar 25-30 years, wind 20-25 years, hydro 50-100 years.
attributes.references: FERC Depreciation Guidelines; IRP Planning Assumptions

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts code for capitalization and depreciation of this renewable generation asset. Typically 334 (Solar), 335 (Wind), 331-333 (Hydro) depending on resource type.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts for Electric Utilities

attributes.name: gis_asset_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier linking this renewable resource to its representation in the utility's GIS system (Esri ArcGIS). Enables spatial analysis, asset visualization, and integration with transmission and distribution network models.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Asset Management Data Model

attributes.name: hub_height_m
attributes.description: Height of the wind turbine hub above ground level in meters. Critical parameter for wind resource assessment and energy yield modeling. Applicable to wind resources only. Null for solar and hydro.

attributes.name: in_service_date
attributes.description: Date when the renewable resource was placed into service for accounting and depreciation purposes. May differ from commercial operation date due to accounting policy. Used for fixed asset management and regulatory rate base calculations.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: installed_capacity_mw_ac
attributes.description: Nameplate capacity of the renewable resource in megawatts AC (alternating current), representing the maximum continuous electrical output at the point of interconnection. For solar, this is the inverter-limited AC capacity.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1 - Electric Plant in Service; EIA Form 860

attributes.name: installed_capacity_mw_dc
attributes.description: For solar PV resources, the total DC capacity of the solar panels before inversion. Null for non-solar resources. Used to calculate DC-to-AC ratio for solar performance analysis.

attributes.name: interconnection_date
attributes.description: Date when the renewable resource was first interconnected to the grid and authorized to deliver energy. Used for depreciation schedules, regulatory reporting, and capacity factor analysis.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1 - Electric Plant in Service

attributes.name: inverter_manufacturer
attributes.description: Manufacturer of the inverter equipment for solar PV resources (e.g., 'SMA', 'Fronius', 'SolarEdge'). Applicable to solar PV only. Null for wind and hydro.

attributes.name: inverter_model
attributes.description: Model designation of the inverter equipment for solar PV resources. Applicable to solar PV only. Null for wind and hydro.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the renewable resource location in decimal degrees. Used for GIS mapping, solar irradiance modeling, wind resource assessment, and transmission planning.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the renewable resource location in decimal degrees. Used for GIS mapping, solar irradiance modeling, wind resource assessment, and transmission planning.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or system account that last modified this renewable resource record. Used for audit trail and data stewardship accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this renewable resource record was last modified. Used for data lineage, change tracking, and audit trail.

attributes.name: nem_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the renewable resource is eligible for Net Energy Metering programs, allowing bidirectional energy flow and credit for excess generation. True if eligible, False otherwise. Primarily applicable to distributed solar resources.
attributes.references: State Public Utility Commission NEM Tariffs

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the renewable resource. In-service indicates active generation capability, standby indicates ready but not generating, out-of-service indicates temporary unavailability, under construction for assets not yet commissioned, retired for permanently decommissioned, mothballed for long-term suspension.

attributes.name: owner_operator_type
attributes.description: Classification of ownership and operational responsibility. Utility-owned indicates direct ownership and operation, third-party PPA indicates independent power producer with power purchase agreement, customer-owned NEM indicates behind-the-meter distributed generation, joint venture indicates shared ownership.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; Internal Ownership Policy

attributes.name: panel_model
attributes.description: Manufacturer and model designation of solar panels installed (e.g., 'SunPower Maxeon 3-400W'). Applicable to solar PV resources only. Null for wind and hydro.

attributes.name: pi_historian_tag_prefix
attributes.description: Tag prefix used in OSIsoft PI Historian for real-time telemetry data streams from this renewable resource. Enables linkage between master data and operational time-series data for performance monitoring and analytics.

attributes.name: ppa_contract_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Power Purchase Agreement governing the sale of energy and/or capacity from this renewable resource. References the contractual terms, pricing structure, and delivery obligations. Confidential business information.
attributes.references: FERC Electric Quarterly Report (EQR); Contract Management System

attributes.name: rec_tracking_system_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) Tracking System ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by the regional REC tracking system (e.g., PJM-GATS, WREGIS, M-RETS) for tracking and trading renewable energy certificates generated by this resource. Used for renewable portfolio standard (RPS) compliance and REC monetization.
attributes.references: Regional REC Tracking System Standards (WREGIS, M-RETS, PJM-GATS)

attributes.name: record_active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this renewable resource record is currently active in the system. True for active records, False for logically deleted or archived records. Used for soft-delete pattern and historical record retention.

attributes.name: reservoir_capacity_acre_feet
attributes.description: Total storage capacity of the hydro reservoir in acre-feet. Applicable to pumped storage and reservoir-based hydro. Null for run-of-river hydro, solar, and wind.

attributes.name: resource_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the renewable resource, used in operational systems and regulatory reporting. Typically follows utility naming convention for generation assets.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1 - Electric Plant in Service

attributes.name: resource_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the renewable generation resource (e.g., 'Sunrise Solar Farm Unit 1', 'Coastal Wind Turbine 12').

attributes.name: resource_type
attributes.description: Classification of the renewable generation technology. Solar PV (photovoltaic), solar thermal (concentrating solar power), wind onshore, wind offshore, run-of-river hydro, or pumped storage hydro.

attributes.name: resource_zone
attributes.description: Geographic or operational zone designation for the renewable resource, used for resource planning and dispatch optimization. May align with ISO/RTO pricing zones or internal planning regions.
attributes.references: Internal Resource Planning Standard; ISO/RTO Zone Definitions

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date when the renewable resource was permanently retired from service. Null for active resources. Used for asset lifecycle tracking and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: rotor_diameter_m
attributes.description: Diameter of the wind turbine rotor (blade tip to blade tip) in meters. Determines swept area and energy capture capability. Applicable to wind resources only. Null for solar and hydro.

attributes.name: scada_integration_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Integration Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the renewable resource is integrated with the utility's SCADA system for real-time telemetry, monitoring, and control. True if integrated, False otherwise. Supports grid operations and outage management.
attributes.references: NERC CIP Standards; SCADA System Architecture

attributes.name: turbine_model
attributes.description: Manufacturer and model designation of wind turbine (e.g., 'GE 2.5-120', 'Vestas V150-4.2MW'). Applicable to wind resources only. Null for solar and hydro.

attributes.name: water_head_m
attributes.description: Vertical distance (head) between the upstream water level and the turbine in meters. Key parameter for hydro generation capacity and efficiency. Applicable to hydro resources only. Null for solar and wind.

products.name: capacity_resource
products.description: Master records for generating units registered as capacity resources in RTO/ISO capacity markets (PJM RPM, MISO PRA, NYISO ICAP, ISO-NE FCA). Captures capacity zone, accredited capacity (MW-ICAP, MW-UCAP), capacity product type (base capacity, CP), qualification test results, effective load carrying capability (ELCC) for renewables, capacity obligation (MW), performance assessment intervals, bonus/penalty amounts, and associated RTO/ISO registration ID. Distinct from capacity market bidding (owned by trading domain) — this product tracks the physical unit's qualification and accreditation status only. Supports capacity revenue forecasting and FERC market compliance.

attributes.name: capacity_resource_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the capacity resource registered in RTO/ISO capacity markets. Primary key.

attributes.name: generating_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical generating unit that this capacity resource represents.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the generation plant where this capacity resource is located.

attributes.name: accredited_capacity_mw_icap
attributes.description: The installed capacity (ICAP) value in megawatts (MW) accredited by the RTO/ISO, representing the maximum capacity the resource can provide under reference conditions.

attributes.name: accredited_capacity_mw_ucap
attributes.description: The unforced capacity (UCAP) value in megawatts (MW), which is ICAP adjusted for the resource's expected forced outage rate (EFORd), representing the expected available capacity.

attributes.name: bonus_amount_usd
attributes.description: The bonus payment amount in USD earned by the resource for exceeding performance requirements during shortage events or peak periods.

attributes.name: capacity_interconnection_rights
attributes.description: The type of interconnection rights held by this capacity resource: firm (full deliverability), non-firm (energy-only), or conditional (subject to transmission constraints).

attributes.name: capacity_obligation_mw
attributes.description: The capacity obligation in megawatts (MW) that this resource has committed to provide in the capacity market for the delivery period.

attributes.name: capacity_product_type
attributes.description: The capacity product type offered by this resource: base capacity, annual capacity, extended summer capacity, or capacity performance (CP) product.

attributes.name: capacity_revenue_forecast_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Capacity Revenue Forecast United States Dollar (USD)
attributes.description: The forecasted capacity revenue in USD for this resource for the current delivery year, used for financial planning and budgeting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 - Regulated Operations Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: capacity_transfer_rights
attributes.description: Indicates whether the capacity obligation can be transferred to another resource or market participant.

attributes.name: capacity_zone
attributes.description: The geographic capacity zone or locational deliverability area (LDA) where this resource is registered for capacity obligations.

attributes.name: cleared_capacity_mw
attributes.description: The capacity in megawatts (MW) that cleared in the most recent capacity auction for this resource.

attributes.name: cleared_capacity_price_usd_per_mw_day
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cleared Capacity Price United States Dollar (USD) per Megawatt (MW) Day
attributes.description: The cleared capacity price in USD per MW-day that this resource received in the capacity auction.

attributes.name: delivery_year
attributes.description: The delivery year (or planning year) for which this capacity resource is committed, typically in format YYYY/YYYY (e.g., 2024/2025).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this capacity resource registration became effective in the RTO/ISO capacity market.

attributes.name: effective_load_carrying_capability_mw
attributes.description: The effective load carrying capability (ELCC) in megawatts (MW) for renewable and intermittent resources, representing the equivalent firm capacity contribution based on probabilistic reliability analysis.

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: The primary fuel type or energy source for this capacity resource. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: coal|natural_gas|nuclear|hydro|wind|solar|oil|biomass|storage — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_performance_assessment_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent performance assessment conducted for this capacity resource.

attributes.name: must_offer_obligation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this capacity resource has a must-offer obligation requiring it to offer its capacity into the energy market during the delivery period.

attributes.name: net_performance_payment_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Performance Payment United States Dollar (USD)
attributes.description: The net performance payment in USD for the assessment period, calculated as bonuses minus penalties.

attributes.name: next_performance_assessment_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next performance assessment of this capacity resource.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special conditions related to this capacity resource registration, qualification, or performance.

attributes.name: penalty_amount_usd
attributes.description: The penalty amount in USD assessed against the resource for failing to meet capacity obligations during performance assessment intervals.

attributes.name: performance_assessment_interval
attributes.description: The frequency at which this capacity resource's performance is assessed against its capacity obligation.

attributes.name: performance_score
attributes.description: The performance score (typically 0-100) representing how well the resource met its capacity obligations during performance assessment periods.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: The current qualification status of the capacity resource in the RTO/ISO capacity market.

attributes.name: qualification_test_date
attributes.description: The date when the capacity qualification test was performed to verify the resource's capability.

attributes.name: qualification_test_result_mw
attributes.description: The measured capacity output in megawatts (MW) achieved during the qualification test.

attributes.name: qualification_test_status
attributes.description: The outcome status of the capacity qualification test.

attributes.name: rec_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this capacity resource is eligible to generate Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) based on its fuel type and certification.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this capacity resource record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this capacity resource record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: The current registration status of the capacity resource in the RTO/ISO system.

attributes.name: resource_name
attributes.description: The business name or designation of the capacity resource as registered with the RTO/ISO.

attributes.name: resource_type
attributes.description: The type of capacity resource: generation (traditional power plant), demand response (load reduction), energy efficiency, or storage (battery/pumped hydro).

attributes.name: rto_iso_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) / Independent System Operator (ISO) Name
attributes.description: The name of the RTO or ISO where this capacity resource is registered. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PJM|MISO|NYISO|ISO-NE|CAISO|ERCOT|SPP — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: rto_iso_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) / Independent System Operator (ISO) Registration Identifier (ID)
attributes.description: The unique registration identifier assigned by the RTO/ISO for this capacity resource in their capacity market system.

attributes.name: seasonal_capacity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a seasonal capacity resource with availability limited to specific seasons (e.g., summer-only peaking units).

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date when this capacity resource registration was or will be terminated, deactivated, or retired from the capacity market.

products.name: startup_shutdown_event
products.description: Transactional records for each generating unit startup and shutdown event capturing event type (hot start, warm start, cold start, normal shutdown, emergency trip), initiating cause, start/end timestamps, fuel consumed during startup (MMBtu), startup cost ($), ramp rate achieved (MW/min), emissions during startup, associated dispatch instruction reference, and unit status transitions. Supports startup cost allocation for LCOE, emissions reporting during non-steady-state operation, and unit commitment optimization. Critical for FERC Form 1 O&M cost allocation and EPA startup/shutdown exemption tracking.

attributes.name: startup_shutdown_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the startup or shutdown event record.

attributes.name: ems_dispatch_instruction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dispatch instruction associated with the event.

attributes.name: generating_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the generating unit that experienced the startup or shutdown.

attributes.name: initiating_technician_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.technician. Business justification: Startup/shutdown logs capture the technician who initiated the event, essential for cost allocation and incident analysis.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the plant where the generating unit is located.

attributes.name: scada_system_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.scada_system. Business justification: Enables correlation of startup/shutdown events with SCADA logs for incident analysis and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.site. Business justification: Event Impact Analysis tracks environmental emissions and cost per site; the link allows aggregation of startup/shutdown metrics for regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Internal cost center responsible for the startup/shutdown expense.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three‑letter ISO currency code for monetary amounts.

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of the event in minutes, calculated from start and end timestamps.

attributes.name: emission_factor_code
attributes.description: Code of the emission factor methodology applied to calculate emissions for this event.

attributes.name: emissions_co2_tons
attributes.description: Carbon dioxide emissions generated during the startup or shutdown event.

attributes.name: emissions_nox_tons
attributes.description: Nitrogen oxides emissions generated during the event.

attributes.name: emissions_so2_tons
attributes.description: Sulfur dioxide emissions generated during the event.

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact timestamp when the unit completed the startup or shutdown process.

attributes.name: event_reference_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code assigned to the event for external tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the primary event occurrence (typically the start of the startup or shutdown).

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the event (e.g., hot start, cold start, normal shutdown, emergency trip).

attributes.name: fuel_consumed_mmbtu
attributes.description: Amount of fuel used during the startup, measured in million British thermal units.

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Primary fuel used during the startup (e.g., coal, natural gas, oil).

attributes.name: initiating_cause
attributes.description: Primary cause that triggered the startup or shutdown.

attributes.name: is_emergency
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the event was an emergency shutdown or startup.

attributes.name: is_estimated
attributes.description: Indicates whether any numeric values (fuel, emissions, cost) are estimated rather than measured.

attributes.name: is_reportable_to_ferc
attributes.description: Indicates if the event must be reported to the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission.

attributes.name: net_startup_cost_usd
attributes.description: Net cost after adjustments, representing the final amount charged for the startup.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free‑form text for additional comments or observations about the event.

attributes.name: ramp_rate_mw_per_min
attributes.description: Maximum ramp rate achieved during the startup, expressed in megawatts per minute.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the event record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: record_source_system
attributes.description: System of record that supplied the event data.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the event record.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating inclusion of this event in regulatory reporting packages.

attributes.name: reporting_period
attributes.description: Month (first day) for which the event is reported to regulators.

attributes.name: start_timestamp

domains.name: transmission

products.name: topology
products.description: Represents the network connectivity model (bus-branch model) of the bulk electric system used by EMS, power flow solvers, and state estimation. Each record defines a directed branch (from-bus to to-bus) with associated transmission line or transformer, impedance parameters (R, X, B in per-unit), line charging, transformer tap ratio, and topology version effective date. Includes time-stamped power flow solution snapshots capturing system MW, MVAR, losses, convergence status, and interchange conditions for post-event analysis and NERC reliability assessments. Supports SCADA-driven real-time network model updates, RTO/ISO contingency analysis, and IRP planning inputs. Sourced from GE PowerOn EMS and OSIsoft PI Historian.

products.name: pole

Captures structure identifier, structure type (pole/vault/manhole/pedestal/riser), GIS coordinates, pole class (ANSI class 1–7 for poles), height (ft), material (wood/steel/concrete/composite/fiberglass), owner (utility/joint-use/third-party), installation year, last inspection date, condition rating, loading capacity (%), number of attachments, associated feeder, and municipality. Supports joint-use attachment management, storm damage assessment, underground access point tracking, and serves as the node element in the distribution network topology (conductor spans connect between structures).

products.name: protective_device
products.description: Master record for distribution-level protective and switching devices including reclosers, sectionalizers, fuses, automated switches, and capacitor banks. Captures device identifier, device type/subtype (protective/switching/reactive compensation), manufacturer, model, rated interrupting current (kA) or rated kVAR, rated voltage (kV), number of steps (for capacitor banks), control mode (fixed/automatic/SCADA-controlled), SCADA-controllable flag, remote/manual operation mode, GIS location, associated feeder segment, upstream/downstream connectivity references, installation date, last test/maintenance date, switching operations count, and operational status. Critical for fault isolation modeling, FLISR automation in GE PowerOn DMS, volt/VAR optimization (VVO), and SAIDI/SAIFI improvement through automated switching.

products.name: distribution_outage_event
products.description: Transactional record for each discrete electric distribution outage event (planned or unplanned) managed in GE PowerOn OMS. Captures outage event identifier, outage type (planned/unplanned/momentary), cause code (weather/equipment failure/animal/vegetation/third-party/unknown), affected feeder(s), protective device that operated, estimated and actual customers affected, outage start and restoration timestamps, outage duration (minutes), crew dispatch reference, customer notification status, associated work order reference, SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI contribution values (customer minutes interrupted per event), IEEE 1366 major event day exclusion flag, and storm event association. Includes detail-level affected customer/service point records with individual customer minutes interrupted (CMI). Primary source for calculating SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reliability indices, PUC reliability reporting, storm restoration performance tracking, and customer outage history. Retains all raw data needed for IEEE 1366 reliability index computation.

domains.name: gridops
domains.description: Owns real-time and near-real-time grid operational data including SCADA monitoring, EMS dispatch, load forecasting, demand response (DR) dispatch, frequency regulation, voltage control, and outage management coordination. Manages balancing area control, switching orders, and reliability event logging. Integrates with OMS, DMS, PI Historian, and DERMS for operational intelligence.
domains.references: NERC EOP/IRO/TOP Standards, IEEE C37.118, RTO/ISO, NIST Smart Grid

products.name: balancing_area
products.description: Master record for each balancing authority area (BAA) or control area managed by the utility, defining geographic and electrical boundaries, interchange schedules, and reliability obligations under NERC standards. Serves as the top-level operational jurisdiction for EMS dispatch and frequency regulation activities.

attributes.name: balancing_area_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the balancing authority area (BAA) record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this master resource entity.
attributes.references: NERC Glossary of Terms; FERC Order 888

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Short-form abbreviation or acronym for the balancing authority area used in SCADA displays, EMS dispatch screens, and operational communications (e.g., MISO, PJM, SPP).
attributes.references: NERC Glossary of Terms; GE PowerOn Advanced EMS

attributes.name: agc_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Automatic Generation Control (AGC) is active for this balancing area. AGC continuously adjusts generator output to maintain ACE within NERC BAL-001 limits. Critical flag for EMS dispatch configuration.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-001-2; GE PowerOn Advanced EMS

attributes.name: area_sq_miles
attributes.description: Total geographic area of the balancing authority service territory in square miles. Used in infrastructure density analysis, storm response planning, and regulatory filings with state PUCs.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; State PUC Rate Case Filings

attributes.name: area_type
attributes.description: Classification of the operational jurisdiction type. Distinguishes between a full NERC-registered balancing authority, a sub-control area operating under a parent BA, or a reserve sharing group. Drives dispatch logic and reliability obligation scope in the EMS.

attributes.name: balancing_area_name
attributes.description: Full legal or operational name of the balancing authority area as registered with NERC and recognized by FERC. Used in regulatory filings, RTO/ISO coordination, and operational reporting.
attributes.references: NERC Glossary of Terms; FERC Order 888

attributes.name: cip_classification
attributes.description: NERC Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) impact classification for this balancing area as a bulk electric system (BES) cyber system. Drives cybersecurity control requirements under NERC CIP-002 through CIP-014 standards.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-002-5.1a; NERC CIP-003-8; FERC Order 822

attributes.name: control_area_ace_limit_mw
attributes.description: The maximum allowable Area Control Error (ACE) in megawatts for this balancing area, as defined in the NERC BAL-001 standard.
