ACE is the real-time difference between actual and scheduled interchange plus frequency bias. This limit drives EMS automatic generation control (AGC) setpoints.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-001-2; GE PowerOn Advanced EMS

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the primary country in which this balancing area operates (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX). Relevant for cross-border balancing areas and NERC international coordination.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this balancing area master record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports data lineage, audit trail, and regulatory record retention requirements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980; NERC Rules of Procedure; ISO 55000

attributes.name: demand_response_capacity_mw
attributes.description: Total enrolled demand response (DR) capacity in megawatts (MW) available within this balancing area for dispatch during peak demand or grid emergency events. Includes both direct load control and interruptible load programs.
attributes.references: FERC Order 745; NERC BAL-002-3; DOE DR Program Guidelines

attributes.name: der_capacity_mw
attributes.description: Total nameplate capacity of distributed energy resources (DER) — including rooftop solar, battery storage, and small-scale generation — interconnected within this balancing area. Used in DERMS integration and load forecasting.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222; NERC TPL-001-4; DOE DERMS Guidelines

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this balancing area record became operationally effective, including any boundary changes, restructuring events, or RTO/ISO membership transitions. Supports temporal analysis of balancing area configuration history.

attributes.name: eia_ba_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Energy Information Administration (EIA) Balancing Authority Code
attributes.description: The EIA-assigned balancing authority code used in mandatory EIA Form 930 (Hourly Electric Grid Monitor) and EIA Form 411 submissions. Enables linkage between operational data and public EIA reporting.
attributes.references: EIA Form 930; EIA Form 411; DOE Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: ems_system_code
attributes.description: The native identifier for this balancing area as configured in the GE PowerOn Advanced Energy Management System (EMS). Used for cross-referencing real-time operational data from the EMS with the lakehouse silver layer record.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn Advanced EMS; OSIsoft PI Historian

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this balancing area record ceases to be effective, typically due to decommissioning, merger with another balancing authority, or transfer of operational control. Null for currently active areas.

attributes.name: frequency_bias_mw_per_hz
attributes.description: The frequency bias setting for this balancing area expressed in megawatts per hertz (MW/Hz). This value is used in the ACE calculation formula and must be reported to NERC annually under BAL-003. Configured in the EMS AGC module.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003-1.1; GE PowerOn Advanced EMS

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Descriptive geographic region or service territory description for the balancing area (e.g., Midwest, Pacific Northwest, Southeast). Used for operational reporting, regulatory filings, and GIS-based analysis in Esri ArcGIS.

attributes.name: installed_capacity_mw
attributes.description: Total nameplate installed generation capacity in megawatts (MW) within the balancing area boundary. Represents the principal quantitative measure of the resource and is used in IRP filings, NERC reliability assessments, and reserve margin calculations.
attributes.references: NERC TPL-001-4; EIA Form 860; FERC Order 888

attributes.name: interchange_scheduling_method
attributes.description: The method used to schedule energy interchange transactions across the balancing area boundary. E-Tag indicates use of the NERC e-Tag system for electronic tagging of interchange. RTO-managed indicates the RTO/ISO controls interchange scheduling.
attributes.references: NERC INT-001-3; NERC INT-004-3.1; FERC Order 888

attributes.name: interconnection
attributes.description: The North American AC synchronous interconnection to which this balancing area belongs. Determines frequency regulation obligations, emergency assistance protocols, and NERC reliability standards applicability.
attributes.references: NERC Glossary of Terms; EIA Form 411

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this balancing area master record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, data quality monitoring, and incremental lakehouse processing.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980; NERC Rules of Procedure; ISO 55000

attributes.name: latitude_centroid
attributes.description: Decimal latitude of the geographic centroid of the balancing area boundary polygon, in WGS84 coordinate reference system. Used for GIS visualization in Esri ArcGIS and spatial analytics.

attributes.name: lmp_pricing_node_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Locational Marginal Price (LMP) Pricing Node Code
attributes.description: The RTO/ISO-assigned pricing node code for the primary Locational Marginal Price (LMP) settlement point associated with this balancing area. Used in Allegro ETRM for energy trading settlement and DAM/RTM position management.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO Tariff; Allegro ETRM

attributes.name: load_serving_entity_count
attributes.description: Number of load serving entities (LSEs) operating within this balancing area. Used in resource adequacy planning, reserve sharing agreements, and NERC reliability assessments.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-002-3; FERC Order 888; State PUC Filings

attributes.name: longitude_centroid
attributes.description: Decimal longitude of the geographic centroid of the balancing area boundary polygon, in WGS84 coordinate reference system. Used for GIS visualization in Esri ArcGIS and spatial analytics.

attributes.name: market_participation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this balancing area participates in a wholesale energy market (Day-Ahead Market or Real-Time Market) operated by an RTO/ISO. True for market-participating areas; False for vertically integrated utilities operating outside organized markets.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; FERC Order 2000; Allegro ETRM

attributes.name: nerc_baa_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Balancing Authority Area (BAA) Code
attributes.description: The official NERC-assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this balancing authority area within the North American bulk electric system. Used in NERC compliance filings, EIA-411 submissions, and interchange scheduling.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-001-2; EIA Form 411; FERC Order 888

attributes.name: nerc_registration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this balancing authority area was formally registered with NERC as a functional entity. Establishes the start of NERC reliability standard compliance obligations.
attributes.references: NERC Rules of Procedure Section 500; NERC BAL-001-2

attributes.name: nominal_frequency_hz
attributes.description: The nominal AC system frequency in hertz (Hz) for this balancing area (typically 60.000 Hz for North American interconnections). Used as the reference frequency for ACE calculations and frequency regulation compliance.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-001-2; NERC BAL-003-1.1; IEEE Std 1547

attributes.name: operating_reserve_requirement_mw
attributes.description: The minimum operating reserve requirement in megawatts (MW) that must be maintained within this balancing area at all times, per NERC BAL-002 and applicable RTO/ISO tariff requirements. Includes both spinning and non-spinning reserves.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-002-3; FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO Tariff

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the balancing area. Active indicates the area is fully operational and participating in real-time dispatch and frequency regulation. Transitioning indicates a merger, transfer, or restructuring is in progress.

attributes.name: peak_load_mw
attributes.description: Historical or projected annual peak demand in megawatts (MW) for the balancing area. Used in reserve margin calculations, IRP planning, and NERC reliability assessments submitted to FERC and state PUCs.
attributes.references: NERC TPL-001-4; EIA Form 411; FERC Order 888

attributes.name: primary_frequency_regulation_mhz
attributes.description: The primary frequency response obligation assigned to this balancing area, expressed in megahertz (MHz) of frequency deviation response capability. Used in NERC BAL-003 compliance tracking and EMS frequency regulation dispatch.

attributes.name: renewable_capacity_mw
attributes.description: Total nameplate capacity of renewable energy sources (wind, solar, hydro, geothermal) in megawatts (MW) within the balancing area. Used in REC tracking, IRP filings, and state renewable portfolio standard (RPS) compliance reporting.
attributes.references: EIA Form 860; State RPS Requirements; FERC Order 888

attributes.name: reserve_margin_pct
attributes.description: The required or actual planning reserve margin expressed as a percentage of peak load. Represents the buffer of generation capacity above peak demand required to maintain reliability. Reported in IRP filings and NERC assessments.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-002-3; FERC Order 888; State PUC IRP Requirements

attributes.name: rto_iso_membership
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) / Independent System Operator (ISO) Membership
attributes.description: Name of the RTO or ISO within which this balancing area operates or is a member (e.g., PJM Interconnection, MISO, SPP, CAISO, ERCOT, NYISO, ISO-NE). Null if the utility operates as an independent balancing authority outside an RTO/ISO.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2000; NERC Glossary of Terms

attributes.name: saidi_target_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: System Average Interruption Duration Index (SAIDI) Target (Minutes)
attributes.description: The annual SAIDI performance target in minutes for this balancing area, representing the average total duration of interruptions per customer. Reported to state PUCs and used in reliability benchmarking.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366; State PUC Reliability Standards; NERC Glossary

attributes.name: saifi_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: System Average Interruption Frequency Index (SAIFI) Target
attributes.description: The annual SAIFI performance target for this balancing area, representing the average number of interruptions per customer per year. Reported to state PUCs and used in reliability benchmarking alongside SAIDI.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366; State PUC Reliability Standards; NERC Glossary

attributes.name: scada_area_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Area Code
attributes.description: The SCADA system area code assigned to this balancing area in the operational technology environment. Used to correlate real-time telemetry from OSIsoft PI Historian with the balancing area master record for operational intelligence.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn Advanced DMS/OMS; OSIsoft PI Historian; NERC CIP-007-6

attributes.name: spinning_reserve_requirement_mw
attributes.description: The minimum spinning (synchronized) reserve requirement in megawatts (MW) for this balancing area. Spinning reserves must be online and capable of responding within 10 minutes per NERC BAL-002 standards.

attributes.name: state_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of two-letter US state abbreviations (e.g., OH,IN,MI) representing the states within or overlapping the balancing area boundary. Determines which state PUC jurisdictions apply for rate case filings and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: tie_line_count
attributes.description: Number of high-voltage transmission tie lines connecting this balancing area to adjacent balancing areas. Used in interchange scheduling, contingency analysis, and NERC CIP-014 physical security assessments.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001-3; NERC FAC-002-3; FERC Order 888

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: The IANA time zone identifier for the primary operating time zone of this balancing area (e.g., America/Chicago, America/New_York). Used for scheduling, dispatch, and market settlement time alignment.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; NERC INT-001-3

attributes.name: transmission_operator_code
attributes.description: The NERC-assigned identifier of the Transmission Operator (TOP) responsible for operating the transmission facilities within this balancing area. May differ from the balancing authority in restructured markets.
attributes.references: NERC TOP-001-4; NERC FAC-001-3; FERC Order 888

attributes.name: transmission_voltage_kv
attributes.description: The primary bulk electric system transmission voltage level in kilovolts (kV) for this balancing area (e.g., 345 kV, 500 kV, 765 kV). Defines the BES threshold and NERC CIP applicability scope.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-002-5.1a; NERC FAC-001-3; FERC Order 888

products.name: control_zone
products.description: Defines electrical control zones within the balancing area, representing logical subdivisions of the grid used for load forecasting, voltage control, and dispatch coordination. Each zone maps to a set of buses, substations, and feeders managed under a unified operational strategy within the EMS/DMS.

attributes.name: control_zone_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the electrical control zone record within the balancing area. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: NERC Reliability Standards; GE PowerOn Advanced DMS/OMS

attributes.name: balancing_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gridops.balancing_area. Business justification: Control zones belong to a balancing area; adding balancing_area_id creates proper hierarchy and removes redundant code column.

attributes.name: cip_standard_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.cip_standard. Business justification: Each control zone is subject to a specific CIP standard; the FK supports compliance tracking and audit readiness.

attributes.name: control_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gridops.control_center. Business justification: A control center oversees multiple control zones; adding control_zone.control_center_id creates the necessary parent relationship and eliminates the silo for control_center.

attributes.name: scada_system_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) System Zone ID
attributes.description: Zone identifier as registered in the SCADA system (OSIsoft PI Historian / GE PowerOn). Used to correlate real-time telemetry data streams, alarm points, and control actions to this logical control zone.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian; GE PowerOn Advanced DMS/OMS; NERC CIP-007

attributes.name: ami_meter_count
attributes.description: Number of Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) smart meters deployed within this control zone. Used for demand response targeting, load disaggregation, and meter data management (MDM) reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM; NIST Smart Grid Framework; EIA Form 861

attributes.name: area_control_error_threshold_mw
attributes.description: Maximum allowable Area Control Error (ACE) in Megawatts (MW) for this control zone before corrective dispatch action is triggered. Defined per NERC BAL-001 compliance requirements for balancing authority performance.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-001; FERC Order 888; RTO/ISO Operating Procedures

attributes.name: bus_count
attributes.description: Number of electrical buses (nodes) within this control zone as modeled in the EMS network topology. Used for state estimation, power flow analysis, and contingency analysis.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn Advanced DMS/OMS; NERC MOD-032; IEEE 30-Bus Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this control zone record was first created in the data lakehouse Silver layer. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and regulatory record retention requirements.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-007; FASB ASC 980; NIST Smart Grid Framework

attributes.name: critical_infrastructure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this control zone contains or serves Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) assets as defined by NERC CIP standards. Zones flagged true require enhanced cybersecurity controls and physical security measures.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-002; NERC CIP-007; DHS Critical Infrastructure Framework

attributes.name: customer_count
attributes.description: Total number of end-use customers (residential and commercial) served within this control zone. Used for SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reliability index calculations and outage impact assessments.
attributes.references: State PUC Reliability Reporting; EIA Form 861; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: der_integration_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Distributed Energy Resources (DER) Integration Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Distributed Energy Resources (DER) — including rooftop solar, battery storage, and small-scale generation — are actively managed within this control zone via the DERMS platform.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222; IEEE 1547; NIST Smart Grid Framework

attributes.name: dispatch_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority rank assigned to this control zone for load dispatch and restoration sequencing. Lower values indicate higher priority. Used by EMS/DMS operators during contingency events and load shedding scenarios.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn Advanced DMS/OMS; NERC EOP-001; State PUC Emergency Operating Procedures

attributes.name: dms_zone_code
attributes.description: Zone identifier as configured in the Distribution Management System (DMS) for feeder switching, fault isolation, and service restoration coordination. Distinct from the EMS zone ID as DMS operates at distribution voltage levels.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn Advanced DMS/OMS; IEEE 1547; NIST Smart Grid Framework

attributes.name: dr_program_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this control zone participates in Demand Response (DR) dispatch programs. Zones flagged true are included in DR event targeting, load curtailment calculations, and DERMS coordination.
attributes.references: FERC Order 745; State PUC DR Programs; NERC BAL-002

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this control zone became operationally active and was formally recognized in the EMS/DMS configuration. Used for regulatory reporting, rate case filings, and historical grid topology analysis.
attributes.references: FERC Form 714; State PUC Filings; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: ems_zone_code
attributes.description: Zone identifier as configured in the Energy Management System (EMS) for state estimation, optimal power flow, and automatic generation control (AGC) dispatch. Enables cross-system traceability between the EMS and the data lakehouse.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn Advanced DMS/OMS; NERC EOP-001; FERC Form 714

attributes.name: feeder_count
attributes.description: Number of distribution feeders managed within this control zone. Supports feeder load balancing, switching order management, and outage restoration planning in the DMS.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn Advanced DMS/OMS; Esri ArcGIS; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: frequency_regulation_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this control zone is eligible to provide frequency regulation ancillary services to the balancing authority or RTO/ISO market. True if the zone has resources capable of automatic generation control (AGC) response.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003; FERC Order 755; RTO/ISO Tariff

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Name or code of the geographic service territory region in which this control zone is located. Used for regional load forecasting, regulatory reporting to state PUCs, and operational area assignment.
attributes.references: State PUC Service Territory Filings; FERC Form 714; EIA Form 861

attributes.name: gis_zone_code
attributes.description: Zone identifier in the Esri ArcGIS geospatial system. Links the logical control zone to its physical geographic boundary polygon for spatial analysis, outage impact mapping, and infrastructure planning.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; NIST Smart Grid Framework; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: installed_capacity_mw
attributes.description: Total installed generation capacity in Megawatts (MW) within or directly serving this control zone. Supports resource adequacy assessments and capacity reserve margin calculations.
attributes.references: NERC MOD-031; FERC Form 860; EIA Form 860

attributes.name: interconnection_type
attributes.description: North American electrical interconnection to which this control zone belongs: Eastern Interconnection, Western Interconnection, ERCOT (Texas), Alaska, or Hawaii. Determines synchronous grid boundaries and applicable NERC reliability standards.
attributes.references: NERC Reliability Standards; FERC Order 888; EIA Form 411

attributes.name: last_configuration_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal review of this control zone's EMS/DMS configuration parameters, including voltage setpoints, protection relay settings, and dispatch parameters. Supports NERC FAC-002 compliance documentation.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-002; NERC CIP-010; GE PowerOn Advanced DMS/OMS

attributes.name: load_forecast_model
attributes.description: Type of load forecasting methodology applied to this control zone within the Energy Management System (EMS). Determines how short-term and long-term load forecasts are generated for dispatch coordination and resource planning.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn Advanced DMS/OMS; OSIsoft PI Historian; NERC MOD-032

attributes.name: load_shedding_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this control zone is eligible for controlled load shedding during grid emergency conditions. Zones containing critical infrastructure (hospitals, emergency services) are typically excluded.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-001; NERC EOP-002; State PUC Emergency Operating Procedures

attributes.name: nerc_cip_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: NERC Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) Impact Classification
attributes.description: NERC CIP impact classification level for Bulk Electric System (BES) assets within this control zone. High and Medium classifications require mandatory cybersecurity and physical security controls per NERC CIP-002 through CIP-014.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-002; NERC CIP-003; NERC CIP-014

attributes.name: net_energy_metering_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers within this control zone are eligible for Net Energy Metering (NEM) programs, allowing bi-directional energy flow credit for distributed generation (e.g., rooftop solar). Affects load forecasting and grid hosting capacity analysis.
attributes.references: State PUC NEM Tariffs; FERC Order 2222; IEEE 1547

attributes.name: oms_zone_code
attributes.description: Zone identifier as registered in the Outage Management System (OMS). Used to correlate outage events, crew dispatch, and restoration activities to this control zone for SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reporting.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn Advanced DMS/OMS; State PUC Outage Reporting; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: peak_load_mw
attributes.description: Maximum recorded or rated peak electrical load in Megawatts (MW) for this control zone. Used as the principal capacity measure for load forecasting, resource adequacy planning, and Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) filings.
attributes.references: NERC MOD-031; FERC Form 714; EIA Form 411

attributes.name: reserve_margin_pct
attributes.description: Minimum required planning reserve margin percentage for this control zone as mandated by the applicable RTO/ISO or state Public Utility Commission (PUC). Expressed as a percentage of peak load.
attributes.references: NERC MOD-031; State PUC Reliability Standards; FERC Order 888

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date on which this control zone was retired or decommissioned from active grid operations. Null for currently active zones. Used for historical topology reconstruction and regulatory asset base (RAB) tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; FERC Form 714; State PUC Filings

attributes.name: rto_iso_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regional Transmission Organization / Independent System Operator (RTO/ISO) Code
attributes.description: Code identifying the Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) or Independent System Operator (ISO) market in which this control zone participates for energy dispatch, ancillary services, and Locational Marginal Price (LMP) settlement.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2000; NERC Reliability Standards; EIA Form 714

attributes.name: saidi_target_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: System Average Interruption Duration Index (SAIDI) Target (Minutes)
attributes.description: Target System Average Interruption Duration Index (SAIDI) in minutes for this control zone as established in the utility's reliability performance plan or state PUC reliability standards. Benchmarks operational reliability performance.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; State PUC Reliability Standards; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: saifi_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: System Average Interruption Frequency Index (SAIFI) Target
attributes.description: Target System Average Interruption Frequency Index (SAIFI) — average number of interruptions per customer per year — for this control zone as defined in the utility's reliability plan or state PUC requirements.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; State PUC Reliability Standards; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code for the primary jurisdiction in which this control zone operates. Determines applicable state Public Utility Commission (PUC) regulations, rate cases, and reliability standards.
attributes.references: State PUC Regulations; FERC Jurisdictional Filings; EIA Form 861

attributes.name: substation_count
attributes.description: Number of substations included within this control zone. Used for operational complexity assessment, maintenance planning, and regulatory asset base (RAB) reporting.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; Maximo EAM; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: tie_line_capacity_mw
attributes.description: Total rated transfer capacity in Megawatts (MW) of all tie lines connecting this control zone to adjacent zones or balancing areas. Used for interchange scheduling and Available Transfer Capability (ATC) calculations.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-012; FERC Order 888; NERC MOD-028

attributes.name: tou_pricing_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether Time-of-Use (TOU) pricing rates are applicable to customers within this control zone. Drives load shape modeling and demand response program design for the zone.
attributes.references: State PUC Rate Cases; FERC Order 745; Oracle CC&B CIS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this control zone record in the data lakehouse. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental processing, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-007; FASB ASC 980; NIST Smart Grid Framework

attributes.name: voltage_control_mode
attributes.description: Operational mode for voltage control within this zone as configured in the DMS/EMS. Automatic mode enables closed-loop voltage regulation; supervisory mode allows operator-directed control; manual mode requires direct field action.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn Advanced DMS/OMS; NERC FAC-002; IEEE 1547

attributes.name: voltage_level_kv
attributes.description: Nominal operating voltage level of the control zone in kilovolts (kV). Defines the voltage class for equipment ratings, protection coordination, and voltage control strategy within the zone.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; IEEE C57.12; GE PowerOn Advanced DMS/OMS

attributes.name: weather_zone_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the weather forecast zone associated with this control zone. Weather zone data drives temperature-sensitive load forecasting models and storm preparedness planning within the EMS.
attributes.references: NOAA Weather Zones; GE PowerOn Advanced DMS/OMS; NERC MOD-032

attributes.name: zone_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the control zone within the Energy Management System (EMS) and Distribution Management System (DMS). Used in SCADA displays, switching orders, and operational reports.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn Advanced DMS/OMS; NERC Reliability Standards; FERC Order 2000

attributes.name: zone_description
attributes.description: Free-text operational description of the control zone including its geographic boundaries, key assets, operational characteristics, and any special operating conditions or constraints relevant to dispatch and reliability management.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn Advanced DMS/OMS; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: zone_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the control zone used in operational dashboards, load forecasting reports, and dispatch coordination communications.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn Advanced DMS/OMS; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: zone_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the control zone within the EMS/DMS. Active zones participate in real-time dispatch and load forecasting. Commissioning zones are being brought into service. Decommissioned zones are retired from grid operations.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn Advanced DMS/OMS; NERC Reliability Standards; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: zone_type
attributes.description: Operational classification of the control zone indicating its primary grid function: load (demand-side), generation (supply-side), transmission (bulk power), distribution (end-delivery), balancing (area control), or interchange (tie-point between areas).
attributes.references: NERC BAL-001; FERC Order 888; GE PowerOn Advanced DMS/OMS

products.name: scada_point
products.description: Master catalog of all SCADA telemetry points (analog and digital) monitored via OSIsoft PI Historian and GE PowerOn EMS/DMS. Each record defines a measurement point including point name, tag ID, associated asset, engineering units, scan rate, deadband, and alarm thresholds. Serves as the SSOT for real-time grid telemetry configuration.

attributes.name: scada_point_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Point ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each SCADA telemetry point in the master catalog. Serves as the primary key for the scada_point product in the Databricks Silver Layer. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — represents a configured telemetry measurement point owned and managed by the utility.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Point Configuration; NERC CIP-007; NIST SP 800-82 ICS Security

attributes.name: associated_asset_asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the grid asset (substation, transformer, generator, transmission line, distribution feeder, capacitor bank, etc.) that this SCADA point monitors or controls. Links the telemetry point to the physical asset in the asset management system (Maximo EAM or Esri ArcGIS). Used for asset health analytics and outage correlation.
attributes.references: Maximo EAM Asset Record; Esri ArcGIS Network Feature; IEC 61968/61970 CIM PowerSystemResource; ISO 55000

attributes.name: associated_asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the grid asset (substation, transformer, generator, transmission line, distribution feeder, capacitor bank, etc.) that this SCADA point monitors or controls. Links the telemetry point to the physical asset in the asset management system (Maximo EAM or Esri ArcGIS). Used for asset health analytics and outage correlation.
attributes.references: Maximo EAM Asset Record; Esri ArcGIS Network Feature; IEC 61968/61970 CIM PowerSystemResource; ISO 55000

attributes.name: balancing_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gridops.balancing_area. Business justification: SCADA points are located within a balancing area; linking provides spatial context and removes string field.

attributes.name: it_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.it_asset. Business justification: Each SCADA point corresponds to a physical IT asset (sensor/device); linking supports maintenance schedules and regulatory asset tracking.

attributes.name: network_device_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.network_device. Business justification: SCADA points are collected via network devices; linking enables IT asset management and cybersecurity compliance for each point.

attributes.name: resource_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to der.der_resource. Business justification: SCADA points monitor DER inverter output for real‑time operations; utility operators need this link for dispatch and compliance.

attributes.name: transmission_substation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the substation or switching station where the field device associated with this SCADA point is physically located. Used for geographic grouping, outage management correlation, and NERC reliability reporting. Links to the substation master record in GIS and EMS network model.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Substation Feature Class; GE PowerOn EMS/DMS Network Model; NERC FAC-001; IEC 61968/61970 CIM Substation

attributes.name: alarm_high_high_limit
attributes.business_glossary_term: SCADA Point Critical High Alarm Limit
attributes.description: The critical upper threshold (High-High) above which an emergency or critical alarm is triggered, indicating a severe operational condition requiring immediate operator action. Expressed in engineering units. Used in EMS/DMS for two-tier alarm escalation (High vs. High-High). Supports NERC reliability event classification.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn EMS/DMS Alarm Configuration; NERC EOP-004-3; IEC 61511 Functional Safety

attributes.name: alarm_high_limit
attributes.description: The upper operational threshold above which an alarm condition is triggered in the EMS/DMS/SCADA system. When the measured value exceeds this limit, an alarm notification is generated for grid operators. Expressed in engineering units. Configured in GE PowerOn EMS/DMS alarm management module.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn EMS/DMS Alarm Configuration; NERC EOP-004-3; NERC CIP-007-6; IEC 62351

attributes.name: alarm_low_limit
attributes.description: The lower operational threshold below which an alarm condition is triggered in the EMS/DMS/SCADA system. When the measured value falls below this limit, an alarm notification is generated for grid operators. Expressed in engineering units. Configured in GE PowerOn EMS/DMS alarm management module.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn EMS/DMS Alarm Configuration; NERC EOP-004-3; NERC CIP-007-6; IEC 62351

attributes.name: alarm_low_low_limit
attributes.business_glossary_term: SCADA Point Critical Low Alarm Limit
attributes.description: The critical lower threshold (Low-Low) below which an emergency or critical alarm is triggered, indicating a severe operational condition requiring immediate operator action. Expressed in engineering units. Used in EMS/DMS for two-tier alarm escalation (Low vs. Low-Low). Supports NERC reliability event classification.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn EMS/DMS Alarm Configuration; NERC EOP-004-3; IEC 61511 Functional Safety

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: The operational asset class of the grid infrastructure element monitored by this SCADA point. Used for domain routing, regulatory reporting boundary classification, and T&D cost allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: generation|transmission|distribution|substation|gas_pipeline|gas_distribution|metering|protection — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101); NERC BES Definition; IEC 61968/61970 CIM

attributes.name: commissioned_date
attributes.description: The date on which this SCADA point was formally commissioned and activated in the operational SCADA/EMS/DMS system. Marks the start of the point's active lifecycle. Used for asset age analysis, warranty tracking, and NERC CIP change management audit trails.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; NERC CIP-010-3 Configuration Change Management; SAP PM Equipment Master

attributes.name: communication_protocol
attributes.description: The communication protocol used to transmit telemetry data from the field device (RTU/IED) to the SCADA master station for this point. Common utility protocols include DNP3, IEC 60870-5-101/104, IEC 61850, Modbus, and ICCP for inter-control-center communications. Used for cybersecurity classification and NERC CIP asset categorization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DNP3|IEC60870-5-101|IEC60870-5-104|Modbus|IEC61850|ICCP|OPC-DA|OPC-UA — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IEEE 1815 DNP3; IEC 60870-5; IEC 61850; NERC CIP-007-6; NIST SP 800-82 ICS Security

attributes.name: compression_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether OSIsoft PI Historian data compression (exception and compression deviation) is enabled for this point. When True, PI Historian applies the deadband_value and compression deviation to reduce storage while preserving data fidelity. When False, all scanned values are archived (raw storage mode). Impacts PI Historian storage sizing and data retrieval performance.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Compression Settings; OSIsoft PI System Management Tools Documentation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this SCADA point record was first created in the master catalog (Silver Layer). Represents the audit creation time in the Databricks Lakehouse. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per enterprise timestamp convention.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-010-3 Configuration Change Management; NIST SP 800-53 AU-3 Audit Records; ISO 55000

attributes.name: data_quality_code
attributes.description: The current or last-known data quality status of this SCADA point as reported by OSIsoft PI Historian or GE PowerOn EMS/DMS. 'good' = valid telemetry; 'bad' = communication failure or device fault; 'uncertain' = questionable signal; 'substituted' = manually overridden value; 'manual_entry' = operator-entered value; 'out_of_range' = value outside raw limits. Used for data quality filtering in analytics.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian System Digital States; IEC 61968/61970 CIM Quality; OPC DA Quality Codes; NERC CIP-007-6

attributes.name: deadband_value
attributes.description: The minimum change in the measured value required to trigger a new data archive event in OSIsoft PI Historian (exception deviation). Expressed in the same engineering units as the point. Prevents excessive data storage for slowly-changing signals while ensuring meaningful changes are captured. Configured per point in PI Historian compression settings.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Compression and Exception Settings; NERC FAC-002; EIA Form 411

attributes.name: decommissioned_date
attributes.description: The date on which this SCADA point was decommissioned and removed from active scanning in the SCADA/EMS/DMS system. Null if the point is still active. Used for lifecycle management, historical data archival decisions, and NERC CIP asset retirement documentation.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; NERC CIP-010-3 Configuration Change Management; SAP PM Equipment Master

attributes.name: ems_point_address
attributes.description: The point address or database key used to reference this telemetry point within the GE PowerOn EMS/DMS real-time database. Typically a hierarchical address string (e.g., 'AREA.SUBSTATION.DEVICE.MEASUREMENT'). Used for EMS state estimation, contingency analysis, and real-time display binding.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn EMS/DMS Real-Time Database Configuration; IEC 61968/61970 CIM; NERC CIP-007-6

attributes.name: energy_type
attributes.description: Identifies whether this SCADA point monitors an electric grid asset or a natural gas infrastructure asset. 'electric' = electric T&D or generation; 'gas' = natural gas pipeline, compressor, or distribution; 'both' = dual-fuel or combined measurement point. Supports domain partitioning for electric vs. gas operations analytics.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1 (Electric); FERC Form 2 (Gas); PHMSA Gas Distribution Reporting; EIA Form 176

attributes.name: engineering_unit
attributes.description: The physical unit of measurement associated with the SCADA point value (e.g., 'kV', 'MW', 'MVAr', 'A', 'Hz', 'degF', 'PSI', 'MCF/hr', 'kWh'). Sourced from OSIsoft PI Historian engineering unit configuration. Critical for correct interpretation of telemetry values in EMS, DMS, and analytics applications. Aligns with IEC 61970 CIM unit symbols.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Engineering Units; IEC 61970-301 CIM UnitSymbol; IEEE C37.118

attributes.name: functional_location
attributes.description: The SAP PM (Plant Maintenance) functional location code identifying the hierarchical physical location of the asset associated with this SCADA point (e.g., 'TX-SUBST-A-XFMR-01'). Links SCADA telemetry to the SAP ERP asset hierarchy for O&M cost allocation, work order management, and CAPEX/OPEX tracking.
attributes.references: SAP PM Functional Location (IL01); SAP ERP FI/CO Asset Accounting; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: gis_feature_reference
attributes.description: The unique feature identifier from Esri ArcGIS for the network element (substation, line segment, transformer, etc.) associated with this SCADA point. Enables spatial analysis, outage mapping, and geographic visualization of real-time telemetry in the GIS platform. Links SCADA data to the geospatial network model.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Electric Network Feature Dataset; IEC 61968/61970 CIM Geographic; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: is_alarmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether alarm processing is enabled for this SCADA point in the EMS/DMS alarm management system. True = alarm limits are active and will generate operator notifications; False = alarm processing suppressed (e.g., during maintenance or commissioning). Drives alarm display filtering in GE PowerOn EMS/DMS.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn EMS/DMS Alarm Management; NERC EOP-004-3; IEC 62351-7

attributes.name: is_bes_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SCADA point is associated with a Bulk Electric System (BES) element as defined by NERC. BES-applicable points are subject to NERC CIP cybersecurity standards and NERC reliability standards reporting requirements. True = BES applicable; False = non-BES (distribution or sub-transmission).
attributes.references: NERC BES Definition (Effective July 1, 2014); NERC CIP-002-5.1a; FERC Order 773

attributes.name: is_cip_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SCADA point is subject to NERC Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) cybersecurity standards. CIP-applicable points require access control, monitoring, and change management per NERC CIP-007-6. True = CIP applicable; False = not subject to CIP requirements.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-002-5.1a; NERC CIP-007-6; NERC CIP-010-3; NIST SP 800-82

attributes.name: is_controllable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SCADA point supports remote control operations (e.g., breaker open/close, tap changer raise/lower, setpoint adjustment) from the EMS/DMS/SCADA master station. True = remote control enabled; False = read-only telemetry. Critical for access control and NERC CIP classification of control points.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn EMS/DMS Control Configuration; NERC CIP-007-6; NERC CIP-005-6 Electronic Security Perimeter

attributes.name: last_calibration_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent calibration or verification of the field instrument (transducer, CT, PT, transmitter) associated with this SCADA point. Used for instrument maintenance scheduling, data quality assurance, and OSHA/PHMSA compliance for gas measurement instruments.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910; PHMSA 49 CFR Part 192/193; NIST Handbook 44; Maximo EAM Calibration Work Order

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this SCADA point record was most recently updated in the master catalog. Tracks configuration changes to point attributes (alarm limits, scan rate, deadband, etc.). Critical for NERC CIP-010-3 configuration change management audit trail and Silver Layer incremental load processing.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-010-3 Configuration Change Management; NIST SP 800-53 AU-3; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: measurement_category
attributes.description: The physical or electrical quantity being measured by this SCADA point. Categorizes the telemetry by measurement domain for analytics, display grouping, and regulatory reporting. Examples: 'voltage' (kV), 'power_mw' (real power), 'power_mvar' (reactive power), 'frequency' (Hz), 'flow_mcf' (gas flow), 'pressure' (PSI). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voltage|current|power_mw|power_mvar|frequency|energy_mwh|flow_mcf|pressure|temperature|status_indication|position — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IEC 61970-301 CIM MeasurementType; IEEE C37.118; EIA Form 411; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: next_calibration_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next calibration or verification of the field instrument associated with this SCADA point. Drives preventive maintenance work order generation in Maximo EAM. Ensures compliance with PHMSA gas measurement calibration intervals and OSHA instrument maintenance requirements.
attributes.references: PHMSA 49 CFR Part 192; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; Maximo EAM PM Schedule; ISO 55000

attributes.name: nominal_value
attributes.description: The expected or design nominal operating value for this SCADA point under normal grid conditions (e.g., nominal voltage = 138.0 kV, nominal frequency = 60.0 Hz). Used as a reference baseline for deviation analysis, alarm limit setting, and grid state estimation in EMS. Expressed in engineering units.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn EMS/DMS State Estimation; NERC FAC-001; IEEE C57.12 Transformer Standards

attributes.name: offset_value
attributes.description: Additive offset applied after scale factor conversion to produce the final engineering unit value from the raw telemetry input. Used to correct for zero-point calibration errors or instrument biases. Configured in OSIsoft PI Historian or GE PowerOn EMS/DMS as part of the point's conversion formula.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Point Attributes; GE PowerOn EMS/DMS Analog Input Configuration; NIST Handbook 44 Calibration

attributes.name: pi_point_code
attributes.description: The native point identifier (PI Point ID or PI Tag Name) assigned by OSIsoft PI Historian for this SCADA telemetry point. Used for direct API queries to PI Historian via PI Web API or PI OLEDB. Enables traceability from the Silver Layer back to the source historian record.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Point Administration; OSIsoft PI Web API; NERC CIP-007-6

attributes.name: point_class
attributes.description: Functional classification of the SCADA point indicating its operational role. 'measurement' = real-time telemetry value; 'status' = equipment state indication; 'control' = remotely operable control point; 'setpoint' = configurable operating parameter; 'alarm' = alarm/event indicator. Used for access control, display filtering, and NERC CIP classification.
attributes.references: IEC 61968/61970 Common Information Model (CIM); NERC CIP-007-6; GE PowerOn EMS/DMS Configuration

attributes.name: point_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the SCADA telemetry point providing additional context about what is being measured, the associated equipment, and its operational significance. Sourced from OSIsoft PI Historian point descriptor field. Used in operator displays, engineering documentation, and data catalog search.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Point Descriptor Attribute; GE PowerOn EMS/DMS Point Documentation

attributes.name: point_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the SCADA telemetry point as configured in OSIsoft PI Historian or GE PowerOn EMS/DMS. Serves as the primary identity label for the point (e.g., 'SUBST_A_BUS1_VOLT', 'GEN_UNIT3_MW_OUTPUT'). Used by grid operators and engineers to identify the measurement in real-time displays and historian queries.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Point Configuration; GE PowerOn EMS/DMS Tag Naming Convention; IEEE C37.118

attributes.name: point_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SCADA point in the master catalog. 'active' = currently scanning and reporting; 'inactive' = configured but not scanning; 'commissioned' = newly added and validated; 'decommissioned' = retired from service; 'suspended' = temporarily halted due to maintenance or fault. Drives data quality filtering in PI Historian and Silver Layer ingestion.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Point Administration; NERC CIP-007-6 R1; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: point_type
attributes.description: Classification of the SCADA telemetry point by signal type. 'analog' = continuous measurement (e.g., voltage, MW flow); 'digital' = discrete state (e.g., breaker open/closed); 'accumulator' = pulse-count integration (e.g., energy meter pulse); 'string' = text-based status; 'calculated' = derived value computed within the historian or EMS.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Point Class Definitions; IEC 61968/61970 CIM; IEEE C37.118.2

attributes.name: raw_high_limit
attributes.description: The maximum raw input value (in engineering units) that the SCADA point can physically receive from the field device before being flagged as out-of-range. Values above this threshold are treated as bad quality data. Configured in OSIsoft PI Historian and GE PowerOn EMS/DMS for data validation.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Point Attributes; GE PowerOn EMS/DMS Limit Configuration; IEC 61968/61970 CIM

attributes.name: raw_low_limit
attributes.description: The minimum raw input value (in engineering units) that the SCADA point can physically receive from the field device before being flagged as out-of-range. Values below this threshold are treated as bad quality data. Configured in OSIsoft PI Historian and GE PowerOn EMS/DMS for data validation.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Point Attributes; GE PowerOn EMS/DMS Limit Configuration; IEC 61968/61970 CIM

attributes.name: rtu_address
attributes.description: The communication address of the Remote Terminal Unit (RTU) or Intelligent Electronic Device (IED) from which this SCADA point is polled. Includes protocol-specific addressing (e.g., DNP3 address, Modbus register, IEC 60870-5-101/104 information object address). Used for field device troubleshooting and communication diagnostics.
attributes.references: DNP3 Protocol Standard (IEEE 1815); IEC 60870-5-101/104; NERC CIP-007-6 R1; NIST SP 800-82

attributes.name: scale_factor
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to the raw telemetry input value to convert it to engineering units. For example, a current transformer (CT) ratio or potential transformer (PT) ratio applied to raw analog counts. Configured in OSIsoft PI Historian or GE PowerOn EMS/DMS as part of the point's conversion formula.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Point Attributes; GE PowerOn EMS/DMS Analog Input Configuration; IEEE C57.13 Instrument Transformers

attributes.name: scan_rate_seconds
attributes.description: The frequency in seconds at which the SCADA system polls or samples this telemetry point from the field device (RTU, IED, or PLC). Common values: 2 (high-frequency protection), 4 (standard SCADA), 30 (slow telemetry), 60 (non-critical). Determines data density in PI Historian and impacts AMI/SCADA bandwidth planning.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Scan Class Configuration; NERC CIP-007-6; IEEE C37.118.2 Synchrophasor Standard

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this SCADA point configuration originates. Identifies whether the point is mastered in OSIsoft PI Historian, GE PowerOn EMS, GE PowerOn DMS, a field RTU/IED, DERMS, or OMS. Critical for data lineage, integration mapping, and Silver Layer ingestion pipeline routing.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian; GE PowerOn EMS/DMS; NERC CIP-007-6 R1; NIST SP 800-82

attributes.name: tag_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique tag identifier assigned to the SCADA point in the source operational system (OSIsoft PI Historian tag name or GE PowerOn point address). This is the business identifier used across OMS, DMS, EMS, and PI Historian integrations to reference the telemetry point. Equivalent to the PI tag name in OSIsoft PI.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Tag Naming Standard; GE PowerOn EMS/DMS Configuration; NERC CIP-007-6

attributes.name: voltage_level_kv
attributes.description: The nominal voltage level in kilovolts (kV) of the electrical bus, equipment, or circuit that this SCADA point is associated with (e.g., 500 kV, 230 kV, 138 kV, 69 kV, 12.47 kV, 0.48 kV). Used for voltage class filtering, T&D boundary classification, and NERC BES (Bulk Electric System) applicability determination.
attributes.references: NERC BES Definition; FERC Order 773; IEC 60038 Standard Voltages; IEEE C57.12

products.name: scada_reading
products.description: Near-real-time and historical telemetry readings and alarm events captured from SCADA points via OSIsoft PI Historian. Stores timestamped analog values (MW, MVAR, kV, Hz, amps, temperature), digital state changes (breaker open/close, switch status, protection relay operations), and alarm records. Alarm data includes alarm point reference, alarm type (thermal overload, voltage violation, equipment failure, communication loss, protection operation), priority level per ISA-18.2 alarm management standard, trigger value, threshold, acknowledgment status, acknowledging operator, shelving status, suppression state, and time to acknowledge/clear. This is the highest-volume product in the domain and the foundation for all real-time operational decisions, alarm management and rationalization, operator performance review, post-event analysis, NERC CIP-007 compliance, and NERC compliance evidence.

attributes.name: scada_reading_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Reading ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each SCADA telemetry reading or alarm event record in the Silver layer. Entity role: EVENT_LOG — this is an append-only stream of immutable timestamped observations and alarm events captured from SCADA points via OSIsoft PI Historian.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Data Model; NERC CIP-007 R4 Security Event Logging

attributes.name: asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical grid asset (transformer, breaker, generator, transmission line, etc.) associated with this SCADA point reading. Enables correlation of telemetry to the asset registry in Maximo EAM.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; Maximo EAM Asset Object; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: crew_member_id
attributes.description: Reference to the grid operator who acknowledged the alarm. Supports operator performance review, shift accountability, and NERC CIP-007 access logging. Null for non-alarm readings or unacknowledged alarms.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-007 R4 Security Event Logging; NERC CIP-004 Personnel Training; GE PowerOn DMS Operator Console

attributes.name: distribution_switching_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the switching order or clearance order in the DMS that initiated or is associated with a digital state change captured in this SCADA reading (e.g., breaker open/close operation). Links telemetry evidence to planned switching operations for post-switching verification.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn DMS Switching Order Management; NERC EOP-005 System Restoration; OSHA 1910.269

attributes.name: dr_dispatch_dr_dispatch_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Demand Response (DR) dispatch event that this SCADA reading is associated with, when the reading reflects load reduction or DR program response. Enables measurement and verification (M&V) of DR performance against dispatch instructions.
attributes.references: FERC Order 745 Demand Response Compensation; NERC BAL-002 Disturbance Control; DERMS DR Dispatch

attributes.name: dr_dispatch_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Demand Response (DR) dispatch event that this SCADA reading is associated with, when the reading reflects load reduction or DR program response. Enables measurement and verification (M&V) of DR performance against dispatch instructions.
attributes.references: FERC Order 745 Demand Response Compensation; NERC BAL-002 Disturbance Control; DERMS DR Dispatch

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the grid operator who acknowledged the alarm. Supports operator performance review, shift accountability, and NERC CIP-007 access logging. Null for non-alarm readings or unacknowledged alarms.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-007 R4 Security Event Logging; NERC CIP-004 Personnel Training; GE PowerOn DMS Operator Console

attributes.name: gridops_outage_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the outage or reliability event record in the OMS (Outage Management System) that this SCADA reading is associated with. Links telemetry evidence to outage events for SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI calculation, post-event analysis, and NERC reliability reporting.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn OMS Event Object; NERC EOP-004 Event Reporting; IEEE 1366 Distribution Reliability Indices

attributes.name: lmp_price_id
attributes.description: Reference to the RTO/ISO pricing node (LMP node) associated with this SCADA measurement point. Enables correlation of real-time telemetry with Day-Ahead Market (DAM) and Real-Time Market (RTM) LMP prices for congestion analysis and energy trading settlement.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888 LMP Pricing; NERC MOD-032; Allegro ETRM LMP Node

attributes.name: ot_asset_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the Remote Terminal Unit (RTU) or Intelligent Electronic Device (IED) that collected and transmitted this SCADA reading to the EMS/DMS. Supports communication path diagnostics, RTU performance monitoring, and NERC CIP-007 device inventory tracking.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-007 R2 Ports and Services; IEC 60870-5-101/104 RTU Protocol; GE PowerOn DMS RTU Configuration

attributes.name: registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical grid asset (transformer, breaker, generator, transmission line, etc.) associated with this SCADA point reading. Enables correlation of telemetry to the asset registry in Maximo EAM.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; Maximo EAM Asset Object; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: resource_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to der.der_resource. Business justification: SCADA readings capture DER telemetry; required for performance reporting and regulatory compliance of distributed resources.

attributes.name: scada_point_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gridops.scada_point. Business justification: Readings are generated by a specific SCADA point; FK enables direct join and eliminates need for point_name lookup.

attributes.name: transmission_substation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the substation or grid node where the SCADA point is physically located. Supports geographic and topological analysis of grid conditions.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS GIS Network Model; NERC FAC-002; GE PowerOn DMS Substation Object

attributes.name: acknowledged_timestamp
attributes.description: The UTC timestamp at which the alarm was acknowledged by a grid operator. Used to calculate time-to-acknowledge (TTA) for operator performance review and ISA-18.2 alarm response time KPI measurement. Null if not yet acknowledged or not an alarm.
attributes.references: ISA-18.2 Alarm Management Standard Section 6; EEMUA Publication 191; NERC CIP-007

attributes.name: alarm_duration_seconds
attributes.description: The elapsed time in seconds between alarm trigger (reading_timestamp) and alarm cleared (cleared_timestamp). Used for ISA-18.2 alarm flood analysis, chattering alarm detection (alarms clearing and re-triggering rapidly), and post-event reliability analysis. Null if alarm is still active or not an alarm record.
attributes.references: ISA-18.2 Alarm Management Standard Section 6; EEMUA Publication 191; NERC EOP-004

attributes.name: alarm_point_ref
attributes.description: The unique identifier or tag reference of the SCADA alarm point as configured in the DMS/EMS alarm management system (e.g., 'ALM_SUB_NORTH_BKR101_THERMAL'). Used to cross-reference alarm events back to the alarm rationalization register and ISA-18.2 master alarm database.
attributes.references: ISA-18.2 Alarm Management Standard; GE PowerOn DMS Alarm Configuration; EEMUA Publication 191

attributes.name: alarm_priority
attributes.description: The ISA-18.2 priority level assigned to the alarm (critical, high, medium, low, advisory). Drives operator response urgency, alarm flood analysis, and alarm rationalization reviews. Null for non-alarm readings.
attributes.references: ISA-18.2 Alarm Management Standard Section 5; EEMUA Publication 191 Chapter 4

attributes.name: alarm_state
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the alarm per ISA-18.2 alarm management workflow (active = unacknowledged and in alarm, acknowledged = operator has acknowledged, cleared = condition returned to normal, shelved = temporarily removed from annunciation, suppressed = disabled by design). Null for non-alarm readings.
attributes.references: ISA-18.2 Alarm Management Standard Section 4; GE PowerOn DMS Alarm Console

attributes.name: alarm_threshold
attributes.description: The configured setpoint or limit value that, when crossed by the measured value, triggers the alarm (e.g., 110 MW thermal limit, 0.95 pu voltage low limit, 59.95 Hz under-frequency threshold). Supports alarm rationalization and threshold optimization analysis.
attributes.references: ISA-18.2 Alarm Management Standard; NERC FAC-001; NERC PRC-024 Frequency Ride-Through

attributes.name: alarm_type
attributes.description: Classifies the category of alarm event when is_alarm is True (e.g., thermal_overload, voltage_violation, equipment_failure, comm_loss, protection_operation, frequency_deviation). Null for non-alarm telemetry readings. Drives alarm rationalization and root-cause categorization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: thermal_overload|voltage_violation|equipment_failure|comm_loss|protection_operation|frequency_deviation|overcurrent|earth_fault — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISA-18.2 Alarm Management Standard; EEMUA Publication 191; NERC PRC-005

attributes.name: analog_value
attributes.description: The numeric measured value for analog SCADA points (e.g., 345.7 kV, 150.3 MW, 60.02 Hz, 1250 amps). This is the principal EVENT_PAYLOAD_OR_VALUE for analog readings. Null for digital state points. Stored in the engineering unit defined by engineering_unit.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Analog Point; IEC 61970 CIM AnalogValue; NERC MOD-032

attributes.name: balancing_area_code
attributes.description: The NERC-registered Balancing Authority Area code within which this SCADA point operates (e.g., the utility's registered BA identifier with NERC/FERC). Required for NERC reliability compliance reporting, RTO/ISO market settlement, and balancing area control performance (CPS1/CPS2) analysis.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-001 Real Power Balancing; FERC Order 888; NERC Functional Model

attributes.name: cleared_timestamp
attributes.description: The UTC timestamp at which the alarm condition returned to normal and the alarm was cleared. Used to calculate alarm duration and time-to-clear (TTC) for post-event analysis and alarm flood studies. Null if alarm is still active or not an alarm record.
attributes.references: ISA-18.2 Alarm Management Standard; EEMUA Publication 191; GE PowerOn DMS

attributes.name: communication_protocol
attributes.description: The SCADA communication protocol used to transmit this reading from the field device to the EMS/DMS (e.g., DNP3, IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, Modbus, ICCP for inter-control-center). Supports protocol-level diagnostics and NERC CIP-007 communication security assessments.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-007 R3 Security Patches; IEC 61850 Communication Standard; DNP3 IEEE 1815

attributes.name: compression_deviation
attributes.description: The PI Historian compression deviation (swinging door algorithm tolerance) applied to this tag. Determines how aggressively PI compresses the time-series data. Understanding compression settings is essential for accurate signal reconstruction in load forecasting and post-event analysis.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Compression Algorithm; NERC MOD-032 Data Submission

attributes.name: digital_state
attributes.description: The discrete state value for digital SCADA points representing equipment status (e.g., breaker open/closed, switch status, protection relay trip/normal, recloser enabled/disabled). Null for analog measurement points. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|closed|trip|lockout|normal|abnormal|on|off|enabled|disabled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Digital State Set; IEC 61970 CIM DiscreteValue; GE PowerOn DMS

attributes.name: engineering_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the analog_value (e.g., MW, MVAR, kV, Hz, A for amps, °C, psi, MCF). Ensures correct interpretation of numeric readings across different measurement types and supports dimensional analysis in grid operations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MW|MVAR|MVA|kV|Hz|A|°C|°F|psi|MCF|therm|%|pu|tap — 14 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IEC 61968/61970 CIM UnitSymbol; NIST SP 811 Units of Measurement; OSIsoft PI Historian Engineering Units

attributes.name: exception_deviation
attributes.description: The configured exception deviation (deadband) value for this PI tag — the minimum change in analog value required to trigger a new archive event in PI Historian. A reading is stored only when the value changes by more than this amount. Used to understand data compression behavior and reconstruct continuous signal profiles.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Exception and Compression Settings; IEC 61968/61970 CIM

attributes.name: ferc_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the asset associated with this SCADA point falls under FERC jurisdictional transmission (interstate), state PUC jurisdictional distribution, or is exempt. Determines applicable regulatory reporting requirements for FERC Form 1, NERC reliability standards, and rate case filings.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; Federal Power Act Section 201; NERC Functional Model

attributes.name: ingested_timestamp
attributes.description: The UTC timestamp at which this record was written into the Silver layer lakehouse table. Used to measure data latency, detect backfill scenarios, and support audit trails. Distinct from reading_timestamp which reflects the real-world event time.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Buffering; Databricks Delta Lake Audit

attributes.name: is_alarm
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents an alarm event (True) or a routine telemetry reading (False). Partitions the dataset for alarm management workflows, ISA-18.2 alarm rationalization analysis, and operator performance review.
attributes.references: ISA-18.2 Alarm Management Standard; EEMUA Publication 191; GE PowerOn DMS Alarm Management

attributes.name: is_shelved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the alarm has been temporarily shelved (removed from active annunciation for a defined period) per ISA-18.2 shelving practice. Shelved alarms are excluded from alarm flood counts but must be tracked for rationalization audits.
attributes.references: ISA-18.2 Alarm Management Standard Section 4.4; EEMUA Publication 191

attributes.name: is_suppressed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the alarm is in a suppressed (by-design disabled) state, such as during planned maintenance or equipment outage. Suppressed alarms must be documented and reviewed per ISA-18.2 alarm rationalization requirements.
attributes.references: ISA-18.2 Alarm Management Standard Section 4.5; EEMUA Publication 191; NERC PRC-005

attributes.name: measurement_type
attributes.description: The engineering quantity being measured by this SCADA point (e.g., MW for real power, MVAR for reactive power, kV for voltage, Hz for frequency, amps for current, temperature_c for equipment temperature, flow_mcf for gas flow). Drives unit-of-measure validation and alarm threshold interpretation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MW|MVAR|kV|Hz|amps|temperature_c|MVA|power_factor|tap_position|flow_mcf|pressure_psi|status — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IEC 61968/61970 CIM MeasurementType; IEEE C37.118; NERC MOD-032

attributes.name: nerc_cip_asset_class
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) Asset Classification
attributes.description: The NERC CIP Bulk Electric System (BES) asset classification for the asset associated with this SCADA point (BES_high, BES_medium, BES_low, non_BES). Determines applicable NERC CIP cybersecurity standards (CIP-002 through CIP-014) and access control requirements for this telemetry data.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-002-5.1a BES Cyber System Categorization; NERC CIP-007 R4 Security Event Logging

attributes.name: pi_archive_name
attributes.description: The name of the OSIsoft PI Historian archive file or data archive from which this reading was extracted (e.g., 'PI_ARCHIVE_2024_Q1'). Supports data lineage, archive retrieval for post-event analysis, and Silver layer backfill reconciliation.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Archive Management; Databricks Delta Lake Data Lineage

attributes.name: pi_tag_code
attributes.description: Reference to the PI Historian tag (SCADA point) that emitted this reading. Serves as the EVENT_SOURCE_REFERENCE linking the observation back to the originating sensor or control point definition.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Tag Configuration; NERC CIP-007 R4

attributes.name: point_name
attributes.description: The human-readable PI tag name or SCADA point descriptor as configured in OSIsoft PI Historian (e.g., 'SUB_NORTH_BKR_101_STATUS', 'GEN_UNIT3_MW_OUTPUT'). Serves as the primary EVENT_TYPE_OR_CHANNEL discriminator and the operational label used by grid operators.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Tag Naming Convention; GE PowerOn DMS Point Configuration

attributes.name: point_type
attributes.description: Classifies the SCADA point as analog (continuous measurement), digital (discrete state), accumulator (pulse count/energy total), string (text state), or calculated (derived value). Determines how the reading_value and digital_state fields are interpreted.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Point Class; IEC 61968/61970 CIM AnalogValue/DiscreteValue

attributes.name: quality_code
attributes.description: OSIsoft PI Historian quality descriptor indicating the reliability of the reading (e.g., good = valid telemetry, bad = hardware/comm failure, uncertain = questionable signal, substituted = manually entered replacement, stale = no update within scan cycle). Critical for filtering unreliable data in operational analytics and NERC compliance evidence. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: good|bad|uncertain|substituted|manual|stale|comm_fail|out_of_scan — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Quality Codes; IEC 61968/61970 CIM Quality61968; NERC CIP-007 R4

attributes.name: raw_value_string
attributes.description: The original unparsed string representation of the SCADA point value as received from the RTU/IED before type conversion and engineering unit scaling. Preserved for data quality investigation, protocol debugging, and Silver layer reconciliation against the Bronze raw landing zone.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Raw Data; Databricks Delta Lake Bronze-to-Silver Lineage

attributes.name: reading_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise UTC timestamp at which the SCADA point value was sampled or the alarm event was triggered, as recorded by OSIsoft PI Historian. This is the principal EVENT_TIMESTAMP and the primary time axis for all operational analysis, post-event review, and NERC compliance evidence.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Timestamp; IEEE C37.118 Synchrophasor Standard; NERC CIP-007 R4

attributes.name: rtu_code
attributes.description: The identifier of the Remote Terminal Unit (RTU) or Intelligent Electronic Device (IED) that collected and transmitted this SCADA reading to the EMS/DMS. Supports communication path diagnostics, RTU performance monitoring, and NERC CIP-007 device inventory tracking.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-007 R2 Ports and Services; IEC 60870-5-101/104 RTU Protocol; GE PowerOn DMS RTU Configuration

attributes.name: scan_rate_seconds
attributes.description: The configured polling interval in seconds at which this SCADA point is scanned by the RTU/IED and reported to PI Historian (e.g., 2 seconds for critical protection points, 30 seconds for non-critical analog measurements). Used to detect stale data and validate scan cycle compliance.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Scan Class; NERC CIP-007 R4; IEC 61850 GOOSE Messaging

attributes.name: shelve_expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: The UTC timestamp at which a shelved alarm is scheduled to automatically return to active annunciation. Supports ISA-18.2 shelving time-limit enforcement and alarm rationalization audit trails. Null if alarm is not shelved.
attributes.references: ISA-18.2 Alarm Management Standard Section 4.4; GE PowerOn DMS Alarm Shelving

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that originated or forwarded this reading to the Silver layer (e.g., PI_Historian for OSIsoft PI, EMS for Energy Management System, DMS for GE PowerOn Distribution Management System, OMS for Outage Management System, DERMS for Distributed Energy Resource Management). Supports data lineage and cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian; GE PowerOn Advanced DMS/OMS; NERC CIP-007

attributes.name: substitution_reason
attributes.description: When quality_code is 'substituted', this field records the reason the original telemetry value was replaced (e.g., manual_entry by operator, estimated from adjacent readings, comm_failure_fill during communication outage, maintenance_hold during planned work). Required for NERC compliance evidence and data quality audit trails.
attributes.references: NERC MOD-032 Data Submission; OSIsoft PI Historian Manual Data Entry; NERC CIP-007

attributes.name: time_to_acknowledge_seconds
attributes.description: The elapsed time in seconds between the alarm trigger (reading_timestamp) and operator acknowledgment (acknowledged_timestamp). Pre-computed at ingestion time for ISA-18.2 alarm response time KPI reporting and operator performance review. Null for non-alarm records or unacknowledged alarms.
attributes.references: ISA-18.2 Alarm Management Standard Section 6; EEMUA Publication 191 KPI Metrics

attributes.name: trigger_value
attributes.description: The actual measured value at the moment the alarm condition was triggered (e.g., 112.5 MW when a 110 MW thermal limit was exceeded). Enables post-event analysis of how far the measured value deviated from the threshold. Null for non-alarm readings.
attributes.references: ISA-18.2 Alarm Management Standard; NERC FAC-001; GE PowerOn DMS

attributes.name: voltage_level_kv
attributes.description: The nominal voltage level in kilovolts (kV) of the bus, line, or equipment associated with this SCADA point (e.g., 345 kV transmission, 138 kV sub-transmission, 12.47 kV distribution). Used to classify readings by voltage tier for T&D performance analysis and NERC FAC compliance.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001 Facility Design; FERC Form 1; IEC 60038 Standard Voltages

products.name: ems_dispatch_instruction
products.description: Records each generation dispatch instruction issued by the Energy Management System (EMS) to generating units or controllable resources within the balancing area. Captures MW setpoint, ramp rate, dispatch reason (economic, reliability, regulation), issuing operator, and acknowledgment status. Integrates with AGC (Automatic Generation Control) and manual operator actions.

attributes.name: ems_dispatch_instruction_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Energy Management System (EMS) Dispatch Instruction ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each EMS dispatch instruction record in the balancing area. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: balancing_area_id
attributes.description: Reference to the balancing authority area within which this dispatch instruction is issued. Aligns with NERC balancing area definitions.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-001; NERC BAL-002; FERC Order 888

attributes.name: bus_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pricing node at which the Locational Marginal Price (LMP) applies for this dispatch instruction. Used for economic dispatch optimization and settlement calculations.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888; FERC Order 719; RTO/ISO LMP methodology

attributes.name: der_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to der.program. Business justification: EMS dispatch may include specific DER program instructions for ancillary services; operators need the program reference.

attributes.name: distribution_switching_order_id
