domains.name: metering
domains.description: Owns all meter asset records, AMI device configurations, interval read data, and meter data validation, estimation, and editing (VEE) workflows. Serves as the SSOT for meter-to-premise associations, register reads, interval energy data (kWh, MCF, Therms), meter events, and data quality. Managed through Oracle Utilities MDM. Supports TOU, RTP, and CPP rate structures and feeds billing with validated consumption.
domains.references: ANSI C12.19/C12.20, NAESB REQ.21 AMI, NIST Smart Grid

products.name: meter
products.description: Master record for every physical meter device deployed across the service territory, covering both electric (AMI/AMR) and gas meters. Stores device identity, manufacturer, model, firmware version, communication module type, meter form factor, voltage class, CT/PT ratios, dial multiplier, number of dials, seal number, AMI endpoint ID, communication protocol (ANSI C12.18/C12.19), installation status, and lifecycle state. Sourced from Oracle Utilities MDM and Maximo EAM. SSOT for meter asset identity in the metering domain.

attributes.name: meter_id
attributes.description: Primary key for meter

attributes.name: asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.registry. Business justification: Asset Management process requires linking each physical meter to its asset record for depreciation, work‑order assignment, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: distribution_service_point_id
attributes.description: Reference to the logical service delivery point representing the utility-customer interconnection. One service point may have multiple meters (e.g., generation and consumption). Used for billing aggregation and rate application.

attributes.name: distribution_transformer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution transformer serving this meter. Used for load balancing, outage analysis, and grid planning. Critical for AMI-based transformer load management and phase identification.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Revenue recognition per meter posts sales to a specific GL account; required for monthly revenue statements.

attributes.name: installer_technician_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.technician. Business justification: Installation Process: records which technician installed the meter for warranty, compliance, and asset‑management reporting.

attributes.name: it_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the AMI communication endpoint or network interface card attached to or embedded in the meter. Used for network provisioning, firmware updates, and outage detection.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM - AMI Endpoint Configuration

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical installation location of the meter. Links to asset location registry with GPS coordinates, address, and GIS spatial data. Used for field dispatch, outage correlation, and service territory mapping.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material_master. Business justification: Needed for asset cost tracking and inventory reconciliation, linking each meter to its material master part number.

attributes.name: pole_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.pole. Business justification: Required for field crew maintenance and outage response reports that map each meter to its mounting pole, enabling precise asset location and work order generation.

attributes.name: premise_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service premise (property/building) where the meter is installed. Critical link between metering, billing, and customer systems. Supports multi-meter premises and meter-to-premise history.

attributes.name: scada_system_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.scada_system. Business justification: SCADA Integration process assigns each meter to a SCADA system for remote reading and regulatory data submission.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.vendor. Business justification: Required for warranty management and vendor performance reports that tie each installed meter to its supplying vendor.

attributes.name: vpp_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engagement.vpp_agreement. Business justification: VPP Participation Agreements list the meters enrolled for dispatch; regulatory filing mandates explicit meter identifiers.

attributes.name: accuracy_class
attributes.description: ANSI accuracy classification indicating maximum allowable measurement error as a percentage of full scale. Lower numbers indicate higher precision. Determines testing frequency and revenue-grade certification requirements.
attributes.references: ANSI C12.20 - Electricity Meters Accuracy Classes

attributes.name: communication_protocol
attributes.description: Technical protocol standard used for meter-to-headend communication (e.g., ANSI C12.18, ANSI C12.19, DLMS/COSEM, Zigbee, cellular). Determines data format, security requirements, and system integration approach.
attributes.references: ANSI C12.18 - Protocol Specification for ANSI Type 2 Optical Port, ANSI C12.19 - Utility Industry End Device Data Tables

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this meter record was first created in the MDM system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and system integration reconciliation. Immutable after initial creation.

attributes.name: ct_ratio
attributes.description: Current transformer ratio for instrument-rated meters (e.g., 200:5, 400:5). Used to calculate actual consumption from meter readings. Null for self-contained meters. Critical for accurate billing calculations.
attributes.references: IEEE C57.13 - Standard Requirements for Instrument Transformers

attributes.name: current_rating_amps
attributes.description: Maximum continuous current rating of the electric meter in amperes. Determines meter capacity and must align with service entrance equipment ratings. Used for load analysis and meter sizing validation.
attributes.references: ANSI C12.1 - Electric Meters Code for Electricity Metering

attributes.name: demand_metering_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the meter measures and records peak demand (kW) in addition to energy consumption (kWh). Required for commercial/industrial rate structures with demand charges. Determines billing calculation logic.
attributes.references: ANSI C12.1 - Electric Meters Code for Electricity Metering

attributes.name: expected_life_years
attributes.business_glossary_term: Meter Expected Service Life in Years
attributes.description: Estimated useful life of the meter asset in years for depreciation and replacement planning. Typically 15-30 years depending on technology and service class. Used for capital planning and rate case filings.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts - Depreciation Rates

attributes.name: firmware_version
attributes.description: Current firmware version installed on the meter device. Critical for security patch management, feature enablement, and compatibility with MDM system. Format varies by manufacturer.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-003 - Cyber Security Management Controls

attributes.name: form
attributes.description: ANSI standard form designation indicating meter socket configuration and wiring arrangement (e.g., Form 2S, Form 12S, Form 16S). Determines physical installation requirements and measurement capabilities.
attributes.references: ANSI C12.10 - Physical Aspects of Watthour Meters

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date the meter was physically installed at the current service location. Used for age analysis, warranty tracking, and lifecycle management. Distinct from manufacturing date.

attributes.name: installation_status
attributes.description: Current physical deployment state of the meter asset. Installed indicates active field deployment. In_stock indicates warehouse inventory. In_shop indicates repair/testing. Retired indicates end-of-life but not yet disposed.

attributes.name: last_communication_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of most recent successful data exchange between the meter and the MDM headend system. Used for communication health monitoring, outage detection, and data quality assessment.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM - Device Communication Log

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the company that manufactured the meter device (e.g., Landis+Gyr, Itron, Sensus, Elster, Aclara). Used for warranty tracking, firmware compatibility, and vendor performance analysis.

attributes.name: meter_class
attributes.description: Customer service class designation for the meter installation. Determines applicable tariffs, demand response eligibility, and regulatory rate class assignment.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts - Account 370

attributes.name: meter_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned serial number stamped on the physical meter device. Externally visible identifier used for field operations, inventory tracking, and regulatory reporting. Must be unique across the service territory.
attributes.references: ANSI C12.1 - Electric Meters Code for Electricity Metering

attributes.name: meter_type
attributes.description: Type of utility commodity measured by this meter device. Determines applicable rate structures, measurement units, and regulatory reporting requirements.

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer model designation identifying the specific meter product line and configuration. Used to determine technical specifications, communication protocols, and compatible firmware versions.
attributes.references: ANSI C12.1 - Electric Meters Code for Electricity Metering

attributes.name: multiplier
attributes.description: Numeric multiplier applied to meter register readings to calculate actual consumption. Derived from CT/PT ratios and meter configuration. Essential for accurate billing and energy accounting.

attributes.name: net_metering_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the meter supports bidirectional energy measurement for customer-owned generation (solar, wind). True for NEM-eligible installations. Requires meter capable of measuring both delivered and received energy.

attributes.name: next_test_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for next required accuracy test or recertification. Calculated based on last test date and regulatory testing interval. Used for compliance tracking and preventive maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: number_of_dials
attributes.description: Count of mechanical register dials on the meter face for manual reading. Determines reading format and maximum register capacity. Typically 4-6 dials for residential, more for commercial/industrial.
attributes.references: ANSI C12.1 - Electric Meters Code for Electricity Metering

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state indicating whether the meter is actively measuring and reporting consumption. Active meters generate billable reads. Failed meters require replacement. Testing indicates commissioning or troubleshooting.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Legal ownership designation for the meter asset. Utility_owned meters are capitalized assets. Customer_owned meters are tracked for service but not depreciated. Third_party indicates DER or submetering arrangements.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts - Account 370

attributes.name: pt_ratio
attributes.description: Potential transformer ratio for high-voltage metering installations (e.g., 7200:120). Used with CT ratio to calculate actual energy consumption. Null for low-voltage self-contained meters.
attributes.references: IEEE C57.13 - Standard Requirements for Instrument Transformers

attributes.name: purchase_cost
attributes.business_glossary_term: Meter Purchase Cost in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Original acquisition cost of the meter device in USD. Used for asset capitalization, depreciation calculations, and rate base reporting. Includes device cost only, not installation labor.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts - Account 370, FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: purchase_date
attributes.description: Date the utility acquired the meter from the manufacturer or vendor. Used for warranty tracking, depreciation calculations, and procurement analytics. May differ from installation date.

attributes.name: read_cycle
attributes.description: Billing cycle designation indicating when the meter is read each month (e.g., cycle 01 = 1st-5th of month). Used for billing schedule coordination and read validation. Typically 20-30 cycles per service territory.

attributes.name: register_capacity_kwh
attributes.description: Maximum cumulative energy value the meter register can display before rolling over to zero. Used to detect and correct rollover events in consumption calculations. Measured in kilowatt-hours for electric meters.
attributes.references: ANSI C12.1 - Electric Meters Code for Electricity Metering

attributes.name: remote_disconnect_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the meter has an integrated service switch that can be remotely controlled to connect or disconnect service. Used for credit management, move-in/move-out automation, and emergency load shedding.
attributes.references: NIST Smart Grid Framework - AMI Functional Requirements

attributes.name: removal_date
attributes.description: Date the meter was removed from service at a premise. Null for currently installed meters. Used for lifecycle tracking, final billing, and asset disposition workflows.

attributes.name: route_code
attributes.description: Geographic route assignment for manual meter reading or field inspection. Used for workforce scheduling and route optimization. May be null for AMI meters with automated reading.

attributes.name: seal_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the tamper-evident seal applied to the meter enclosure. Used to detect unauthorized access, meter tampering, and theft of service. Recorded during installation and verified during field inspections.

attributes.name: test_date
attributes.description: Date of most recent accuracy test or calibration performed on the meter. Used to schedule periodic testing per regulatory requirements and manufacturer recommendations. Typically required every 5-15 years depending on jurisdiction.

attributes.name: time_of_use_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the meter is configured to collect interval data for time-differentiated rate structures. True for meters supporting TOU, CPP, or RTP rates. Requires AMI technology and MDM interval data processing.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of most recent modification to any field in this meter record. Used for change data capture, downstream system synchronization, and data quality monitoring. Updated automatically on every record change.

attributes.name: voltage_class
attributes.description: Nominal voltage rating for electric meters indicating the electrical service level. Used for safety compliance, meter selection, and grid operations. Primary voltage indicates high-voltage metering with instrument transformers.
attributes.references: ANSI C12.1 - Electric Meters Code for Electricity Metering

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date the manufacturer warranty coverage expires. Used to determine repair vs. replace decisions and vendor claim eligibility. Typically 5-10 years from purchase date.

products.name: meter_configuration
products.description: AMI device configuration record defining the programmed settings for each meter, including measurement channels, register configuration, TOU schedule assignment, demand interval length (15/30/60 min), load profile recording settings, outage detection thresholds, tamper detection flags, remote connect/disconnect capability flag, firmware version deployed, and last configuration push timestamp. Tracks the active configuration profile applied to a meter at any point in time. Supports TOU, RTP, and CPP rate structure configurations.

attributes.name: meter_configuration_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate key for each meter configuration record.

attributes.name: meter_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the meter to which this configuration applies.

attributes.name: product_rate_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Critical Peak Pricing rate plan associated with this configuration.

attributes.name: tariff_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Real‑Time Pricing rate plan associated with this configuration.

attributes.name: technician_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.technician. Business justification: Configuration Change Control: ties configuration updates to the authorizing technician, needed for audit trails and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: tou_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Time‑of‑Use schedule applied by this configuration.

attributes.name: config_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the configuration profile.

attributes.name: config_name
attributes.description: Human‑readable name for the configuration profile.

attributes.name: config_type
attributes.description: Category of rate structure the configuration supports (e.g., Time‑of‑Use, Real‑Time Pricing, Critical Peak Pricing).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the configuration record was initially created.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0‑100) representing overall data quality of the configuration's measurements.

attributes.name: demand_interval_length_minutes
attributes.description: Length of the demand measurement interval used for demand‑side analytics.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the configuration ceases to be effective (null if open‑ended).

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the configuration becomes effective for the meter.

attributes.name: estimation_method
attributes.description: Method used to estimate missing or estimated interval data for this configuration.

attributes.name: firmware_version
attributes.description: Version of the meter firmware to which this configuration applies.

attributes.name: interval_length_minutes
attributes.description: Length of the measurement interval for energy consumption reads (e.g., 15, 30, 60).

attributes.name: last_push_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time when the configuration was last pushed to the meter.

attributes.name: load_profile_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether detailed load‑profile recording is enabled.

attributes.name: meter_configuration_description
attributes.description: Free‑form text describing the purpose and details of the configuration.

attributes.name: meter_configuration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the configuration.

attributes.name: outage_detection_threshold
attributes.description: Power threshold (in kilowatts) used to detect a potential outage.

attributes.name: remote_connect_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the meter can be remotely connected (energized) via the configuration.

attributes.name: remote_disconnect_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the meter can be remotely disconnected (de‑energized) via the configuration.

attributes.name: tamper_detection_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether tamper detection logic is active for the meter.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who last updated the configuration record.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the configuration record.

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Result of the configuration validation workflow.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the configuration profile.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who created the configuration record.

products.name: meter_premise
products.description: Time-bounded association record establishing which meter is installed at which metering service point, including NEM bidirectional metering configuration flags and net metering register indicators for customers with on-site generation
products.reference: Oracle Utilities MDM Service Point Device Installation

attributes.name: meter_premise_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate key for each meter-premise association record.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Premise‑level installation and service costs are charged to a cost center for expense tracking.

attributes.name: meter_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the physical meter device assigned to the premise.

attributes.name: premise_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the service point (premise) where the meter is installed.

attributes.name: association_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the meter‑premise relationship, used in operational and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: association_type
attributes.description: Classification of the relationship (e.g., primary service meter, secondary backup meter).

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free‑form notes regarding the meter‑premise relationship, such as special installation conditions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the association record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date when the meter became officially associated with the premise.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date when the association ends or is scheduled to end; null if open‑ended.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date the meter was physically installed at the premise.

attributes.name: last_validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent data validation run for this association.

attributes.name: measurement_unit
attributes.description: Unit of energy or volume measured by the meter (kilowatt‑hour, thousand cubic feet, therm).

attributes.name: meter_premise_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the meter‑premise association.

attributes.name: meter_status
attributes.description: Current operational condition of the meter device.

attributes.name: net_metering_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the premise participates in net metering (bidirectional flow).

attributes.name: net_metering_register
attributes.description: Specifies which register(s) capture net‑metered energy.

attributes.name: rate_structure
attributes.description: Rate plan applied to the meter (Time‑of‑Use, Real‑Time Pricing, Critical Peak Pricing, or Flat).

attributes.name: register_type
attributes.description: Type of register captured (total consumption, peak demand, off‑peak, etc.).

attributes.name: removal_date
attributes.description: Date the meter was removed or decommissioned; null if still active.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the association record.

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Result of the latest validation process for the meter‑premise data.

products.name: metering_service_point
products.description: Master record for each utility service delivery point representing the fixed physical location where energy measurement occurs. Stores service point identifier, service address, GPS coordinates, premise type (residential/commercial/industrial), service voltage level, phase configuration (single/three-phase), distribution transformer reference, feeder reference, gas pressure zone, service type (electric/gas), NEM eligibility flag, and AMI communication attributes (endpoint serial, comm technology, signal strength, last communication timestamp). Unlike meter_premise which tracks which meter is installed where over time, this entity represents the permanent location itself. The SSOT for service point identity and AMI connectivity status within the metering domain.

attributes.name: large_customer_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the service point record.

attributes.name: metering_service_point_id
attributes.description: Primary key for service_point

attributes.name: balancing_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gridops.balancing_area. Business justification: Required for load forecasting and ISO reporting; each service point must be assigned to its balancing area to aggregate demand per market region.

attributes.name: control_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gridops.control_zone. Business justification: Needed for voltage regulation and demand‑response coordination; control zones manage distribution assets and service points are mapped to them for operational decisions.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Service‑point OPEX cost allocation to cost centers is used in distribution expense reporting.

attributes.name: cycle_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the billing cycle applicable to the service point.

attributes.name: distribution_transformer_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary distribution transformer serving the point.

attributes.name: feeder_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the electric feeder line associated with the service point.

attributes.name: meter_read_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to metering.meter_read_schedule. Business justification: A service point follows a reading schedule; linking service point to meter_read_schedule enables schedule lookup without duplication.

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.parcel. Business justification: Required for Service Point to Parcel Mapping Report used in billing, regulatory compliance, and NEM eligibility calculations.

attributes.name: primary_meter_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the currently active meter serving the point.

attributes.name: product_rate_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.rate_schedule. Business justification: Direct link to the applicable rate_schedule for the service point; needed for accurate charge calculation and rate schedule version tracking.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.purchase_order. Business justification: Supports mapping service points to the purchase order that supplied the primary meter for cost allocation and audit compliance.

attributes.name: rate_season_calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.rate_season_calendar. Business justification: Seasonal calendar determines seasonal rate applicability for a service point; required for seasonal pricing compliance and reporting.

attributes.name: scada_system_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.scada_system. Business justification: Service‑point level SCADA mapping is required for outage management and compliance reporting, linking each point to its SCADA system.

attributes.name: transmission_substation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to transmission.transmission_substation. Business justification: Required for Substation‑Service Point Mapping report used in outage impact analysis and load forecasting (max 50 words).

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Capital project budgeting tracks upgrades to service points via WBS elements in the project hierarchy.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the service point.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address information (suite, unit, etc.).

attributes.name: ami_communication_technology
attributes.description: Technology used for AMI data transmission.

attributes.name: ami_endpoint_serial
attributes.description: Serial number of the AMI communication endpoint installed at the point.

attributes.name: ami_signal_strength

products.name: interval_read
products.description: High-frequency interval energy measurement record captured by AMI meters at configured intervals (typically 15, 30, or 60 minutes). Stores energy delivered (kWh), energy received (kWh for NEM/DER customers), reactive energy (kVAR), demand (kW), gas volume (MCF/Therms), interval start timestamp, interval end timestamp, interval duration, channel number, raw measured value, and initial quality code before VEE processing. products.name: vee_result
products.description: Validation, Estimation, and Editing (VEE) processing outcome record and the domain's consolidated data quality management entity. Each record represents a VEE processing result for an interval or register read, storing: original raw value, VEE rule applied, validation outcome (pass/fail/estimated/edited), estimation algorithm used (weather-based/similar-day/linear interpolation), edited value, processing timestamp, and override reason code. Also serves as the SSOT for all data quality issue tracking within the metering domain: captures issue type (spike/gap/negative/rollover/communication failure/anomalous consumption/missing reads), affected date range, number of affected intervals, assigned analyst, investigation notes, resolution status, resolution action taken, root cause classification, and escalation history. Supports both automated VEE pipeline outcomes and manual data quality investigation workflows. Core to Oracle Utilities MDM VEE processing, regulatory reporting on estimated bill percentages, and SLA compliance for data completeness.

products.name: enrollment
products.description: Unified transactional and master record capturing a customer's enrollment, participation, and disenrollment lifecycle in any utility program, tariff rider, or special service offering. Program types include: NEM (Net Energy Metering) with interconnection attributes (system capacity kW-DC, inverter type, export limit, NEM version, true-up period, annual true-up date); DR (Demand Response) with dispatch attributes (enrolled load kW, curtailment obligation, control method, notification lead time, ISO/RTO registration reference); budget billing with levelized payment attributes (monthly amount, true-up balance, review date, calculation basis); TOU, CPP, auto-pay, paperless billing, CARE/FERA, and LIHEAP assistance programs. Core attributes across all types: enrollment date, effective date, program code, program type discriminator, enrollment channel (web, call center, field), enrollment status lifecycle, cancellation reason, and associated service agreement reference. Distinct from the program catalog owned by the product domain. Supports polymorphic conditional attributes by program type.

domains.name: billing
domains.description: Single source of truth for all revenue transactions including invoice generation, rate schedule application, payment processing, adjustments, deposits, disputes, and collections. Manages residential and commercial billing cycles, TOU/CPP/RTP rate calculations, and revenue recognition per FASB ASC 980. Supports GRC and ROE reporting. Integrates with Oracle CC&B and SAP FI/CO for revenue posting.
domains.references: FASB ASC 980, FERC Uniform System of Accounts, PUC Tariff Requirements

products.name: bill
products.description: Core billing document representing the periodic invoice issued to a residential or commercial customer for energy consumption (kWh, MCF, Therm) and applicable charges. Captures billing period, due date, total amount due, bill type (regular, final, corrected), bill status, and source system reference from Oracle CC&B. Serves as the SSOT for all customer-facing billing documents and is the anchor entity for revenue recognition per FASB ASC 980.

products.name: billing_account
products.description: Financial account entity representing the billable customer relationship for energy service delivery. Captures account number, account class (residential, commercial, industrial), billing cycle assignment, budget billing enrollment, paperless billing preference, auto-pay enrollment, credit score, deposit balance, current account balance, and current arrears balance. Serves as the SSOT for customer account balance and arrears tracking — all monetary movements (bills, payments, adjustments, deposits) update this entity's balance fields. Anchor for all billing transactions and the billing-domain counterpart to the customer master. One customer may have multiple billing accounts across service locations.

products.name: adjustment

products.name: collection_action
products.description: Record of a collections action taken against a delinquent customer billing account, including dunning notices, disconnect warnings, field disconnect orders, payment arrangement offers, and agency referrals. Captures action type (dunning letter, disconnect notice, field order, agency referral, service termination), action date, delinquent amount at action time, days past due, response received flag, next action scheduled date, and regulatory compliance flags (winter moratorium, medical certificate hold, COVID protection). Supports the end-to-end collections lifecycle, regulatory disconnect moratorium compliance, and bad debt forecasting.

products.name: assistance
products.description: Customer enrollment record in a utility assistance program (LIHEAP, CARE, FERA, medical baseline, or utility-specific hardship programs). Captures program code, program name, eligibility criteria reference, enrollment date, expiration date, recertification due date, benefit type (percentage discount, fixed credit, arrears forgiveness), benefit amount or discount rate, enrollment status, income verification status, household size, and program-specific eligibility documentation flags. Tracks active participation of individual billing accounts in assistance programs, drives automated bill credit application, and supports PUC-mandated program participation reporting.

products.description: This association captures the enrollment of a billing account in a safety program. Each record links one billing account to one safety program and stores attributes that are specific to the enrollment such as the start date and compliance status.. domains.name: trading
domains.description: Energy trading and risk management including wholesale power purchases, PPAs, REC transactions, DAM and RTM market participation, hedging strategies, portfolio optimization, and ancillary services. Manages trading positions, counterparty contracts, LMP-based settlements, mark-to-market valuations, and market exposure. Integrates with Allegro ETRM for position management and risk reporting.
domains.references: FERC Order 2000, CFTC Dodd-Frank Reporting, RTO/ISO, EIA

products.name: counterparty
products.description: Master record for all trading counterparties including wholesale power buyers/sellers, financial institutions, ISOs/RTOs, PPA offtakers, and fuel suppliers. Captures legal entity details, credit ratings (S&P/Moody's), FERC/NERC registration status, DUNS number, jurisdiction, counterparty type (utility, marketer, financial, ISO, generator), approved credit limit, current credit exposure, collateral requirements (CSA terms), netting agreement flag, master agreement references (ISDA/NAESB/EEI), and credit watch status. Serves as the SSOT for counterparty identity, credit profile, and exposure management within the trading domain.

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the trading counterparty. Primary key for the counterparty master record.

attributes.name: approved_credit_limit_usd
attributes.description: Maximum unsecured credit exposure approved for this counterparty in US dollars, representing the aggregate mark-to-market value of open positions before collateral posting is required.
attributes.references: Credit Risk Management Policy, ISDA Credit Support Annex

attributes.name: collateral_held_usd
attributes.description: Total value of collateral (cash, letters of credit, guarantees) currently held from this counterparty to secure trading obligations, denominated in US dollars.
attributes.references: ISDA Credit Support Annex, Collateral Management Standards

attributes.name: collateral_posted_usd
attributes.description: Total value of collateral posted by the utility to this counterparty to secure trading obligations, denominated in US dollars.
attributes.references: ISDA Credit Support Annex, Collateral Management Standards

attributes.name: counterparty_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the counterparty relationship: active (approved for trading), suspended (temporarily restricted), inactive (no current trading), credit_watch (under credit review), terminated (relationship ended).

attributes.name: counterparty_type
attributes.description: Classification of the counterparty based on their role in energy markets: utility (regulated electric/gas utility), marketer (wholesale power/gas marketer), financial_institution (bank or trading firm), iso_rto (Independent System Operator or Regional Transmission Organization), generator (power generation company), fuel_supplier (coal, natural gas, uranium supplier).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this counterparty record was first created in the system, used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards, Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: credit_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the credit contact for credit-related communications, margin calls, and collateral requests.

attributes.name: credit_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the credit department contact responsible for credit limit negotiations, collateral management, and exposure monitoring.

attributes.name: credit_watch_status
attributes.description: Current credit monitoring status indicating whether the counterparty is under special credit surveillance: none (normal monitoring), positive_watch (potential upgrade), negative_watch (potential downgrade), under_review (active credit assessment in progress).

attributes.name: csa_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Credit Support Annex (collateral agreement) with this counterparty became effective, governing margin and collateral posting requirements.

attributes.name: csa_minimum_transfer_amount_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Credit Support Annex (CSA) Minimum Transfer Amount (USD)
attributes.description: Minimum dollar amount for any single collateral transfer under the Credit Support Annex, used to avoid administrative burden of small transfers.

attributes.name: csa_threshold_amount_usd
attributes.description: Threshold amount in US dollars below which no collateral posting is required under the Credit Support Annex terms.

attributes.name: current_credit_exposure_usd
attributes.description: Current mark-to-market credit exposure to this counterparty in US dollars, calculated as the net present value of all open trading positions.
attributes.references: FERC Credit Policy Requirements, Mark-to-Market Accounting

attributes.name: dba_name
attributes.description: Trade name or doing-business-as name used by the counterparty in commercial transactions, if different from legal entity name.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit unique identifier assigned by Dun & Bradstreet for business entity identification and credit assessment.

attributes.name: ferc_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Registration Number
attributes.description: FERC-assigned registration identifier for entities authorized to participate in wholesale energy markets under FERC jurisdiction.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2000, FERC Market-Based Rate Authority

attributes.name: fitch_credit_rating
attributes.description: Current long-term issuer credit rating assigned by Fitch Ratings used for counterparty credit risk assessment.

attributes.name: guarantee_amount_usd
attributes.description: Maximum amount in US dollars guaranteed by the parent or third-party guarantor for this counterparty's obligations.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the counterparty's corporate headquarters for legal notices and correspondence.

attributes.name: headquarters_address_line2

attributes.name: headquarters_city
attributes.description: City where the counterparty's corporate headquarters is located.

attributes.name: headquarters_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the counterparty's headquarters location, typically USA, CAN (Canada), or MEX (Mexico) for North American energy markets.

attributes.name: headquarters_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the counterparty's corporate headquarters address.

attributes.name: headquarters_state_province
attributes.description: State or province code where the counterparty's corporate headquarters is located.

attributes.name: internal_credit_rating
attributes.description: Internally assigned credit rating based on the utility's proprietary credit scoring model and risk assessment framework.

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: Primary regulatory jurisdiction governing the counterparty's operations (e.g., state public utility commission, FERC, provincial regulator).
attributes.references: FERC Jurisdictional Standards, State PUC Authority

attributes.name: last_credit_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent comprehensive credit review and risk assessment performed for this counterparty.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this counterparty record, used for change tracking and audit purposes.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards, Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: legal_entity_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the counterparty as registered with regulatory authorities and used in master trading agreements.

attributes.name: master_agreement_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the master trading agreement with this counterparty became legally effective and binding.
attributes.references: Contract Law Standards, NAESB Business Practice Standards

attributes.name: master_agreement_reference_number
attributes.description: Unique reference number or identifier assigned to the master trading agreement for contract management and trade confirmation purposes.

attributes.name: master_agreement_type
attributes.description: Type of master trading agreement governing transactions with this counterparty: ISDA (International Swaps and Derivatives Association for financial derivatives), NAESB (North American Energy Standards Board for physical gas), EEI (Edison Electric Institute for physical power), WSPP (Western Systems Power Pool), or custom bilateral agreement.
attributes.references: ISDA Master Agreement, NAESB Base Contract, EEI Master Power Purchase and Sale Agreement

attributes.name: moodys_credit_rating
attributes.description: Current long-term issuer credit rating assigned by Moody's Investors Service (e.g., Aaa, Baa2, etc.) used for counterparty credit risk assessment.

attributes.name: nerc_registration_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Registration Identifier (ID)
attributes.description: NERC-assigned identifier for registered entities subject to Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) standards and reliability compliance.
attributes.references: NERC Compliance Registry, NERC CIP Standards

attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a payment netting agreement is in place allowing offsetting of amounts owed between parties (True = netting agreement exists, False = gross settlement required).
attributes.references: ISDA Master Agreement Section 2(c), NAESB Netting Standards

attributes.name: next_credit_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic credit review and risk reassessment of this counterparty.

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date when the counterparty was initially onboarded and approved for trading activity, marking the start of the business relationship.

attributes.name: parent_guarantor_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the parent company or third-party entity providing a guarantee for this counterparty's trading obligations, if applicable.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary business contact for trade confirmations, scheduling notifications, and operational communications.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact for trading operations and contract administration at the counterparty organization.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Business telephone number of the primary contact for urgent trading and operational matters.

attributes.name: sp_credit_rating
attributes.description: Current long-term issuer credit rating assigned by Standard & Poor's (e.g., AAA, AA+, BBB-, etc.) used for counterparty credit risk assessment.

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Federal tax identification number (EIN for corporations, SSN for sole proprietors) used for tax reporting and IRS Form 1099 issuance.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the trading relationship with this counterparty was terminated or the master agreement expired, if applicable.

products.name: trade
products.description: Core transactional record for every executed energy trade including wholesale power purchases/sales, natural gas trades, financial swaps, options, forwards, futures, FTRs/ARRs/CRRs (congestion revenue rights), and hedge instruments. Captures ETRM system trade number, trade date/time, commodity type (power, gas, REC, capacity, FTR), trade type (physical, financial, exchange), buy/sell indicator, volume (MWh/MCF/MW), price, delivery period start/end, delivery point, counterparty reference, trader ID, portfolio/book reference, hedge program reference (if designated), ASC 815 hedge designation, confirmation status, confirmation method, execution venue (bilateral, DAM, RTM, ICE, CME), broker reference, and amendment/novation history. Primary transactional anchor for the trading domain encompassing all instrument types including virtual transactions and congestion hedges.

attributes.name: trade_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the energy trade transaction. Primary key for the trade entity.

attributes.name: application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.application. Business justification: Regulatory audit requires linking each trade to the trading application that originated it for traceability and system performance monitoring.

attributes.name: asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.registry. Business justification: Required for Trade Delivery Allocation Report linking each trade to the physical asset delivering electricity, a FERC regulatory need.

attributes.name: balancing_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gridops.balancing_area. Business justification: Settlement & market reporting require associating each trade with the balancing area it impacts for FERC compliance and load balancing.

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the counterparty entity with whom the trade was executed. May be a wholesale supplier, another utility, a power marketer, or an organized market operator.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: REQUIRED: Large industrial customers have direct wholesale trades; the link supports the Customer Trade Allocation Report and regulatory cost allocation per account.

attributes.name: customer_service_point_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.service_point. Business justification: REQUIRED: Certain trades are location‑specific; associating a trade with the service point allows settlement and pricing reports by physical delivery point.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or trader who executed this trade on behalf of the utility.

attributes.name: filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.filing. Business justification: Regulatory Trade Reporting: each trade must be linked to the specific filing (e.g., FERC Form) that reports it for compliance.

attributes.name: fuel_supply_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.fuel_supply_schedule. Business justification: Generation scheduling uses the Fuel Supply Schedule tied to a specific trade; reconciliation reports need this FK.

attributes.name: generating_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to generation.generating_unit. Business justification: Physical trade scheduling requires assigning a specific generating unit to fulfill the contract; this is core to dispatch and settlement processes.

attributes.name: generation_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.facility. Business justification: Regulatory trade reporting requires linking each trade to the generating facility for generation scheduling and settlement.

attributes.name: metering_service_point_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to metering.metering_service_point. Business justification: Trade execution and regulatory settlement need the service point identifier to align trade deliveries with metered consumption.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engagement.opportunity. Business justification: Required for Trade Execution Report linking each trade to the originating sales opportunity, enabling revenue attribution and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trading.portfolio. Business justification: Trade belongs to a portfolio; linking via portfolio_id enables portfolio‑level reporting and eliminates the free‑text portfolio_book column.

attributes.name: pricing_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trading.pricing_node. Business justification: Trade references a pricing node by name; adding pricing_node_id creates a proper FK to the pricing_node master.

attributes.name: procurement_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.procurement_contract. Business justification: Fuel Procurement‑Trade Mapping Report requires each trade to reference its underlying procurement contract for cost allocation and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: resource_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to der.der_resource. Business justification: ISO Generation Trade Attribution report requires mapping each trade to the specific DER asset that produced the electricity.

attributes.name: trader_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or trader who executed this trade on behalf of the utility.

attributes.name: transmission_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to transmission.line. Business justification: Transmission Service Allocation: each trade is assigned a specific transmission line for delivery, required for NERC reporting and congestion cost calculation.

attributes.name: transmission_substation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to transmission.transmission_substation. Business justification: Trade Delivery Point: regulatory filings require the delivery substation for each trade, used in settlement and market reporting.

attributes.name: amendment_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent amendment to the trade terms. Null if no amendments have been made.

attributes.name: amendment_version
attributes.description: Version number tracking amendments to the original trade. 0 = original trade, incremented for each amendment or modification.

attributes.name: broker_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the broker or intermediary who facilitated the trade, if applicable. Null for direct bilateral trades or exchange-executed trades.

attributes.name: buy_sell_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the utility is buying or selling the commodity in this trade. Buy = utility is purchasing, Sell = utility is selling.

attributes.name: commodity_type
attributes.description: The type of energy commodity being traded. Power = electricity, Natural Gas = gas supply, REC = Renewable Energy Certificate, Capacity = generation capacity rights, FTR/ARR/CRR = Financial/Auction/Congestion Revenue Rights for transmission hedging, Ancillary Services = grid support services. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: power|natural_gas|rec|capacity|ftr|arr|crr|ancillary_services — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: confirmation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the trade was confirmed by both parties.

attributes.name: confirmation_method
attributes.description: The method by which the trade was confirmed with the counterparty. Electronic = automated system confirmation, Exchange Matched = automatically matched on exchange platform.

attributes.name: confirmation_status
attributes.description: The current status of trade confirmation with the counterparty. Pending = awaiting counterparty confirmation, Confirmed = both parties have confirmed terms, Disputed = discrepancy identified, Cancelled = trade cancelled before settlement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this trade record was first created in the ETRM system.

attributes.name: credit_limit_check
attributes.description: Indicates whether the trade passed credit limit validation at time of execution. True = credit approved, False = credit limit exceeded or waived.

attributes.name: delivery_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the delivery period when the commodity will be delivered or the contract expires.

attributes.name: delivery_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the delivery period when the commodity will be delivered or the contract becomes effective.

attributes.name: etrm_trade_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Energy Trading and Risk Management (ETRM) Trade Number
attributes.description: The unique trade number assigned by the Allegro ETRM system. This is the business identifier used by traders and risk managers to reference the trade.

attributes.name: execution_venue
attributes.description: The market or platform where the trade was executed. Bilateral = over-the-counter direct negotiation, DAM = Day-Ahead Market, RTM = Real-Time Market, ICE = Intercontinental Exchange, CME = Chicago Mercantile Exchange, NYMEX = New York Mercantile Exchange. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bilateral|dam|rtm|ice|cme|nymex|other_exchange — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: hedge_designation
attributes.description: The hedge accounting designation under ASC 815 for financial reporting purposes. Cash Flow Hedge = hedges exposure to variability in cash flows, Fair Value Hedge = hedges exposure to changes in fair value, Net Investment Hedge = hedges foreign currency exposure in foreign operations, Not Designated = derivative not designated for hedge accounting.

attributes.name: hedge_program_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific hedging program or strategy this trade supports, if designated as a hedge. Used for tracking hedge effectiveness and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: instrument_type
attributes.description: The financial instrument structure of the trade. Spot = immediate delivery, Forward = future delivery bilateral contract, Future = exchange-traded standardized contract, Swap = exchange of cash flows, Option = right but not obligation to transact, PPA = Power Purchase Agreement long-term contract.

attributes.name: mark_to_market_value
attributes.description: The current fair value of the trade based on current market prices. Updated daily for risk management and financial reporting. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: market_type
attributes.description: The temporal market structure in which the trade was executed. Day-Ahead = next-day commitment market, Real-Time = same-hour balancing market, Bilateral = negotiated outside organized markets, Forward = future delivery beyond day-ahead.

attributes.name: master_agreement_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the master trading agreement (e.g., ISDA, EEI, NAESB) that governs the legal terms of this trade with the counterparty.
attributes.references: ISDA Master Agreement / EEI Master Power Purchase and Sale Agreement

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this trade record was last modified in the ETRM system.

attributes.name: mtm_valuation_date
attributes.description: The date as of which the mark-to-market value was calculated.

attributes.name: novation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this trade has been novated (transferred to a new counterparty). True = trade has been novated, False = original counterparty remains.

attributes.name: original_trade_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the original trade if this trade is an amendment, novation, or related transaction. Used to maintain audit trail of trade modifications.

attributes.name: price
attributes.description: The agreed-upon price per unit for the commodity. For power typically in $/MWh, for gas in $/MMBtu or $/MCF, for RECs in $/certificate. For LMP-based trades this may be the fixed price or the LMP reference.

attributes.name: price_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the trade price, indicating the currency and commodity unit basis.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this trade must be reported to regulatory authorities (FERC EQR, CFTC, etc.). True = reporting required, False = exempt from reporting.

attributes.name: rto_iso_market
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) or Independent System Operator (ISO) Market
attributes.description: The RTO or ISO market in which the trade was executed, if applicable. Examples: PJM, MISO, CAISO, ERCOT, NYISO, ISO-NE, SPP.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: The current status of financial settlement for the trade. Pending = awaiting settlement period, In Progress = settlement calculations underway, Settled = payment completed, Failed = settlement issue requiring resolution.

attributes.name: total_contract_value
attributes.description: The total notional value of the trade contract, calculated as volume multiplied by price. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: trade_date
attributes.description: The date on which the trade was executed and agreed upon by both parties.

attributes.name: trade_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the trade. Active = trade is live and in delivery period, Completed = delivery and settlement finished, Cancelled = trade cancelled before delivery, Terminated = trade ended early by mutual agreement.

attributes.name: trade_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the trade was executed, including timezone information. Critical for Day-Ahead Market (DAM) and Real-Time Market (RTM) reconciliation.

attributes.name: trade_type
attributes.description: Classification of the trade structure. Physical = actual delivery of commodity, Financial = cash-settled derivative with no physical delivery, Exchange = traded on organized exchange (ICE, CME), Virtual = virtual bid/offer in DAM/RTM with no physical asset.

attributes.name: transmission_service_type
attributes.description: The type of transmission service associated with power delivery for this trade. Firm = guaranteed delivery, Non-Firm = interruptible, Network = integrated network service, Point-to-Point = specific path reservation, Not Applicable = no transmission component (e.g., gas trade).

attributes.name: unrealized_gain_loss
attributes.description: The unrealized profit or loss on the trade based on current mark-to-market valuation versus original contract value. Positive = gain, Negative = loss. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: volume_quantity
attributes.description: The total quantity of the commodity being traded. Units depend on commodity type: MWh for power, MCF or MMBtu for natural gas, MW for capacity, number of certificates for RECs.

attributes.name: volume_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the volume quantity. MWh = Megawatt-Hour (energy), MW = Megawatt (capacity), MCF = Thousand Cubic Feet (gas volume), MMBtu = Million British Thermal Units (gas energy), Therm = 100,000 BTU, REC Certificate = individual renewable energy certificate.

products.name: trade_leg
products.description: Individual delivery leg or settlement leg of a multi-leg trade or structured product, existing as a first-class entity because each leg has independent delivery terms, settlement cycles, and confirmation status. Captures leg sequence, commodity, volume, price, delivery period, delivery point, buy/sell indicator, settlement currency, leg-level confirmation status, and leg-specific scheduling/nomination data. Supports complex instruments such as heat rate options, spark spread trades, basis swaps, tolling agreements, and multi-period PPAs where each leg settles independently and may have different counterparty credit treatment.

attributes.name: trade_leg_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the individual trade leg or settlement leg within a multi-leg structured product or complex trade instrument.

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trading counterparty for this leg. Links to counterparty master data for credit management, settlement, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: metering_service_point_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to metering.metering_service_point. Business justification: Each leg of a trade may be delivered to a specific service point; linking enables precise measurement and settlement per leg.

attributes.name: trade_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent trade transaction that this leg belongs to. Links this leg to the overall trade structure in the ETRM system.

attributes.name: ancillary_services_included_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether ancillary services (regulation, reserves, reactive power) are bundled with this leg. True if ancillary services are included in the transaction, false if energy-only.

attributes.name: buy_sell_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leg represents a purchase (buy) or sale (sell) position from the utility's perspective. Critical for position management and risk exposure calculation.

attributes.name: collateral_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether collateral posting is required for this leg based on credit terms and current exposure. True if collateral is required, false otherwise.

attributes.name: commodity_type
attributes.description: Type of energy commodity or product being traded in this leg. Includes physical power, natural gas, RECs, capacity rights, ancillary services, and emissions allowances.
attributes.references: EIA Form 923 - Energy Trading Commodity Classification

attributes.name: confirmation_date
attributes.description: Date when this leg was confirmed with the counterparty. Critical for regulatory compliance and audit trail of trade execution.

attributes.name: confirmation_status
attributes.description: Status of trade confirmation with the counterparty for this specific leg. Independent confirmation may be required for each leg in multi-leg structures.

attributes.name: contract_price
attributes.description: Agreed price per unit for this leg. May be a fixed price, floating price indexed to market, or formula-based price. Currency specified in settlement_currency field.

attributes.name: contract_quantity
attributes.description: Contracted volume or quantity for this leg. Represents the notional amount of the commodity to be delivered or settled. Unit of measure specified in quantity_unit_of_measure field.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this trade leg record was first created in the lakehouse. Used for data lineage and audit purposes.

attributes.name: credit_exposure
attributes.description: Current credit exposure to the counterparty for this leg. Calculated based on mark-to-market value and potential future exposure. Used for credit limit monitoring and collateral management.

attributes.name: delivered_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity physically delivered or financially settled for this leg. Used for final settlement reconciliation and variance analysis against contract and scheduled quantities.

attributes.name: delivery_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the delivery or settlement period for this leg. Defines when physical delivery or financial settlement obligations conclude.

attributes.name: delivery_point_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the delivery location such as PJM Western Hub, Henry Hub, or specific substation or pipeline interconnection point.

attributes.name: delivery_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the delivery or settlement period for this leg. Defines when physical delivery or financial settlement obligations begin.

attributes.name: hedge_designation
attributes.description: Accounting designation of this leg for hedge accounting purposes under FASB ASC 815. Distinguishes between cash flow hedges, fair value hedges, economic hedges without hedge accounting, and speculative positions.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this trade leg record was most recently updated. Tracks data currency and supports change data capture processes.

attributes.name: leg_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordering of this leg within the parent trade structure. Used to maintain the chronological or logical order of delivery or settlement legs in multi-period instruments.

attributes.name: leg_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this trade leg. Tracks progression from initial booking through confirmation, scheduling, physical delivery or financial settlement, and final closure.

attributes.name: leg_type
attributes.description: Classification of the leg type within the structured product. Distinguishes between physical delivery legs, financial settlement legs, option exercise legs, swap components, and basis differential legs.

attributes.name: mark_to_market_value
attributes.description: Current market valuation of this leg based on prevailing market prices. Updated regularly for risk management and financial reporting. Represents unrealized gain or loss.

attributes.name: market_type
attributes.description: Classification of the market in which this leg is transacted. Distinguishes between Day-Ahead Market (DAM), Real-Time Market (RTM), bilateral over-the-counter, forward contracts, and exchange-traded futures.

attributes.name: mtm_valuation_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent mark-to-market valuation for this leg. Used to track valuation currency and support daily risk reporting.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for trader notes, special instructions, or additional context specific to this leg. May include operational constraints, scheduling instructions, or settlement clarifications.

attributes.name: price_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the contract price. Defines the pricing basis such as dollars per MWh, dollars per MW-day for capacity, dollars per MMBtu for gas, or dollars per REC.

attributes.name: pricing_formula
attributes.description: Mathematical formula or algorithm used to calculate the final settlement price for this leg. May include heat rate calculations, basis adjustments, escalation factors, or complex option payoff structures.

attributes.name: pricing_index
attributes.description: Market pricing index or benchmark used for floating price legs. Examples include Day-Ahead LMP at specific node, Real-Time LMP, Henry Hub gas index, or bilateral index agreements.

attributes.name: quantity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the contract quantity. Common units include MWh (Megawatt-Hour) for electricity energy, MW (Megawatt) for capacity, MMBtu or Dth for natural gas, REC for renewable certificates, and ton CO2 for emissions.

attributes.name: renewable_attribute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leg includes renewable energy attributes or Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs). True if renewable attributes are part of the transaction, false for conventional energy.

attributes.name: rto_iso_market
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) / Independent System Operator (ISO) Market
attributes.description: Identifies the RTO or ISO market where this leg is executed for organized market transactions. Null for bilateral trades outside organized markets. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PJM|CAISO|ERCOT|MISO|NYISO|ISO_NE|SPP — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: scheduled_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity scheduled or nominated for physical delivery for this leg. May differ from contract quantity due to operational constraints, curtailments, or market conditions.

attributes.name: scheduling_status
attributes.description: Status of physical scheduling or nomination for this leg. Tracks whether the leg has been scheduled with the RTO/ISO or pipeline operator, and any curtailments or adjustments.

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: Final financial settlement amount for this leg in the settlement currency. Calculated based on delivered quantity, final price, and any adjustments or penalties.

attributes.name: settlement_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for financial settlement of this leg. Predominantly USD for North American energy markets.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date when financial settlement for this leg is completed. May differ from delivery end date based on market settlement cycles and payment terms.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system from which this trade leg data originated. Typically Allegro ETRM but may include other trading platforms or manual entry systems.

attributes.name: source_system_leg_reference
attributes.description: Original leg identifier from the source ETRM system. Maintained for traceability and reconciliation with upstream trading systems.

attributes.name: trade_execution_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when this leg was executed or booked in the ETRM system. Critical for regulatory reporting and audit trail.

attributes.name: transmission_rights_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether firm transmission rights or Financial Transmission Rights (FTRs) are required to support physical delivery for this leg. True if transmission rights are needed, false otherwise.

products.name: portfolio
products.description: Master record defining trading books and portfolios used to organize positions, attribute P&L, and enforce risk governance. Captures portfolio name, portfolio type (generation hedge, load hedge, proprietary, ancillary, fuel), commodity scope, responsible trader/desk, regulatory classification (merchant vs. utility), mark-to-market methodology, approved risk limits (VaR limit, open position limit, stop-loss limit, tenor limit, credit exposure limit), limit breach actions (alert, block, escalate), current limit utilization, board approval date, and ETRM system book ID. Serves as the organizational unit for position aggregation, risk limit enforcement, and P&L attribution.

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the trading portfolio. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.cost_center

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.profit_center

attributes.name: vpp_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engagement.vpp_agreement. Business justification: Portfolio‑level VPP contract tracking needed for dispatch scheduling, financial settlement, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: board_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the board of directors or authorized governance committee approved the establishment of this portfolio and its risk limits.

attributes.name: board_approval_resolution_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the board resolution or governance document that approved this portfolio.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: High-level business unit or division to which this portfolio belongs (e.g., Wholesale Power, Gas Supply, Renewable Energy).

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date on which this trading portfolio was permanently closed. Null if the portfolio is still active or suspended.

attributes.name: closure_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for closing the portfolio (e.g., strategic realignment, regulatory change, market exit, consolidation with another portfolio).

attributes.name: commodity_scope
attributes.description: Primary commodity or commodities traded within this portfolio: power (electricity), gas (natural gas), coal, fuel oil, renewable (RECs and renewable energy), or multi-commodity (mixed).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this portfolio record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_exposure_limit_usd
attributes.description: Maximum approved credit exposure limit for counterparty risk within this portfolio, expressed in US dollars. Represents the aggregate mark-to-market exposure to all counterparties.

attributes.name: current_credit_utilization_percent
attributes.description: Current credit exposure utilization as a percentage of the approved credit limit. Calculated as (current credit exposure / credit limit) * 100.

attributes.name: current_position_utilization_percent
attributes.description: Current open position utilization as a percentage of the approved position limit. Calculated as (current net position / position limit) * 100.

attributes.name: current_var_utilization_percent
attributes.description: Current VaR utilization as a percentage of the approved VaR limit. Calculated as (current VaR / VaR limit) * 100.

attributes.name: etrm_system_book_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Energy Trading and Risk Management (ETRM) System Book ID
attributes.description: Unique book identifier in the Allegro ETRM system corresponding to this portfolio. Used for system integration and position reconciliation.

attributes.name: hedge_accounting_designation
attributes.description: Accounting treatment designation under FASB ASC 815: cash flow hedge (hedging variability in cash flows), fair value hedge (hedging changes in fair value), net investment hedge (hedging foreign currency exposure), or not designated (mark-to-market through earnings).

attributes.name: hedge_effectiveness_test_method
attributes.description: Method used to assess hedge effectiveness for accounting purposes: dollar offset (change in hedge value vs hedged item), regression (statistical correlation), var reduction (reduction in portfolio VaR), or not applicable (no hedge accounting).

attributes.name: inception_date
attributes.description: Date on which this trading portfolio was first established and became operational.

attributes.name: last_limit_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent periodic review of risk limits for this portfolio. Risk limits are typically reviewed quarterly or annually.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this portfolio record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: limit_breach_action
attributes.description: Automated or procedural action taken when a risk limit is breached: alert (notify trader and risk manager), block (prevent new trades), escalate (escalate to senior management), or auto liquidate (automatically close positions).

attributes.name: mark_to_market_methodology
attributes.description: Valuation methodology used for mark-to-market calculations: forward curve (market forward prices), LMP-based (locational marginal pricing), broker quote (third-party broker quotes), model derived (internal pricing model), or cost basis (historical cost).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 815 - Derivatives and Hedging, FERC Order 741

attributes.name: next_limit_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of risk limits for this portfolio.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the portfolio management, risk limits, or operational considerations.

attributes.name: open_position_limit_mmbtu
attributes.description: Maximum approved open position limit for gas portfolios expressed in million British thermal units. Represents the maximum net long or short position allowed.

attributes.name: open_position_limit_mwh
attributes.description: Maximum approved open position limit for power portfolios expressed in megawatt-hours. Represents the maximum net long or short position allowed.

attributes.name: pnl_attribution_method
attributes.description: Method used to attribute profit and loss: trade level (P&L calculated and attributed at individual trade level), portfolio level (P&L calculated at aggregate portfolio level), or blended (combination of both).

attributes.name: portfolio_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used as the business identifier for the portfolio in trading systems and reports.

attributes.name: portfolio_name
attributes.description: Business name of the trading portfolio used for identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: portfolio_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the trading portfolio: active (operational and accepting new positions), suspended (temporarily inactive), closed (permanently closed), or pending approval (awaiting board or management approval).

attributes.name: portfolio_type
