attributes.description: Classification of the portfolio by its primary business purpose: generation hedge (hedging generation output), load hedge (hedging customer load obligations), proprietary (speculative trading), ancillary (ancillary services), fuel (fuel procurement hedging), or renewable (renewable energy and REC trading).

attributes.name: regulatory_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory classification of the portfolio: merchant (unregulated competitive trading), utility (regulated utility hedging activities subject to PUC oversight), or hybrid (mixed activities).
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts, State PUC Regulations

attributes.name: rto_iso_market
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) / Independent System Operator (ISO) Market
attributes.description: Primary RTO or ISO market in which this portfolio operates (e.g., PJM, CAISO, ERCOT, MISO, NYISO, ISO-NE, SPP). Relevant for power portfolios participating in organized wholesale markets.

attributes.name: stop_loss_limit_usd
attributes.description: Maximum approved cumulative loss threshold in US dollars. When exceeded, triggers mandatory position reduction or closure actions.

attributes.name: tenor_limit_months
attributes.description: Maximum approved tenor (time to maturity) for positions within this portfolio, expressed in months. Limits how far forward positions can be taken.

attributes.name: trading_desk
attributes.description: Name of the trading desk or organizational unit to which this portfolio is assigned (e.g., Power Trading Desk, Gas Trading Desk, Renewables Desk).

attributes.name: var_confidence_level_percent
attributes.description: Confidence level used for VaR calculation, typically expressed as a percentage (e.g., 95.00, 99.00).

attributes.name: var_limit_usd
attributes.description: Maximum approved Value at Risk limit for this portfolio expressed in US dollars. Represents the maximum potential loss at a specified confidence level over a defined time horizon.

attributes.name: var_time_horizon_days
attributes.description: Time horizon in days over which VaR is calculated (e.g., 1 day, 10 days).

products.name: position
products.description: Daily snapshot of the net open trading position for a given portfolio, commodity, delivery period, and delivery point as of a specific valuation date. Captures long/short volume (MWh/MCF/RECs/MW), average price, mark-to-market value, unrealized P&L, delta equivalent, position source (physical, financial, net), capacity obligations (for capacity commodity type), REC inventory balances (for REC commodity type), and position change from prior day. Updated daily from the ETRM position management module. Supports risk reporting, regulatory position disclosure, RPS compliance planning, and resource adequacy tracking.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the trading position snapshot record.

attributes.name: balancing_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gridops.balancing_area. Business justification: Position statements are aggregated by balancing area for reliability and RTO reporting; linking provides required geographic context.

attributes.name: market_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trading.market. Business justification: Positions are reported for a market; adding market_id provides direct market context without redundant market_segment column.

attributes.name: person_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trader or trading desk responsible for managing this position.

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trading portfolio that holds this position.

attributes.name: resource_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to der.der_resource. Business justification: Position statements for trading portfolios need to attribute volumes to individual DER resources for risk and capacity reporting.

attributes.name: rps_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.rps_obligation. Business justification: RPS Compliance: positions are tied to Renewable Portfolio Standard obligations; linking enables RPS reporting and gap analysis.

attributes.name: trader_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Needed for Position Management Dashboard to attribute each position to the trader employee responsible for that position.

attributes.name: transmission_substation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to transmission.transmission_substation. Business justification: Position reporting at delivery substation: physical delivery positions are tied to a substation for market compliance and reporting.

attributes.name: average_long_price
attributes.description: The volume-weighted average price of all long positions in this snapshot, in USD per unit.

attributes.name: average_net_price
attributes.description: The volume-weighted average price of the net open position, in USD per unit.

attributes.name: average_short_price
attributes.description: The volume-weighted average price of all short positions in this snapshot, in USD per unit.

attributes.name: capacity_obligation_mw
attributes.description: For capacity commodity type, the total capacity obligation in Megawatts (MW) that must be delivered or procured to meet resource adequacy requirements.

attributes.name: change_value
attributes.description: The change in mark-to-market value from the prior valuation date, in USD.

attributes.name: change_volume
attributes.description: The change in net volume from the prior valuation date, measured in the same units as net_volume.

attributes.name: commodity_type
attributes.description: The type of energy commodity for this position (power, natural gas, capacity, Renewable Energy Certificate, or ancillary services).
attributes.references: FERC Electric Quarterly Report (EQR) Commodity Classifications

attributes.name: counterparty_exposure
attributes.description: The total credit exposure to counterparties for this position, representing the potential loss if all counterparties default, in USD.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this position snapshot record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: delivery_period_end
attributes.description: The end date of the delivery period for which this position applies.

attributes.name: delivery_period_start
attributes.description: The start date of the delivery period for which this position applies.

attributes.name: delta_equivalent
attributes.description: The delta-adjusted equivalent volume for options and structured products, representing the linear price risk exposure in the same units as net_volume.
attributes.references: CFTC Commodity Pool Operator Risk Disclosure

attributes.name: hedge_designation
attributes.description: The accounting hedge designation for this position under FASB ASC 815 (cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, net investment hedge, or undesignated).

attributes.name: hedge_effectiveness_percent
attributes.description: The percentage effectiveness of the hedge relationship, used to determine hedge accounting treatment eligibility (typically 80-125% range for highly effective hedges).

attributes.name: long_volume
attributes.description: The total volume of long (buy) positions held, measured in MWh for power, MCF for gas, MW for capacity, or REC count for renewable certificates.
attributes.references: FERC Form 552 Annual Report of Natural Gas Transactions

attributes.name: mark_to_market_value
attributes.description: The fair value of the net open position calculated using current market prices, in USD.

attributes.name: market_price
attributes.description: The current market price (LMP for power, index price for gas, or market clearing price for capacity/RECs) used for mark-to-market valuation as of the valuation date, in USD per unit.
attributes.references: ISO/RTO Day-Ahead Market (DAM) and Real-Time Market (RTM) Pricing

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: The market segment in which this position was established (Day-Ahead Market, Real-Time Market, bilateral contract, futures exchange, or options exchange).

attributes.name: net_volume
attributes.description: The net open position volume (long minus short), measured in MWh for power, MCF for gas, MW for capacity, or REC count for renewable certificates.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this position snapshot, including any manual adjustments, special circumstances, or trader annotations.

attributes.name: position_source
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is derived from physical contracts, financial derivatives, or the net of both.

attributes.name: position_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the position (open, closed, expired, or settled).

attributes.name: rec_inventory_balance
attributes.description: For REC commodity type, the current inventory balance of Renewable Energy Certificates held in the portfolio, measured in certificate count.
attributes.references: State Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) Compliance Tracking Systems

attributes.name: rec_vintage_year
attributes.description: For REC commodity type, the vintage year of the renewable energy generation that created the certificates.
attributes.references: State Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) Compliance Tracking Systems

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position must be included in regulatory filings such as FERC EQR or state PUC reports.

attributes.name: rps_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position (particularly REC positions) contributes to state Renewable Portfolio Standard compliance obligations.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: The settlement status for positions in or past their delivery period (pending, partial, complete, or disputed).

attributes.name: short_volume
attributes.description: The total volume of short (sell) positions held, measured in MWh for power, MCF for gas, MW for capacity, or REC count for renewable certificates.
attributes.references: FERC Form 552 Annual Report of Natural Gas Transactions

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which this position data was extracted (typically Allegro ETRM).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this position record in the source system (Allegro ETRM position key).

attributes.name: trading_book
attributes.description: The trading book or sub-portfolio classification for internal risk management and P&L attribution.

attributes.name: unrealized_pnl
attributes.description: The unrealized profit or loss on the net open position, calculated as the difference between mark-to-market value and book value, in USD.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this position snapshot record was last modified.

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The business date as of which this position snapshot was calculated.

attributes.name: var_95
attributes.description: The Value at Risk (VaR) for this position at 95% confidence level, representing the maximum expected loss over a one-day holding period, in USD.

attributes.name: volume_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the position volume (Megawatt-Hour, Thousand Cubic Feet, Megawatt, Renewable Energy Certificate, or Million British Thermal Units).

products.name: ppa_contract
products.description: Master record for Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) including long-term bilateral contracts for renewable and conventional generation. Captures PPA contract number, counterparty, resource type (solar, wind, hydro, gas), contracted capacity (MW), energy volume (MWh), contract term start/end, pricing structure (fixed, indexed, tolling), delivery point, REC inclusion flag, curtailment provisions, force majeure terms, FERC filing reference, and contract status. Distinct from short-term wholesale trades.

attributes.name: ppa_contract_id
attributes.description: Primary key for ppa_contract

attributes.name: asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.registry. Business justification: PPA contracts must reference the generation asset supplying power for compliance and accounting of contracted capacity.

attributes.name: balancing_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gridops.balancing_area. Business justification: Renewable PPAs must be tied to a balancing area to satisfy Renewable Portfolio Standard tracking and regional compliance.

attributes.name: business_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.business_entity. Business justification: REQUIRED: PPA contracts are signed with corporate customers; linking enables billing, compliance, and reporting of contract obligations to the specific business entity.

attributes.name: contract_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the internal employee responsible for managing and administering this PPA.
attributes.references: Internal Human Resources Master Data Standard

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the counterparty entity (generator, IPP, or wholesale supplier) with whom the PPA is executed.

attributes.name: delivery_point_node_id
attributes.description: The ISO/RTO pricing node identifier for the delivery point, used for LMP-based settlement.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.facility. Business justification: PPA contracts are executed with a specific generation facility; accounting and compliance reports need the facility reference.

attributes.name: generating_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to generation.generating_unit. Business justification: PPAs are executed for particular generating units; the contract stores pricing, delivery point, and term details tied to that unit.

attributes.name: metering_service_point_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to metering.metering_service_point. Business justification: PPA contracts specify a delivery point; linking to the service point allows compliance reporting and meter‑based verification of renewable deliveries.

attributes.name: product_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_program. Business justification: Required for Renewable Energy Incentive Program reporting linking PPAs to the program they support.

attributes.name: regulatory_rate_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.rate_case. Business justification: Rate Case Approval: PPAs often require approval in a rate case; linking tracks which rate case governs each contract.

attributes.name: resource_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to der.der_resource. Business justification: PPA contract management tracks which DER asset is the source of contracted power for compliance and performance reporting.

attributes.name: scada_system_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.scada_system. Business justification: PPA performance monitoring and FERC reporting require associating each contract with the SCADA system that records generation at the contracted facility.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: The internal business unit or division responsible for this PPA (e.g., 'Wholesale Power', 'Renewable Procurement').

attributes.name: capacity_payment_per_mw_month
attributes.description: The monthly capacity payment in USD per MW of contracted capacity, applicable when pricing structure includes separate capacity payments.

attributes.name: collateral_requirement_usd
attributes.description: The amount of collateral in USD that the counterparty must post to secure performance under the PPA.

attributes.name: contract_amendment_count
attributes.description: The number of amendments or modifications made to the original PPA since execution.

attributes.name: contract_execution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the PPA was signed by both parties and became legally binding.

attributes.name: contract_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the Power Purchase Agreement, often including counterparty and resource type for easy identification.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the Power Purchase Agreement, typically used in legal documents and FERC filings.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the Power Purchase Agreement: draft (under negotiation), pending approval (awaiting internal or regulatory approval), active (in force), suspended (temporarily halted), terminated (ended early), or expired (reached natural end date).

attributes.name: contract_term_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Power Purchase Agreement expires and energy delivery obligations cease, unless extended or terminated early.

attributes.name: contract_term_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Power Purchase Agreement becomes effective and energy delivery obligations begin.

attributes.name: contract_term_years
attributes.description: The duration of the PPA in years, calculated from start date to end date.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the Power Purchase Agreement structure: bilateral (fixed delivery), tolling (fuel provided by buyer), unit contingent (delivery subject to unit availability), baseload, peaking, or renewable-specific.

attributes.name: contract_value_usd
attributes.description: The estimated total value of the PPA in USD over its full term, calculated from contracted volumes and pricing.

attributes.name: contracted_capacity_mw
attributes.description: The nameplate capacity in megawatts (MW) that the seller commits to make available under the PPA.

attributes.name: contracted_energy_mwh_annual
attributes.description: The annual energy volume in megawatt-hours (MWh) that the seller is expected to deliver under the PPA, often used for renewable PPAs with production estimates.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this PPA contract record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_rating_requirement
attributes.description: Minimum credit rating required for the counterparty under the PPA, if specified (e.g., 'BBB- or higher').

attributes.name: curtailment_compensation_terms
attributes.description: Description of compensation terms when energy delivery is curtailed, such as payment for lost generation or no compensation.

attributes.name: curtailment_provision_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the PPA includes provisions allowing the buyer to curtail (reduce or stop) energy delivery under certain conditions (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: ferc_filing_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Filing Reference
attributes.description: Reference number or docket number for the FERC filing associated with this PPA, if applicable for jurisdictional contracts.

attributes.name: fixed_price_per_mwh
attributes.description: The fixed price in USD per megawatt-hour for energy delivered under the PPA, applicable when pricing structure is fixed.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1 Energy Purchase Price Reporting

attributes.name: force_majeure_terms
attributes.description: Summary of force majeure provisions that excuse performance due to unforeseeable events (natural disasters, war, regulatory changes, etc.).

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent amendment to the PPA, if any amendments have been made.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this PPA contract record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special conditions related to the PPA.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days after invoice date within which payment is due under the PPA (e.g., 30 days).

attributes.name: price_escalation_rate_percent
attributes.description: The annual percentage rate at which the PPA price escalates over the contract term, if applicable.

attributes.name: price_index_reference
attributes.description: The market index or benchmark to which the PPA price is tied (e.g., 'Henry Hub Natural Gas', 'PJM Day-Ahead LMP'), applicable when pricing structure is indexed.

attributes.name: pricing_structure
attributes.description: The pricing mechanism for the PPA: fixed (flat rate per MWh), indexed (tied to market index or fuel cost), tolling (buyer provides fuel), hybrid (combination), or capacity and energy (separate capacity and energy payments).

attributes.name: rec_inclusion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) are included in the PPA and transferred to the buyer (True) or retained by the seller (False).
attributes.references: EPA Renewable Energy Tracking System Standards

attributes.name: rec_transfer_mechanism
attributes.description: Mechanism for REC transfer: bundled (RECs delivered with energy), unbundled (RECs delivered separately), or retained by seller.
attributes.references: EPA Renewable Energy Tracking System Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_status
attributes.description: Status of regulatory approval for the PPA: not required (non-jurisdictional), pending (submitted awaiting decision), approved (accepted by regulator), or rejected.

attributes.name: renewable_portfolio_standard_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether energy from this PPA qualifies for state Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) compliance (True) or not (False).
attributes.references: State Public Utility Commission RPS Standards

attributes.name: settlement_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which energy deliveries and payments are settled under the PPA: monthly, quarterly, or annual.

attributes.name: termination_provisions
attributes.description: Summary of conditions under which either party may terminate the PPA early, including notice periods and penalties.

products.name: market_bid
products.description: Record of energy bids and offers submitted to ISO/RTO day-ahead (DAM) and real-time (RTM) markets. Captures bid ID, market (MISO, PJM, CAISO, SPP), market type (DAM/RTM), operating day, hour/interval, resource ID, bid type (energy, capacity, ancillary), bid price ($/MWh), bid quantity (MW), bid curve segments, acceptance status, cleared quantity, and cleared price. Sourced from ISO market interface and ETRM system.

attributes.name: market_bid_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the market bid record. Primary key for the market bid entity.

attributes.name: application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.application. Business justification: ISO market bid submissions are made via a bidding application; linking enables bid audit, compliance reporting, and performance analysis.

attributes.name: asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the generation or demand response resource submitting the bid. Links to the resource registry in the generation or demand response domain.

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the market participant or trading counterparty submitting the bid. Used for credit management and settlement.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.facility. Business justification: Market bids are submitted by generating facilities; market participation reports require facility identification.

attributes.name: lmp_node_id
attributes.description: The pricing node or location identifier where the resource is electrically connected and where LMP is calculated. Used for settlement and congestion analysis.

attributes.name: market_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trading.market. Business justification: Market bids are submitted to a specific market; linking to market_id normalizes market reference and removes duplicate market code fields.

attributes.name: person_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the individual trader or automated trading system that submitted the bid. Used for audit trails and performance analysis.

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the trading portfolio or book to which this bid is assigned. Used for position management and risk aggregation.

attributes.name: product_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_program. Business justification: Demand‑Response market bids must reference the enrolled DR program for eligibility and performance reporting.

attributes.name: resource_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to der.der_resource. Business justification: DER owners submit market bids; each bid must be linked to the DER resource providing the capacity for market‑bid reporting.

attributes.name: trader_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Required for Market Bid Execution Report linking each bid to the responsible trader employee; traders are employees who submit bids.

attributes.name: transmission_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to transmission.line. Business justification: Market Bid location: bids are submitted for a physical line corridor; ISO market rules require line identification for congestion pricing.

attributes.name: acceptance_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the bid was accepted by the ISO/RTO market clearing engine. Null if the bid was rejected or is still pending.

attributes.name: bid_curve_segment_number
attributes.description: The segment number within a multi-part bid curve. Used when a resource submits multiple price-quantity pairs to represent a non-linear supply or demand curve.

attributes.name: bid_price_per_mwh
attributes.description: The price offered or requested for energy delivery, expressed in dollars per megawatt-hour. For supply bids, this is the minimum acceptable price; for demand bids, this is the maximum willingness to pay.

attributes.name: bid_quantity_mw
attributes.description: The quantity of energy or capacity offered or requested in the bid, expressed in megawatts. Represents the resource capability or demand flexibility.

attributes.name: bid_reference_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for the bid as submitted to the ISO/RTO market system. Used for reconciliation and audit trails.

attributes.name: bid_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the bid in the market clearing process. Tracks whether the bid has been accepted, rejected, or partially cleared by the ISO/RTO.

attributes.name: bid_type
attributes.description: The product type for which the bid is submitted. Energy bids are for MWh delivery; ancillary service bids are for reserves and regulation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: energy|capacity|regulation_up|regulation_down|spinning_reserve|non_spinning_reserve|supplemental_reserve — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: block_bid_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bid is an all-or-nothing block bid that must be accepted in its entirety or not at all. Used for resources with inflexible operating constraints.

attributes.name: cleared_price_per_mwh
attributes.description: The market clearing price at which the bid was accepted, expressed in dollars per megawatt-hour. This is the Locational Marginal Price (LMP) at the resource node.

attributes.name: cleared_quantity_mw
attributes.description: The actual quantity of energy or capacity that was accepted and cleared by the market. Null if the bid was not accepted or is still pending.

attributes.name: congestion_component
attributes.business_glossary_term: Congestion Component of Locational Marginal Price (LMP)
attributes.description: The portion of the LMP attributable to transmission congestion. Represents the cost of delivering power through constrained transmission paths.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trails and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The currency in which bid prices and settlement amounts are denominated. Typically USD for North American markets.

attributes.name: energy_component
attributes.business_glossary_term: Energy Component of Locational Marginal Price (LMP)
attributes.description: The base energy component of the LMP, representing the marginal cost of generation before congestion and losses.

attributes.name: hedge_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bid is part of a hedging strategy (physical or financial) or is speculative. Used for risk management and accounting treatment under ASC 815.

attributes.name: loss_component
attributes.business_glossary_term: Loss Component of Locational Marginal Price (LMP)
attributes.description: The portion of the LMP attributable to marginal transmission losses. Represents the incremental cost of electrical losses in the transmission system.

attributes.name: maximum_quantity_mw
attributes.description: The maximum quantity that can be delivered or consumed, representing the upper bound of the resource capability or demand flexibility.

attributes.name: minimum_down_time_hours
attributes.description: The minimum number of consecutive hours the resource must remain offline after shutdown. Reflects cooling and maintenance requirements.

attributes.name: minimum_quantity_mw
attributes.description: The minimum quantity that must be accepted for the bid to be economically viable. Used for resources with minimum run constraints or block bids.

attributes.name: minimum_run_time_hours
attributes.description: The minimum number of consecutive hours the resource must operate once started. Reflects operational constraints of thermal generating units.

attributes.name: no_load_cost
attributes.description: The fixed hourly cost of keeping the generating unit online at minimum output, expressed in dollars per hour. Used in unit commitment optimization.

attributes.name: operating_day
attributes.description: The operating day for which energy delivery is scheduled. In day-ahead markets, this is the next day; in real-time markets, this is the current day.
attributes.references: NERC Glossary of Terms - Operating Day

attributes.name: price_taker_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bid is submitted as a price taker (willing to accept any market clearing price). Common for renewable resources with zero marginal cost.

attributes.name: ramp_rate_mw_per_minute
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ramp Rate in Megawatts (MW) per Minute
attributes.description: The maximum rate at which the resource can increase or decrease output, expressed in megawatts per minute. Critical for real-time dispatch and frequency regulation.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided by the ISO/RTO for why the bid was rejected. Includes validation errors, credit issues, or market rule violations.

attributes.name: self_schedule_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bid is a self-schedule (must-run) rather than an economic bid. Self-schedules are committed regardless of economics, often for reliability or contractual obligations.

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: The total dollar amount settled for this bid, calculated as cleared quantity multiplied by cleared price, plus any uplift payments or penalties.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The system from which the bid record originated (e.g., Allegro ETRM, ISO market interface, manual entry). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: start_up_cost
attributes.description: The cost incurred to start the generating unit from an offline state, expressed in dollars. Used in commitment decisions for thermal units.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the bid was submitted to the ISO/RTO market system. Critical for determining bid acceptance and market timeline compliance.
attributes.references: ISO Market Rules - Bid Submission Deadlines

attributes.name: trading_hour
attributes.description: The hour of the operating day for which the bid applies (1-24 in HE format, Hour Ending). Used for hourly market products.

attributes.name: trading_interval
attributes.description: The sub-hourly interval within the trading hour (e.g., 5-minute or 15-minute intervals). Null for hourly products. Used in real-time markets with sub-hourly dispatch.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this record was last modified in the data platform. Used for change tracking and incremental processing.

products.name: lmp_price
products.description: Market price records covering both spot Locational Marginal Prices (LMP) and forward price curves for all relevant pricing nodes, hubs, and zones across ISO/RTO markets. For spot prices: captures pricing node ID/name, node type (generator bus, load zone, hub, interface, trading hub), market (MISO/PJM/CAISO/SPP), market interval (hourly/5-min), operating date/hour, LMP ($/MWh), energy/congestion/loss components, and market type (DAM/RTM). For forward curves: captures curve date, commodity (power, gas, RECs, capacity, FTRs), delivery hub, tenor, forward price, curve source (ICE, CME, broker, internal), and confidence interval. Also serves as the master reference for pricing node identity (node ID, name, type, ISO, voltage level, geographic coordinates). Unified reference price source for trade settlement, MTM valuation, FTR valuation, and hedging analysis.

attributes.name: lmp_price_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the LMP price record.

attributes.name: asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pricing node where this LMP applies.

attributes.name: market_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ISO/RTO market (MISO, PJM, CAISO, SPP, ERCOT, NYISO, ISO-NE).

attributes.name: commodity_type
attributes.description: Type of energy commodity for which this price applies: power (energy), capacity, ancillary services, Financial Transmission Rights (FTR), Renewable Energy Certificates (REC), or natural gas.

attributes.name: confidence_interval_lower
attributes.description: For forward curves: lower bound of the confidence interval for the forward price, used for risk assessment.

attributes.name: confidence_interval_upper
attributes.description: For forward curves: upper bound of the confidence interval for the forward price, used for risk assessment.

attributes.name: congestion_component
attributes.description: Congestion component of the LMP representing the cost of transmission constraints binding at this location.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts. Utility operates exclusively in USD.

attributes.name: curve_date
attributes.description: For forward prices: the date on which the forward curve was published or captured. Null for spot prices.

attributes.name: curve_source
attributes.description: Source of the forward curve data: ICE (Intercontinental Exchange), CME (Chicago Mercantile Exchange), broker quote, internal model, ISO-published, or third-party vendor.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or market data feed from which this price was obtained (e.g., PJM eMKT, MISO Market Portal, Allegro ETRM).

attributes.name: delivery_hub
attributes.description: For forward curves: the standardized delivery hub or zone for the forward contract (e.g., PJM West Hub, MISO Indiana Hub).

attributes.name: energy_component
attributes.description: Energy component of the LMP representing the system marginal energy cost, excluding congestion and losses.

attributes.name: forward_price
attributes.description: For forward curves: the forward price for the specified tenor and delivery hub in dollars per megawatt-hour.

attributes.name: geographic_latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the pricing node location in decimal degrees, used for spatial analysis and mapping.

attributes.name: geographic_longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the pricing node location in decimal degrees, used for spatial analysis and mapping.

attributes.name: ingestion_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this price record was ingested into the enterprise data lakehouse.

attributes.name: interval_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration of the market interval in minutes (typically 5, 15, or 60 depending on market and ISO).

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this price record is currently active (True) and should be used for valuation and settlement, or superseded (False) by a later settlement run.

attributes.name: lmp_total
attributes.description: Total Locational Marginal Price in dollars per megawatt-hour ($/MWh), representing the marginal cost of serving the next increment of load at this location.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888, ISO/RTO LMP Calculation Methodology

attributes.name: loss_component
attributes.description: Marginal loss component of the LMP representing the cost of electrical losses from the reference bus to this location.

attributes.name: market_interval_end
attributes.description: Precise end timestamp of the market interval.

attributes.name: market_interval_start
attributes.description: Precise start timestamp of the market interval (5-minute, 15-minute, or hourly depending on ISO/RTO).

attributes.name: market_type
attributes.description: Type of market for which this LMP applies: Day-Ahead Market (DAM), Real-Time Market (RTM), Hour-Ahead, or Ancillary Services.

attributes.name: negative_price_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the LMP is negative (True), which can occur during periods of excess renewable generation or transmission constraints.

attributes.name: node_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pricing node indicating its role in the market topology.

attributes.name: operating_date
attributes.description: The operating day for which this LMP price applies, representing the delivery date in the market.

attributes.name: operating_hour
attributes.description: The hour-ending (HE) of the operating day (1-24 or 1-25 for DST transitions) for which this price applies.

attributes.name: price_quality_flag
attributes.description: Data quality indicator for the price: valid (normal), estimated (interpolated), missing (no data), anomaly (outlier detected), or corrected (manually adjusted).

attributes.name: price_spike_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this price represents a price spike event (True) or normal market conditions (False), based on threshold rules.

attributes.name: price_type
attributes.description: Classification of the price record: spot (actual market clearing), forward (future delivery curve), forecast (predicted), or settlement (final reconciled).

attributes.name: pricing_zone
attributes.description: Aggregated pricing zone or load zone to which this node belongs, used for zonal pricing and settlement.

attributes.name: publication_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the price was officially published or made available by the ISO/RTO or market data provider.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this record was first created in the data lakehouse.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this record was last updated in the data lakehouse, supporting audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: settlement_run_number
attributes.description: Sequential number of the settlement run that produced this price (e.g., initial, T+3, T+55 resettlement).

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Status of the price in the settlement process: preliminary (initial posting), final (after settlement run), resettlement (corrected), or disputed (under review).

attributes.name: tenor
attributes.description: For forward curves: the delivery period or tenor of the forward price (e.g., Month-1, Quarter-2, Cal-2025, Peak, Off-Peak).

attributes.name: voltage_level_kv
attributes.description: Voltage level in kilovolts (kV) at which the pricing node operates, relevant for transmission-level pricing nodes.

products.name: settlement
products.description: Financial settlement record for completed trades, market transactions, and PPA deliveries. Captures settlement ID, settlement period, trade/contract reference, counterparty, commodity, settled volume, settlement price, gross settlement amount, netting adjustments, collateral applied, net payable/receivable, settlement status (preliminary, final, disputed), and payment due date. Integrates with SAP FI for accounts payable/receivable posting.

attributes.name: settlement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the financial settlement record. Primary key for the settlement entity.

attributes.name: balancing_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to gridops.balancing_area. Business justification: Settlement calculations and regulatory filings aggregate by balancing area; the link enables accurate area‑level financial reporting.

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the counterparty entity involved in the settlement. Identifies the other party in the transaction (buyer or seller).

attributes.name: dr_event_participation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engagement.dr_event_participation. Business justification: Financial settlement of DR events requires linking settlement records to the participation record for accurate payment and penalty processing.

attributes.name: filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.filing. Business justification: Settlement Reporting: settlements are disclosed in regulatory filings; linking enables audit of reported settlement amounts.

attributes.name: it_service_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.it_service. Business justification: Settlement processing is executed by a specific IT service; linking supports audit trails, cost allocation, and service‑level reporting.

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trading portfolio or book to which this settlement is allocated. Used for position management and profit and loss (P&L) attribution.

attributes.name: ppa_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master contract or Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) under which this settlement occurs. Used for long-term bilateral agreements.

attributes.name: trade_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating trade transaction that this settlement resolves. Links to the trade execution record in the ETRM system.

attributes.name: transmission_outage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to transmission.transmission_outage. Business justification: Outage‑Impact Settlement: settlements reference the specific transmission outage that generated transmission and congestion charges.

attributes.name: ancillary_services_charge
attributes.description: Charges for ancillary services including regulation, spinning reserves, non-spinning reserves, and voltage support required to maintain grid reliability.

attributes.name: collateral_applied
attributes.description: Amount of collateral (cash, letter of credit, or other security) applied against this settlement to reduce credit exposure.

attributes.name: commodity
attributes.description: Type of energy commodity or service being settled. Determines unit of measure and pricing conventions.

attributes.name: congestion_charge
attributes.description: Congestion cost component of the settlement, reflecting transmission constraints and locational price differences in the market.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center to which this settlement is allocated for internal management reporting and cost tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this settlement record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the settlement. Typically USD for US markets, CAD for Canadian markets, MXN for Mexican markets.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this settlement is under dispute. True if either party has raised a dispute regarding pricing, volume, or charges.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for dispute if dispute_flag is true. Captures the nature of the disagreement for resolution tracking.

attributes.name: etrm_system_deal_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Energy Trading and Risk Management (ETRM) System Deal ID
attributes.description: Unique deal identifier in the Allegro ETRM system. Used for reconciliation between settlement records and the source trading system.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which this settlement will be posted in the financial system. Determines the accounting treatment and financial statement classification.

attributes.name: gross_settlement_amount
attributes.description: Total settlement value before adjustments, calculated as settled volume multiplied by settlement price. Represents the base transaction value.

attributes.name: hedge_designation
attributes.description: Hedge accounting designation for this settlement under FASB ASC 815. Determines whether hedge accounting treatment applies and the method of gain/loss recognition.

attributes.name: imbalance_charge
attributes.description: Penalty or credit for deviations between scheduled and actual delivery volumes. Calculated based on real-time imbalance pricing.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this settlement record. Tracks when adjustments, status changes, or corrections were made.

attributes.name: loss_charge
attributes.description: Marginal loss charge reflecting energy losses during transmission from generation to load. Based on loss factors published by the ISO/RTO.

attributes.name: net_settlement_amount
attributes.description: Final settlement amount after all adjustments, charges, taxes, netting, and collateral. This is the actual payable or receivable amount.

attributes.name: netting_adjustment
attributes.description: Adjustment amount applied when multiple settlements with the same counterparty are netted together under a master netting agreement.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or contextual information about the settlement. Used for audit trails and operational communication.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which payment was made or received. Null until payment is completed.

attributes.name: payment_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this settlement results in a payment obligation (payable) or an amount to be received (receivable) from the counterparty perspective.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment must be made or received according to the contract terms or market rules. Used for cash flow planning and credit monitoring.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the payment obligation. Tracks whether the settlement has been paid, received, or is in default.

attributes.name: period_end
attributes.description: Ending timestamp of the delivery or performance period covered by this settlement. Defines the end of the energy delivery window.

attributes.name: period_start
attributes.description: Beginning timestamp of the delivery or performance period covered by this settlement. Defines the start of the energy delivery window.

attributes.name: price
attributes.description: Unit price applied to the settled volume. May be a fixed contract price, Locational Marginal Price (LMP), or market clearing price depending on transaction type.

attributes.name: price_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the settlement price. Typically USD per MWh for electricity, USD per MMBtu for gas, USD per REC for certificates, USD per MW-day for capacity.

attributes.name: profit_center_code

attributes.name: commodity_type

attributes.name: fair_value_hierarchy_level

attributes.name: mtm_value_per_unit

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: open_volume_mmbtu

attributes.name: price_volatility_percent

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag

attributes.name: risk_category

attributes.name: rto_iso_market

attributes.name: settlement_method

attributes.name: tenor_months

attributes.name: var_contribution_usd

products.name: risk_limit
products.description: Approved risk limit records defining maximum allowable exposure thresholds that are monitored independently of the portfolios they govern. Captures limit type (VaR, open position, stop-loss, credit exposure, tenor, Greeks), portfolio/desk/trader scope, commodity, limit value, limit currency, effective date, expiry date, approval authority (board, CRO, desk head), breach action (alert, block, escalate), current utilization percentage, breach history, and regulatory mandate reference (FERC, state PUC). Distinct from trading_portfolio because limits have their own approval lifecycle, can span multiple portfolios, and require independent audit trail for regulatory examination.

attributes.name: risk_limit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the risk limit record. Primary key for the risk limit entity.

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trading.trading_portfolio. Business justification: Risk limits are defined per trading portfolio; adding trading_portfolio_id links limits to their portfolio and eliminates siloing.

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Organizational role or body that approved this risk limit. Board indicates board of directors approval for enterprise-level limits, CRO (Chief Risk Officer) for portfolio-level limits, CFO (Chief Financial Officer) for financial exposure limits, risk committee for cross-functional limits, desk head for trader-level limits, and trading director for desk-level limits.
attributes.references: Corporate Governance Policy, FERC Risk Management Requirements

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the approval authority formally approved this risk limit. Required for regulatory audit trail and governance documentation.
attributes.references: Internal Audit Standards, FERC Compliance Requirements

attributes.name: approval_resolution_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the board resolution, committee decision, or executive approval document that authorized this risk limit. Used for audit trail and regulatory examination.

attributes.name: breach_action
attributes.description: Automated or procedural action to be taken when this risk limit is breached. Alert generates notification to risk management, block prevents new trades that would increase exposure, escalate triggers management review, auto_hedge initiates automated hedging transactions, manual_review requires trader or desk head intervention before proceeding.
attributes.references: FERC Order 741 Risk Controls, Internal Risk Policy

attributes.name: breach_count
attributes.description: Total number of times this risk limit has been breached since its effective_date. Incremented each time current_exposure_value exceeds limit_value. Used for risk reporting and limit effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: Business unit or division responsible for managing activities subject to this risk limit. Examples include Power Trading, Gas Supply, Renewable Energy, or Commercial Operations. Used for organizational reporting and accountability.

attributes.name: commodity
attributes.description: Energy commodity or product type to which this risk limit applies. Power includes wholesale electricity, natural gas includes pipeline gas and LNG, RECs are renewable energy certificates, capacity represents generation capacity rights, ancillary services include frequency regulation and reserves, emissions cover carbon credits and allowances. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: power|natural_gas|coal|renewable_energy_certificate|capacity|ancillary_services|emissions|multi_commodity — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: confidence_level_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Value at Risk (VaR) Confidence Level Percentage
attributes.description: Statistical confidence level used for VaR calculation when limit_type is 'var'. Typical values are 95% or 99%. Represents the probability that losses will not exceed the VaR limit over the specified time horizon. Nullable for non-VaR limit types.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP ERP cost center code associated with the organizational unit responsible for this risk limit. Used for financial reporting and cost allocation of risk management activities.

attributes.name: counterparty_credit_rating_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum credit rating required for counterparties when this limit applies to credit exposure. Expressed using standard rating agency notation (e.g., BBB-, A+, AA). Used to enforce credit quality standards in trading relationships. Nullable for non-credit-related limits.
attributes.references: Credit Risk Management Policy, Rating Agency Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this risk limit record was first created in the system. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Part of audit trail for regulatory compliance and data lineage.

attributes.name: current_exposure_value
attributes.description: Current absolute exposure value being monitored against this limit, expressed in the same units as limit_value. Sourced from Allegro ETRM mark-to-market valuations, position reports, or credit exposure calculations depending on limit_type.

attributes.name: current_utilization_percent
attributes.description: Current utilization of this risk limit expressed as a percentage of the limit_value. Calculated as (current_exposure / limit_value) * 100. Updated in near real-time from Allegro ETRM position data. Values approaching 100% trigger breach alerts.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this risk limit becomes active and enforceable. Limits are monitored and enforced starting from this date.

attributes.name: etrm_system_limit_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Energy Trading and Risk Management (ETRM) System Limit ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this risk limit in the Allegro ETRM system. Used for system integration, real-time monitoring, and automated breach detection. Enables bidirectional synchronization between lakehouse and operational ETRM platform.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this risk limit expires and is no longer enforced. Nullable for evergreen limits that remain in effect until explicitly revised or terminated.

attributes.name: last_breach_date
attributes.description: Most recent date on which this risk limit was breached. Nullable if the limit has never been breached. Used for breach pattern analysis and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: last_breach_value
attributes.description: Exposure value at the time of the most recent breach, expressed in limit_unit. Captures the magnitude of the breach for severity analysis and escalation decisions.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Limit Record Last Modified Timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this risk limit record. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Updated whenever any field value changes. Essential for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal review of this risk limit by the approval_authority. Used to track compliance with review_frequency requirements and ensure limits remain appropriate for current market conditions and business strategy.

attributes.name: limit_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to this risk limit for system identification and cross-reference with Allegro ETRM.

attributes.name: limit_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for monetary limit values. Typically USD for US-based utility operations, but may include CAD for cross-border transactions or other currencies for international hedging activities.

attributes.name: limit_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name or title assigned to this risk limit for identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: limit_scope
attributes.description: Organizational or business dimension to which this risk limit applies, defining whether the limit governs a portfolio, trading desk, individual trader, counterparty relationship, commodity type, geographic region, or ETRM book. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: portfolio|desk|trader|counterparty|commodity|region|book — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: limit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the risk limit defining the type of exposure being controlled. VaR (Value at Risk) measures potential loss, open position limits maximum volume exposure, stop-loss caps realized losses, credit exposure limits counterparty risk, tenor limits time-based exposure, Greeks measure option sensitivities, concentration limits single-asset exposure, and liquidity limits market depth constraints. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: var|open_position|stop_loss|credit_exposure|tenor|greeks|concentration|liquidity — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: limit_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the limit_value field. USD for monetary limits, MWh (Megawatt-Hour) for electric energy volume, MMBtu for gas volume, MW (Megawatt) for capacity, MCF (Thousand Cubic Feet) for gas volume, days for tenor limits, percent for concentration limits, and Greek letters (delta, gamma, vega, theta) for option sensitivity limits. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: usd|mwh|mmbtu|mw|mcf|days|percent|delta|gamma|vega|theta — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NERC Glossary of Terms, FERC Accounting Standards

attributes.name: limit_value
attributes.description: Numeric threshold value defining the maximum allowable exposure for this risk limit. Interpretation depends on limit_type: for VaR and stop-loss this is a monetary amount, for open position this is a volume (MWh or MMBtu), for credit exposure this is a dollar amount, for tenor this is a time period in days.

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: Specific energy market segment to which this risk limit applies. DAM (Day-Ahead Market) for forward commitments, RTM (Real-Time Market) for spot transactions, bilateral for over-the-counter contracts, financial for purely financial hedges, physical for delivery obligations, ancillary services for frequency regulation and reserves.
attributes.references: FERC Market Rules, RTO/ISO Operating Procedures

attributes.name: monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which this risk limit is evaluated and current_utilization_percent is updated. Real-time for critical limits monitored continuously via ETRM, intraday for multiple checks per day, daily for end-of-day position reports, weekly or monthly for strategic limits reviewed in periodic risk committee meetings.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Next Scheduled Risk Limit Review Date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review of this risk limit. Calculated based on last_review_date and review_frequency. Triggers workflow notifications to risk management and approval_authority as the date approaches.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional context, special conditions, or explanatory notes about this risk limit. May include rationale for limit level, historical context, or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: SAP ERP profit center code for the business segment whose profitability is impacted by activities governed by this risk limit. Used for segment reporting and performance attribution.

attributes.name: regulatory_mandate_reference
attributes.description: Citation of the regulatory requirement, order, or mandate that necessitates this risk limit. Examples include FERC Order 741, state PUC (Public Utility Commission) directives, NERC (North American Electric Reliability Corporation) standards, or internal policy references. Nullable for discretionary limits not driven by regulatory mandate.
attributes.references: FERC Orders, State PUC Regulations, NERC Standards

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency for formal review and potential revision of this risk limit by the approval_authority. Quarterly for dynamic trading limits, annual for strategic enterprise limits, ad-hoc for event-driven reviews triggered by market changes or regulatory updates.

attributes.name: risk_limit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this risk limit. Active limits are enforced, suspended limits are temporarily not enforced but remain on record, expired limits have passed their expiry_date, pending_approval limits await formal authorization, superseded limits have been replaced by newer versions.

attributes.name: rto_iso_market
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) or Independent System Operator (ISO) Market
attributes.description: RTO or ISO market to which this risk limit applies when the limit is market-specific. Examples include PJM, CAISO, ERCOT, MISO, ISO-NE, NYISO, SPP. Nullable for limits that span multiple markets or apply to bilateral transactions outside organized markets.
attributes.references: FERC Market Oversight, NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: scope_identifier
attributes.description: Specific identifier of the entity to which this limit applies (e.g., portfolio code, desk name, trader ID, counterparty code). Used in conjunction with limit_scope to define the exact boundary of the limit.

attributes.name: time_horizon_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Limit Time Horizon in Days
attributes.description: Time period in days over which the risk limit is measured. For VaR limits, this is the holding period (typically 1 day for trading portfolios). For tenor limits, this is the maximum forward duration allowed. Nullable for instantaneous limits like stop-loss.

attributes.name: hedge_effectiveness_test_method

attributes.description: Confidence level for VaR calculation expressed as a percentage (e.g., 95.00 or 99.00). Defines the statistical confidence interval for the VaR limit.
