attributes.name: var_limit_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Value at Risk (VaR) Limit in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Maximum Value at Risk (VaR) limit for this hedge program expressed in USD. Defines the maximum potential loss at the specified confidence level and time horizon. Used for risk monitoring and limit compliance.
attributes.references: Corporate Risk Management Policy, Basel Committee on Banking Supervision VaR Standards

attributes.name: var_time_horizon_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Value at Risk (VaR) Time Horizon in Days
attributes.description: Time horizon for VaR calculation expressed in days (e.g., 1 for daily VaR, 10 for 10-day VaR). Defines the holding period assumption for the risk measure.
attributes.references: Corporate Risk Management Policy, Basel Committee VaR Methodology

attributes.name: volume_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for approved volumes: MWh (megawatt-hour for electricity), MMBtu (million British thermal units for gas), tons (for coal), GJ (gigajoules), or therms.

products.name: rec_transaction
products.description: Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) transaction record capturing purchases, sales, retirements, and transfers of RECs. Captures REC transaction ID, transaction type (purchase, sale, retirement, transfer), REC vintage year, technology type (solar, wind, hydro, biomass), generation facility, state registry (WREGIS, NEPOOL-GIS, PJM-GATS), certificate serial numbers, quantity (MWh), price ($/REC), counterparty, transaction date, compliance program (RPS, voluntary), and retirement reason. Supports renewable portfolio standard (RPS) compliance tracking.

attributes.name: rec_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the REC transaction record. Primary key.

attributes.name: asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.registry. Business justification: REC transactions must be tied to the generating asset for renewable credit tracking and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the counterparty organization in the trading system or master data repository.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: REQUIRED: REC sales are billed to specific customer accounts; linking enables REC Sales to Customer reporting for compliance and invoicing.

attributes.name: dsm_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engagement.dsm_program. Business justification: REC transaction reporting must attribute each transaction to the DSM program that generated it for compliance and incentive calculations.

attributes.name: generation_facility_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the generation facility in the registry system or EIA database. May be EIA plant code or registry-specific facility ID.

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the trading portfolio or book to which this REC transaction is assigned for risk management and P&L attribution.

attributes.name: product_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_program. Business justification: Needed to associate REC transactions with the specific incentive program for compliance and tracking.

attributes.name: rec_certificate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to generation.generation_rec_certificate. Business justification: REC transactions settle specific renewable energy certificates generated by units; linking to the certificate record enables audit and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: rec_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.rec_inventory. Business justification: REC Transaction Tracking: each REC transaction must reference the specific REC registry entry it affects for compliance and tracking.

attributes.name: scada_system_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.scada_system. Business justification: REC validation depends on SCADA generation data; linking the transaction to the SCADA system ensures traceability for compliance.

attributes.name: broker_name
attributes.description: Name of the broker or intermediary that facilitated the REC transaction, if applicable. Null if transaction was direct between parties.

attributes.name: compliance_program
attributes.description: The regulatory compliance program or voluntary program for which the RECs are intended: state RPS (Renewable Portfolio Standard), voluntary green power program, carbon offset program, or corporate sustainability commitment. Free-text to accommodate various state and voluntary programs.

attributes.name: compliance_year
attributes.description: The compliance year for which the RECs will be applied or retired. May differ from vintage year due to banking or forward purchase provisions.

attributes.name: confirmation_date
attributes.description: Date when the REC transaction was confirmed by the counterparty or broker, validating the transaction terms.

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: Confirmation number or reference provided by the counterparty or broker confirming the REC transaction details.

attributes.name: contract_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the master agreement, PPA, or specific contract under which this REC transaction was executed.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center code in the financial system (SAP FI/CO) to which the REC transaction costs or revenues are allocated.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this REC transaction record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which RECs are delivered: registry transfer (electronic transfer within tracking system), physical certificate (paper certificate delivery), or electronic transfer (outside registry system).

attributes.name: eligibility_flags
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of eligibility attributes or certifications for the RECs: new_renewable, solar_carve_out, offshore_wind, community_solar, low_income_eligible, etc. Used for state-specific RPS tier compliance.

attributes.name: etrm_system_deal_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Energy Trading and Risk Management (ETRM) System Deal ID
attributes.description: Unique deal or transaction identifier in the Allegro ETRM system or other energy trading platform. Used for reconciliation between lakehouse and source system.

attributes.name: facility_state
attributes.description: U.S. state or Canadian province where the renewable generation facility is located. Important for state-specific RPS compliance.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code in the chart of accounts where the REC transaction is recorded for financial reporting.

attributes.name: green_e_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the RECs are certified under the Green-e voluntary renewable energy certification program. True if Green-e certified, False otherwise.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this REC transaction record was last updated or modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who last modified this REC transaction record. Used for audit and accountability.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the REC transaction, including special terms, conditions, or operational details.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date when payment for the REC transaction was made or received. Null if payment is still pending.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current status of payment for the REC transaction: pending (awaiting payment), paid (payment completed), overdue (payment past due date), disputed (payment under dispute), or waived (payment not required).

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Payment terms for the REC transaction: net 30, net 60, payment on delivery, advance payment, or other negotiated terms.

attributes.name: price_per_rec
attributes.description: Unit price paid or received per REC certificate, typically expressed in dollars per REC ($/REC). Used to calculate total transaction value.

attributes.name: quantity_mwh
attributes.description: Quantity of renewable energy certificates in megawatt-hours (MWh). Each REC typically represents 1 MWh of renewable energy generation.

attributes.name: registry_system
attributes.description: The renewable energy certificate tracking system or registry where the RECs are registered: WREGIS (Western), NEPOOL-GIS (New England), PJM-GATS (PJM), M-RETS (Midwest), NAR (North American Renewables), ERCOT, or MIRECS (Michigan). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WREGIS|NEPOOL-GIS|PJM-GATS|M-RETS|NAR|ERCOT|MIRECS — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this REC transaction must be included in regulatory compliance reporting to state PUC, FERC, or EPA. True if reportable, False otherwise.

attributes.name: retirement_account
attributes.description: Registry account name or identifier where RECs were retired, if applicable. Used for audit trail and compliance verification.

attributes.name: retirement_reason
attributes.description: Reason for retiring the RECs if transaction type is retirement: RPS compliance, voluntary green power claim, carbon neutrality goal, corporate sustainability reporting, or other specific purpose. Null for non-retirement transactions.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date when the REC transaction was settled and recorded in the registry system, completing the transfer of ownership or retirement.

attributes.name: technology_type
attributes.description: Type of renewable energy technology that generated the RECs: solar (photovoltaic or thermal), wind (onshore or offshore), hydro (hydroelectric), biomass (organic matter combustion), geothermal (earth heat), or landfill gas (methane capture).

attributes.name: total_transaction_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the REC transaction in USD, calculated as quantity multiplied by price per REC. Represents the gross transaction amount before fees or adjustments.

attributes.name: trader_name
attributes.description: Name of the trader or trading desk personnel responsible for executing this REC transaction.

attributes.name: transaction_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction. Typically USD for U.S. transactions or CAD for Canadian transactions.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: Date when the REC transaction was executed or agreed upon between parties. This is the business event date for the transaction.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique transaction number or reference code for the REC transaction, used for external communication and audit trails.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the REC transaction: pending (awaiting confirmation), confirmed (counterparty confirmed), settled (completed and recorded in registry), cancelled (voided before settlement), failed (transaction did not complete), or reversed (settled transaction reversed).

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of REC transaction: purchase (acquiring RECs from market or counterparty), sale (selling RECs to counterparty), retirement (retiring RECs for compliance or voluntary purposes), transfer (moving RECs between accounts or registries), issuance (initial creation of RECs from generation), or cancellation (voiding RECs).

attributes.name: vintage_year
attributes.description: The year in which the renewable energy was generated that corresponds to these RECs. Vintage year is critical for compliance programs with specific vintage requirements.

products.name: ancillary_award
products.description: ISO/RTO ancillary services award record for capacity cleared in regulation, spinning reserve, non-spinning reserve, and voltage support markets. Captures award ID, market, operating day, hour/interval, service type (regulation up/down, spinning reserve, non-spin, reactive), resource ID, awarded MW, clearing price ($/MW), obligation start/end, performance score, and settlement amount. Supports ancillary revenue tracking and NERC reliability compliance.

attributes.name: ancillary_award_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the ancillary services award record. Primary key for the ancillary award entity.

attributes.name: asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the generation or demand response resource that received the ancillary services award.

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the counterparty entity (resource owner or scheduling coordinator) that holds the ancillary services award.

attributes.name: filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.filing. Business justification: Ancillary Service Reporting: awards are reported in regulatory filings; linking provides traceability for compliance audits.

attributes.name: market_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ISO/RTO market in which the ancillary service was awarded.

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal trading portfolio or book to which this ancillary services award is allocated for risk management and P&L tracking.

attributes.name: pricing_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the locational marginal pricing (LMP) node or zone where the resource is located and the ancillary service price applies.

attributes.name: product_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_program. Business justification: Ancillary service awards are tied to specific program participation; linking enables program‑level award tracking.

attributes.name: transmission_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to transmission.line. Business justification: Ancillary Service Award tied to a specific transmission line for frequency regulation or voltage support, needed for award verification.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_mw
attributes.description: Actual capacity in megawatts delivered by the resource when called upon to provide the ancillary service. May differ from awarded capacity.

attributes.name: award_amount_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Award Amount in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Total dollar amount of the ancillary services award, calculated as awarded capacity multiplied by clearing price.

attributes.name: award_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for the ancillary services award assigned by the ISO/RTO market system.

attributes.name: award_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ancillary services award: awarded (initial), confirmed (accepted by resource), deployed (actively providing service), settled (financially settled), cancelled, or expired.

attributes.name: award_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the ISO/RTO issued the ancillary services award to the resource.

attributes.name: awarded_capacity_mw
attributes.description: The capacity in megawatts (MW) that was awarded to the resource for providing the ancillary service during the specified interval.

attributes.name: clearing_price_per_mw
attributes.description: The market clearing price in dollars per megawatt ($/MW) for the ancillary service capacity awarded.

attributes.name: confirmation_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the resource owner or scheduling coordinator confirmed acceptance of the ancillary services award.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ancillary award record was first created in the data platform.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which the ancillary award data was ingested (e.g., ISO/RTO market system, Allegro ETRM).

attributes.name: deployment_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration in minutes that the ancillary service was actively deployed during the interval.

attributes.name: deployment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ancillary service was actually deployed (called upon) during the interval. True if deployed, False if only capacity payment applies.

attributes.name: energy_payment_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Energy Payment in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Additional payment in dollars for energy delivered when the ancillary service was deployed, separate from the capacity award amount.

attributes.name: etrm_deal_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Energy Trading and Risk Management (ETRM) Deal Number
attributes.description: Deal or transaction number in the Allegro ETRM system associated with this ancillary services award.

attributes.name: ingestion_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the ancillary award record was ingested into the utility's data platform from the source system.

attributes.name: interval_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration of the market interval in minutes (e.g., 5, 15, 60) for which the award applies.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ancillary award record was last modified in the data platform.

attributes.name: market_interval_end
attributes.description: End timestamp of the market interval for which the ancillary service award applies.

attributes.name: market_interval_start
attributes.description: Start timestamp of the market interval for which the ancillary service award applies, typically in 5-minute or 15-minute increments.

attributes.name: market_type
attributes.description: Type of market in which the ancillary service was awarded: day-ahead market (DAM), real-time market (RTM), or supplemental procurement.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the ancillary services award, including any special conditions, adjustments, or operational remarks.

attributes.name: obligation_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the resource's obligation to provide the ancillary service ends.

attributes.name: obligation_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the resource's obligation to provide the ancillary service begins.

attributes.name: operating_date
attributes.description: The operating day for which the ancillary service capacity was awarded and must be available.

attributes.name: operating_hour
attributes.description: The hour-ending (HE) of the operating day for which the award applies, typically 1-24 or 0-23 depending on ISO/RTO convention.

attributes.name: performance_score
attributes.description: Performance score as a percentage (0-100) measuring how well the resource met its ancillary service obligation during the interval. Used for settlement adjustments and future market qualification.

attributes.name: pricing_zone
attributes.description: Name of the pricing zone or load zone where the ancillary service award applies.

attributes.name: publication_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the ISO/RTO published the ancillary services award results to market participants.

attributes.name: resource_type
attributes.description: Type of resource providing the ancillary service (e.g., thermal generation, hydro, battery storage, demand response, wind, solar).

attributes.name: rto_iso_market
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) / Independent System Operator (ISO) Market
attributes.description: Name of the RTO or ISO market operator that issued the award (e.g., PJM, CAISO, ERCOT, MISO, NYISO, ISO-NE, SPP).

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: Broader category of ancillary service: frequency regulation, contingency reserve, voltage control, or black start capability.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Type of ancillary service awarded: regulation up, regulation down, spinning reserve, non-spinning reserve, supplemental reserve, reactive power, or voltage support. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: regulation_up|regulation_down|spinning_reserve|non_spinning_reserve|supplemental_reserve|reactive_power|voltage_support — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Order 888, NERC Reliability Standards BAL-001, BAL-002

attributes.name: settlement_amount_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Settlement Amount in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Final settlement amount in dollars after applying performance adjustments, penalties, and energy payments. May differ from initial award amount.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date when the ancillary services award was financially settled by the ISO/RTO.

attributes.name: settlement_run_number
attributes.description: Sequential number of the settlement run (initial, resettlement, final) in which this award was settled. ISO/RTOs may perform multiple settlement passes.

products.name: credit_exposure
products.description: Time-series counterparty credit exposure record tracking daily current and potential future credit exposure calculations, distinct from the static credit profile on counterparty. Captures exposure date, counterparty, credit rating snapshot (S&P/Moodys as of date), approved credit limit, current mark-to-market exposure, potential future exposure (PFE) using Monte Carlo or parametric methods, collateral posted (cash/LC) and received, net exposure after collateral, credit utilization percentage, margin call threshold, days to margin call, and credit status (normal, watch, restricted, suspended). Serves as the time-series audit trail for credit decisions while counterparty holds the static credit profile.

attributes.name: credit_exposure_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the credit exposure record. Primary key for time-series credit exposure tracking.

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the counterparty entity for which credit exposure is being tracked. Links to the master counterparty record.

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trading portfolio associated with this credit exposure calculation.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the credit exposure record or status change was approved by the credit officer.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the credit officer or risk manager who approved the credit exposure calculation or status change.

attributes.name: approved_credit_limit_usd
attributes.description: Maximum credit exposure limit approved for this counterparty in US Dollars. Represents the total authorized exposure threshold.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts - Account 146

attributes.name: breach_amount_usd
attributes.description: Amount by which the current exposure exceeds the approved credit limit in US Dollars. Null if no breach exists.

attributes.name: collateral_posted_usd
attributes.description: Total value of collateral posted by the utility to the counterparty in US Dollars. Includes cash, letters of credit, and other eligible collateral forms.

attributes.name: collateral_received_usd
attributes.description: Total value of collateral received from the counterparty in US Dollars. Includes cash, letters of credit, and other eligible collateral forms.

attributes.name: collateral_type_posted
attributes.description: Type of collateral posted by the utility to the counterparty (e.g., cash, letter of credit, parent guarantee).

attributes.name: collateral_type_received
attributes.description: Type of collateral received from the counterparty (e.g., cash, letter of credit, parent guarantee).

attributes.name: commodity_concentration_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the exposure to this counterparty represents a concentration risk in a specific commodity (power, gas, RECs). True if concentration risk exists, False otherwise.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this credit exposure record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer.

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: Credit rating of the counterparty as of the exposure date. Snapshot value from the specified rating agency (e.g., AAA, BBB+, Ba2).

attributes.name: credit_rating_agency
attributes.description: The rating agency providing the credit rating snapshot as of the exposure date.

attributes.name: credit_rating_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the credit rating became effective or was last updated by the rating agency.

attributes.name: credit_status
attributes.description: Current credit status classification for the counterparty. Determines trading restrictions and approval requirements.

attributes.name: credit_status_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the current credit status became effective.

attributes.name: credit_status_reason
attributes.description: Business reason or justification for the current credit status classification (e.g., rating downgrade, payment default, limit breach).

attributes.name: credit_utilization_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of the approved credit limit currently utilized. Calculated as (net exposure / approved credit limit) * 100.

attributes.name: credit_valuation_adjustment_usd
attributes.description: Credit valuation adjustment representing the market value of counterparty credit risk. Calculated as the difference between risk-free portfolio value and value adjusted for counterparty default risk.
attributes.references: Basel III Counterparty Credit Risk - CVA

attributes.name: current_exposure_usd
attributes.description: Current mark-to-market exposure to the counterparty in US Dollars. Represents the replacement cost if the counterparty defaults today.
attributes.references: Basel III Counterparty Credit Risk - Current Exposure Method

attributes.name: days_to_margin_call
attributes.description: Number of days until a margin call is required based on current exposure trajectory and contractual terms. Null if no margin call is anticipated.

attributes.name: etrm_system_exposure_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Energy Trading and Risk Management (ETRM) System Exposure ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this credit exposure record in the source Allegro ETRM system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: expected_credit_loss_usd
attributes.description: Expected credit loss calculated per IFRS 9 or CECL accounting standards. Represents the probability-weighted estimate of credit losses.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments - Expected Credit Loss

attributes.name: exposure_at_default_usd
attributes.description: Estimated exposure amount at the time of counterparty default in US Dollars. Used in expected credit loss calculations.
attributes.references: Basel III Credit Risk - Exposure at Default

attributes.name: exposure_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the current exposure exceeds the approved credit limit. True if in breach, False otherwise.

attributes.name: exposure_calculation_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the credit exposure calculation was performed by the ETRM system.

attributes.name: exposure_date
attributes.description: Business date for which the credit exposure is calculated. Represents the snapshot date for this time-series record.
attributes.references: FERC Form 552 - Annual Report of Natural Gas Transactions

attributes.name: geographic_concentration_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the exposure to this counterparty represents a concentration risk in a specific geographic region or RTO/ISO market. True if concentration risk exists, False otherwise.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this credit exposure record was last updated in the lakehouse silver layer.

attributes.name: loss_given_default_percent
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of exposure that will be lost if the counterparty defaults, after accounting for recovery.
attributes.references: Basel III Credit Risk - Loss Given Default

attributes.name: margin_call_status
attributes.description: Current status of margin call activity for this counterparty as of the exposure date.
attributes.value_regex: No Call Required|Call Issued|Call Pending|Call Satisfied|Call Disputed

attributes.name: margin_call_threshold_usd
attributes.description: Exposure threshold in US Dollars at which a margin call is triggered per the credit agreement or ISDA CSA.

attributes.name: net_exposure_usd
attributes.description: Net credit exposure after accounting for collateral posted and received. Calculated as current exposure plus potential future exposure minus net collateral.
attributes.references: Basel III Counterparty Credit Risk - Net Exposure Calculation

attributes.name: netting_agreement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a legally enforceable netting agreement (e.g., ISDA Master Agreement) is in place with the counterparty. True if netting is allowed, False otherwise.

attributes.name: netting_set_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the netting set under which trades with this counterparty are grouped for exposure calculation purposes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional comments, observations, or context regarding the credit exposure calculation or counterparty credit status.

attributes.name: pfe_calculation_method
attributes.description: Methodology used to calculate the potential future exposure (e.g., Monte Carlo simulation, parametric VaR, historical simulation).
attributes.references: Basel III Counterparty Credit Risk - Internal Model Method

attributes.name: pfe_confidence_level_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Potential Future Exposure (PFE) Confidence Level Percent
attributes.description: Confidence level used in the PFE calculation expressed as a percentage (e.g., 95.00, 99.00). Represents the statistical confidence interval for the exposure estimate.
attributes.references: Basel III Counterparty Credit Risk - Internal Model Method

attributes.name: pfe_time_horizon_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Potential Future Exposure (PFE) Time Horizon Days
attributes.description: Time horizon in days over which the potential future exposure is calculated (e.g., 10 days, 30 days, 365 days).
attributes.references: Basel III Counterparty Credit Risk - Internal Model Method

attributes.name: potential_future_exposure_usd
attributes.description: Potential future exposure calculated using Monte Carlo or parametric methods. Represents the maximum expected exposure over the life of the contracts at a specified confidence level.
attributes.references: Basel III Counterparty Credit Risk - Internal Model Method

attributes.name: probability_of_default_percent
attributes.description: Estimated probability that the counterparty will default within a specified time horizon, expressed as a percentage.
attributes.references: Basel III Credit Risk - Probability of Default

attributes.name: regulatory_capital_charge_usd
attributes.description: Regulatory capital charge required for this credit exposure per Basel III or applicable regulatory framework in US Dollars.

attributes.name: risk_weighted_asset_usd
attributes.description: Risk-weighted asset value for this credit exposure calculated per Basel III standardized or internal ratings-based approach in US Dollars.

products.name: market
products.description: Master reference table for market. Referenced by market_id.

attributes.name: market_id
attributes.description: Primary key for market

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the market record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency
attributes.description: Currency used for pricing and settlement in the market.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the market's purpose and characteristics.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date when the market definition becomes effective.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date when the market definition expires or is superseded; null if indefinite.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether the market is currently active for trading.

attributes.name: market_category
attributes.description: High-level category grouping markets by function.

attributes.name: market_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the market (e.g., DAM for Day-Ahead Market).

attributes.name: market_data_refresh_rate_minutes
attributes.description: Frequency, in minutes, at which market data is refreshed.

attributes.name: market_data_source
attributes.description: System or vendor providing market data feeds.

attributes.name: market_is_financial

attributes.name: market_is_hedgeable
attributes.description: Indicates whether positions in this market can be used for hedging.

attributes.name: market_is_physical

attributes.name: market_lmp_basis

attributes.name: market_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the market.

attributes.name: market_notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes or comments about the market.

attributes.name: market_operator

attributes.name: market_price_precision
attributes.description: Number of decimal places used for market price values.

attributes.name: market_price_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for market prices (e.g., USD/MWh).

attributes.name: market_regulation
attributes.description: Regulatory authority governing the market.

attributes.name: market_settlement_period
attributes.description: Standard settlement interval for the market.

attributes.name: market_subtype
attributes.description: More granular classification within the market category.

attributes.name: market_timezone
attributes.description: Time zone identifier for market operating hours (e.g., America/New_York).

attributes.name: market_type
attributes.description: Classification of the market based on trading horizon or service.

attributes.name: market_volatility_index
attributes.description: Numeric indicator of price volatility for the market.

attributes.name: market_website
attributes.description: Public-facing website URL for the market.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Geographic region or ISO country code where the market operates.

attributes.name: settlement_rule
attributes.description: Rule defining how market settlements are calculated.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the market record.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the market record.

attributes.name: parent_market_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on market (parent_market_id)

products.name: pricing_node
products.description: Master reference table for pricing_node. Referenced by pricing_node_id.

attributes.name: pricing_node_id
attributes.description: Primary key for pricing_node

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Business code used to reference the pricing node in trading systems.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the pricing node record was first created in the lakehouse.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three‑letter ISO currency code for the price.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Free‑form description of the pricing node's purpose or characteristics.

attributes.name: effective_from

domains.name: asset
domains.description: Enterprise asset management serving as the SSOT for all physical infrastructure assets across generation, T&D, gas systems, substations, and field equipment. Manages asset registry, lifecycle status, condition metrics, depreciation schedules, maintenance work orders, inspections, and CAPEX planning. Integrates with Maximo EAM and Esri ArcGIS for geospatial asset tracking. Supports ISO 55000 compliance and RAB reporting.
domains.references: ISO 55000, FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USOA)

products.name: registry
products.description: Master record for every physical infrastructure asset owned or operated by the utility, including generation plant equipment, T&D poles/lines/cables, gas pipeline segments, substations, transformers, meters, and field devices. Serves as the enterprise SSOT for asset identity, classification (referencing asset class), installation details, geospatial location (FK to location), manufacturer data, model/serial numbers, rated capacity, voltage class, material composition, commissioning date, retirement date, and current lifecycle status. Integrates with Maximo EAM as the system of record and Esri ArcGIS for spatial attributes. Supports ISO 55000 asset management compliance and RAB reporting to state PUCs. Technical material specifications for procurement are referenced via FK to the supply domain's material master.
products.reference: Maximo Asset Master / ISO 55000 Asset Register

products.name: hierarchy
products.description: Defines the parent-child structural hierarchy of utility assets, enabling roll-up from individual components (e.g., a circuit breaker) to functional units (e.g., a substation bay) to facilities (e.g., a substation) to network segments (e.g., a transmission corridor). Captures hierarchy type (functional, spatial, accounting), relationship effective dates, and hierarchy level codes. Used for CAPEX roll-up, maintenance planning, outage impact analysis, and RAB reporting. Sourced from Maximo EAM location/asset hierarchy and Esri ArcGIS network topology.
products.reference: Maximo Asset Hierarchy / ISO 55000 Asset System

attributes.name: hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Primary key for hierarchy

attributes.name: child_asset_asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the child asset in the hierarchy structure. References the subordinate asset in the parent-child relationship.

attributes.description: Identifier of the child asset in the hierarchy structure. References the subordinate asset in the parent-child relationship.

attributes.name: hierarchy_asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent asset in the hierarchy structure. References the superior asset in the parent-child relationship.

attributes.description: Percentage of child asset costs (Operations and Maintenance, depreciation, CAPEX) allocated to the parent asset for financial roll-up and rate base reporting. May differ from ownership percentage in regulated utility accounting. Value between 0.00 and 100.00.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the hierarchy relationship record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: criticality_inheritance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child asset inherits criticality classification from the parent asset. True means child criticality is derived from parent, false means child has independent criticality assessment.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Automated data quality score for the hierarchy relationship record based on completeness, consistency, and validation rules. Value between 0.00 and 1.00 where 1.00 represents perfect quality.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the hierarchy relationship ceases or ceased to be effective. Null indicates an open-ended relationship. Used for temporal hierarchy queries and asset reorganization tracking.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the hierarchy relationship becomes or became effective. Used for temporal hierarchy queries and historical asset structure analysis.

attributes.name: geographic_containment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child asset is physically contained within the geographic boundaries of the parent asset. True for spatial containment (e.g., transformer inside substation), false for logical relationships without physical containment.

attributes.name: gis_feature_relationship_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Geographic Information System (GIS) Feature Relationship Identifier (ID)
attributes.description: External identifier linking this hierarchy relationship to the corresponding feature relationship in Esri ArcGIS. Enables synchronization between EAM and GIS systems for geospatial asset tracking.

attributes.name: hierarchy_description
attributes.description: Free-text description explaining the nature and business purpose of the parent-child relationship. Provides context for non-standard or complex hierarchical arrangements.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the hierarchy tree structure where level 1 is the root and higher numbers represent deeper nesting. Used for roll-up calculations and tree traversal.

attributes.name: hierarchy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the hierarchy relationship type. Functional represents operational groupings, spatial represents physical location containment, accounting represents financial roll-up structures, network represents electrical or gas connectivity, organizational represents ownership or responsibility structures, and maintenance represents work planning groupings.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management, Maximo EAM Hierarchy Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified the hierarchy relationship record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the hierarchy relationship record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change detection, and incremental data processing.

attributes.name: maintenance_responsibility_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the organizational unit or crew responsible for maintaining the child asset within this hierarchy context. Used for work order routing and maintenance planning.

attributes.name: maximo_relationship_code
attributes.description: External identifier from Maximo EAM system representing the source asset relationship record. Used for data lineage and bidirectional synchronization with the operational EAM system.

attributes.name: network_topology_role
attributes.description: Role of the child asset relative to the parent in electrical or gas network topology. Upstream indicates the child feeds the parent, downstream indicates the parent feeds the child, parallel indicates side-by-side configuration, redundant indicates backup relationship, and isolated indicates no active flow relationship.
attributes.references: NERC Bulk Electric System Standards, Esri ArcGIS Network Topology

attributes.name: outage_propagation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an outage of the parent asset automatically causes an outage of the child asset. True for dependent assets where parent failure cascades to children, false for independent operation. Used in Outage Management System (OMS) impact analysis.
attributes.references: NERC Reliability Standards, GE PowerOn OMS

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the child asset owned or allocated to the parent asset in joint ownership or shared asset scenarios. Used for proportional CAPEX allocation and Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) calculations. Value between 0.00 and 100.00.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations, FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: path
attributes.description: Full hierarchical path from root to child asset represented as a delimited string of asset identifiers. Enables efficient ancestor and descendant queries. Format example: /1/45/892/3421.

attributes.name: primary_hierarchy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary hierarchy relationship for the child asset when multiple hierarchy types exist. True designates the authoritative parent-child relationship for default reporting and CAPEX roll-up.

attributes.name: rab_allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate child asset value to parent for Regulatory Asset Base reporting. Direct assigns full value to parent, proportional uses ownership percentage, shared distributes across multiple parents, and excluded removes from RAB roll-up.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts, State PUC Rate Case Requirements

attributes.name: relationship_established_date
attributes.description: Date when the hierarchy relationship was first created in the system. Distinct from effective start date; represents the administrative creation date for audit purposes.

attributes.name: relationship_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the hierarchy relationship. Active indicates the relationship is currently in effect, inactive indicates it has been terminated, pending indicates it is scheduled for future activation, and superseded indicates it has been replaced by a newer relationship.

attributes.name: relationship_terminated_date
attributes.description: Date when the hierarchy relationship was administratively terminated or removed from the system. Used for audit trail and historical analysis of asset reorganizations.

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordering sequence of the child asset among its siblings within the same parent. Used for display ordering and operational sequencing in maintenance routes and inspection plans.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: System of origin for the hierarchy relationship record. Maximo indicates EAM system, ArcGIS indicates geospatial system, SAP PM indicates plant maintenance module, manual indicates user-entered data, and migration indicates legacy system conversion.

attributes.name: termination_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for terminating the hierarchy relationship. Asset retired indicates child asset decommissioned, asset transferred indicates ownership change, reorganization indicates structural change, error correction indicates data quality fix, asset replaced indicates equipment upgrade, and consolidation indicates merger of asset records.

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Status of data quality validation for the hierarchy relationship. Validated indicates passed all business rules, pending review indicates flagged for manual inspection, failed indicates rule violations detected, and not validated indicates validation not yet performed.

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the most recent data quality validation was performed on the hierarchy relationship record.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created the hierarchy relationship record. Used for audit trail and data governance.

attributes.name: asset_class_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the asset class, including typical use cases, technical characteristics, and operational context within the utility's infrastructure.

attributes.name: asset_class_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the asset classification hierarchy, with 1 representing top-level categories and higher numbers representing more granular sub-classifications.

attributes.name: asset_class_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the asset class (e.g., 'Distribution Transformer', 'Transmission Tower', 'Gas Regulator Station').

attributes.name: asset_criticality_rating
attributes.description: Default criticality classification for assets in this class based on impact to grid reliability, safety, and regulatory compliance. Used for prioritizing maintenance and capital investment.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management, NERC Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP)

attributes.name: average_unit_cost
attributes.description: Average acquisition or installation cost per unit for assets in this class, used for budgeting and capital expenditure (CAPEX) planning. Updated periodically based on procurement history.

attributes.name: average_unit_cost_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the average unit cost (e.g., USD, CAD).

attributes.name: capitalization_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Minimum dollar value required for an asset in this class to be capitalized as a fixed asset rather than expensed. Aligns with FASB ASC 980 and internal CAPEX policies.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations, Internal CAPEX Policy

attributes.name: capitalization_threshold_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the capitalization threshold amount (e.g., USD, CAD).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this asset class record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to depreciate assets in this class: straight-line (equal annual expense), declining balance (accelerated), sum-of-years digits, units of production (usage-based), group/composite (pooled depreciation), or other method approved by regulatory authority.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations, FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this asset class definition was retired or superseded. Null if currently active. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this asset class definition became effective for use in asset registration and accounting. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets in this class are subject to Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) or state environmental regulations (e.g., emissions monitoring, hazardous materials handling, spill prevention). True if environmental compliance tracking is required.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act, EPA Clean Water Act, State Environmental Regulations

attributes.name: ferc_account_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Number
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts number for regulatory accounting classification. Maps asset class to the appropriate plant account for rate base and depreciation reporting (e.g., 364 for Poles and Fixtures, 365 for Overhead Conductors).
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101)

attributes.name: gis_trackable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets in this class are spatially tracked in the Esri ArcGIS system with geospatial coordinates. True if GIS location tracking is required for operational and planning purposes.

attributes.name: insurance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets in this class must be covered by property insurance policies. True if insurance coverage is mandatory for risk management and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management, State PUC Requirements

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this asset class record was most recently updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: maintenance_strategy
attributes.description: Standard maintenance approach for assets in this class: reactive (repair on failure), preventive (scheduled maintenance), predictive (sensor-driven), condition-based (inspection-driven), reliability-centered (RCM), or run-to-failure (no maintenance).
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management, Maximo EAM Best Practices

attributes.name: manufacturer_agnostic_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this asset class is defined independently of manufacturer or vendor (true) or is specific to a particular manufacturer's product line (false).

attributes.name: mobile_asset_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets in this class are mobile (e.g., fleet vehicles, portable generators, mobile substations) rather than fixed infrastructure. True if the asset class represents mobile equipment.

attributes.name: nerc_cip_applicable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets in this class are subject to NERC CIP cybersecurity and physical security standards for Bulk Electric System (BES) protection. True if CIP standards apply, false otherwise.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, special instructions, or clarifications regarding the asset class definition and usage.

attributes.name: replacement_cycle_years
attributes.description: Typical replacement or refresh cycle for assets in this class, used for long-term capital planning and Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) forecasting. May differ from depreciation life.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management, IRP Planning Standards

attributes.name: safety_inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets in this class require periodic safety inspections per Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) or utility safety standards. True if mandatory safety inspections apply.
attributes.references: OSHA Standards, NESC (National Electrical Safety Code)

attributes.name: salvage_value_percentage
attributes.description: Expected residual value of assets in this class at end of useful life, expressed as a percentage of original cost. Used in depreciation calculations per FERC and FASB ASC 980 requirements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations, FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: serialized_asset_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual assets in this class are tracked by unique serial numbers or asset tags. True if serialization is required for inventory and lifecycle management.

attributes.name: standard_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit used to quantify assets in this class for inventory and planning purposes (e.g., 'each', 'mile', 'meter', 'MVA', 'MCF'). Aligns with industry measurement standards.
attributes.references: ISO 80000 Quantities and Units, Industry Standards

attributes.name: standard_useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected service life of assets in this class, measured in years, as approved by the Public Utility Commission (PUC) for depreciation rate calculation and Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) reporting.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts, State PUC Depreciation Studies

attributes.name: warranty_tracking_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets in this class require warranty period and warranty claim tracking. True if warranty management is applicable for this asset class.

products.name: condition_assessment
products.description: Comprehensive condition monitoring and assessment records for utility assets, serving as the single source of truth for asset health data. Captures three integrated record types: (1) Inspection events — formal field inspections conducted by utility crews, third-party inspectors, or regulatory auditors including inspection type (routine patrol, thermographic, structural, environmental, NERC CIP, PHMSA pipeline), inspector certification, inspection result (pass/fail/conditional), findings summary, deficiency count, and regulatory program association; (2) Condition scores — periodic condition grades (1-5 scale), condition index scores, failure probability ratings, remaining useful life estimates, recommended remediation actions, and assessment method (visual, thermographic, ultrasonic, oil sample); (3) Operational readings — quantitative measurements from SCADA/PI Historian and field instruments including transformer loading %, oil temperature, dissolved gas analysis (DGA) ppm, cable insulation resistance MΩ, gas pipeline pressure PSI, vibration levels, and threshold breach flags. Feeds asset health index calculations for risk-based maintenance prioritization and CAPEX planning. Sourced from Maximo inspection workflows, OSIsoft PI Historian, and field measurement instruments. Distinct from AMI meter interval reads (owned by metering domain).
products.reference: Maximo Condition Monitoring / ISO 55000 Asset Health Index

attributes.name: condition_assessment_id

attributes.name: asset_registry_id

attributes.name: generating_unit_id

attributes.name: gis_location_id
attributes.description: Esri ArcGIS location identifier for geospatial tracking of the asset being assessed. Enables spatial analysis of asset condition patterns.

attributes.name: registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical asset being assessed. Links to the asset registry for generation, transmission, distribution, or gas infrastructure equipment.

attributes.name: scada_point_id

attributes.description: Reference to the SCADA point or PI Historian tag that provided the operational reading data for automated measurements.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian, IEC 61850 SCADA Standards

attributes.name: technician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technician or inspector who performed the assessment. Links to workforce technician registry.

attributes.name: work_order_id

attributes.name: ambient_temperature_c

attributes.name: assessment_cost
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for performing the condition assessment including labor, equipment, and contractor fees. Supports O&M (Operations and Maintenance) cost tracking.

attributes.name: assessment_method

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: visual|thermographic|ultrasonic|oil_sample|vibration|dga|insulation_test — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: assessment_source
attributes.description: Origin of the condition assessment data: field inspection by utility crews, automated SCADA reading, PI Historian data feed, manual data entry, or third-party contractor assessment.

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the condition assessment activity.

attributes.name: assessment_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the condition assessment was performed or measurement was captured. Primary business event timestamp for the assessment.

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Category of condition assessment record: inspection event, condition score evaluation, or operational reading measurement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: inspection|condition_score|operational_reading|thermographic|structural|environmental|regulatory — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Regulatory compliance status based on assessment results: compliant with requirements, non-compliant requiring corrective action, pending regulatory review, or remediation in progress.
attributes.references: NERC CIP Standards, FERC Compliance Requirements

attributes.name: condition_index
attributes.description: Calculated condition index score (0-100 scale) representing overall asset health based on multiple assessment factors.

attributes.name: condition_score
attributes.description: Numeric condition grade on a 1-5 scale where 5 is excellent/new condition and 1 is poor/end-of-life. Used for asset health index calculations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: deficiency_count

attributes.name: dga_ppm

attributes.description: Concentration of dissolved gases in transformer oil measured in parts per million. Used to detect incipient faults in oil-filled electrical equipment.

attributes.name: failure_probability_rating
attributes.description: Assessed likelihood of asset failure within the planning horizon. Used for risk-based maintenance prioritization.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management, IEEE Asset Management Standards

attributes.name: findings_summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of inspection findings, observations, and deficiencies identified during the assessment.

attributes.name: gas_pressure_psi
attributes.description: Measured natural gas pipeline pressure in pounds per square inch. Critical safety and operational parameter for gas distribution systems.

attributes.name: inspection_result
attributes.description: Overall outcome of the inspection: pass (no issues), fail (critical deficiencies), conditional (minor issues noted), or requires follow-up investigation.

attributes.name: inspection_type
attributes.description: Specific type of inspection conducted for inspection assessment records. attributes.references: NERC CIP Standards, PHMSA Pipeline Safety Regulations

attributes.name: inspector_certification
attributes.description: Professional certification or qualification held by the inspector conducting the assessment (e.g., Level II Thermographer, NACE Corrosion Specialist, API 510 Pressure Vessel Inspector).
attributes.references: OSHA Training Requirements, Industry Certification Bodies

attributes.name: insulation_resistance_mohm
attributes.description: Measured insulation resistance in megaohms for cables and electrical equipment. Indicates insulation integrity and moisture ingress.

attributes.name: measurement_parameter
attributes.description: Name of the operational parameter being measured for operational reading records (e.g., transformer loading, oil temperature, gas pressure, insulation resistance).
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian Tag Naming Convention

attributes.name: measurement_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the operational reading (e.g., %, °C, PSI, MΩ, ppm, Hz, kV).

attributes.name: measurement_value
attributes.description: Quantitative measurement value captured from SCADA/PI Historian or field instruments for operational readings.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this condition assessment record was last modified. Audit trail for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: next_assessment_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required condition assessment based on regulatory requirements, manufacturer recommendations, or risk-based maintenance intervals.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, observations, or context provided by the inspector or assessment system.

attributes.name: oil_temperature_c
attributes.description: Measured oil temperature in degrees Celsius for oil-filled transformers and circuit breakers. Key indicator of thermal stress and cooling system performance.

attributes.name: photo_attachment_count
attributes.description: Number of digital photographs or thermal images attached to the assessment record for documentation purposes.

attributes.name: recommended_action
attributes.description: Recommended remediation action based on condition assessment: continue monitoring, schedule routine maintenance, perform corrective maintenance, major repair, or asset replacement.

attributes.name: regulatory_program
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory compliance program associated with this assessment (e.g., NERC CIP-006, PHMSA Integrity Management, EPA Environmental Inspection).
attributes.references: NERC CIP Standards, PHMSA Regulations, EPA Requirements

attributes.name: remaining_useful_life_years
attributes.description: Estimated remaining useful life of the asset in years based on current condition assessment. Supports CAPEX planning and replacement scheduling.

attributes.name: third_party_contractor
attributes.description: Name of the third-party inspection contractor or vendor if assessment was performed by external party.

attributes.name: threshold_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the measured value exceeded acceptable threshold limits (true) or remained within normal operating range (false).

attributes.name: threshold_min
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable threshold value for the operational parameter. Values below this trigger alerts.

attributes.name: transformer_loading_pct
attributes.description: Current loading percentage of transformer capacity for transformer assets. Critical operational metric for transmission and distribution transformers.

attributes.name: vibration_level_mm_s
attributes.description: Measured vibration velocity in millimeters per second for rotating equipment (generators, turbines, motors). Indicates mechanical condition and bearing health.

attributes.name: weather_conditions
attributes.description: Weather conditions at the time of field inspection (e.g., clear, rain, snow, high wind) that may affect assessment accuracy or asset condition.

products.name: work_order
products.description: Maximo-sourced work order master representing all planned, corrective, and emergency maintenance activities performed on utility assets. Captures work order number, work type (preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, inspection, capital project, emergency restoration), priority level, originating source (SCADA alarm, inspection finding, customer complaint, scheduled PM), work order status, planned start/finish dates, actual start/finish dates, crew assignment, estimated and actual labor hours, estimated and actual material cost, and associated asset. Central operational record linking asset maintenance to workforce dispatch and supply chain material consumption.
products.reference: Maximo Work Order (WO) / EAM Work Management

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the work order record. Primary key sourced from Maximo Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) system.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the manager or engineer who approved the work order for execution. Required for capital project and high-priority work.

attributes.name: asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the physical asset on which maintenance work is performed. Links work order to asset registry in Maximo and GIS.

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_account. Business justification: Work orders for customer‑initiated service are billed to the customer’s account; linking enables invoice generation and revenue recognition per work order.

attributes.name: ci_account_id

attributes.name: closed_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the user who closed the work order. Indicates final review and acceptance of completed work.

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the supervisor or foreman responsible for overseeing work order execution. Links to workforce management system.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.facility. Business justification: MAINTENANCE: Work orders are scheduled per facility (substation/plant) to coordinate crews and meet safety regulations.

attributes.name: generating_unit_id

attributes.name: it_service_id

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the geographic location or facility where work is performed. Supports crew dispatch routing and outage coordination.

attributes.name: parent_work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent work order if this is a child or sub-task work order. Supports hierarchical project breakdown for capital projects.

attributes.name: pm_schedule_id

attributes.name: primary_work_technician_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the supervisor or foreman responsible for overseeing work order execution. Links to workforce management system.

attributes.name: registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the physical asset on which maintenance work is performed. Links work order to asset registry in Maximo and GIS.

attributes.name: safety_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.safety_program. Business justification: Work orders must reference the applicable safety program (e.g., lockout/tagout) to ensure required safety procedures are followed and documented.

attributes.name: site_id

attributes.name: tertiary_work_closed_by_technician_id

attributes.name: actual_finish_timestamp

attributes.name: actual_labor_hours

attributes.name: actual_material_cost

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when work order execution began. Captured from crew mobile device or workforce management system for labor tracking.

attributes.name: actual_total_cost
attributes.description: Total cost actually incurred for the work order. Captured from SAP ERP for financial reporting and Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) reporting.

attributes.name: capitalized_flag

attributes.name: closed_timestamp

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: estimated_labor_hours

attributes.name: estimated_material_cost

attributes.name: estimated_total_cost
attributes.description: Planned total cost of the work order including labor, materials, equipment, and contractor costs. Used for budget authorization and CAPEX/OPEX planning.

attributes.name: failure_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the type of asset failure or condition that triggered corrective maintenance. Used for reliability analysis and failure mode tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the work order record was last modified. Audit field for change tracking and data lineage.

attributes.name: originating_source
attributes.description: System or business process that initiated the work order. Identifies root cause trigger for maintenance activity and supports reliability analysis.

attributes.name: outage_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Planned or actual duration of the outage in minutes. Used for SAIDI/SAIFI reliability metrics calculation and customer impact assessment.

attributes.name: outage_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the work order requires a planned outage of the asset or circuit. Used for outage coordination with OMS and customer notification.

attributes.name: permit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether regulatory or municipal permits are required before work can begin. Triggers permit acquisition workflow.

attributes.name: planned_finish_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date when work order execution is planned to be completed. Used for outage duration planning and customer communication.

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date when work order execution is planned to begin. Used for resource planning and outage coordination.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level determining scheduling sequence and resource allocation urgency. Emergency priority triggers immediate dispatch for grid reliability.

attributes.name: problem_description

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this work order is required for regulatory compliance (NERC CIP, FERC, PUC mandates). Used for compliance reporting and audit trails.

attributes.name: resolution_description

attributes.name: work_order_number

attributes.name: work_order_status

attributes.name: measurement_unit

attributes.name: measurement_value

products.name: pm_schedule
products.description: Preventive maintenance program master defining both the strategic maintenance policy and operational scheduling for asset classes and individual assets. Serves as the single source of truth for all PM configuration — equivalent to the Maximo PM record. Captures PM program name, maintenance strategy type (time-based, condition-based, reliability-centered RCM, risk-based), strategy rationale, frequency type and interval (calendar days, operating hours, condition trigger), criticality tier (1-critical, 2-essential, 3-standard), regulatory compliance driver (NERC, PHMSA, PUC), associated job plan template, applicable asset class or individual asset, annual O&M budget allocation, required inspection frequency, last completion date, next due date, schedule status, and plan review cycle. Drives automatic work order generation in Maximo, supports O&M budget forecasting, documents maintenance compliance for regulatory filings, and provides the strategic policy context for maintenance program governance.

attributes.name: failure_event_number

attributes.name: failure_mode
