attributes.description: Indicates whether the failure was caused by or contributed to by weather conditions such as lightning, wind, ice, temperature extremes, or flooding. Used for major event day (MED) exclusions in reliability reporting.

products.name: depreciation_schedule
products.description: Asset depreciation schedule records aligned with FERC Uniform System of Accounts and FASB ASC 980 regulated operations accounting. Captures asset ID, depreciation method (straight-line, MACRS, units-of-production), depreciable cost basis, accumulated depreciation to date, annual depreciation expense, net book value, remaining depreciable life, salvage value estimate, depreciation study reference, and effective date. Supports RAB (Regulatory Asset Base) calculation for rate case filings with state PUCs and FERC. Integrates with SAP FI/CO fixed asset module.
products.reference: SAP Asset Accounting / FERC USofA / FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: depreciation_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the depreciation schedule record. Primary key for the depreciation schedule entity.

attributes.name: asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical asset being depreciated. Links to the asset registry in the enterprise asset management system.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Depreciation expense allocation needs cost center reference for OPEX reporting per asset schedule.

attributes.name: registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical asset being depreciated. Links to the asset registry in the enterprise asset management system.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: WBS element links depreciation charges to project work breakdown for capital budgeting.

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: The total depreciation expense recognized to date since the asset was placed in service. Represents the cumulative reduction in the asset's book value. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations, FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: annual_depreciation_expense
attributes.description: The calculated annual depreciation expense for this asset based on the depreciation method and remaining life. Used for financial reporting and rate case filings. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts, State PUC Rate Case Requirements

attributes.name: asset_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the asset type for reporting and analysis. Aligns with major business functions and regulatory reporting segments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: generation|transmission|distribution|gas_distribution|substation|metering|it_equipment|vehicles|buildings|land — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts, Internal Asset Taxonomy

attributes.name: asset_class_code
attributes.description: Internal classification code grouping similar assets for depreciation purposes. Examples include transformers, poles, conductors, meters, generation equipment.

attributes.name: asset_location_code
attributes.description: Geographic or functional location code for the asset. May reference GIS coordinates, substation ID, service territory, or facility code.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Asset Location Standard, Internal Location Taxonomy

attributes.name: book_reserve_percentage
attributes.description: The accumulated depreciation expressed as a percentage of the original cost. Used in depreciation studies to assess the adequacy of depreciation rates. Also known as reserve ratio.

attributes.name: book_tax_timing_difference
attributes.description: The cumulative difference between book depreciation and tax depreciation, creating deferred tax assets or liabilities. Important for regulatory accounting and rate-making. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740 Income Taxes, FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this depreciation schedule record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: depreciable_cost_basis
attributes.description: The original cost basis of the asset subject to depreciation, net of any salvage value. Represents the total amount to be depreciated over the asset's useful life. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations, FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: The accounting method used to calculate depreciation expense for this asset. Straight-line is most common for utility assets under FERC regulations. MACRS (Modified Accelerated Cost Recovery System) is used for tax purposes.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts, IRS Publication 946

attributes.name: depreciation_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The annual depreciation rate expressed as a percentage of the depreciable cost basis. Calculated based on depreciation method and useful life. Used in regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts, State PUC Rate Case Requirements

attributes.name: depreciation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the depreciation schedule. Active schedules accrue depreciation expense; suspended schedules are temporarily paused; fully depreciated assets have zero net book value; retired assets are no longer in service.

attributes.name: depreciation_study_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or citation to the depreciation study that established the depreciation parameters for this asset class. Depreciation studies are typically conducted every 5-10 years and filed with regulatory commissions.

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: The FERC Uniform System of Accounts code that classifies this asset for regulatory reporting. Examples include 311 (Intangible Plant), 314 (Transmission Plant), 360-373 (Distribution Plant).

attributes.name: impairment_indicator_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this asset has been flagged for potential impairment testing due to events such as obsolescence, damage, regulatory disallowance, or changes in market conditions.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment, FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: impairment_loss_amount
attributes.description: The cumulative impairment loss recognized for this asset if its carrying value exceeds its recoverable amount. Expressed in USD. Null if no impairment has been recorded.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: in_service_date
attributes.description: The date the asset was placed into service and began being depreciated. Critical for calculating accumulated depreciation and remaining life.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts, FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: last_depreciation_run_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent depreciation calculation run that updated accumulated depreciation and net book value for this asset. Typically monthly or quarterly.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this depreciation schedule record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who last modified this depreciation schedule record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: The current book value of the asset calculated as depreciable cost basis minus accumulated depreciation. Represents the undepreciated value remaining on the balance sheet. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: next_depreciation_run_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next depreciation calculation run. Used for planning and ensuring timely financial close.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or explanations regarding the depreciation schedule, such as special regulatory treatment, study assumptions, or adjustments.

attributes.name: original_useful_life_years
attributes.description: The estimated useful life of the asset in years as determined at the time of initial capitalization or most recent depreciation study. Used to calculate annual depreciation rates.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts, ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: rate_base_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this asset is eligible for inclusion in the Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) for rate-making purposes. True for used and useful assets; false for assets not yet in service or disallowed by regulators.
attributes.references: State PUC Rate Case Requirements, FERC Rate Base Regulations

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the regulatory order, rate case docket number, or Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity (CPCN) that approved the capitalization and depreciation treatment of this asset.
attributes.references: State PUC Rate Case Orders, FERC Docket System

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The regulatory authority governing the depreciation treatment of this asset. Federal jurisdiction applies to interstate transmission assets under FERC; state jurisdiction applies to distribution and generation assets under state PUCs.

attributes.name: remaining_useful_life_years
attributes.description: The estimated remaining useful life of the asset in years from the current date. Used for capital planning, replacement forecasting, and rate base calculations.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management, State PUC Rate Case Requirements

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: The date the asset was retired from service and depreciation ceased. Null for assets still in service.

attributes.name: salvage_value
attributes.description: The estimated residual value of the asset at the end of its useful life. Subtracted from original cost to determine depreciable cost basis. May be zero for many utility assets. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: salvage_value_percentage
attributes.description: The salvage value expressed as a percentage of the original asset cost. Commonly used in depreciation studies and rate case filings.

attributes.name: schedule_effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this depreciation schedule becomes effective for the asset. Typically the asset in-service date or the date of a depreciation study revision.

attributes.name: tax_depreciation_life_years
attributes.description: The useful life used for tax depreciation purposes, which may differ from book depreciation life. Determined by IRS asset class and recovery period tables.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 946, MACRS Recovery Period Tables

attributes.name: tax_depreciation_method
attributes.description: The depreciation method used for income tax purposes, which may differ from book depreciation. MACRS (Modified Accelerated Cost Recovery System) is most common for tax purposes.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: The project WBS element if this asset was capitalized as part of a capital project. Links to SAP PS project structure for CAPEX tracking and reporting.
attributes.references: SAP PS Project System, Internal CAPEX Management Standard

products.name: asset_capex_project
products.description: Capital expenditure project master for utility infrastructure investments including new construction, major refurbishment, system upgrades, technology modernization, and asset replacement programs. Captures project number (SAP WBS element), project name, project type (new construction, replacement, upgrade, compliance-driven, capacity expansion), sponsoring business unit, total authorized budget (CAPEX), actual spend to date, forecast at completion, project phase (planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, closed), in-service date target, regulatory approval reference (CPCN), IRP alignment flag, replacement driver (end-of-life, condition-based, compliance, capacity, technology obsolescence), replacement priority score, planning horizon (1-year, 5-year, 10-year), and funding source. Integrates with SAP PS (Project System) and supports CAPEX planning, replacement program management, and rate case capital testimony.
products.reference: SAP WBS Element / Capital Project / CPCN Filing

attributes.name: asset_capex_project_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the capital expenditure project record. Primary key.

attributes.name: classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.classification. Business justification: Capex project is associated with an asset class; replace free‑text asset_class with FK to classification for consistency.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Cost center identifier for the organizational unit responsible for the capital project budget and expenditures.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.facility. Business justification: CAPITAL PLANNING: Projects are tied to a specific facility for budgeting, regulatory approval, and cost allocation.

attributes.name: procurement_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.procurement_contract. Business justification: Capital Project Procurement Link; associates a capex project with its procurement contract, required for contract compliance, milestone reporting, and audit of project expenditures.

attributes.name: project_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Capital project management requires linking each capex project to its responsible employee manager for budgeting, reporting, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.site. Business justification: CAPITAL PLANNING: Large projects (e.g., new generation site) require site linkage for environmental permits and reporting.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: SAP Work Breakdown Structure element identifier linking the capital project to the financial and project management hierarchy.

attributes.name: actual_spend_to_date_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative actual capital expenditure incurred on the project as of the current reporting period, expressed in USD.

attributes.name: budget_variance_amount
attributes.description: Difference between the total authorized budget and the forecast at completion, indicating over or under budget status, expressed in USD.

attributes.name: contingency_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Contingency reserve budget allocated for unforeseen risks and changes during project execution, expressed in USD.

attributes.name: cpcn_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity (CPCN) Number
attributes.description: Certificate number issued by the state Public Utility Commission (PUC) or Public Service Commission (PSC) authorizing the utility to construct or acquire major capital assets.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the capital project record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Depreciation method to be applied to the capital asset once placed in service (e.g., Straight-Line, Declining Balance, Units of Production).

attributes.name: environmental_permit_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the environmental permit or approval obtained for the capital project.

attributes.name: environmental_permit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the capital project requires environmental permits or assessments from EPA or state environmental agencies.

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts code for the capital asset classification, used for regulatory reporting and rate base determination.

attributes.name: forecast_at_completion_amount
attributes.description: Projected total capital expenditure at project completion based on current actuals and remaining estimates, expressed in USD.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Source of capital funding for the project, such as rate base recovery, debt financing, equity, grants, or customer contributions.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or service territory where the capital project is located (e.g., Northern Region, Southern Region, Metro Area).

attributes.name: in_service_date_actual
attributes.description: Actual date when the capital asset or system was placed into operational service, triggering depreciation and rate base inclusion.

attributes.name: in_service_date_target
attributes.description: Target date when the capital asset or system is planned to be placed into operational service and begin depreciation.

attributes.name: irp_alignment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the capital project is aligned with and included in the utility's approved Integrated Resource Plan (IRP).
attributes.references: State Public Utility Commission IRP Requirements

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the capital project record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: planning_horizon
attributes.description: Time horizon category for capital planning purposes: 1-year (near-term), 5-year (mid-term), or 10-year (long-term) planning cycle.

attributes.name: project_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the capital project was officially closed and all deliverables were completed.

attributes.name: project_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the capital project scope, objectives, deliverables, and business justification.

attributes.name: project_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the capital project for human identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: project_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the CAPEX project, typically the SAP Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element or project code used across financial and project management systems.

attributes.name: project_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the capital project officially commenced, marking the beginning of planning or execution activities.

attributes.name: project_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle phase of the capital project: planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, or closed.

attributes.name: project_type
attributes.description: Classification of the capital project by its primary purpose: new construction, asset replacement, system upgrade, compliance-driven investment, capacity expansion, or technology modernization.

attributes.name: rab_inclusion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the capital project is included in the Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) for rate-making purposes.

attributes.name: rate_case_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the General Rate Case (GRC) filing in which the capital project is included for cost recovery.
attributes.references: State Public Utility Commission Rate Case Procedures

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the regulatory approval or Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity (CPCN) authorizing the capital investment.

attributes.name: replacement_driver
attributes.description: Primary business or technical reason driving the asset replacement or capital investment: end-of-life, condition-based assessment, regulatory compliance, capacity constraints, or technology obsolescence.

attributes.name: replacement_priority_score
attributes.description: Numerical score representing the relative priority of the replacement project based on risk, condition, criticality, and business impact assessment.

attributes.name: safety_classification
attributes.description: Safety risk classification of the capital project based on OSHA and internal safety standards (e.g., High Risk, Medium Risk, Low Risk).
attributes.references: OSHA Occupational Safety and Health Administration

attributes.name: service_territory_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific service territory or operating area where the capital project is deployed.

attributes.name: sponsoring_business_unit
attributes.description: The organizational division or business unit responsible for sponsoring and owning the capital project (e.g., Generation, Transmission, Distribution, Gas Operations).

attributes.name: total_authorized_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total capital expenditure budget authorized for the project by executive management or board approval, expressed in USD.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected useful life of the capital asset in years, used for depreciation calculation and asset management planning.

products.name: lifecycle_event
products.description: Chronological log of significant lifecycle state transitions for each asset, capturing event type (commissioned, transferred, modified, refurbished, retired, disposed, written-off), event date, previous status, new status, triggering work order or project reference, authorizing personnel, and event notes. Provides a complete audit trail of an assets life from installation through retirement. Supports ISO 55000 lifecycle management, regulatory asset tracking, and insurance valuation. Distinct from asset_condition (health snapshots) and failure_event (unplanned failures).
products.reference: Maximo Asset Status History / ISO 55000 Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: lifecycle_event_id
attributes.description: Primary key for lifecycle_event

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee or contractor who authorized the lifecycle event.

attributes.name: filing_id

attributes.name: primary_lifecycle_asset_registry_id

attributes.name: primary_lifecycle_technician_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee or contractor who authorized the lifecycle event.

attributes.name: registry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the physical asset to which the lifecycle event applies.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work order that triggered or is associated with this lifecycle event.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval state of the event.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the event was approved.

attributes.name: asset_condition_after

attributes.name: asset_condition_before

attributes.name: asset_location_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the asset's primary location (e.g., substation or plant code).

attributes.name: asset_serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer‑assigned serial number of the asset.

attributes.name: asset_tag_number
attributes.description: Physical tag number affixed to the asset.

attributes.name: capital_expenditure_flag
attributes.description: True if the event is classified as a capital expenditure.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Compliance outcome after the event.

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: Monetary cost directly attributable to the lifecycle event.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three‑letter ISO currency code for the cost amount.

attributes.name: depreciation_impact_amount
attributes.description: Change to the asset's depreciation schedule caused by the event.

attributes.name: depreciation_impact_type
attributes.description: Nature of the depreciation impact.

attributes.name: emissions_change_tons_co2e
attributes.description: Net change in CO₂‑equivalent emissions attributable to the event, expressed in metric tons.

attributes.name: environmental_impact_flag
attributes.description: True if the event has a measurable environmental impact (e.g., emissions change).

attributes.name: event_category
attributes.description: High‑level classification of the lifecycle event.

attributes.name: event_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference (e.g., URL or file ID) to supporting documentation for the event.

attributes.name: event_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the new status becomes effective.

attributes.name: event_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the event's effect expires, if applicable.

attributes.name: event_location_latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the asset at the time of the event.

attributes.name: event_location_longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the asset at the time of the event.

attributes.name: event_notes
attributes.description: Free‑text notes providing additional context or justification for the event.

attributes.name: event_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number of the event for the given asset, starting at 1.

attributes.name: event_source_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the event originated from an automated system or manual entry.

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the lifecycle event occurred, recorded in UTC.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Type of lifecycle transition (e.g., commissioned, transferred, modified, refurbished, retired, disposed, written-off).

attributes.name: impact_on_rab_flag
attributes.description: True if the event changes the asset's contribution to the Regulatory Asset Base.

attributes.name: is_manual_entry
attributes.description: True if the event was entered manually rather than generated by a system.

attributes.name: new_status
attributes.description: Asset status code after the event was applied.

attributes.name: opex_expenditure_flag
attributes.description: True if the event is classified as an operating expense.

attributes.name: previous_status
attributes.description: Asset status code before the event was applied.

attributes.name: project_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the capital project associated with the event, if any.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the event record was first loaded into the lakehouse.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the event record.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: True if the event must be reported to a regulatory body.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: System of record that originated the event data.

attributes.name: warranty_status_after

attributes.name: warranty_status_before

products.name: risk_assessment
products.description: Risk assessment records for utility assets capturing probability of failure score, consequence of failure score (safety, reliability, environmental, financial), composite risk index, risk tier classification (high/medium/low), risk driver (age, condition, loading, environmental exposure, criticality of served load), recommended risk mitigation action, target mitigation date, and risk assessment date. Supports risk-based asset management per ISO 55000, CAPEX prioritization for replacement programs, and regulatory justification for capital investments in rate cases.
products.reference: ISO 55000 Risk Assessment / PAS 55 Asset Risk

attributes.name: risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for risk_assessment

attributes.name: assessor_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the person who performed the risk assessment, linking to SAP HR records.

attributes.name: asset_capex_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the capital project in SAP ERP that includes this asset replacement or upgrade, if the mitigation action requires capital investment.

attributes.name: asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical asset being assessed for risk. Links to the asset registry in Maximo EAM.

attributes.name: mitigation_work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Maximo work order created to execute the risk mitigation action, if applicable.

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.parcel. Business justification: RISK MANAGEMENT: Parcel location is needed to evaluate environmental and community exposure in risk scores.

attributes.name: rate_case_filing_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the General Rate Case (GRC) or other regulatory filing that includes this asset risk assessment as justification for capital investment.

attributes.name: registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical asset being assessed for risk. Links to the asset registry in Maximo EAM.

attributes.name: regulatory_rate_case_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the General Rate Case (GRC) or other regulatory filing that includes this asset risk assessment as justification for capital investment.

attributes.name: technician_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the person who performed the risk assessment, linking to SAP HR records.

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: Date when the risk assessment was performed or last updated.

attributes.name: assessment_method
attributes.description: Methodology used to perform the risk assessment (quantitative analysis, qualitative scoring, condition-based assessment, age-based analysis, or hybrid approach).

attributes.name: assessment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context, assumptions, data sources, or special considerations for the risk assessment.

attributes.name: assessor_name
attributes.description: Name of the engineer or analyst who performed the risk assessment.

attributes.name: asset_age_years
attributes.description: Age of the asset in years at the time of risk assessment, calculated from in-service date. Key input for age-based risk models.

attributes.name: asset_condition_index
attributes.description: Numerical index representing the current physical condition of the asset based on inspection findings, test results, and maintenance history. Typically scaled 0-100 where higher values indicate better condition.

attributes.name: asset_health_score
attributes.description: Overall health score combining condition, performance, and reliability metrics. Used as input to probability of failure calculations.

attributes.name: composite_risk_index
attributes.description: Overall risk score calculated by combining probability of failure and consequence of failure scores. Typically computed as POF × (weighted sum of COF components). Used for asset prioritization and CAPEX planning.

attributes.name: consequence_of_failure_environmental_score
attributes.description: Score quantifying the environmental impact if the asset fails, including potential for spills, emissions, contamination, and EPA compliance violations.

attributes.name: consequence_of_failure_financial_score
attributes.description: Score quantifying the direct and indirect financial impact if the asset fails, including replacement cost, lost revenue, regulatory fines, and emergency response costs.

attributes.name: consequence_of_failure_reliability_score
attributes.description: Score quantifying the reliability and service continuity impact if the asset fails, including effects on SAIDI, SAIFI, and customer interruptions.

attributes.name: consequence_of_failure_safety_score
attributes.description: Score quantifying the safety impact if the asset fails, including risk to personnel, public safety, and OSHA compliance exposure.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this risk assessment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: criticality_score
attributes.description: Score representing the importance of the asset to system operations, based on number of customers served, load magnitude, redundancy availability, and strategic importance.

attributes.name: customers_at_risk_count
attributes.description: Number of customers who would be affected by failure of this asset. Key input to consequence of failure reliability scoring and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Score representing the quality and completeness of input data used for the risk assessment. Higher scores indicate more reliable risk estimates.

attributes.name: estimated_failure_cost_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Failure Cost in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Estimated total cost in USD if the asset fails, including emergency response, lost revenue, regulatory fines, customer compensation, and reputational damage.

attributes.name: estimated_replacement_cost_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Replacement Cost in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Estimated cost in USD to replace the asset with equivalent functionality, including equipment, labor, engineering, and project management. Used for consequence of failure financial scoring and CAPEX planning.

attributes.name: expected_useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected useful life of the asset in years based on manufacturer specifications, industry standards, and utility experience. Used to calculate remaining life and depreciation schedules.

attributes.name: load_at_risk_mw
attributes.description: Total electrical load in megawatts that would be interrupted if this asset fails. Used for consequence of failure reliability calculations.

attributes.name: loading_factor_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of rated capacity at which the asset is currently operating. High loading accelerates aging and increases failure probability.

attributes.name: mitigation_action_recommended
attributes.description: Recommended action to mitigate the identified risk, such as accelerated replacement, enhanced monitoring, load transfer, preventive maintenance upgrade, or operational restrictions.

attributes.name: mitigation_priority
attributes.description: Priority level for executing the recommended mitigation action based on risk tier, asset criticality, and available resources.

attributes.name: mitigation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the risk mitigation action execution.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this risk assessment record was last modified.

attributes.name: next_assessment_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic risk assessment of this asset. Assessment frequency is typically based on asset criticality and risk tier.

attributes.name: probability_of_failure_score
attributes.description: Numerical score representing the likelihood that the asset will fail within a defined time horizon. Typically scaled 0-100 or 0-10 depending on methodology.

attributes.name: regulatory_justification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this risk assessment is being used to justify capital investment in a rate case filing with the PUC or other regulatory body.

attributes.name: remaining_useful_life_years
attributes.description: Estimated remaining useful life of the asset in years. Calculated as expected useful life minus asset age, adjusted for condition and operational factors.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date when the risk assessment was reviewed and approved by management or engineering leadership.

attributes.name: risk_driver_primary
attributes.description: The dominant factor contributing to the asset's risk profile (asset age, physical condition, operational loading, environmental exposure, criticality of served load, or technological obsolescence).

attributes.name: risk_driver_secondary
attributes.description: The secondary factor contributing to the asset's risk profile. Provides additional context for risk mitigation planning.

attributes.name: risk_tier
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the asset risk level based on the composite risk index. Used to prioritize maintenance, replacement, and capital investment decisions.

products.name: operational_reading

attributes.description: Primary key for operational_reading

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or engineer who validated this operational reading, ensuring data quality and accuracy for analytics and reporting.

attributes.name: inspection_id

attributes.name: data_validation_status

attributes.name: instrument_tag_code

attributes.name: last_calibration_date

attributes.name: measurement_location_description

attributes.name: measurement_method_code

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable_flag

attributes.name: source_system_code

attributes.name: unit_of_measure

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this operational reading was validated or approved by engineering or operations personnel.

attributes.name: weather_condition_code

products.name: compliance_document

attributes.name: hire_date
attributes.description: The date the technician was officially hired by the utility company. Used to calculate seniority for union dispatch priority, benefit eligibility, and workforce tenure analytics. Sourced from SAP HR Infotype 0000.
attributes.references: SAP HR Infotype 0000; Collective Bargaining Agreement; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: hourly_rate
attributes.description: The technician's current base hourly wage rate in USD. Used for labor cost allocation to work orders, CAPEX vs OPEX labor tracking, and regulatory rate case (GRC) labor cost filings. Sourced from SAP HR Infotype 0008. Classified as confidential.
attributes.references: SAP HR Infotype 0008; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; FASB ASC 980; Collective Bargaining Agreement

attributes.name: last_osha_training_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Training Date
attributes.description: The date the technician most recently completed required OSHA safety training (e.g., OSHA 10, OSHA 30, or utility-specific electrical safety training per 29 CFR 1910.269). Used to enforce training currency requirements and trigger recertification workflows.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; OSHA 29 CFR 1926 Subpart V; NERC CIP-004

attributes.name: nerc_cip_access_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) Access Level
attributes.description: The level of NERC CIP-authorized access granted to the technician for Bulk Electric System (BES) critical infrastructure. Determines eligibility for work assignments at substations and control facilities subject to NERC CIP-004 personnel risk assessment requirements.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-004; NERC CIP-006; FERC Order 706

attributes.name: nerc_cip_background_check_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) Background Check Date
attributes.description: The date the technician's most recent NERC CIP-004 personnel risk assessment (background check) was completed. Required for access to BES critical cyber assets and physical security perimeters. Must be renewed per NERC CIP-004 requirements.

attributes.name: org_unit_code
attributes.description: The SAP HR organizational unit (department or work group) to which the technician belongs. Defines the reporting hierarchy for workforce planning, headcount reporting, and regulatory labor filings. Sourced from SAP HR Infotype 0001.
attributes.references: SAP HR Infotype 0001; FERC Form 1; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: osha_qualified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Qualified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the technician holds current OSHA qualification status required for field work on electrical or gas infrastructure. Derived from active OSHA training certifications. Critical gate for dispatch eligibility on T&D and O&M work orders.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; OSHA 29 CFR 1926 Subpart V; NERC CIP-004

attributes.name: osha_training_expiration_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Training Expiration Date
attributes.description: The date on which the technician's current OSHA safety training certification expires. When this date is reached, dispatch_eligible is set to False until recertification is completed. Critical for OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269 compliance.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; OSHA 29 CFR 1926 Subpart V; NERC CIP-004

attributes.name: overtime_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the technician is eligible for overtime pay under FLSA and applicable CBA rules. Exempt (salaried management) technicians are False; non-exempt hourly field workers are True. Sourced from SAP HR Infotype 0008.
attributes.references: SAP HR Infotype 0008; Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); Collective Bargaining Agreement

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: The compensation pay grade or band assigned to the technician, determining base wage range and step progression under the applicable CBA or management compensation structure. Sourced from SAP HR Infotype 0008. Classified as confidential business data.
attributes.references: SAP HR Infotype 0008; Collective Bargaining Agreement; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: preferred_name
attributes.description: The name the technician prefers to be called in operational communications, dispatch notifications, and crew coordination. May differ from legal first name. Sourced from SAP HR or ClickSoftware WFM profile.

attributes.name: primary_skill_code
attributes.description: The primary technical skill code assigned to the technician in ClickSoftware WFM, used as the dominant matching criterion for work order assignment and crew scheduling. Aligns with the WFM skill catalog (e.g., OH_LINE_CONSTRUCTION, UG_CABLE_SPLICE, GAS_MAIN_REPAIR, AMI_METER_INSTALL). Sourced from ClickSoftware WFM resource profile.
attributes.references: ClickSoftware WFM Skill Catalog; NERC CIP-004; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the technician master record was first created in the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and record lifecycle tracking. Populated automatically on initial load from SAP HR or ClickSoftware WFM.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; NIST Smart Grid Framework; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the technician master record was most recently updated in the Databricks Silver Layer. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental processing, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; NIST Smart Grid Framework; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: sap_personnel_number
attributes.description: The unique personnel number assigned to the technician in SAP HR (Infotype 0000). This is the authoritative source-system identifier used to cross-reference payroll, benefits, and HR master data in SAP ERP. Distinct from the surrogate technician_id.

attributes.name: secondary_skill_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of secondary skill codes from the ClickSoftware WFM skill catalog that the technician is qualified to perform beyond their primary skill. Enables flexible multi-skill dispatch during storm response and peak demand periods. Sourced from ClickSoftware WFM.
attributes.references: ClickSoftware WFM Skill Catalog; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269

attributes.name: service_start_date
attributes.description: The date the technician began active field service in their current craft or role. May differ from hire_date if the technician transferred from a non-field role or changed craft classification. Used for craft seniority calculations and CBA compliance.
attributes.references: SAP HR Infotype 0000; Collective Bargaining Agreement

attributes.name: service_territory_code
attributes.description: The geographic service territory or district to which the technician is primarily assigned for T&D operations, O&M dispatch, and emergency response. Aligns with GIS-defined service territory boundaries in Esri ArcGIS. Sourced from ClickSoftware WFM.
attributes.references: ClickSoftware WFM; Esri ArcGIS; GE PowerOn DMS/OMS

attributes.name: storm_response_tier
attributes.description: The emergency storm response mobilization tier assigned to the technician, defining their priority and role during major outage events. Tier 1 = immediate first responders; Tier 2 = secondary wave; Tier 3 = support/logistics; Exempt = not required for storm duty. Used by OMS and ClickSoftware WFM for emergency staffing.
attributes.references: ClickSoftware WFM; GE PowerOn OMS; NERC CIP; Collective Bargaining Agreement

attributes.name: supervisor_personnel_number
attributes.description: The SAP personnel number of the technician's direct supervisor or crew foreman. Used for approval workflows, OSHA incident reporting chain of command, and dispatch escalation. Sourced from SAP HR Infotype 0001 (Organizational Assignment).

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date the technician's employment was terminated, if applicable. Null for active employees. Used to deactivate dispatch eligibility, revoke system access, and support workforce attrition reporting. Sourced from SAP HR Infotype 0000.
attributes.references: SAP HR Infotype 0000; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: travel_radius_miles
attributes.description: The maximum travel radius in miles from the technician's base location that they are contractually or operationally authorized to travel for work assignments under normal (non-storm) conditions. Used by ClickSoftware WFM for geographic dispatch optimization.

attributes.name: union_affiliation
attributes.description: The labor union to which the technician belongs, if any. Drives application of collective bargaining agreement (CBA) rules for scheduling, overtime, dispatch priority, and grievance management. Common affiliations include IBEW (International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers) and UWUA (Utility Workers Union of America). Sourced from SAP HR Infotype 0011.
attributes.references: SAP HR Infotype 0011; National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); Collective Bargaining Agreement

attributes.name: union_local_number
attributes.description: The specific local chapter number of the union to which the technician belongs (e.g., IBEW Local 1245). Required for CBA compliance, grievance tracking, and labor reporting. Null for non-union and management employees. Sourced from SAP HR.
attributes.references: SAP HR Infotype 0011; National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); Collective Bargaining Agreement

attributes.name: vehicle_assignment_code
attributes.description: The fleet asset code of the utility vehicle (bucket truck, service van, digger derrick, etc.) currently assigned to the technician for field operations. Used for fleet management, GPS tracking integration, and work order costing. Sourced from Maximo EAM or fleet management system.
attributes.references: Maximo EAM; ClickSoftware WFM; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: work_schedule_code
attributes.description: The SAP HR work schedule rule code defining the technician's standard shift pattern (e.g., 4x10, 5x8, rotating shift, on-call). Drives ClickSoftware WFM availability windows, overtime eligibility, and CBA compliance for scheduling. Sourced from SAP HR Infotype 0007.
attributes.references: SAP HR Infotype 0007; ClickSoftware WFM; Collective Bargaining Agreement

attributes.name: worker_classification
attributes.description: The hierarchical skill and responsibility classification of the technician within their craft. Determines pay grade, work assignment eligibility, and supervisory authority on crew dispatches. Sourced from SAP HR Infotype 0001 and union agreement tables.
attributes.references: SAP HR Infotype 0001; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; Collective Bargaining Agreement

products.name: crew
products.description: Defines a named field crew unit composed of one or more technicians assigned to perform T&D construction, O&M maintenance, storm restoration, or gas distribution work. Tracks crew type (electric line, gas, metering, substation), crew size, home depot/garage, crew lead, and operational status. A crew is a persistent organizational unit that can be dispatched as a single entity in ClickSoftware WFM.

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the field crew unit within the Power and Utilities workforce data platform. Primary key for the crew entity. Role classification: MASTER_RESOURCE.

attributes.name: gis_boundary_id
attributes.description: Reference to the geographic dispatch zone or service territory to which this crew is primarily assigned. Supports territory-based routing and load balancing in the Distribution Management System (DMS) and ClickSoftware WFM.
attributes.references: ClickSoftware WFM; GE PowerOn DMS/OMS; Esri ArcGIS

attributes.name: home_depot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility (depot, garage, or service center) where this crew is based and from which it is typically dispatched. Used for travel-time optimization, vehicle assignment, and storm staging logistics in ClickSoftware WFM.

attributes.name: labor_rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.labor_rate. Business justification: Crew's labor rates are defined in labor_rate table; linking provides accurate rate lookup and removes code column.

attributes.name: lead_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP HR employee record of the designated crew lead (foreman or lead technician) responsible for supervising field operations, safety compliance, and work order sign-off for this crew.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.site. Business justification: Field operations assign crews to sites for outage restoration; site linkage supports crew deployment dashboards.

attributes.name: technician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP HR employee record of the designated crew lead (foreman or lead technician) responsible for supervising field operations, safety compliance, and work order sign-off for this crew.

attributes.name: union_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.union_agreement. Business justification: Crew belongs to a union agreement; linking enables enforcement of labor rules and eliminates redundant code column.

attributes.name: arc_flash_rating_cal_cm2
attributes.description: Maximum arc flash incident energy rating in calories per square centimeter (cal/cm²) for which this crew's PPE is rated. Determines the maximum voltage class and equipment the crew can safely work on. Required for NFPA 70E and OSHA electrical safety compliance.

attributes.name: avg_jobs_per_shift
attributes.description: Historical average number of work orders completed by this crew per shift, calculated over a rolling period. Used by ClickSoftware WFM capacity planning and scheduling optimization to set realistic daily job load targets.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this crew record was first created in the source system (ClickSoftware WFM or SAP HR). Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.

attributes.name: crew_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the crew unit as assigned in ClickSoftware WFM and referenced in dispatch orders, work orders, and SAP PM. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.

attributes.name: crew_name
attributes.description: Human-readable display name of the crew unit (e.g., 'North District Line Crew 4', 'Gas Distribution Crew 12'). Serves as the IDENTITY_LABEL for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. Used in dispatch screens, scheduling boards, and operational reports.

attributes.name: crew_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the crew by the type of utility work performed. Drives dispatch eligibility, skill matching, and safety protocol assignment. Serves as the primary CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: electric_line|gas_distribution|metering|substation|transmission|storm_restoration — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ClickSoftware WFM; NERC CIP; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this crew unit was disbanded, deactivated, or permanently removed from dispatch eligibility. Null for currently active crews. Supports historical workforce analysis and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this crew unit became operationally active and eligible for dispatch. Marks the start of the crew's lifecycle in the workforce management system. Used for tenure reporting and historical crew composition analysis.

attributes.name: gas_operator_qualified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this crew holds Operator Qualification (OQ) certification required by PHMSA for performing covered tasks on natural gas distribution and transmission pipelines. True = OQ-certified for gas work.
attributes.references: DOT PHMSA 49 CFR Part 192; 49 CFR Part 199

attributes.name: gis_region_code
attributes.description: Esri ArcGIS region code identifying the geographic service territory region where this crew primarily operates. Enables spatial analysis of crew coverage, outage response mapping, and T&D asset maintenance territory alignment.

attributes.name: is_emergency_qualified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this crew is certified and pre-qualified for emergency storm response and mutual aid dispatch under NERC reliability standards and state PUC emergency response plans. True = eligible for emergency activation.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-011; State PUC Emergency Response Plans; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269

attributes.name: is_mutual_aid_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this crew can be deployed to assist other utilities under mutual aid agreements (e.g., EEI Mutual Assistance Program). Distinct from internal emergency qualification — mutual aid requires additional credentialing and travel authorization.
attributes.references: EEI Mutual Assistance Program; NERC EOP-011; State PUC

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this crew record in the source system. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change detection, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: last_safety_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent safety audit or field safety observation conducted for this crew. Used to track compliance with internal safety management programs and OSHA recordkeeping requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904; NERC CIP; Internal Safety Management Program

attributes.name: max_travel_radius_miles
attributes.description: Maximum distance in miles this crew is authorized or contractually permitted to travel from their home depot for a standard (non-emergency) dispatch. Used by ClickSoftware WFM routing engine to filter eligible crews for a given work order location.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or remarks about this crew unit, such as temporary restrictions, special capabilities, equipment limitations, or scheduling constraints. Visible to dispatchers in ClickSoftware WFM.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the crew unit indicating whether it is available for dispatch and assignment. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. 'storm_standby' indicates the crew is pre-positioned for emergency storm response.

attributes.name: osha_safety_training_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the crew's current OSHA-mandated safety training certification expires. Crews with expired certifications must be blocked from dispatch until recertification is completed. Supports OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269 compliance tracking.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; OSHA 29 CFR 1926 Subpart V

attributes.name: overtime_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether members of this crew are eligible for overtime pay under the applicable union CBA and FLSA regulations. Drives overtime cost calculations in SAP HR payroll and ClickSoftware WFM scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP HR; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); IBEW CBA

attributes.name: ppe_compliance_status
attributes.description: Current status of the crew's Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) compliance as verified during the most recent safety inspection. Non-compliant crews must be blocked from energized work dispatch per OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269.

attributes.name: safety_incident_count_ytd
attributes.description: Count of OSHA-recordable safety incidents attributed to this crew in the current calendar year. Used for safety performance monitoring, crew risk scoring, and OSHA 300 log compliance. Reset annually.

attributes.name: sap_hr_org_unit_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP Human Resources (HR) Organizational Unit ID
attributes.description: SAP HR organizational unit identifier to which this crew is mapped in the HR hierarchy. Enables linkage between field crew operational data and HR cost reporting, headcount planning, and payroll processing.

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Standard shift schedule assigned to this crew. Drives scheduling windows in ClickSoftware WFM, overtime eligibility calculations, and union CBA compliance for shift differentials.
attributes.references: ClickSoftware WFM; SAP HR; IBEW CBA

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Authorized headcount (number of personnel) assigned to this crew unit. Serves as the principal MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. Used for capacity planning, dispatch feasibility, and OSHA minimum crew-size compliance checks.

attributes.name: specialty_certifications
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of specialty certifications held by the crew as a unit (e.g., 'CDL,HazMat,Gas_Leak_Response,Confined_Space'). Drives advanced dispatch eligibility filtering for specialized work orders in ClickSoftware WFM.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; DOT PHMSA; ClickSoftware WFM

attributes.name: standard_end_time
attributes.description: Scheduled end time (HH:MM, 24-hour format) for this crew's standard shift. Used alongside standard_start_time to define the crew's available dispatch window and calculate daily labor hours.

attributes.name: standard_start_time
attributes.description: Scheduled start time (HH:MM, 24-hour format) for this crew's standard shift. Used by ClickSoftware WFM for automated scheduling, dispatch window calculation, and overtime threshold monitoring.

attributes.name: storm_priority_tier
attributes.description: Integer priority tier (1 = highest priority) assigned to this crew for storm restoration dispatch sequencing. Tier 1 crews are activated first during major outage events. Used by the OMS storm management module to optimize SAIDI/SAIFI restoration performance.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn OMS; NERC EOP-011; State PUC SAIDI/SAIFI Standards

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary fleet vehicle (bucket truck, digger derrick, service van, etc.) assigned to this crew for field operations. Sourced from the fleet/asset management system and linked to Maximo EAM vehicle records.
attributes.references: Maximo EAM; SAP PM; ClickSoftware WFM

attributes.name: voltage_class
attributes.description: Highest voltage class this crew is authorized and qualified to work on. Critical for dispatch eligibility — a distribution crew cannot be dispatched to transmission-level work. Aligns with NERC and OSHA electrical safety qualification requirements.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; NESC (National Electrical Safety Code)

attributes.name: wfm_crew_external_code
attributes.description: Native crew identifier as stored in ClickSoftware WFM. Preserved for cross-system reconciliation, data lineage tracing, and integration with WFM dispatch APIs. Distinct from the surrogate crew_id used in the lakehouse.

attributes.name: work_function
attributes.description: Primary operational function this crew is configured to perform. Distinguishes T&D construction crews from O&M maintenance crews, storm restoration crews, and gas operations crews. Used for work order routing and resource planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: construction|maintenance|inspection|storm_restoration|gas_ops|metering|emergency — promote to reference product]

products.name: crew_member
products.description: Association entity linking individual technicians to crews, capturing role within the crew (lead, journeyman, apprentice, helper), effective dates of crew membership, union classification, and active status. Supports many-to-many crew composition over time as crew rosters change with seasonal staffing, storm augmentation, and contractor supplementation.
products.reference: Crew Roster / ClickSoftware Resource Group Member

attributes.name: crew_member_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the crew member association record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Serves as the primary key for this junction entity linking a worker to a crew with a specific role and effective period.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; ClickSoftware WFM Data Model

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Tracking each crew member's cost center is required for labor budgeting and expense allocation reports.

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Reference to the crew to which this worker is assigned. Supports many-to-many crew composition over time as rosters change with seasonal staffing, storm augmentation, and contractor supplementation.
attributes.references: ClickSoftware WFM; SAP HR Organizational Management

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual field worker (technician, lineworker, meter reader, or field service personnel) assigned to this crew. Sourced from SAP HR employee master.
attributes.references: SAP HR PA (Personnel Administration); ClickSoftware WFM

attributes.name: technician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual field worker (technician, lineworker, meter reader, or field service personnel) assigned to this crew. Sourced from SAP HR employee master.
attributes.references: SAP HR PA (Personnel Administration); ClickSoftware WFM

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.vendor. Business justification: Contractor companies are registered vendors; linking enables labor cost tracking, compliance, and contractor performance monitoring.

attributes.name: apprentice_program_year
attributes.description: For workers with crew_role of 'apprentice', indicates the current year of the apprenticeship program (1 through 5 for IBEW lineworker apprenticeships). Determines eligible task scope, supervision ratio requirements, and applicable wage step per the CBA.
attributes.references: IBEW/NECA Joint Apprenticeship Training Committee (JATC) Standards; DOL 29 CFR Part 29 Apprenticeship Programs

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the crew membership assignment. Permanent assignments reflect standard roster composition. Storm assignments are activated during emergency response events. Mutual aid assignments reflect workers deployed from or received by other utilities under mutual assistance agreements.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-011 Emergency Operations; Edison Electric Institute Mutual Assistance Program; ClickSoftware WFM

attributes.name: availability_end_time
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this crew member's availability for dispatch ends for their shift. Used by ClickSoftware WFM to prevent over-scheduling and to manage fatigue rule compliance during extended storm restoration events.
attributes.references: ClickSoftware WFM Shift Configuration; NERC FAC-002 Fatigue Management; DOT Hours of Service 49 CFR Part 395

attributes.name: availability_start_time
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this crew member becomes available for dispatch at the start of their shift for this assignment. Used by ClickSoftware WFM scheduling engine for real-time crew availability and OMS outage restoration crew dispatch.
attributes.references: ClickSoftware WFM Shift Configuration; GE PowerOn OMS Crew Availability

attributes.name: background_check_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent background check was completed for this crew member. Required for NERC CIP-004 compliance for workers with CIP access, and for contractor qualification per state PUC requirements.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-004-6 R3 Personnel Risk Assessment; State PUC Contractor Qualification; OSHA Multi-Employer Worksite

attributes.name: cdl_expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the worker's Commercial Driver's License. Used to trigger renewal alerts and prevent dispatch of workers with expired CDLs to vehicle-operating roles. Integrated with ClickSoftware WFM compliance checks.

attributes.name: cdl_license_number
attributes.description: The state-issued Commercial Driver's License number for this worker, required when cdl_required_flag is true. Stored for DOT compliance verification and pre-dispatch validation. Classified as confidential PII per FMCSA regulations.
attributes.references: FMCSA 49 CFR Part 383; DOT Motor Carrier Safety Administration

attributes.name: cdl_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this crew member role requires a valid Commercial Driver's License (CDL) for operating heavy utility vehicles, bucket trucks, or digger derricks assigned to this crew. Drives pre-dispatch license verification checks.
attributes.references: FMCSA 49 CFR Part 383 CDL Requirements; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.178; DOT Motor Carrier Safety

attributes.name: cip_access_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this crew member has been granted access to NERC CIP-defined Critical Infrastructure Protection facilities (e.g., substations, control rooms, communication nodes). Requires background check and personnel risk assessment per NERC CIP-004.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-004 Personnel and Training; NERC CIP-006 Physical Security; DHS Critical Infrastructure Protection

attributes.name: contractor_po_number
attributes.description: The SAP MM purchase order number governing the contract under which this contractor crew member is engaged. Links workforce deployment to financial commitments for CAPEX/OPEX cost tracking and accounts payable reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP MM Purchase Order (ME21N); FASB ASC 420 Exit or Disposal Cost Obligations; State PUC Rate Case Filing

attributes.name: craft_code
attributes.description: The trade or craft designation identifying the worker's primary skill set (e.g., lineworker, electrician, gas technician, meter technician, substation technician). Used in ClickSoftware WFM for skill-based dispatch and crew composition validation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: lineworker|electrician|gas_tech|meter_tech|substation_tech|cable_splicer|tree_trimmer — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ClickSoftware WFM Skill/Craft Configuration; SAP HR Qualifications Catalog; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this crew member association record was first created in the system, sourced from ClickSoftware WFM or SAP HR. Provides audit trail for crew roster changes and supports regulatory compliance documentation.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; NERC CIP-007 System Security Management; SAP HR Change Documents

attributes.name: crew_lead_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this worker is designated as the crew lead or foreman for this crew assignment. A crew may have only one active lead at a time. Used for supervisory accountability, safety briefing responsibility, and OSHA incident reporting chain of command.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1926.952 Qualified Person; ClickSoftware WFM Crew Lead Designation

attributes.name: crew_role
attributes.description: The functional role of the worker within the crew hierarchy. Determines supervisory authority, task eligibility, and pay rate applicability. Lead and foreman roles carry supervisory responsibility; apprentice and helper roles require journeyman oversight per union agreement and OSHA safety standards.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910/1926 Electrical Safety; IBEW Collective Bargaining Agreement; ClickSoftware WFM Role Configuration

attributes.name: dispatch_zone
attributes.description: The geographic dispatch zone or service territory code within which this crew member is authorized and expected to respond. Used by GE PowerOn DMS/OMS for crew dispatch during outage restoration and by ClickSoftware WFM for field service scheduling.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn Advanced DMS/OMS Zone Configuration; ClickSoftware WFM Territory; Esri ArcGIS GIS Zone

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the worker's membership in this crew ended or is scheduled to end. Null indicates an open-ended, currently active assignment. Populated upon crew reassignment, seasonal demobilization, storm crew stand-down, or contractor departure.
attributes.references: SAP HR Infotype 0001 Organizational Assignment; ClickSoftware WFM

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the worker's membership in this crew became effective. Used to reconstruct historical crew composition for incident investigation, regulatory reporting, and workforce analytics. Supports time-bounded crew roster queries.
attributes.references: SAP HR Infotype 0001 Organizational Assignment; ClickSoftware WFM Schedule Horizon

attributes.name: fatigue_hours_worked
attributes.description: Cumulative hours worked by this crew member in the current fatigue management window (typically 16-hour or 24-hour rolling period). Used to enforce NERC FAC-002 fatigue management rules and DOT hours-of-service limits during storm restoration.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-002 Fatigue Management; DOT 49 CFR Part 395 Hours of Service; OSHA Fatigue Risk Management

attributes.name: last_safety_briefing_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent safety tailgate briefing attended by this crew member. Required for OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269 pre-job briefing compliance documentation and safety audit trails.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269(c) Pre-Job Briefing; NERC PER-005; SAP HR Training Records

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this crew member association record. Supports incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer and provides audit trail for crew roster change management.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Capture; SAP HR Change Documents

attributes.name: membership_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the worker's crew membership. Active indicates the worker is currently rostered on the crew. Suspended may reflect a safety hold or disciplinary action. Pending indicates a future-dated assignment awaiting activation.
attributes.references: ClickSoftware WFM Resource Status; SAP HR Actions Infotype 0000

attributes.name: mobile_device_code
attributes.description: The identifier of the mobile device (tablet or smartphone) issued to this crew member for ClickSoftware WFM field app access, work order receipt, and real-time status updates. Used for device management and field connectivity troubleshooting.
attributes.references: ClickSoftware WFM Mobile Configuration; NIST SP 800-124 Mobile Device Security

attributes.name: mutual_aid_utility
attributes.description: For storm augmentation or mutual aid assignments, identifies the name of the external utility company that deployed this worker. Null for internal employees. Required for mutual aid cost recovery billing and EEI mutual assistance program reporting.
attributes.references: Edison Electric Institute (EEI) Mutual Assistance Program; NERC EOP-011; FEMA Public Assistance Program

attributes.name: nerc_qualified_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Qualified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this crew member holds current NERC PER-005 qualification for performing switching operations on the Bulk Electric System (BES). Required for crew members assigned to transmission switching, substation operations, or SCADA-controlled switching tasks.
attributes.references: NERC PER-005 Personnel Performance Training and Certification; NERC CIP-004 Personnel Training

attributes.name: osha_qualified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this worker meets OSHA's definition of a 'qualified person' for electrical work on energized lines and equipment as required by 29 CFR 1910.269 and 1926.950. Must be true for workers assigned to live-line T&D construction and maintenance tasks.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; OSHA 29 CFR 1926.950; NERC PER-005 Personnel Performance Training

attributes.name: overtime_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this crew member is eligible for overtime compensation under the applicable CBA or FLSA provisions for this crew assignment. Drives overtime cost forecasting during storm response and extended outage restoration events.
attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 778 Overtime Compensation; IBEW CBA Overtime Provisions; SAP HR Time Management

attributes.name: per_diem_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this crew member is entitled to per diem allowances (meals, lodging) for this assignment, typically applicable to storm mutual aid deployments or out-of-territory assignments. Drives travel expense accruals and FEMA cost recovery documentation.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463 Travel Expenses; FEMA Public Assistance Program; EEI Mutual Assistance Cost Recovery

attributes.name: ppe_kit_assigned
attributes.description: Identifier or description of the Personal Protective Equipment kit assigned to this crew member for this assignment (e.g., arc flash PPE category, rubber glove class). Required for OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269 PPE compliance tracking and safety audit trails.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269(l) PPE Requirements; NFPA 70E Arc Flash PPE Categories; ANSI Z89.1 Head Protection

attributes.name: primary_work_center
attributes.description: The SAP PM/HR work center or service territory to which this crew member is primarily assigned. Determines geographic dispatch zone, vehicle assignment, and T&D operational area responsibility.
attributes.references: SAP PM Work Center (CR01); ClickSoftware WFM Territory Configuration; Esri ArcGIS Service Territory

attributes.name: safety_training_current_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker's mandatory OSHA safety training certifications are current and not expired as of the effective_start_date of this crew assignment. A false value should prevent dispatch to hazardous work orders per OSHA compliance controls.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269(a)(2); NERC PER-005; SAP HR Training and Event Management

attributes.name: scheduled_hours
attributes.description: The number of labor hours this crew member is scheduled to work on this crew assignment for the current scheduling period. Used by ClickSoftware WFM for capacity planning and by SAP HR time management for shift scheduling.
attributes.references: ClickSoftware WFM Scheduling Engine; SAP HR Time Management Infotype 2003

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this crew member association record was ingested into the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports data lineage tracking and conflict resolution when multiple systems contribute crew roster data.
attributes.references: NIST SP 800-53 Data Provenance; Databricks Delta Lake Data Lineage; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: union_classification
attributes.description: The union job classification code applicable to this worker in this crew assignment (e.g., IBEW Journeyman Lineman, IBEW Apprentice Lineman, UWUA Gas Technician). Governs applicable wage rates, work rules, overtime eligibility, and jurisdictional work boundaries per the collective bargaining agreement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IBEW_journeyman_lineman|IBEW_apprentice_lineman|UWUA_gas_tech|IBEW_foreman|non_union|contractor — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IBEW Collective Bargaining Agreement; UWUA CBA; SAP HR Infotype 0008 Basic Pay

attributes.name: union_local_number
attributes.description: The specific union local chapter number to which the worker belongs (e.g., IBEW Local 1245, UWUA Local 132). Required for labor relations reporting, grievance tracking, and CBA compliance verification.
attributes.references: IBEW Local Chapter Registry; UWUA Local Chapter Registry; NLRA Section 9

attributes.name: vehicle_code
attributes.description: Reference to the utility vehicle (bucket truck, service van, digger derrick) assigned to this crew member for this assignment period. Supports fleet utilization tracking and DOT vehicle inspection compliance.
attributes.references: SAP PM Equipment Master; Maximo EAM Asset; DOT FMCSA Vehicle Inspection Requirements

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: The SAP PS Work Breakdown Structure element for capital project labor cost allocation when this crew member is assigned to a CAPEX project (e.g., transmission line construction, substation upgrade). Required for RAB tracking and CPCN project reporting.
attributes.references: SAP PS WBS Element (CJ01); FERC Uniform System of Accounts; State PUC CPCN Reporting

attributes.name: worker_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the worker's employment relationship with the utility. Distinguishes regular employees from contractors, temporary hires, seasonal workers, and storm augmentation personnel. Drives payroll treatment, benefits eligibility, and OSHA recordkeeping obligations.
attributes.references: SAP HR Employee Group/Subgroup; OSHA 29 CFR 1904 Recordkeeping; IRS Worker Classification

products.name: work_order_assignment
