products.description: Transactional record capturing the dispatch and assignment of a technician or crew to a specific work order (sourced from Maximo EAM or GE PowerOn OMS). Tracks assignment date/time, scheduled start and end, actual arrival and departure, travel time, assignment status (dispatched, en-route, on-site, completed, cancelled), and mobile acknowledgment. This is the core operational dispatch record in ClickSoftware WFM linking workforce to work execution.

attributes.name: work_order_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the work order assignment record. Primary key for this transactional dispatch entity linking workforce resources to work execution tasks.

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Reference to the crew or team assigned to this work order when the assignment is for a multi-person crew rather than an individual technician. Nullable when assignment is to a single technician.

attributes.name: technician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual technician, lineworker, meter reader, or field service personnel assigned to this work order. Links to the workforce employee master record in SAP HR or ClickSoftware resource pool.
attributes.references: SAP HR Personnel Number, ClickSoftware Resource ID

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent work order from Maximo EAM or GE PowerOn OMS that this assignment fulfills. Links the dispatch record to the underlying maintenance, construction, or service task.
attributes.references: Maximo Work Order Object, GE PowerOn Work Order

attributes.name: actual_arrival_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the technician or crew arrived at the work site, typically captured via mobile device GPS or manual check-in. Used for SLA compliance tracking and labor costing.

attributes.name: actual_departure_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the technician or crew departed the work site, typically captured via mobile device. Used for travel time calculation and next-assignment routing.

attributes.name: actual_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when work was completed on site. Used for labor costing, productivity metrics, and work order closure processing.
attributes.references: ClickSoftware Actual End, Maximo Actual Finish

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when work began on site, distinct from arrival time. Captures the moment active work commenced, used for labor tracking and productivity analysis.
attributes.references: ClickSoftware Actual Start, Maximo Actual Start

attributes.name: assignment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or special instructions for the technician or crew regarding this assignment. May include site access instructions, customer contact information, safety warnings, or work-specific guidance.
attributes.references: ClickSoftware Assignment Notes, Maximo Long Description

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for this assignment, typically generated by ClickSoftware WFM or the dispatching system. Used for operational tracking and communication with field personnel.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the work order assignment. Tracks the progression from initial dispatch through field execution to completion or cancellation. Updated by mobile workforce application or dispatcher. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: dispatched|en_route|on_site|in_progress|completed|cancelled|suspended|reassigned — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the assignment based on the nature and urgency of the work. Distinguishes between planned maintenance, emergency response, storm restoration, and other operational categories.
attributes.references: ClickSoftware Assignment Type, Maximo Work Type

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the reason for assignment cancellation when status is cancelled. Used for operational analysis and process improvement. Nullable when assignment is not cancelled. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: customer_cancelled|weather|equipment_unavailable|crew_unavailable|duplicate|work_completed_by_other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: certification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether specific certifications or qualifications are required for this assignment (e.g., OSHA safety training, CDL, confined space entry). True when certifications are mandatory, False otherwise.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this assignment record was first created in the source system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: customer_appointment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assignment requires a scheduled customer appointment or access to customer premises. True when customer coordination is required, False for utility-side work. Used for appointment window tracking and customer communication.

attributes.name: dispatch_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the assignment was dispatched to the technician or crew by the workforce management system or dispatcher. Represents the official start of the assignment lifecycle.

attributes.name: equipment_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether specialized equipment or vehicles are required for this assignment (e.g., bucket truck, digger derrick, cable splicer). True when special equipment is needed, False for standard assignments.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this assignment record was last updated in the source system. Used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: mobile_acknowledgment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the technician acknowledged receipt of the assignment via mobile device. True when acknowledged, False when not yet acknowledged. Used for dispatch confirmation and communication tracking.

attributes.name: mobile_acknowledgment_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the technician acknowledged the assignment via mobile device. Used for response time tracking and dispatcher confirmation.

attributes.name: on_site_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total time in minutes spent on site from arrival to departure. Calculated as the difference between actual departure and actual arrival timestamps. Used for labor costing and productivity metrics.

attributes.name: outage_related_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assignment is related to a customer outage or service interruption. True for outage restoration work, False for non-outage work. Used for reliability metrics (SAIDI, SAIFI, CAIDI) and priority dispatch.

attributes.name: overtime_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assignment is eligible for overtime compensation based on time of day, day of week, or assignment type. True when overtime rules apply, False for regular time. Used for labor costing and payroll integration.
attributes.references: SAP HR Time Management, Union Agreement

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: Business priority level for this assignment, determining dispatch sequence and resource allocation. Critical assignments (e.g., public safety hazards, major outages) receive immediate attention.

attributes.name: reassignment_count
attributes.description: Number of times this work order has been reassigned to different technicians or crews. Used for dispatch efficiency analysis and work order complexity assessment. Zero for first-time assignments.

attributes.name: safety_hazard_code
attributes.description: Code identifying known safety hazards at the work site (e.g., energized equipment, confined space, traffic hazard, hazardous materials). Used for crew safety briefings and OSHA compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: energized_equipment|confined_space|traffic_hazard|hazmat|fall_hazard|excavation|overhead_lines — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: scheduled_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned date and time when the work is expected to be completed. Used for scheduling optimization, customer communication, and capacity planning.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned date and time when the technician or crew is expected to begin work on site. Used for crew scheduling, customer appointment windows, and resource planning.

attributes.name: service_territory_code
attributes.description: Geographic service territory or district where the work is being performed. Used for crew routing, jurisdiction tracking, and regional reporting. Aligns with utility service area boundaries.

attributes.name: skill_requirement_code
attributes.description: Primary skill or qualification required for this assignment (e.g., lineworker, electrician, meter technician, gas fitter). Used for crew matching and certification compliance. Aligns with union job classifications.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system that originated this assignment record (ClickSoftware WFM, Maximo EAM, GE PowerOn OMS, SAP PM, or manual dispatch). Used for data lineage and system integration tracking.

attributes.name: storm_response_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assignment is part of an emergency storm restoration effort. True for storm-related work, False for normal operations. Used for mutual aid tracking and regulatory reporting (SAIDI/SAIFI exclusions).
attributes.references: GE PowerOn Storm Mode, NERC EOP

attributes.name: travel_time_minutes
attributes.description: Total travel time in minutes from the technician's previous location to the work site. Used for labor costing, route optimization, and workforce productivity analysis.

attributes.name: union_agreement_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the applicable collective bargaining agreement or union contract governing this assignment. Used for labor costing, overtime rules, and crew assignment compliance.

attributes.name: work_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Actual productive work time in minutes, calculated as the difference between actual start and actual end timestamps. Excludes setup, breaks, and non-productive time. Used for labor costing and efficiency analysis.
attributes.references: Maximo Labor Hours, ClickSoftware Work Duration

attributes.name: work_location_address
attributes.description: Street address or location description of the work site. Used for crew navigation, customer communication, and operational reporting. May include customer premises or utility infrastructure locations.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Service Address, GIS Location

attributes.name: work_location_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the work site in decimal degrees. Used for mobile navigation, crew routing, and geospatial analysis. Sourced from GIS or mobile device GPS.

attributes.name: work_location_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the work site in decimal degrees. Used for mobile navigation, crew routing, and geospatial analysis. Sourced from GIS or mobile device GPS.

products.name: shift
products.description: Defines scheduled work shifts for field workforce including shift type (day, evening, night, rotating), shift start and end times, shift duration, overtime eligibility, and applicable union agreement provisions. Shifts are the building blocks of crew scheduling and are used to calculate labor hours, overtime costs, and OSHA fatigue compliance for T&D field operations.
products.reference: Shift Definition / SAP HR Work Schedule Rule

attributes.name: shift_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the work shift. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Shift labor costs are charged to cost centers for overtime and premium pay reporting.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.facility. Business justification: Shift staffing reports require the facility where the shift occurs for labor compliance and overtime tracking.

attributes.name: call_out_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether crew members on this shift are eligible for emergency call-out outside their regular shift hours. True if call-out provisions apply per union agreement, false if shift is exempt from call-out duty.

attributes.name: consecutive_shift_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of consecutive shifts of this type that can be worked before mandatory rest period is required. Enforces OSHA fatigue management and union agreement provisions to prevent worker exhaustion and safety incidents.
attributes.references: OSHA Work Hours and Fatigue Management Guidelines

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created this shift record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shift record was first created in the system. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: crew_size_maximum
attributes.description: Maximum number of personnel that can be assigned to this shift based on operational capacity, equipment availability, and budget constraints.

attributes.name: crew_size_minimum
attributes.description: Minimum number of qualified personnel required to staff this shift to meet operational and safety requirements. Based on work type, equipment requirements, and OSHA safety regulations for field operations.
attributes.references: OSHA Safety Standards for Electric Power Generation, Transmission, and Distribution (29 CFR 1910.269)

attributes.name: duration_hours
attributes.description: Total duration of the shift measured in hours, including any built-in break periods. Calculated as the difference between end_time and start_time, accounting for overnight shifts that span midnight. Used for labor hour calculations and OSHA fatigue compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: OSHA Work Hours and Fatigue Management Guidelines

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this shift definition expires or is no longer available for scheduling. Null for open-ended shifts. Used to manage seasonal shifts, temporary emergency shifts, and shift pattern changes.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this shift definition becomes active and available for crew scheduling. Supports seasonal shift patterns and operational changes.

attributes.name: emergency_response_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shift is designated for emergency response and storm restoration work. True for shifts that can be mobilized for outage management system (OMS) dispatch and critical infrastructure protection (CIP) incidents.

attributes.name: end_time
attributes.description: Scheduled end time of the shift in 24-hour HH:mm format (e.g., 15:00, 23:30, 07:00). Represents the time when crew members are expected to complete work. May extend into the next calendar day for overnight shifts.

attributes.name: fatigue_risk_score
attributes.description: Calculated risk score (0-100) assessing fatigue-related safety risk based on shift duration, time of day, consecutive shifts, and rest periods. Higher scores indicate greater fatigue risk requiring additional monitoring and mitigation measures per OSHA fatigue management guidelines.
attributes.references: OSHA Work Hours and Fatigue Management Guidelines

attributes.name: geographic_service_area
attributes.description: Geographic territory or service area covered by this shift (e.g., North Region, Metro District, Coastal Zone). Used for crew dispatch optimization and emergency response coordination.

attributes.name: hazard_level
attributes.description: Risk classification of the shift based on work activities and safety hazards. Low hazard shifts involve minimal risk (office work), moderate hazard shifts include routine field operations, high hazard shifts involve energized equipment or elevated work, and critical hazard shifts require specialized safety protocols (e.g., high-voltage transmission work, confined space entry).
attributes.references: OSHA Safety Standards for Electric Power Generation, Transmission, and Distribution (29 CFR 1910.269)

attributes.name: holiday_work_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shift may be scheduled on recognized holidays. True if holiday work is permitted, false if holidays are excluded. Affects premium pay calculations and holiday compensation per union agreements.

attributes.name: minimum_rest_hours
attributes.description: Minimum number of hours of rest required between the end of this shift and the start of the next shift for the same crew member. Ensures compliance with OSHA fatigue management guidelines and union rest period provisions.
attributes.references: OSHA Work Hours and Fatigue Management Guidelines

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this shift record. Used for audit trail and change management.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shift record was last updated. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional shift information, special instructions, or operational notes for crew scheduling and dispatch coordination.

attributes.name: overtime_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether hours worked during this shift are eligible for overtime compensation under applicable labor agreements and regulations. True if overtime rules apply, false if shift is exempt or salaried.

attributes.name: overtime_threshold_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours after which overtime compensation begins for this shift type. Typically 8 hours per day or 40 hours per week under FLSA, but may vary based on union agreements and state regulations.

attributes.name: paid_break_minutes
attributes.description: Total minutes of paid break time included within the shift duration. Paid breaks are compensated time and count toward total hours worked for overtime calculations.

attributes.name: ppe_requirements
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of required personal protective equipment for this shift (e.g., ARC_FLASH_SUIT, HARD_HAT, SAFETY_GLASSES, INSULATED_GLOVES, FALL_PROTECTION). Ensures compliance with OSHA safety standards and utility safety programs.
attributes.references: OSHA Personal Protective Equipment Standards (29 CFR 1910.132)

attributes.name: premium_pay_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base hourly rate for premium compensation (e.g., 1.5 for time-and-a-half, 2.0 for double-time). Used for night differential, weekend premium, holiday pay, or emergency call-out compensation as defined in union agreements.

attributes.name: qualification_requirement_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of qualification codes required for personnel assigned to this shift (e.g., LINEWORKER_JOURNEYMAN, CDL_CLASS_A, CONFINED_SPACE_ENTRY, FIRST_AID_CPR). Used to match crew members with appropriate certifications and training to shift requirements.

attributes.name: reporting_location
attributes.description: Physical location where crew members report at shift start (e.g., Operations Center, Service Yard, Substation). May include address or facility identifier for dispatch and timekeeping purposes.

attributes.name: rotation_cycle_days
attributes.description: Total number of days in one complete rotation cycle before the pattern repeats. Used for long-term crew scheduling and labor planning.

attributes.name: rotation_pattern
attributes.description: Description of the rotation schedule for rotating shifts (e.g., 4-on-3-off, 2-2-3 Panama, 5-2 weekly). Defines the repeating pattern of work days and rest days for crew scheduling.

attributes.name: scheduling_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking (1-100) used by ClickSoftware WFM to optimize crew assignments. Higher values indicate higher priority for staffing. Emergency and critical infrastructure shifts receive highest priority.

attributes.name: shift_category
attributes.description: Operational category of the shift indicating the primary work purpose. Regular shifts support standard operations and maintenance (O&M), emergency shifts respond to unplanned outages, storm shifts mobilize for weather-related restoration, maintenance shifts focus on preventive and corrective asset maintenance, construction shifts support transmission and distribution (T&D) infrastructure projects, and inspection shifts perform regulatory compliance and safety inspections.

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the shift used in scheduling systems and crew assignments. Typically follows organizational naming conventions (e.g., DAY-A, NIGHT-B, ROT-1).

attributes.name: shift_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the shift for display and reporting purposes (e.g., Day Shift - A Crew, Night Shift - Emergency Response).

attributes.name: shift_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the shift definition. Active shifts are available for crew scheduling, inactive shifts are temporarily disabled, suspended shifts are on hold pending review, and archived shifts are retained for historical reference only.

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Classification of the shift based on time-of-day pattern. Day shifts typically run morning to afternoon, evening shifts cover afternoon to late evening, night shifts cover overnight hours, rotating shifts cycle through multiple patterns, on-call shifts require availability for emergency dispatch, and standby shifts are reserved for contingency staffing.
attributes.references: OSHA Work Hours and Fatigue Management Guidelines

attributes.name: start_time
attributes.description: Scheduled start time of the shift in 24-hour HH:mm format (e.g., 07:00, 15:30, 23:00). Represents the time when crew members are expected to begin work.

attributes.name: union_agreement_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the collective bargaining agreement (CBA) or union contract that governs labor terms for this shift. References specific union local agreements (e.g., IBEW_LOCAL_1245, UWUA_LOCAL_304) that define work rules, compensation, and scheduling provisions.

attributes.name: unpaid_break_minutes
attributes.description: Total minutes of unpaid break time (typically meal breaks) within the shift. Unpaid breaks do not count toward compensable hours and are excluded from overtime calculations.

attributes.name: weekend_work_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shift regularly includes weekend work (Saturday/Sunday). True if shift pattern includes weekend days, false if Monday-Friday only. Used for premium pay calculations and work-life balance planning.

attributes.name: work_location_type
attributes.description: Primary location type where shift work is performed. Field shifts involve outdoor transmission and distribution (T&D) work, office shifts are administrative or control center operations, yard shifts are depot or warehouse-based, substation shifts involve electrical substation operations, plant shifts are generation facility operations, mobile shifts have no fixed location, and remote shifts are performed from home or remote offices. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: field|office|yard|substation|plant|mobile|remote — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: work_order_type_default
attributes.description: Default work order type code from Maximo Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) for work performed during this shift (e.g., PM for preventive maintenance, CM for corrective maintenance, EM for emergency, PROJ for capital projects). Used to pre-populate work order creation and labor tracking.

products.name: schedule
products.description: Planned work schedule for a technician or crew over a defined planning horizon (daily, weekly, or monthly). Captures scheduled shifts, days on/off, planned assignments, territory coverage, and schedule status (draft, published, confirmed). Generated by ClickSoftware WFM optimization engine and used for resource capacity planning, outage response readiness, and union contract compliance (minimum rest periods, consecutive days worked).
products.reference: ClickSoftware Schedule / SAP HR Work Schedule

attributes.name: schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the workforce schedule record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Schedules are budgeted to cost centers; the link supports schedule cost roll‑up and financial planning.

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Reference to the crew assigned to this schedule. Nullable if schedule is for an individual technician rather than a crew.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the workforce planner or system user who created this schedule record.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary work location or service center where the technician reports for this schedule.

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: Schedules tied to internal orders allow project‑level cost tracking and compliance with capital project accounting.

attributes.name: modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the workforce planner or system user who last modified this schedule record.

attributes.name: resource_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to der.der_resource. Business justification: Maintenance and inspection schedules are created per DER asset; linking enables automated schedule generation and reporting.

attributes.name: service_territory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the geographic service territory covered by this schedule. Used for T&D operations and outage response planning.

attributes.name: technician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technician or field worker assigned to this schedule.

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.vehicle. Business justification: Schedule may assign a vehicle for the shift; linking to vehicle provides full vehicle details and removes redundant code column.

attributes.name: work_assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the planned work assignment or work order associated with this schedule. Nullable for general availability schedules.

attributes.name: break_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total scheduled break time in minutes (lunch, rest breaks). Required for labor law compliance and union contract adherence.

attributes.name: certification_required
attributes.description: Specific certifications or licenses required for this schedule (e.g., CDL Class A, NERC CIP training, confined space entry). Pipe-separated list if multiple.

attributes.name: confirmed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the technician acknowledged and confirmed the schedule. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: consecutive_days_worked
attributes.description: Number of consecutive days the technician is scheduled to work without a rest day. Used for union contract compliance (maximum consecutive days rules).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this schedule record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date when this schedule period ends. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: mobile_device_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the mobile device (tablet, smartphone) assigned to the technician for field data collection and work order updates.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this schedule record was last modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: mutual_assistance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule involves mutual assistance deployment to another utility service territory during emergency response.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or special instructions for the schedule (e.g., safety requirements, equipment needs, coordination instructions).

attributes.name: on_call_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule includes on-call duty for emergency response. True if technician is on standby for outage or emergency dispatch.

attributes.name: optimization_score
attributes.description: Score generated by ClickSoftware WFM optimization engine indicating schedule quality (0-100). Higher scores indicate better resource utilization and constraint satisfaction.

attributes.name: overtime_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether hours worked under this schedule are eligible for overtime compensation per union agreement or FLSA rules.

attributes.name: planning_horizon
attributes.description: Time period covered by this schedule (daily shift, weekly rotation, monthly assignment, or quarterly plan).

attributes.name: published_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the schedule was published and communicated to the technician. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: rest_period_hours
attributes.description: Minimum rest period in hours between shifts. Required for OSHA safety compliance and union contract adherence.

attributes.name: schedule_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the schedule, typically generated by ClickSoftware WFM system. Format: SCH-YYYYMMDD.

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the schedule. Draft schedules are being planned, published schedules are communicated to workers, confirmed schedules are acknowledged by workers.

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the schedule type indicating the nature of the work period.

attributes.name: shift_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total duration of the scheduled shift in hours, including breaks. Used for labor capacity planning and union contract compliance.

attributes.name: shift_end_time
attributes.description: Timestamp when the scheduled shift ends. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: shift_pattern_code
attributes.description: Code representing the shift rotation pattern (e.g., 4x10, 5x8, 12HR-ROTATING). Used for union contract compliance and workforce planning.

attributes.name: shift_start_time
attributes.description: Timestamp when the scheduled shift begins. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: skill_requirement_code
attributes.description: Primary skill or certification required for this schedule (e.g., LINEWORKER_JOURNEYMAN, METER_TECH_L2, SUBSTATION_OPERATOR). Used for qualification matching.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the system of record that created this schedule (ClickSoftware WFM, SAP HR, Maximo, or manual entry).

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date when this schedule period begins. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: storm_response_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule is part of emergency storm response staffing. True during major outage events requiring extended crew deployment.

attributes.name: travel_time_minutes
attributes.description: Estimated travel time in minutes from work location to service territory or first job site. Used for schedule optimization and capacity planning.

attributes.name: union_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the labor union governing this schedule. Used for contract compliance validation (work rules, overtime, rest periods).

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: SAP WBS element for capital project work. Used for CAPEX labor tracking on T&D construction and infrastructure projects.

products.name: time_entry
products.description: Transactional record of actual hours worked by a technician for a given date, work order, or cost object. Captures regular, overtime, double-time, travel, standby, and on-call hours with applicable pay code and cost center. Includes overtime pre-authorization tracking (requesting supervisor, authorization type, estimated vs actual hours). Supports CAPEX/OPEX labor cost classification via WBS element, union agreement overtime provisions, and FERC account coding. Sourced from ClickSoftware mobile time capture and integrated into SAP HR/Payroll.
products.reference: SAP HR CATS Time Entry / ClickSoftware Time Sheet

attributes.name: time_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the time entry record. Primary key.

attributes.name: approving_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user (supervisor or timekeeper) who approved the time entry.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Cost center to which labor hours are charged for financial accounting and cost allocation.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supervisor who authorized or approved the overtime hours.

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Internal order number for tracking costs against specific operational or maintenance activities.

attributes.name: primary_time_technician_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the technician or field worker who performed the work. Links to workforce personnel master data.

attributes.name: resource_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to der.der_resource. Business justification: Labor tracking for DER maintenance tasks requires associating time entries with the specific DER asset worked on.

attributes.name: storm_event_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the storm event or major outage event for which this time was recorded, enabling storm cost tracking and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: tertiary_time_approving_user_technician_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user (supervisor or timekeeper) who approved the time entry.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: WBS element for project-based work, enabling CAPEX/OPEX labor cost classification and project tracking.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the work order for which time was recorded. Links to work order management system.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the time entry was approved by the supervisor or timekeeper.

attributes.name: authorization_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when overtime authorization was granted by the supervisor.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes entered by the technician or supervisor providing additional context about the work performed or time recorded.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the time entry record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: double_time_hours
attributes.description: Number of double-time hours worked, typically for holidays, emergency call-outs, or extended overtime per union agreement.
attributes.references: SAP HR Time Management, Union Collective Bargaining Agreement

attributes.name: emergency_response_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the time entry is associated with emergency response work such as storm restoration, outage repair, or critical infrastructure protection.

attributes.name: estimated_hours
attributes.description: Estimated hours submitted during overtime pre-authorization request, used for variance analysis against actual hours.

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: FERC uniform system of accounts code for regulatory financial reporting and rate case preparation.

attributes.name: geographic_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the geographic location or service territory where the work was performed, used for regional cost allocation.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS, GIS Geographic Information System

attributes.name: gps_latitude
attributes.description: GPS latitude coordinate where the time entry was captured, used for field workforce location verification and audit.

attributes.name: gps_longitude
attributes.description: GPS longitude coordinate where the time entry was captured, used for field workforce location verification and audit.

attributes.name: labor_cost_classification
attributes.description: Classification of labor cost as CAPEX (capital expenditure for new construction), OPEX (operating expenditure for maintenance), or specific categories like emergency or storm response.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts, SAP FI/CO

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the time entry record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: mobile_capture_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the time entry was captured via mobile device in the field using ClickSoftware mobile workforce application.

attributes.name: on_call_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours in on-call status, available for emergency dispatch with on-call premium pay per union agreement.

attributes.name: overtime_authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether pre-authorization was required for overtime hours per company policy or union agreement.

attributes.name: overtime_authorization_status
attributes.description: Status of overtime pre-authorization: not required, pending approval, approved, denied, or retroactively authorized.

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Number of overtime hours worked beyond regular shift hours, subject to premium pay rates per union agreement or labor law.

attributes.name: pay_code
attributes.description: Payroll code indicating the type of time and applicable pay rate (e.g., REG for regular, OT for overtime, DT for double-time, TRV for travel).

attributes.name: payroll_period
attributes.description: Payroll period identifier (e.g., 2024-03-W2 for week 2 of March 2024) to which this time entry belongs for wage calculation.

attributes.name: payroll_posting_date
attributes.description: Date when the time entry was posted to payroll for wage calculation and payment processing.

attributes.name: regular_hours
attributes.description: Number of regular work hours recorded, typically within standard shift hours per union agreement or employment contract.

attributes.name: shift_end_time
attributes.description: Timestamp when the technician completed their shift or work assignment for the day.

attributes.name: shift_start_time
attributes.description: Timestamp when the technician began their shift or work assignment for the day.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: System of record from which the time entry originated: ClickSoftware WFM, SAP HR, Maximo EAM, or manual entry.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the time entry in the source system, used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: standby_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours on standby or ready-to-respond status, typically for emergency response crews with standby pay provisions.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the time entry was submitted for approval by the technician or timekeeper.

attributes.name: time_entry_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the time entry, typically system-generated for reference and audit purposes.

attributes.name: time_entry_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the time entry: draft (not submitted), submitted (pending approval), approved, rejected, posted (to payroll), or cancelled.

attributes.name: time_type
attributes.description: Classification of time entry as productive (direct work), non-productive (downtime), indirect (support), administrative, or training.

attributes.name: total_hours
attributes.description: Total hours recorded across all time categories (regular, overtime, double-time, travel, standby, on-call) for the time entry.

attributes.name: travel_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours spent traveling to and from work sites, compensable per union agreement or company policy.

attributes.name: union_agreement_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the applicable collective bargaining agreement governing overtime provisions, pay rates, and work rules for this time entry.

attributes.name: work_activity_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific type of work activity performed (e.g., line repair, meter installation, vegetation management, substation maintenance).

attributes.name: work_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the work was performed. Used for payroll period determination and labor cost allocation.

products.name: qualification
products.description: Master catalog of workforce qualifications, certifications, and competencies required for field utility work. Includes qualification type (CDL Class A, OSHA 10/30, NFPA 70E Arc Flash, Gas Operator Qualification, Substation Switching Authorization, Lineworker Journeyman Certificate), issuing authority, validity period, renewal requirements, and regulatory mandate (OSHA, PHMSA, NERC CIP). This is the reference catalog — not the individual worker's attainment record.
products.reference: OSHA / PHMSA Operator Qualification / NERC CIP Training Catalog

attributes.name: qualification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the workforce qualification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: superseded_by_qualification_id
attributes.description: Reference to the qualification_id that supersedes this qualification if it has been replaced by a newer version or updated standard. Null if not superseded.

attributes.name: cost_per_worker_usd
attributes.description: Standard cost in US dollars to obtain or renew this qualification per worker, including training fees, examination fees, and certification fees. Used for workforce development budgeting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this qualification record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this qualification definition became effective and available for assignment to workers in the workforce management system.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when this qualification definition was retired or superseded. Null if currently active. Used to maintain historical qualification definitions for audit and reporting.

attributes.name: examination_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an examination or assessment is required to obtain this qualification (True) or if completion of training alone is sufficient (False).

attributes.name: external_training_provider
attributes.description: Name of the primary external training provider or vendor if internal training is not available. Null if training is provided internally.

attributes.name: internal_training_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the utility offers internal training programs for this qualification (True) or if workers must obtain it through external providers (False).

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the organization, agency, or body that issues or certifies this qualification (e.g., State Department of Motor Vehicles, OSHA, NFPA, PHMSA, internal utility training department).

attributes.name: issuing_authority_type
attributes.description: Classification of the issuing authority: government agency (OSHA, DMV), industry association (NFPA, IEEE), internal utility training program, third-party certification body, or professional organization.

attributes.name: job_role_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of job roles or positions for which this qualification is applicable or required (e.g., Lineworker, Substation Technician, Gas Service Technician, Meter Reader, Crew Chief).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this qualification record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: minimum_experience_months
attributes.description: Minimum months of relevant work experience required before a worker can pursue this qualification. Null if no experience requirement.

attributes.name: nerc_cip_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: NERC CIP (Critical Infrastructure Protection) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this qualification is required under North American Electric Reliability Corporation Critical Infrastructure Protection standards for personnel with access to Bulk Electric System cyber or physical assets.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, special instructions, or contextual information about this qualification that does not fit in other structured fields.

attributes.name: practical_demonstration_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a hands-on practical demonstration or field evaluation is required to obtain this qualification (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: prerequisite_qualifications
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of qualification codes that are prerequisites for obtaining this qualification. Null if no prerequisites exist.

attributes.name: qualification_category
attributes.description: Broad functional category grouping qualifications by purpose: safety (OSHA, Arc Flash), technical (CDL, equipment operation), operational (switching authorization), regulatory (gas operator qualification), leadership (crew chief), or specialized (confined space entry).

attributes.name: qualification_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the qualification (e.g., CDL-A, OSHA-30, NFPA70E). Used for external reference and system integration.

attributes.name: qualification_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the qualification including scope, purpose, and what competencies or knowledge it represents.

attributes.name: qualification_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the qualification (e.g., Commercial Driver License Class A, OSHA 30-Hour Construction Safety, NFPA 70E Arc Flash Safety Training).

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the qualification in the catalog. Active qualifications are available for assignment and tracking; inactive or retired qualifications are no longer issued but may be maintained for historical worker records.

attributes.name: qualification_type
attributes.description: Category of qualification distinguishing licenses, certifications, training completions, competency assessments, authorizations, and permits.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body that mandates this qualification if regulatory_mandate_flag is True (e.g., OSHA, PHMSA, NERC, State Public Utility Commission). Null if not regulatory-mandated.
attributes.references: OSHA, PHMSA, NERC CIP, FERC, State PUC

attributes.name: regulatory_citation
attributes.description: Specific regulation, code section, or standard citation that mandates this qualification (e.g., 29 CFR 1910.269, 49 CFR Part 192 Subpart N, NERC CIP-004). Null if not regulatory-mandated.
attributes.references: OSHA CFR, PHMSA CFR, NERC CIP Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_mandate_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this qualification is mandated by federal, state, or local regulation (True) or is voluntary/internal best practice (False). Regulatory-mandated qualifications have compliance implications.
attributes.references: OSHA, PHMSA, NERC CIP, State PUC Requirements

attributes.name: renewal_method
attributes.description: Method by which the qualification must be renewed: retraining course, examination, continuing education credits, practical demonstration, administrative review, or not applicable if no renewal required.

attributes.name: renewal_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this qualification requires periodic renewal (True) or is valid indefinitely once obtained (False).

attributes.name: safety_critical_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this qualification is designated as safety-critical (True), meaning its absence creates immediate safety risk to workers or the public. Used for compliance monitoring and workforce planning.

attributes.name: training_duration_hours
attributes.description: Standard duration in hours of the training or course required to obtain this qualification. Null if not applicable (e.g., for licenses obtained through examination without formal training).

attributes.name: union_agreement_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the collective bargaining agreement or union contract section that governs this qualification if applicable. Null if not covered by union agreement.

attributes.name: validity_period_months
attributes.description: Standard validity period for this qualification in months from date of issuance. Null if the qualification does not expire (e.g., some licenses are perpetual until revoked).

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for this qualification definition (e.g., 1.0, 2.1). Used when qualification requirements or standards are updated over time.

attributes.name: work_type_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of work types or activities for which this qualification is required (e.g., Overhead Line Construction, Underground Cable Splicing, Substation Switching, Gas Main Repair, Confined Space Entry, Energized Work).

products.name: technician_qualification
products.description: Tracks each technician's attainment, expiration, and renewal status for every required qualification or certification. Captures issue date, expiration date, certifying body, certificate number, training provider, and compliance status. Supports OSHA safety training compliance, PHMSA Operator Qualification (OQ) program for gas workers, NERC CIP personnel training requirements, and ClickSoftware skill-based dispatch matching. Triggers renewal alerts before expiration.
products.reference: PHMSA OQ Record / OSHA Training Record / NERC CIP Personnel Training

attributes.name: technician_qualification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the technician qualification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: technician_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the technician who holds this qualification. Links to the technician master record in workforce management systems.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.vendor. Business justification: External vendors issue many certifications; tracking issuing vendor is needed for safety audits, regulatory reporting, and cost allocation.

attributes.name: assessment_score
attributes.description: Numeric score or percentage achieved on the qualification assessment or examination. Null if no scored assessment was required.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate or credential number assigned by the certifying body. Used for verification and audit purposes.

attributes.name: certifying_body
attributes.description: Name of the organization, agency, or institution that issued the qualification (e.g., OSHA, NERC, PHMSA, state licensing board, equipment manufacturer, internal training department).
attributes.references: OSHA, NERC, PHMSA, State Regulatory Agencies

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance state of the qualification indicating whether the technician is authorized to perform associated work. Expiring_soon triggers alerts; expired/suspended/revoked blocks dispatch assignment.
attributes.references: ClickSoftware WFM, OSHA Compliance Standards, NERC CIP Personnel Training Requirements

attributes.name: continuing_education_credits
attributes.description: Number of continuing education units (CEUs) or professional development hours earned through this qualification. Used for license maintenance and career development tracking.

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost incurred to obtain or renew this qualification, including training fees, examination fees, certification fees, and travel expenses. Used for workforce development budget tracking.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the qualification cost. Defaults to USD for domestic operations.

attributes.name: dispatch_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this qualification enables the technician to be dispatched for specific work order types in ClickSoftware. True if qualification is used for skill-based dispatch matching.

attributes.name: documentation_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the digital copy of the qualification certificate, training completion record, or supporting documentation stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the qualification becomes valid and the technician is authorized to perform associated work activities.

attributes.name: equipment_authorization
attributes.description: Description of specialized equipment, tools, or vehicles the technician is authorized to operate based on this qualification (e.g., bucket truck, directional drill, live-line tools).

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the qualification expires and must be renewed. Null for qualifications with no expiration. Triggers renewal alerts in workforce management systems.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date Format, OSHA Training Requirements, PHMSA OQ Program

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Entity that funded the qualification training and certification costs (company-paid, employee self-funded, government/industry grant, union training fund, vendor-sponsored).

attributes.name: instructor_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary instructor or trainer who delivered the qualification training. Used for training quality assessment and instructor evaluation.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this qualification record is currently active and should be considered for dispatch eligibility and compliance reporting. False for historical or superseded records.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the qualification or certification was originally issued or awarded to the technician.

attributes.name: last_renewal_date
attributes.description: Most recent date on which the qualification was renewed or recertified. Null if never renewed since original issue.

attributes.name: next_renewal_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date by which the qualification must be renewed to maintain compliance. Used to trigger proactive renewal workflows and alerts.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date Format, Workforce Compliance Management

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional information, special conditions, restrictions, or comments related to this qualification record.

attributes.name: passing_score_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum score required to pass the qualification assessment. Used to validate qualification attainment.

attributes.name: proficiency_level
attributes.description: Assessed skill level or proficiency tier for this qualification, used for work assignment complexity matching and career development planning.

attributes.name: qualification_category
attributes.description: Broad functional category grouping qualifications by domain: safety (OSHA), technical (electrical/gas systems), regulatory (NERC CIP, PHMSA OQ), operational (SCADA, DMS), leadership, or specialized equipment operation.

attributes.name: qualification_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the specific qualification, certification, or training credential. Used for skill-based dispatch matching in ClickSoftware.
attributes.references: ClickSoftware Workforce Management (WFM), OSHA Training Standards

attributes.name: qualification_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the qualification or certification (e.g., OSHA 10-Hour Construction Safety, NERC CIP Cyber Security Training, PHMSA Operator Qualification for Gas Distribution).
attributes.references: OSHA, NERC CIP, PHMSA Operator Qualification Program

attributes.name: qualification_type
attributes.description: Category of the qualification distinguishing certifications, licenses, training completions, operator qualifications, safety credentials, and technical skills.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this qualification record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Audit field for data lineage.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Format, Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this qualification record was last updated in the lakehouse silver layer. Audit field for change tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Format, Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this qualification is mandated by federal, state, or industry regulatory bodies (OSHA, NERC CIP, PHMSA OQ, PUC requirements). True for mandatory qualifications.
attributes.references: OSHA, NERC CIP, PHMSA, State PUC Regulations

attributes.name: renewal_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the renewal reminder notification was sent. Null if no notification has been sent.

attributes.name: renewal_notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a renewal reminder notification has been sent to the technician and their supervisor. True once notification is dispatched.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this qualification record originated (ClickSoftware WFM, SAP HR, internal training management system).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this qualification record in the source operational system. Used for data reconciliation and traceability.

attributes.name: training_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the technician completed the required training or assessment for this qualification. May precede the issue date.

attributes.name: training_hours
attributes.description: Total number of training hours completed to earn this qualification. Used for continuing education tracking and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: OSHA Training Hour Requirements, Continuing Education Standards

attributes.name: training_location
attributes.description: Physical or virtual location where the qualification training was conducted (facility name, city, or online platform).

attributes.name: training_provider
attributes.description: Name of the organization or vendor that delivered the training or assessment leading to this qualification (may differ from certifying body).

attributes.name: union_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this qualification is required by collective bargaining agreement or union contract provisions. True for union-mandated qualifications.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the qualification credentials were last verified by HR, safety, or compliance personnel. Used for audit trail and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date Format, Compliance Audit Standards

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or system that verified the authenticity and validity of this qualification record.

attributes.name: work_type_authorization
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of work order types, task categories, or job classifications that this qualification authorizes the technician to perform (e.g., high-voltage switching, gas main repair, confined space entry).

products.name: union_agreement
products.description: Master record for collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) governing unionized field workforce including IBEW (International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers) and other trade union contracts. Captures agreement name, union local number, effective and expiration dates, wage scales by classification, overtime rules, call-out provisions, storm pay provisions, grievance procedures, and jurisdictional work rules. Drives labor cost calculations and scheduling constraint enforcement.

attributes.name: union_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the collective bargaining agreement (CBA) record. Primary key.

attributes.name: agreement_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the collective bargaining agreement, typically including union name and jurisdiction.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier for the collective bargaining agreement, typically formatted as CBA- followed by alphanumeric code.

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the collective bargaining agreement by scope and purpose: master (company-wide), local (facility-specific), supplemental (addendum to master), project (specific construction project), or interim (temporary).

attributes.name: arbitration_provision_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement includes binding arbitration as the final step in grievance resolution. True if arbitration is included, False otherwise.

attributes.name: bargaining_unit
attributes.description: Description of the employee group covered by this agreement, such as field technicians, lineworkers, meter readers, or substation operators.

attributes.name: base_wage_increase_pct
attributes.description: Percentage increase in base wages negotiated in this agreement, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 3.50 for 3.5% increase).

attributes.name: callout_minimum_hours
attributes.description: Minimum number of hours guaranteed for pay when an employee is called out for emergency or unscheduled work, regardless of actual hours worked.

attributes.name: callout_response_time_minutes
attributes.description: Maximum number of minutes within which an employee must respond to a call-out notification, as specified in the agreement.

attributes.name: covered_employee_count
attributes.description: Number of employees covered under this collective bargaining agreement at the time of ratification or most recent count.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this union agreement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: document_reference_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the full legal text of the collective bargaining agreement document stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: dues_checkoff_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employer agrees to deduct union dues from employee paychecks and remit to the union. True if dues checkoff is authorized, False otherwise.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the collective bargaining agreement becomes binding and enforceable.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the collective bargaining agreement terminates or requires renegotiation. Nullable for open-ended agreements.

attributes.name: grievance_procedure_steps
attributes.description: Detailed description of the formal grievance resolution process defined in the agreement, including escalation steps, timelines, and arbitration provisions.

attributes.name: health_benefits_summary
attributes.description: Summary of health insurance, medical benefits, and wellness programs provided under this agreement, including employer contribution levels and coverage tiers.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_description
attributes.description: Geographic or operational scope defining where this agreement applies, such as specific service territories, facilities, or operational divisions.

attributes.name: layoff_recall_provisions
attributes.description: Detailed provisions governing workforce reductions, layoff procedures, bumping rights, and recall procedures based on seniority and qualifications.
attributes.references: Worker Adjustment and Retraining Notification (WARN) Act

attributes.name: management_rights_clause
attributes.description: Statement of rights reserved to management that are not subject to collective bargaining, such as operational decisions, technology adoption, and business strategy.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who last modified this union agreement record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this union agreement record was last modified or updated in the system.

attributes.name: negotiating_team_lead
attributes.description: Name of the primary management representative who led negotiations for this agreement.

attributes.name: negotiation_end_date
attributes.description: Date when formal negotiations concluded with agreement reached or impasse declared.

attributes.name: negotiation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when formal negotiations for this agreement began between management and union representatives.

attributes.name: no_strike_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement includes a no-strike provision prohibiting work stoppages during the term of the agreement. True if no-strike clause exists, False otherwise.

attributes.name: overtime_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base wage for overtime hours, typically 1.5 for time-and-a-half or 2.0 for double-time.

attributes.name: overtime_threshold_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked in a period (daily or weekly) after which overtime rates apply, typically 8 hours per day or 40 hours per week.

attributes.name: pension_contribution_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of wages contributed by employer to pension or retirement plan on behalf of covered employees, as specified in the agreement.

attributes.name: ratification_date
attributes.description: Date when union membership voted to approve and ratify the collective bargaining agreement.

attributes.name: safety_training_requirements
attributes.description: Mandatory safety training and certification requirements specified in the agreement for covered employees, aligned with OSHA and NERC standards.

attributes.name: seniority_rules
attributes.description: Description of how seniority is calculated, applied, and used for purposes such as shift bidding, layoff order, recall rights, and vacation scheduling.

attributes.name: shift_differential_pct
attributes.description: Percentage premium added to base wage for non-standard shifts such as evening, night, or weekend shifts.

attributes.name: sick_leave_accrual_rate
attributes.description: Rate at which sick leave accrues for covered employees, typically expressed as hours per pay period or days per year.

attributes.name: storm_pay_multiplier
attributes.description: Premium pay multiplier applied during declared storm or emergency restoration events, typically higher than standard overtime rates.

attributes.name: storm_pay_trigger_conditions
attributes.description: Specific conditions or criteria that must be met to activate storm pay provisions, such as declaration of emergency by management or threshold of outages.

attributes.name: subcontracting_restrictions
attributes.description: Limitations or conditions on the company's ability to subcontract work normally performed by bargaining unit members, including notification and consultation requirements.

attributes.name: union_agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the collective bargaining agreement: draft (being prepared), active (in force), expired (past end date), terminated (ended early), under_negotiation (being renegotiated), or ratified (approved but not yet effective).

attributes.name: union_local_number
attributes.description: Local chapter or lodge number of the union, identifying the specific regional or facility-based union organization.

attributes.name: union_name
attributes.description: Full name of the labor union or trade organization party to this agreement, such as International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers (IBEW).

attributes.name: union_representative_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary union representative or business agent who led negotiations on behalf of the union.

attributes.name: union_security_clause
attributes.description: Type of union membership or dues requirement for employees in the bargaining unit: open_shop (voluntary), union_shop (must join), agency_shop (must pay fees), closed_shop (must be member before hire), or right_to_work (no requirement).

attributes.name: vacation_accrual_rate
attributes.description: Rate at which vacation time accrues for covered employees, typically expressed as hours per pay period or days per year based on seniority.

attributes.name: wage_scale_structure
attributes.description: Description of the wage classification system and pay scales defined in the agreement, including job classifications, step progressions, and rate tables.

attributes.name: work_rules_summary
attributes.description: Summary of key work rules and operational provisions defined in the agreement, including jurisdictional boundaries, crew composition requirements, and work assignment protocols.

products.name: labor_rate
products.description: Reference table of labor rates by craft classification, union agreement, pay grade, and effective date period. Captures straight-time rate, overtime rate, double-time rate, on-call rate, storm rate, and applicable burden/overhead percentages. Used for work order cost estimation, CAPEX/OPEX labor cost allocation, rate case labor cost support, and contractor vs. employee cost comparison. Sourced from SAP HR wage type configuration and union CBA schedules.
products.reference: SAP HR Wage Type / CBA Wage Schedule

attributes.name: labor_rate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the labor rate record. Primary key.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.facility. Business justification: Costing models use facility‑specific labor rates to calculate project estimates and regulatory cost reporting.

attributes.name: union_agreement_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.union_agreement

attributes.name: burden_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage markup applied to direct labor rate to account for benefits, payroll taxes, insurance, and other overhead costs. Used for fully-loaded labor cost calculations in work order costing and rate case filings.
attributes.references: SAP Controlling (CO) Overhead Rate Configuration, FERC Uniform System of Accounts, FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: capex_opex_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether labor costs for this craft are typically capitalized (CAPEX), expensed (OPEX), or split between both. Drives accounting treatment in work order settlement.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 (Regulated Operations), FERC Uniform System of Accounts, SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) Settlement Rules

attributes.name: cost_center_default
attributes.description: Default SAP cost center for charging labor costs associated with this craft classification. Used for work order cost allocation and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP Controlling (CO) Cost Center Accounting, FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: craft_classification_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the craft or trade classification (e.g., lineworker, electrician, meter technician, substation operator). Aligns with union job classifications and SAP HR organizational assignment codes.
attributes.references: SAP HR Organizational Management, Union Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) Job Classifications

attributes.name: craft_classification_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the craft or trade classification (e.g., Journeyman Lineworker, Senior Substation Electrician, Advanced Meter Technician).
attributes.references: SAP HR Organizational Management, Union CBA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this labor rate record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SAP HR Master Data Audit Trail, Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary rates (typically USD for U.S. utilities).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes, SAP Financial Accounting (FI) Currency Configuration

attributes.name: double_time_rate
attributes.description: Hourly labor rate for double-time hours (typically 2x straight time rate). Applied for holidays, Sundays, or extended overtime per union agreement.
attributes.references: SAP HR Payroll Wage Type, Union CBA Premium Pay Provisions

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this labor rate expires or is superseded by a new rate. Null indicates the rate is currently active with no defined end date.
attributes.references: SAP HR Master Data Time Constraints, Union CBA Effective Dates

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this labor rate becomes effective. Supports rate changes due to union negotiations, annual adjustments, or contract renewals.
attributes.references: SAP HR Master Data Time Constraints, Union CBA Effective Dates

attributes.name: employee_class
attributes.description: Broad classification of employee role (field workforce, office staff, technical specialist, supervisory, executive). Used for workforce planning and cost allocation.

attributes.name: flsa_status
attributes.description: FLSA classification determining overtime eligibility. Non-exempt employees are entitled to overtime pay; exempt employees are not.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA), SAP HR Payroll Configuration

attributes.name: gl_account_default
attributes.description: Default general ledger account code for posting labor expenses. Aligns with FERC Uniform System of Accounts for regulated utility accounting.
attributes.references: SAP Financial Accounting (FI) Chart of Accounts, FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this labor rate record.
attributes.references: SAP HR Master Data Audit Trail, Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this labor rate record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SAP HR Master Data Audit Trail, Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context about the labor rate, such as special conditions, negotiation history, or application rules.
attributes.references: SAP HR Master Data Long Text

attributes.name: on_call_rate
attributes.description: Hourly or daily rate paid to employees on standby/on-call status, available for emergency dispatch. May be a flat rate or percentage of straight time rate.
attributes.references: SAP HR Payroll Wage Type, Union CBA On-Call Provisions

attributes.name: overhead_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage markup for indirect overhead costs (supervision, facilities, administrative support) allocated to labor. Used in CAPEX/OPEX cost allocation and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP Controlling (CO) Overhead Rate Configuration, FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: overtime_rate
attributes.description: Hourly labor rate for overtime hours (typically 1.5x straight time rate). Applied for hours worked beyond standard shift or weekly threshold per union agreement and FLSA regulations.
attributes.references: SAP HR Payroll Wage Type, Union CBA Overtime Provisions, Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA)

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: Pay grade or step level within the craft classification (e.g., Grade 1, Grade 2, Step A, Step B). Determines base compensation level per union agreement or company pay structure.
attributes.references: SAP HR Payroll Wage Type Configuration, Union CBA Pay Schedules

attributes.name: rate_approval_authority
attributes.description: Entity or individual who approved the labor rate (e.g., HR Director, Union Negotiating Committee, Public Utility Commission).
attributes.references: Union CBA, SAP HR Workflow Approval Records

attributes.name: rate_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the labor rate was formally approved by management, union ratification, or regulatory authority.
attributes.references: Union CBA Ratification Records, SAP HR Master Data Audit Trail

attributes.name: rate_source
attributes.description: Source authority for the labor rate (union collective bargaining agreement, company compensation policy, market survey, contractor agreement, regulatory mandate).
attributes.references: Union CBA, SAP HR Compensation Management

attributes.name: rate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the labor rate record (active and in use, pending approval, expired, superseded by newer rate, suspended).
attributes.references: SAP HR Master Data Status Management

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the labor rate source and employment relationship (union employee, non-union employee, contractor, temporary worker, apprentice, management).
attributes.references: SAP HR Personnel Administration, Union CBA

attributes.name: shift_differential_rate
attributes.description: Additional hourly premium for non-standard shifts (evening, night, weekend shifts). Added to base straight time rate.
attributes.references: SAP HR Payroll Wage Type, Union CBA Shift Premium Provisions

attributes.name: storm_emergency_rate
attributes.description: Premium hourly rate applied during declared storm or emergency restoration events. Typically higher than standard overtime to incentivize rapid response for grid restoration.
attributes.references: SAP HR Payroll Wage Type, Union CBA Emergency Response Provisions, NERC Emergency Operations Standards

attributes.name: straight_time_rate
attributes.description: Standard hourly labor rate for regular working hours (typically Monday-Friday, standard shift). Expressed in USD per hour.
