attributes.references: SAP HR Payroll Wage Type, Union CBA Wage Schedules, FASB ASC 980 (Regulated Operations)

attributes.name: work_location_type
attributes.description: Primary work location type for this labor classification (field-based, office-based, hybrid, remote). Impacts travel time allowances and expense policies.
attributes.references: SAP HR Organizational Management, Union CBA Work Rules

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this labor rate record.
attributes.references: SAP HR Master Data Audit Trail, Internal Data Governance Standards

products.name: absence
products.description: Transactional record of planned and unplanned workforce absences including vacation, sick leave, FMLA, union leave, jury duty, military leave, and workers compensation leave. Captures absence type, start date, end date, duration in hours, approval status, and impact on crew coverage. Integrated with SAP HR absence management and used by ClickSoftware WFM to adjust available resource capacity for scheduling and storm response staffing.
products.reference: SAP HR Absence / FMLA Leave Record

attributes.name: absence_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the workforce absence record. Primary key.

attributes.name: absence_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who is absent. Links to the employee master record in SAP HR.

attributes.name: absence_replacement_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee assigned to cover the absent employee's shifts or work assignments. Nullable if no replacement assigned.

attributes.name: absence_replacement_employee_technician_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee assigned to cover the absent employee's shifts or work assignments. Nullable if no replacement assigned.

attributes.name: absence_technician_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who is absent. Links to the employee master record in SAP HR.

attributes.name: approver_technician_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supervisor or manager who approved or rejected the absence request.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Absence cost accruals are allocated to cost centers for labor cost forecasting and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the crew or work group to which the absent employee is assigned. Used to assess crew coverage impact.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supervisor or manager who approved or rejected the absence request.

attributes.name: payroll_period_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the payroll period in which this absence was processed for payment or deduction.

attributes.name: absence_category
attributes.description: Classification of the absence as planned (scheduled in advance), unplanned (short-notice or same-day), or emergency (critical unplanned absence requiring immediate coverage).

attributes.name: accrual_deduction_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours deducted from the employee's leave accrual balance (e.g., vacation bank, sick leave bank) for this absence.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when the absence request was approved or rejected by the approver.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the absence request in the workflow. Pending indicates awaiting supervisor approval, approved indicates authorized absence, rejected indicates denied request, cancelled indicates approved absence later revoked, withdrawn indicates employee retracted the request.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this absence record was first created in the source system.

attributes.name: duration_days
attributes.description: Total duration of the absence measured in calendar days or working days depending on absence type configuration.

attributes.name: duration_hours
attributes.description: Total duration of the absence measured in hours. Used for payroll deduction and crew capacity planning.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date when the absence period ends. Nullable for open-ended absences pending return confirmation.

attributes.name: fmla_case_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Case Number
attributes.description: Case number assigned to FMLA leave requests for tracking compliance with the Family Medical Leave Act. Populated only for FMLA absence types.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Labor FMLA Regulations (29 CFR 825)

attributes.name: impact_on_crew_coverage
attributes.description: Assessment of the operational impact of this absence on crew coverage and service delivery. Critical indicates absence jeopardizes minimum crew requirements or emergency response capability.

attributes.name: intermittent_leave_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this absence is part of an approved intermittent leave arrangement (e.g., recurring FMLA leave taken in separate blocks rather than continuously).
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Labor FMLA Regulations (29 CFR 825)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this absence record was last updated in the source system.

attributes.name: medical_certification_date
attributes.description: The date when medical certification documentation was received and validated.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Labor FMLA Regulations (29 CFR 825)

attributes.name: medical_certification_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether required medical certification documentation has been received for absences requiring medical justification (e.g., FMLA, extended sick leave, workers compensation).
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Labor FMLA Regulations (29 CFR 825)

attributes.name: notification_method
attributes.description: The method by which the employee or their representative notified the employer of the absence (e.g., phone call, email, mobile app, direct supervisor notification, emergency contact).

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the absence was first reported or notified to the employer.

attributes.name: paid_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the absence is paid (true) or unpaid (false). Determines payroll treatment.

attributes.name: payroll_processed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the absence has been processed in payroll for wage deduction or paid leave disbursement.

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text description or notes providing additional context about the reason for the absence. May include details for reporting or documentation purposes.

attributes.name: replacement_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a replacement worker must be scheduled to cover the absent employee's duties. True for critical roles or minimum crew requirements.

attributes.name: return_to_work_clearance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee received medical or safety clearance to return to work following injury, illness, or extended absence. Required for workers compensation and FMLA cases.

attributes.name: return_to_work_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the employee returned to active work status following the absence. May differ from planned end_date.

attributes.name: scheduled_shift_end_time
attributes.description: The originally scheduled end time of the shift or work assignment that the employee missed due to the absence.

attributes.name: scheduled_shift_start_time
attributes.description: The originally scheduled start time of the shift or work assignment that the employee missed due to the absence.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the system of record where the absence was originally created (SAP_HR for SAP HR Absence Management, CLICKSOFTWARE for ClickSoftware WFM, ESS for Employee Self-Service portal, MANUAL for manual entry).

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this absence record in the source system of record. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date when the absence period begins.

attributes.name: storm_response_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this absence occurred during a declared storm or emergency response period, impacting crew availability for critical restoration work.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the employee or their representative submitted the absence request.

attributes.name: type_code
attributes.description: Code representing the type of absence (e.g., VAC for vacation, SICK for sick leave, FMLA for Family Medical Leave Act, UNION for union leave, JURY for jury duty, MIL for military leave, WC for workers compensation leave, UNPAID for unpaid leave).

attributes.name: type_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the absence type (e.g., Vacation, Sick Leave, FMLA Leave, Union Business, Jury Duty, Military Leave, Workers Compensation, Unpaid Leave).

attributes.name: union_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the labor union to which the employee belongs. Relevant for union leave types and collective bargaining agreement compliance.

attributes.name: work_center_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the work center or operational facility where the employee is normally assigned. Used for resource capacity planning.

attributes.name: workers_comp_claim_number
attributes.description: Claim number assigned to workers compensation leave for tracking occupational injury or illness cases. Populated only for workers compensation absence types.
attributes.references: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Recordkeeping

products.name: storm_event
products.description: Master record for declared storm and emergency events that trigger emergency workforce mobilization protocols. Captures storm name, storm type (hurricane, ice storm, derecho, nor'easter), declaration date/time, affected service territory, estimated restoration time (ERT), storm level (1-5 severity), mutual aid activation flag, and storm status (active, restoration, demobilization, closed). Drives storm crew scheduling, mutual aid crew tracking, and SAIDI/SAIFI storm exclusion reporting.
products.reference: OMS Storm Event / Emergency Operations Plan

attributes.name: storm_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the storm or emergency event record. Primary key for the storm event entity.

attributes.name: incident_commander_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the designated Incident Commander responsible for overall storm response coordination and decision-making authority.

attributes.name: technician_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the designated Incident Commander responsible for overall storm response coordination and decision-making authority.

attributes.name: actual_restoration_cost_usd
attributes.description: Final actual cost in US dollars incurred for storm restoration activities. Captured after event closure for regulatory rate case filing and insurance claims.

attributes.name: actual_restoration_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when full service restoration was completed and all customers were restored to service.

attributes.name: affected_customer_count
attributes.description: Total number of customers who experienced service interruption during the storm event. Used for SAIDI/SAIFI reliability metric calculations and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: affected_service_territory
attributes.description: Geographic description of the service territory areas impacted by the storm event. May include multiple regions, districts, or the entire service territory.

attributes.name: closure_notes
attributes.description: Free-text summary of final storm event outcomes, lessons learned, and any outstanding follow-up actions required. Used for after-action review and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: closure_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the storm event was officially closed, indicating completion of all restoration activities, demobilization of crews, and final cost reconciliation.

attributes.name: contractor_crew_count
attributes.description: Total number of contractor crews engaged for storm restoration work under existing or emergency procurement agreements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the storm event record was first created in the data management system.

attributes.name: damage_assessment_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether comprehensive damage assessment of transmission and distribution infrastructure has been completed following the storm event.

attributes.name: damage_assessment_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the initial comprehensive damage assessment was completed, enabling accurate restoration time estimates.

attributes.name: declaration_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the storm event was officially declared by operations leadership, triggering emergency workforce mobilization protocols and mutual aid activation.

attributes.name: emergency_operations_center_location
attributes.description: Physical location or facility name where the Emergency Operations Center was established for storm event coordination.

attributes.name: estimated_restoration_cost_usd
attributes.description: Projected total cost in US dollars for storm restoration activities including labor, materials, equipment, and mutual aid expenses. Updated as event progresses.

attributes.name: estimated_restoration_time
attributes.description: Projected date and time when full service restoration is expected to be completed across all affected areas. Updated throughout the event as conditions and resource availability change.

attributes.name: fema_declaration_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) Declaration Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the storm event resulted in a federal disaster declaration by FEMA, enabling potential federal assistance and cost recovery.

attributes.name: fema_declaration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) Declaration Number
attributes.description: Official FEMA disaster declaration number assigned to the event if federally declared. Used for tracking federal assistance and reimbursement claims.

attributes.name: incident_command_activated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal Incident Command System (ICS) structure was activated for coordinated emergency response management.

attributes.name: internal_crew_count
attributes.description: Total number of internal utility crews mobilized for storm response and restoration activities.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the storm event record was most recently updated, reflecting changes to status, estimates, or other event attributes.

attributes.name: media_inquiries_count
attributes.description: Total number of media inquiries received from news organizations during the storm event, indicating public and media attention level.

attributes.name: mutual_aid_activated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether mutual aid resources from other utilities were requested and activated for this storm event. True when external crews are mobilized.

attributes.name: mutual_aid_crew_count
attributes.description: Total number of external mutual aid crews deployed to support restoration efforts during the storm event.

attributes.name: oms_event_external_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Outage Management System (OMS) Event External Identifier (ID)
attributes.description: External system identifier from GE PowerOn Advanced OMS for linking storm event to outage records and restoration tracking.

attributes.name: peak_outage_count
attributes.description: Maximum number of customers simultaneously without service at any point during the storm event. Key metric for assessing storm impact severity.

attributes.name: public_communications_issued_count
attributes.description: Total number of public communications (press releases, social media updates, customer notifications) issued during the storm event for customer and stakeholder awareness.

attributes.name: regulatory_report_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline date by which post-storm regulatory reports must be submitted to the Public Utility Commission per regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: regulatory_report_submitted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether required post-storm regulatory reports have been submitted to the Public Utility Commission or other regulatory authorities.

attributes.name: saidi_exclusion_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: System Average Interruption Duration Index (SAIDI) Exclusion Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storm event qualifies for exclusion from SAIDI reliability metric calculations under IEEE 1366 major event day (MED) criteria or regulatory commission rules.

attributes.name: saifi_exclusion_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: System Average Interruption Frequency Index (SAIFI) Exclusion Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storm event qualifies for exclusion from SAIFI reliability metric calculations under IEEE 1366 major event day (MED) criteria or regulatory commission rules.

attributes.name: state_emergency_declaration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the state governor declared a state of emergency for this storm event, which may trigger regulatory reporting requirements and cost recovery provisions.

attributes.name: storm_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual or forecasted date and time when the storm conditions ended or are expected to end in the service territory.

attributes.name: storm_event_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code assigned to the storm event for external reference and communication with mutual aid partners, regulatory agencies, and internal systems.

attributes.name: storm_name
attributes.description: Official name assigned to the storm event (e.g., Hurricane Sandy, Winter Storm Jonas). May be assigned by National Weather Service or internal operations.

attributes.name: storm_severity_level
attributes.description: Numeric severity classification from 1 (minor) to 5 (catastrophic) that determines the scale of workforce mobilization, mutual aid activation, and executive escalation. Aligns with company emergency response plan tiers.

attributes.name: storm_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual or forecasted date and time when the storm conditions began or are expected to begin impacting the service territory.

attributes.name: storm_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the storm event indicating the phase of emergency response and workforce mobilization.

attributes.name: storm_type
attributes.description: Classification of the storm or emergency event type that determines response protocols and resource mobilization strategies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hurricane|tropical_storm|ice_storm|winter_storm|thunderstorm|tornado|derecho|noreaster|flood|wildfire|earthquake|other — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: total_crew_hours
attributes.description: Cumulative labor hours worked by all crews (internal, mutual aid, and contractor) during the storm event. Used for cost tracking and resource utilization analysis.

attributes.name: weather_forecast_source
attributes.description: Name of the meteorological service or vendor providing weather forecasting data for storm event planning and response (e.g., National Weather Service, DTN, Weather Company).

attributes.name: wfm_storm_event_external_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Workforce Management (WFM) Storm Event External Identifier (ID)
attributes.description: External system identifier from ClickSoftware Workforce Management system for cross-system reconciliation and integration.

products.name: storm_assignment
products.description: Transactional record tracking crew and technician assignments during a declared storm event, including both internal utility crews and mutual aid crews from other utilities under EEI mutual aid agreements. Captures storm event reference, assigned crew or technician, assignment role (restoration, damage assessment, wire guard), reporting depot, mobilization and demobilization timestamps, and hours worked under storm pay provisions. For mutual aid crews: originating utility, crew composition, equipment brought, and cost reimbursement tracking. Supports IBEW storm pay calculation, EEI mutual aid billing, and post-storm cost recovery filings.
products.reference: Storm Crew Deployment Record / Mutual Aid Agreement Tracking

attributes.name: storm_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the storm assignment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center charged for this storm assignment. Used for financial accounting and Operations and Maintenance (O&M) expense allocation in SAP Financial Accounting (FI).

attributes.name: created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person or system that created this storm assignment record. Typically a dispatcher or workforce management system user.

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Reference to the crew assigned to this storm event. May be internal utility crew or mutual aid crew from another utility under Edison Electric Institute (EEI) mutual aid agreements.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to individual technician or lineworker assigned to storm duty. Used when assignment is to a specific employee rather than a crew. Mutually exclusive with crew_id for individual assignments.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operations depot or staging area where the crew or technician reports for storm duty. Used for logistics coordination and resource deployment planning.

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP internal order used for storm cost collection. Enables tracking of all storm-related costs for regulatory cost recovery and financial reporting.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person or system that last modified this storm assignment record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: storm_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the declared storm event under which this assignment was created. Links to the storm event master record that triggered emergency response protocols.

attributes.name: technician_id
attributes.description: Reference to individual technician or lineworker assigned to storm duty. Used when assignment is to a specific employee rather than a crew. Mutually exclusive with crew_id for individual assignments.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific work order or restoration job assigned during the storm event. Links storm assignment to actual field work performed for outage restoration tracking.

attributes.name: actual_total_cost
attributes.description: Actual total cost incurred for the storm assignment. Calculated after demobilization based on actual hours, equipment usage, and expenses. Used for post-storm cost recovery filings with regulatory authorities.
attributes.references: PUC Storm Cost Recovery Filing Requirements

attributes.name: assignment_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the storm assignment officially ended. May differ from demobilization timestamp due to administrative closeout activities.

attributes.name: assignment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments about the storm assignment. May include special instructions, coordination details, or post-assignment observations from supervisors or crew leads.

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the storm assignment. Format: SA-XXXXXXXXXX where X is numeric. Used for tracking and reporting in workforce management systems.

attributes.name: assignment_role
attributes.description: Functional role assigned to the crew or technician during the storm event. Determines work scope, safety protocols, and pay classification under International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers (IBEW) storm pay provisions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: restoration|damage_assessment|wire_guard|tree_removal|substation_repair|switching_operations|customer_liaison|logistics_support — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: assignment_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the storm assignment officially begins. Marks the start of storm pay eligibility and labor cost tracking for the assignment.
attributes.references: IBEW Labor Agreement - Storm Pay Provisions

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the storm assignment. Tracks progression from initial assignment through mobilization, active work, and demobilization phases.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this storm assignment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: demobilization_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the crew or technician was released from storm duty and demobilized. Marks the end of storm pay period and triggers final labor cost calculation.
attributes.references: IBEW Labor Agreement - Storm Pay Provisions

attributes.name: dispatch_zone_code
attributes.description: Reference to the geographic dispatch zone where the crew or technician is assigned to work during the storm. Used for territory management and resource allocation optimization.

attributes.name: double_time_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked at double-time pay rate during the storm assignment. Applied for extended shifts or specific high-priority restoration work under union agreements.
attributes.references: IBEW Labor Agreement - Premium Pay Provisions

attributes.name: estimated_daily_cost
attributes.description: Estimated daily cost for the storm assignment including labor, equipment, lodging, and meals. Used for budget tracking and cost recovery planning. For mutual aid crews, based on EEI reimbursement rates.
attributes.references: EEI Mutual Aid Agreement - Cost Reimbursement Schedule

attributes.name: is_mutual_aid_crew
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this assignment is for a mutual aid crew from another utility under Edison Electric Institute (EEI) mutual aid agreements. True for external crews, False for internal utility crews.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this storm assignment record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking throughout the assignment lifecycle.

attributes.name: lodging_location
attributes.description: Name and address of the hotel or facility where lodging was provided. Used for expense tracking and mutual aid cost reimbursement.

attributes.name: lodging_provided
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether lodging accommodations were provided for the crew or technician during the storm assignment. Relevant for mutual aid crews and extended storm response operations.
attributes.references: EEI Mutual Aid Agreement - Lodging Provisions

attributes.name: meals_provided_count
attributes.description: Total number of meals provided to the crew or technician during the storm assignment. Used for per diem calculation and mutual aid cost reimbursement under EEI agreements.
attributes.references: EEI Mutual Aid Agreement - Meal Reimbursement

attributes.name: mobilization_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the crew or technician physically mobilized to the storm response area. Distinct from assignment start; captures actual deployment time for logistics tracking.

attributes.name: mutual_aid_crew_size
attributes.description: Number of personnel in the mutual aid crew. Used for lodging, meals, and logistics planning. Populated only for mutual aid assignments.
attributes.references: EEI Mutual Aid Agreement - Resource Tracking

attributes.name: mutual_aid_equipment_description
attributes.description: Description of equipment and vehicles brought by the mutual aid crew (e.g., bucket trucks, digger derricks, wire trailers). Used for asset tracking and cost reimbursement.
attributes.references: EEI Mutual Aid Agreement - Equipment Inventory

attributes.name: originating_utility_code
attributes.description: Standard utility identifier code for the mutual aid provider. Follows EEI utility coding standards for mutual aid coordination and billing.

attributes.name: originating_utility_name
attributes.description: Name of the utility company that provided the mutual aid crew. Populated only for mutual aid assignments. Used for cost reimbursement tracking and EEI mutual aid billing.
attributes.references: EEI Mutual Aid Agreement - Participating Utilities Registry

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked at overtime pay rate during the storm assignment. Typically hours beyond standard shift under IBEW storm pay provisions.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for the storm assignment. Critical assignments address public safety hazards or critical infrastructure. Drives crew dispatch sequencing and resource allocation decisions.

attributes.name: regular_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked at regular pay rate during the storm assignment. Component of total hours worked for payroll and cost allocation.
attributes.references: IBEW Labor Agreement - Pay Rate Classification

attributes.name: reporting_depot_code
attributes.description: Reference to the operations depot or staging area where the crew or technician reports for storm duty. Used for logistics coordination and resource deployment planning.

attributes.name: safety_incident_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of any safety incident that occurred during the storm assignment. Populated only if safety_incident_flag is True. Used for OSHA reporting and safety analysis.

attributes.name: safety_incident_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a safety incident occurred during this storm assignment. Triggers Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) reporting and safety review processes.

attributes.name: sap_hr_assignment_code
attributes.description: Assignment identifier from SAP HR system used for payroll processing and labor cost accounting. Links storm assignment to SAP HR time recording and payroll modules.

attributes.name: storm_pay_multiplier
attributes.description: Pay rate multiplier applied for storm duty under union agreement provisions. Typically ranges from 1.5x to 2.5x regular rate depending on conditions and duration. Used for payroll calculation.
attributes.references: IBEW Labor Agreement - Storm Pay Calculation

attributes.name: total_hours_worked
attributes.description: Total number of hours worked during the storm assignment period. Used for storm pay calculation under IBEW provisions and cost recovery filings with Public Utility Commission (PUC).
attributes.references: IBEW Labor Agreement - Storm Pay Calculation

attributes.name: union_agreement_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the applicable union collective bargaining agreement governing pay rates and working conditions for this assignment. Typically references IBEW local agreement for utility workers.

attributes.name: wfm_assignment_external_code
attributes.description: External identifier from the source Workforce Management system (ClickSoftware). Used for data integration and reconciliation between lakehouse and operational WFM system.

products.name: on_call_rotation
products.description: Defines the on-call rotation schedule for field technicians and crews responsible for after-hours emergency response including outage restoration, gas leak response, and downed wire calls. Captures rotation period (weekly, bi-weekly), technician assigned, backup technician, on-call start and end date/time, response time SLA (e.g., 30-minute callout), and union on-call pay provision. Supports 24/7 emergency dispatch readiness and union CBA on-call compensation compliance.

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: crew_id

attributes.name: dispatch_zone_id

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the workforce scheduler or system user who created this rotation record.

attributes.name: primary_on_technician_id

attributes.name: sap_hr_shift_id

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: On‑call activities are charged to WBS elements to track project‑level labor effort and compliance.

attributes.name: avg_response_time_minutes

attributes.description: Minimum billable hours guaranteed per union agreement when technician is called out (e.g., 4-hour minimum per CBA).

attributes.name: callout_radius_miles

attributes.name: cdl_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a valid CDL is required for this on-call rotation.

attributes.name: clicksoftware_rotation_code
attributes.description: External identifier for this on-call rotation in the ClickSoftware Workforce Management system.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number to reach the on-call technician during this rotation period.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this on-call rotation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dispatch_center_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the dispatch center responsible for activating this on-call rotation.

attributes.name: emergency_type_coverage
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of emergency incident types covered by this rotation (e.g., outage, gas leak, downed wire, transformer failure).

attributes.name: gas_operator_qualified_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether DOT Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA) gas operator qualification is required for this rotation.
attributes.references: PHMSA Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this on-call rotation record was last updated.

attributes.name: mutual_aid_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether technician/crew in this rotation can be deployed for mutual aid to other utilities during major events.

attributes.name: nerc_cip_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether NERC CIP security clearance is required for this on-call rotation due to critical infrastructure access.
attributes.references: NERC CIP Critical Infrastructure Protection Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes regarding special conditions, coverage changes, or incidents during this rotation period.

attributes.name: on_call_pay_provision
attributes.description: Specific union CBA clause or company policy defining on-call compensation (e.g., standby pay rate, minimum call-in hours, overtime multiplier).

attributes.name: on_call_pay_rate
attributes.description: Hourly or daily standby pay rate for being on-call during this rotation period.

attributes.name: osha_qualification_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Qualification Required
attributes.description: OSHA safety qualifications required for technicians in this rotation (e.g., OSHA 10, OSHA 30, confined space, arc flash).
attributes.references: OSHA Occupational Safety and Health Administration

attributes.name: overtime_multiplier
attributes.description: Overtime pay multiplier applied to callout work during on-call rotation (e.g., 1.5x, 2.0x for weekend/holiday).

attributes.name: priority_tier
attributes.description: Priority tier for emergency dispatch escalation (Tier 1 = first responder, Tier 2 = backup, Tier 3 = management escalation).

attributes.name: response_time_sla_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Response Time Service Level Agreement (SLA) Minutes
attributes.description: Maximum number of minutes allowed for technician to respond to emergency callout during this rotation (e.g., 30-minute callout SLA).
attributes.references: NERC North American Electric Reliability Corporation Standards

attributes.name: rotation_end_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when the on-call rotation period ends.

attributes.name: rotation_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for the on-call rotation schedule (e.g., Week 1 Gas Emergency, Storm Response Rotation A).

attributes.name: rotation_start_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when the on-call rotation period begins.

attributes.name: rotation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the on-call rotation schedule.

attributes.name: rotation_type
attributes.description: Frequency pattern of the on-call rotation schedule.

attributes.name: service_territory_code
attributes.description: Geographic service territory covered by this on-call rotation.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Type of emergency service this on-call rotation covers.

attributes.name: sla_compliance_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of callouts during this rotation that met the response time SLA.
attributes.references: NERC North American Electric Reliability Corporation Standards

attributes.name: storm_response_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rotation is eligible for storm emergency response activation.

attributes.name: union_agreement_code
attributes.description: Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) code governing on-call pay provisions and work rules for this rotation.

attributes.name: voltage_class_coverage
attributes.description: Voltage classes this on-call rotation is qualified to handle (e.g., low voltage, medium voltage, high voltage, transmission).
attributes.references: NERC North American Electric Reliability Corporation Standards

products.name: line_crew_assignment
products.description: Represents the assignment of a field crew to a transmission line. Each record captures the crew, the line, the assignment start and end dates, and the crew's role for that assignment.. Existence Justification: A transmission line can be serviced by many field crews over its lifecycle, and a crew can be dispatched to work on many different transmission lines. The utility actively creates, updates, and deletes assignment records that capture which crew is assigned to which line, with start/end dates and role information.

attributes.name: crew_id

attributes.name: assignment_start_date

attributes.name: role

products.name: asset_technician_authorization
products.description: Represents the authorization of field technicians to work on specific utility assets. Each record links one asset registry entry to one technician and stores attributes that belong only to the authorization relationship.. Existence Justification: Technicians are authorized to work on specific utility assets for safety, compliance, and scheduling. An asset can have multiple authorized technicians, and a technician can be authorized on many assets. Each authorization record captures dates, certification level, and status, making the relationship a managed business entity.

attributes.name: asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the asset registry

attributes.name: technician_id

attributes.name: asset_technician_authorization_status
attributes.description: Current status of the authorization (active, suspended, revoked)

attributes.name: authorization_date
attributes.description: Date the technician was authorized to work on the asset

attributes.name: certification_level
attributes.description: Certification level required for the asset work

attributes.name: expiration_date

products.name: storm_parcel_impact
products.description: Represents the operational link between a storm event and a utility-owned parcel. Each record captures the damage assessment status and restoration timing for that specific parcel during the storm.. Existence Justification: Each storm event can affect many land parcels, and a single parcel can be impacted by multiple storm events over time. The utility creates and maintains a record for each storm‑parcel pair that captures damage assessment status and restoration timestamps, which are operational data managed by crews.

products.name: goods_receipt
products.description: Records the physical receipt and acceptance of all materials, equipment, fuel deliveries, and contractor services against purchase orders at utility plants, warehouses, and staging yards. Captures document number, posting date, receipt type, quantity received, unit of measure, storage location, plant, movement type, and quality inspection status. For generation fuel deliveries: captures fuel type, BTU content, sulfur/ash content (coal), calorific value, supplier, carrier, pipeline nomination confirmation, and EIA-923 reporting fields. domains.name: der
domains.description: Distributed energy resources management including rooftop solar, battery storage, EV charging infrastructure, microgrids, and customer-sited generation. products.name: resource
products.description: Master record for each distributed energy resource (DER) asset — customer-sited or utility-owned — including rooftop solar PV, battery storage (BESS), EV charging stations, fuel cells, small wind, and backup generators. Captures nameplate capacity (kW/kWh), technology type, manufacturer/model, installation address, GPS coordinates, commissioning date, operational status, interconnection point (POI), serving circuit/feeder, DERMS asset ID, IEEE 1547 category, and complete technical configuration: inverter settings (Volt-VAR curve, Volt-Watt curve, frequency-watt response), export/import limits (kW), ramp rate limits (kW/min), communication protocol (IEEE 2030.5, OpenADR, OCPP, Modbus), DERMS device ID, firmware version, last configuration push timestamp, and configuration approval status. Serves as the single source of truth for all DER physical assets, their DERMS-registered configurations, and IEEE 1547-2018 advanced inverter function compliance within the utility service territory.

products.name: interconnection_request
products.description: Tracks the full lifecycle of a customer or third-party application to interconnect a DER to the utility distribution grid, from initial application through technical studies to executed interconnection agreement. Captures application date, applicant identity, proposed DER type and capacity (kW), point of interconnection (POI), study queue position, technical review phases (feasibility, system impact, facilities — with findings, costs, and engineer assignments), approval milestones, permit tracking (permit type, issuing authority, submission/approval dates, conditions), inspection records (inspection type, date, inspector, pass/fail, deficiency notes), and the executed interconnection agreement details (execution date, maximum export capacity, protection/control requirements, metering requirements, insurance obligations, indemnification terms, termination conditions). products.name: microgrid
products.description: Master record and complete operational history for each microgrid system within the utility service territory — utility-owned, customer-owned, or community microgrids. Captures microgrid name, geographic boundary, total generation capacity (kW), storage capacity (kWh), critical load served (kW), grid-connected vs islanded capability, point of common coupling (PCC), control system type, islanding protection scheme, operational status, and full mode transition event log: event timestamps, transition types (grid-connected to islanded, resynchronization, planned test), trigger causes (utility outage, scheduled test, operator command), island duration, load served during island (kW), generation sources active during island, and resynchronization outcomes. Supports resilience planning, SAIDI/SAIFI impact assessment, reliability reporting, and DERMS integration. Single source of truth for microgrid assets and their operational events.
products.reference: IEEE 2030.7 Microgrid Controller / Microgrid Asset Registry

products.name: performance_summary
products.description: Periodic (daily/monthly) performance, availability, and curtailment record for each DER asset. Captures performance period, expected vs actual output (kWh/kW), performance ratio (%), availability factor (%), capacity factor, and all curtailment events within the period: curtailment start/end timestamps, reason codes (voltage violation, thermal overload, overgeneration, operator-directed), curtailment authority (utility, ISO/RTO, DERMS auto), curtailed energy (kWh), and compensation eligibility flag. Supports program compliance verification, CAISO Rule 21 curtailment reporting, FERC Order 2222 compliance, incentive payment calculations, and DER fleet performance analytics. Single source of truth for DER operational performance and curtailment history.

Tracks rider code, description, applicable rate schedules, calculation method (per-kWh, per-therm, fixed), effective dates, and PUC filing reference. Riders are additive to base rates and must be versioned independently.

products.name: tou_period

products.name: rate_tier
products.description: Tiered (inclining or declining block) rate structure definitions subordinate to a rate component. Each tier specifies a consumption block boundary (e.g., first 500 kWh, 501-1000 kWh, above 1000 kWh), the unit price for that block, the baseline allocation method (territory average, household size), season applicability, and CARE/FERA discount tier indicators. Supports California-style baseline allowance structures, conservation-incentive pricing, and declining-block industrial rates. Contains 8+ business attributes: tier_number, lower_bound_kwh, upper_bound_kwh, unit_price, baseline_method, season_code, discount_indicator, effective_date, and price_unit. Subordinate to rate_component — accessed via parent FK for billing engine tier resolution.

products.name: eligibility_rule
products.description: Business rules governing customer qualification, applicability, and territory assignment for rate schedules, tariff riders, and utility programs. Each rule defines criteria including customer class, service territory, voltage level, load profile type, demand threshold (kW), annual consumption range, premise type, geographic zone, and special conditions (medical baseline, EV ownership, solar interconnection, income level). Also maps rate schedules to applicable service territories, voltage levels, and customer classes — specifying whether assignment is mandatory or optional. Rules are composable with AND/OR logic. Consumed by CIS enrollment validation, self-service portal eligibility checks, CSR rate recommendation tools, and territory-specific rate lookups. Serves as the single source of truth for all 'who qualifies for what' and 'where does this rate apply' logic in the product catalog.

products.name: program_measure
products.description: Catalog of eligible measures, technologies, or qualifying equipment within any utility program type. For EE programs: rebate-eligible measures (LED lighting, HVAC upgrades, smart thermostats, insulation) with deemed savings values (kWh/year), demand reduction (kW), measure life (years), and incentive amounts ($/unit or $/kWh saved) sourced from PUC-approved deemed savings databases. products.name: filing
products.description: Master record for every regulatory filing or submission made by the utility to any regulatory body (FERC, NERC, state PUCs, EPA, PHMSA, DOE, EIA). Encompasses rate case filings, IRP submissions, CPCN applications, NERC CIP self-certifications, environmental permit applications, FERC Forms (1, 2, 714), EIA surveys (860, 861, 923), and all other mandatory or voluntary regulatory submissions. Captures filing type, form number, docket reference, filing date, regulatory body, filing status, submission method, responsible organizational unit, reporting period, key reported metrics, financial data summaries, IRP planning horizon and resource mix details, and amendment history. Discriminated by filing_type (FERC_FORM, EIA_SURVEY, IRP, RATE_CASE_FILING, CPCN, CIP_CERTIFICATION, ENVIRONMENTAL, OTHER) to support form-specific attributes. Serves as the SSOT for all regulatory submission events and their lifecycle from draft through final disposition.

products.name: compliance_obligation
products.description: Master record for every compliance obligation imposed on the utility by regulatory orders, rules, standards, or statutes — together with the complete evidence portfolio and audit/examination history. Encompasses NERC CIP requirements, RPS obligations, EPA/PHMSA safety mandates, and all other regulatory mandates. Captures obligation description, source regulation or order, regulatory body, obligation type, due date, responsible business unit, completion status, penalty exposure, and compliance gap analysis. products.name: cip_standard
products.description: NERC Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) standard master record with associated BES Cyber System and asset impact classifications. Captures the standard identifier (CIP-002 through CIP-014), standard title, version, effective date, requirement count, applicability criteria, and compliance category. Includes BES asset impact classifications: asset identifier, asset type (substation, control center, generation facility, transmission line), assigned impact level (high, medium, low), classification rationale, classification date, review cycle, and responsible engineer. Covers permits issued by EPA, state environmental agencies, or PHMSA: permit number, permit type (air quality, water discharge, hazardous waste, pipeline safety, stormwater), issuing agency, facility covered, issue/expiration dates, renewal status, emission limits, and compliance monitoring requirements. domains.name: safety
domains.description: Manages occupational safety programs, environmental health, incident reporting, hazardous material handling, and environmental compliance across all utility operations. products.name: incident
products.description: OSHA recordable incidents, near-misses, first-aid events, unsafe conditions, and fatalities occurring across all utility operations (generation, T&D, gas, field crews). products.name: safety_audit
products.description: Formal safety audits, inspections, and regulatory examinations conducted internally or by external regulators (OSHA, PSC, PHMSA, NERC), including all associated findings, violations, and observations as line-level detail. Header level captures audit type (scheduled, unannounced, regulatory), scope, audit team composition, schedule, compliance rating, and overall disposition. Finding/line level captures individual deficiencies with finding ID, severity classification (critical, major, minor, observation), regulatory citation (e.g., OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147), violation determination, penalty assessment, required corrective action, responsible party, due date, closure status, and evidence of remediation. Serves as the authoritative SSOT for the complete audit execution lifecycle from planning through finding closure and regulatory response management. No separate finding-level product exists — all finding data lives here.

products.name: hazmat_inventory
products.description: Hazardous materials lifecycle management covering chemical inventory, storage, and reportable release/spill events at utility facilities (generation plants, substations, gas compressor stations, service centers). For inventory: tracks chemical name, CAS number, maximum/average quantity on hand, storage location, SDS reference, SARA Title III Tier II reporting status, and EPA RMP applicability. For releases/spills: captures release type (spill, leak, atmospheric emission), substance, quantity released, release point, environmental media affected (air, water, soil), regulatory notification timeline and status (EPA NRC, state agency, local LEPC), containment and remediation actions, and root cause. products.name: cip_compliance_record
products.description: NERC CIP (Critical Infrastructure Protection) compliance evidence records for bulk electric system (BES) cyber and physical security standards. Tracks CIP standard and requirement (CIP-002 through CIP-014), applicable BES Cyber System or physical asset, evidence type (policy, procedure, log, screenshot, attestation), evidence collection date, compliance period, responsible entity and compliance owner, RSAW (Reliability Standard Audit Worksheet) mapping, and self-certification or audit disposition status. Supports NERC CIP annual self-certification filings, FERC/NERC audit readiness, and internal compliance monitoring programs.
products.reference: NERC CIP Standards CIP-002 through CIP-014

products.name: emergency_drill
products.description: Emergency drill and exercise records documenting planned and executed emergency response exercises required by OSHA 1910.38 (emergency action plans), PHMSA 49 CFR 192.615 (gas pipeline emergency response), NRC emergency preparedness (nuclear), and state/local fire marshal requirements. Captures drill type (tabletop, functional, full-scale), scenario description, participating personnel and agencies, drill date, performance objectives, after-action findings, improvement items, and regulatory compliance status. Supports annual drill compliance tracking, mutual aid coordination documentation, and emergency preparedness program effectiveness measurement.

domains.name: finance
domains.description: Corporate financial management serving as the SSOT for general ledger, cost centers, capital project accounting, budgeting, financial planning, CAPEX/OPEX tracking, depreciation, and financial reporting. Manages chart of accounts, RAB valuation, ROE calculations, EBITDA reporting, and FASB ASC 980 regulatory asset/liability accounting. Supports rate case cost-of-service studies and FERC Form 1 reporting. Integrates with SAP FI/CO.

products.name: chart_of_accounts
products.description: Master repository of all general ledger account codes used by the utility, organized by account class (assets, liabilities, equity, revenues, expenses, O&M). Aligned with FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) and FASB ASC 980 regulated operations classifications. Serves as the foundational reference for all financial postings across SAP FI/CO, rate case cost-of-service studies, and FERC Form 1 reporting.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each general ledger account record in the chart of accounts. Serves as the primary key for all downstream joins and references across the finance domain.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Chart of Accounts; FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA)

attributes.name: account_class
attributes.description: High-level financial statement classification of the account indicating its role in the balance sheet or income statement. Values: asset, liability, equity, revenue, expense, other. Drives financial statement presentation and FERC Form 1 schedule mapping.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980; FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) 18 CFR Part 101; GAAP

attributes.name: account_group
attributes.description: SAP FI/CO account group (field KTOKS) that controls the number range and field status for this GL account. Account groups organize accounts into logical segments (e.g., utility plant, O&M expenses, revenue accounts) for master data governance.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO T077S Table; FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA)

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the GL account within the chart of accounts. Active accounts accept financial postings; blocked accounts are temporarily restricted; marked_for_deletion accounts are pending archival. Controls posting eligibility in SAP FI/CO.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO SKA1 Table; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: SAP FI/CO account type indicator (field KTOKS) classifying the account as balance sheet, profit and loss, non-operating, or statistical. Controls how balances are carried forward at year-end and how the account behaves in financial close processes.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO T077S Table; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: alternative_account_number
attributes.description: Country-specific or local statutory account number (SAP field ALTKT) used for local GAAP or statutory reporting requirements in jurisdictions where the utility operates. Supports mapping between FERC USoA accounts and state-specific chart of accounts requirements.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO SKA1 Table; State PUC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_code
attributes.description: SAP FI/CO chart-of-accounts key (field KTOPL) identifying the specific chart of accounts plan to which this account belongs (e.g., 'UTIL' for the utility operating chart, 'CONS' for consolidated). Supports multi-company-code deployments.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO T004 Table; FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP FI/CO company code (field BUKRS) to which this account is assigned, representing the legal entity or subsidiary within the utility holding company structure. Enables multi-entity financial consolidation and separate regulatory reporting per legal entity.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO T001 Table; FASB ASC 810 Consolidation; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: consolidation_account_number
attributes.description: The group-level or holding company consolidation account number to which this operating entity GL account maps for intercompany elimination and consolidated financial statement preparation. Supports multi-entity utility holding company structures.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Group Chart of Accounts; FASB ASC 810 Consolidation; SEC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: SAP CO controlling area code (field KOKRS) to which this account is relevant for management accounting, cost center accounting, and internal order settlement. Links GL accounts to the CO module for CAPEX/OPEX tracking and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP CO TKA01 Table; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: cost_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Capital Expenditure / Operating Expenditure (CAPEX/OPEX) Cost Category
attributes.description: Classifies the account as capital expenditure (CAPEX), operating expenditure (OPEX), regulatory asset, regulatory liability, or other. Critical for rate case cost-of-service studies, RAB valuation, and FASB ASC 980 regulatory accounting treatment.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations; FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA); GAAP

attributes.name: cost_element_category
attributes.description: SAP CO cost element category indicating whether the account is a primary cost element (originating from FI postings), secondary cost element (internal allocations only), or not applicable. Governs cost flow in SAP CO for rate case cost-of-service studies.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Element Master Data; FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this chart of accounts record was first created in the source system (SAP FI/CO). Provides audit trail for master data governance, SOX compliance, and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO SKA1 Table (ERDAT/ERZET fields); SOX Section 404; NIST SP 800-53 Audit Controls

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the account's operating currency (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency reporting for utilities with cross-border operations or foreign-denominated PPAs and energy trading contracts.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP FI/CO Currency Configuration; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this GL account was deactivated or blocked from further postings. Null for currently active accounts. Supports chart of accounts lifecycle management and historical financial reporting for prior periods.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Account Master Data; FERC Form 1 Historical Reporting

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Depreciation method applied to plant accounts associated with this GL account for regulatory and book depreciation purposes. Straight-line is the standard method for regulated utility plant per FERC USoA and PUC-approved depreciation studies.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA); State PUC Depreciation Study Guidelines

attributes.name: depreciation_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is subject to depreciation calculations in SAP Asset Accounting (AA). Relevant for utility plant accounts included in the Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) and depreciation studies filed with the PUC.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Accounting; FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA)

attributes.name: ebitda_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) Category
attributes.description: Maps this account to its EBITDA component for management reporting and investor relations disclosures. Enables automated EBITDA bridge calculations from the general ledger without manual reclassification.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 230; SEC Regulation G Non-GAAP Financial Measures; EIA Financial Reporting

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this GL account became effective and available for financial postings. Supports historical chart of accounts versioning for rate case cost-of-service studies referencing prior test year periods.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Account Master Data; FERC Form 1 Historical Reporting

attributes.name: ferc_account_description
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Description
attributes.description: Official FERC USoA account title and description corresponding to the mapped FERC account number. Provides regulatory context for auditors, rate case analysts, and FERC Form 1 preparers.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) 18 CFR Part 101

attributes.name: ferc_account_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Number
attributes.description: The FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) account number to which this GL account maps for regulatory reporting purposes. Used in FERC Form 1 annual report filings and rate case cost-of-service studies. Format follows FERC USoA three-digit primary account with optional sub-account suffix (e.g., 101, 303.1).
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) 18 CFR Part 101; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: ferc_schedule_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Form 1 Schedule Reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific FERC Form 1 schedule and line number where balances in this account are reported (e.g., 'Schedule F1-200 Line 10'). Enables automated mapping of GL balances to FERC regulatory filings.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1 Instructions; FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) 18 CFR Part 101

attributes.name: field_status_group
attributes.description: SAP FI/CO field status group (field FSTAG) assigned to this account, controlling which fields are required, optional, or suppressed during journal entry posting. Ensures data completeness for cost center, profit center, and project assignments on regulated utility accounts.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO T004F Table; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: functional_area_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether postings to this account require a functional area assignment in SAP FI/CO for cost-of-function reporting. Supports FERC Form 1 functional classification between production, transmission, distribution, and customer service.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Functional Area Configuration; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: functional_class
attributes.description: FERC USoA functional classification indicating the utility service function to which the account relates. Drives cost-of-service allocation between electric and gas operations for rate case filings and FERC Form 1 reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: electric_plant|gas_plant|common_plant|general_plant|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) 18 CFR Part 101; State PUC Rate Case Guidelines

attributes.name: gl_account_long_description
attributes.description: Extended narrative description of the general ledger account purpose, scope, and allowable posting types. Supports regulatory filings, auditor inquiries, and rate case cost-of-service documentation.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO SKAT Table; FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) 18 CFR Part 101

attributes.name: gl_account_name
attributes.description: Short descriptive name of the general ledger account as maintained in SAP FI/CO (field TXTKS/TXT50). Used as the human-readable identity label displayed in financial reports, trial balances, and rate case filings.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO SKA1/SKAT Tables; FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA)

attributes.name: gl_account_number
attributes.description: The externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the general ledger account within the SAP FI/CO chart of accounts. Used as the primary business identifier for financial postings, rate case cost-of-service studies, and FERC Form 1 reporting. Typically a 6- to 10-digit numeric string aligned with the FERC Uniform System of Accounts numbering convention.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO SKA1 Table; FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) 18 CFR Part 101

attributes.name: house_bank_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is a bank account managed through SAP FI house bank configuration. When True, the account is linked to a physical bank account for cash management, treasury operations, and bank reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Bank Accounting; FASB ASC 230 Statement of Cash Flows

attributes.name: intercompany_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is used for intercompany transactions between affiliated entities within the utility holding company structure. Intercompany accounts are subject to elimination in consolidated financial statements and FERC affiliate transaction rules.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810 Consolidation; FERC Standards of Conduct 18 CFR Part 358; SAP FI/CO Intercompany Configuration

attributes.name: last_changed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this chart of accounts master record in SAP FI/CO (fields LAEDA/LAEDT). Supports change management auditing, SOX compliance, and incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO SKA1 Table (LAEDA/LAEDT fields); SOX Section 404; NIST SP 800-53 Audit Controls

attributes.name: line_item_display
attributes.description: SAP FI/CO indicator (field XKRES) specifying whether individual line items are stored and displayed for this account. When True, individual journal entry line items are retained for audit trail and detailed account analysis. Required for reconciliation accounts and high-value utility plant accounts.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Account Master Data; SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: normal_balance
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account normally carries a debit or credit balance per double-entry bookkeeping conventions. Used by SAP FI/CO to validate postings and by financial reporting to detect sign anomalies.
attributes.references: GAAP; SAP FI/CO Account Master Data

attributes.name: om_category
attributes.description: Sub-classification of expense accounts into Operations, Maintenance, or Administrative and General (A&G) per FERC USoA conventions. Used in O&M cost tracking, rate case testimony, and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) 18 CFR Part 101; State PUC Rate Case Guidelines

attributes.name: open_item_management
attributes.description: SAP FI/CO indicator (field XOPVW) specifying whether open item management is active for this account. When True, individual postings remain open until cleared by a matching offsetting entry. Used for clearing accounts, suspense accounts, and intercompany accounts.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Account Master Data; GAAP Clearing Account Procedures

attributes.name: plant_function
attributes.description: FERC USoA plant function sub-classification for utility plant accounts (e.g., Steam Production, Nuclear Production, Transmission, Distribution, General). Used in rate base (RAB) calculations and depreciation studies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: steam_production|nuclear_production|hydraulic_production|other_production|transmission|distribution|general — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) 18 CFR Part 101; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: posting_blocked
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether direct financial postings to this account are currently blocked in SAP FI/CO (field XSPEB). When True, the account cannot receive new journal entries until unblocked by an authorized finance administrator.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO SKA1 Table; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: profit_center_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether postings to this account require a profit center assignment in SAP CO. When True, all journal entries must carry a profit center, enabling segment-level P&L reporting for electric vs. gas operations and regulatory ring-fencing.
attributes.references: SAP CO Profit Center Accounting; State PUC Ring-Fencing Requirements

attributes.name: rab_inclusion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account contributes to the Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) used in rate-of-return calculations and ROE determination. RAB-included accounts form the basis for allowed revenue requirement in rate case filings.
attributes.references: FERC Rate of Return Policy; State PUC Rate Case Guidelines; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: rate_case_inclusion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether balances in this account are included in the cost-of-service study for General Rate Case (GRC) or FERC rate case filings. Accounts flagged True are subject to regulatory scrutiny and must be supported by workpapers.
attributes.references: State PUC General Rate Case (GRC) Guidelines; FERC Rate Case Procedures; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: reconciliation_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is a reconciliation account (subledger control account) in SAP FI/CO. Reconciliation accounts aggregate balances from subledgers (AP, AR, asset accounting) and cannot receive direct manual postings.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Account Master Data; GAAP Subledger Reconciliation

attributes.name: reconciliation_account_type
attributes.description: Specifies the subledger type for reconciliation accounts in SAP FI/CO (field MITKZ): accounts receivable, accounts payable, fixed assets, or not applicable for non-reconciliation accounts. Governs which subledger module posts to this control account.

attributes.name: regulatory_asset_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account records a regulatory asset as defined under FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations. Regulatory assets represent costs deferred for future recovery in rates approved by the PUC or FERC. Critical for RAB valuation and rate case filings.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations; FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA); State PUC Orders

attributes.name: regulatory_liability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account records a regulatory liability as defined under FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations. Regulatory liabilities represent obligations to return over-collected revenues or costs to customers through future rate reductions.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations; FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA); State PUC Orders

attributes.name: sort_key
attributes.description: SAP FI/CO sort key (field ZUAWA) that determines the assignment field populated in line items for this account, controlling how line items are sorted and displayed in account statements. Common values include 001 (posting date), 012 (document number).
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO T021S Table; SAP FI/CO Account Master Data

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: SAP FI/CO tax category indicator (field MWSKZ) specifying whether the account is relevant for input tax, output tax, or is tax-exempt. Drives automatic tax determination during financial postings for utility sales tax and use tax compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: input_tax|output_tax|tax_exempt|not_relevant — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Tax Configuration; IRS Tax Code; State PUC Tax Regulations

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: PUC-approved or FERC-approved estimated useful life in years for plant accounts subject to depreciation. Used in straight-line depreciation rate calculations for rate base recovery and FERC Form 1 depreciation schedules.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA); State PUC Depreciation Study Orders; FASB ASC 360

products.name: cost_center
products.description: Organizational cost collection master representing both permanent cost centers (generation plants, T&D districts, corporate functions) and temporary cost collectors (internal orders for maintenance jobs, storm restoration, overhead pools). Supports OPEX allocation, departmental budgeting, overhead cost pooling, storm restoration cost capture, activity-based cost tracking, and cost-of-service studies for rate case filings. Hierarchically organized by cost center group aligned with the utility's organizational structure. Internal orders provide short-term cost collection for activities that do not warrant a full project structure.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the cost center or internal order record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Cost Center Master Data

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.facility. Business justification: Cost centers are assigned to facilities to allocate operating expenses per building or plant.

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.parcel. Business justification: Cost centers are organized by geographic parcels for OPEX reporting and internal cost allocation.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.profit_center

attributes.name: activity_type_code
attributes.description: SAP CO activity type code associated with this cost center, defining the type of work or service output (e.g., labor hours, machine hours, kWh produced). Activity types are used to calculate activity prices and allocate costs to cost objects such as maintenance orders and capital projects.

attributes.name: allocation_basis
attributes.description: The statistical or activity-based basis used to allocate costs from this cost center (e.g., headcount, floor area, kWh consumed, labor hours). Used in overhead cost allocation cycles and cost-of-service studies to distribute shared costs equitably across cost objects and customer classes.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Statistical Key Figures; FERC Cost Allocation Methodology

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: SAP CO allocation method used to distribute costs from this cost center to other cost objects. 'direct' posts costs directly; 'assessment' uses assessment cycles to allocate overhead; 'distribution' reallocates primary costs; 'periodic_reposting' corrects mispostings. Drives month-end cost closing procedures.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Cost Allocation Configuration; Activity-Based Costing (ABC)

attributes.name: annual_opex_budget
attributes.description: Approved annual OPEX budget amount for this cost center in the controlling currency. Represents the authorized spending limit for operations and maintenance activities. Used in budget variance analysis, rate case cost-of-service studies, and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980; FERC Form 1; Internal Budget Management Policy

attributes.name: budget_fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (four-digit integer, e.g., 2025) to which the annual OPEX budget applies. Aligns with the utility's regulatory fiscal year for rate case filings and FERC Form 1 annual reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Fiscal Year Variant; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: SAP Business Area code representing a distinct area of operations for internal balance sheet and P&L reporting. For utilities, commonly used to separate electric, gas, and corporate segments for regulatory reporting and FERC jurisdictional cost separation.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Business Area; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity or regulated subsidiary to which this cost center is assigned. Used for statutory financial reporting, FERC Form 1 filing, and separation of electric vs. gas utility accounts per regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Company Code; FERC Form 1; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: SAP Controlling Area code to which this cost center belongs. The controlling area defines the organizational unit within which cost accounting is performed. For a utility, typically maps to the legal entity or regulated operating company (e.g., electric vs. gas utility segment).
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Controlling Area Configuration; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: cost_center_category
attributes.description: SAP CO cost center category code that controls which activity types and statistical key figures can be posted.
