Common utility categories include E (Energy/Production), F (Field Operations), G (General Administration), V (Service/Overhead). Drives cost allocation rules and activity rate calculations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: E|F|G|V|P|I|H|D — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Cost Center Category Configuration

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The externally-known alphanumeric code assigned to the cost center in SAP CO, used across all financial transactions, journal entries, and cost allocations. Serves as the business identifier referenced in FERC Form 1 reporting and rate case cost-of-service studies.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Cost Center Master; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: cost_center_description
attributes.description: Long-form textual description of the cost center's purpose, scope, and organizational context. Provides additional detail beyond the short name for use in financial reports, rate case documentation, and audit support.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Cost Center Master; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: cost_center_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the cost center (e.g., 'Transmission District 3 Operations', 'Nuclear Generation Plant A', 'Storm Restoration Pool'). Used in financial reports, budget presentations, and rate case filings.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Cost Center Master; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: cost_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost center. 'active' indicates the cost center is open for postings; 'locked' prevents new postings while retaining history; 'closed' indicates the cost center has been decommissioned. Controls whether financial transactions can be posted against this cost center in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Cost Center Master; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: cost_center_type
attributes.description: Classifies whether this record represents a permanent cost center (e.g., generation plant, T&D district, corporate function) or a temporary cost collector such as an internal order for maintenance jobs, storm restoration events, or overhead pools. Drives allocation logic and reporting treatment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: permanent|internal_order|overhead_pool|storm_restoration|project_collector — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Cost Center Category; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost center master record was first created in the source system (SAP CO). Supports audit trail requirements, data lineage tracking, and compliance with NERC CIP and FASB record retention requirements.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Audit Trail; FASB ASC 980; NERC CIP-003

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cost center's controlling currency (e.g., 'USD'). Defines the currency in which budgets, actual costs, and variances are recorded and reported for this cost center.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP FI/CO Controlling Area Currency

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Organizational department code to which this cost center is assigned. Supports departmental budgeting, OPEX tracking, and organizational reporting. Aligns with the utility's organizational chart and workforce management structure.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Organizational Structure; Internal Organizational Chart

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USofA) account code associated with this cost center for regulatory financial reporting. Maps cost center expenditures to the prescribed FERC account structure required for Form 1 filing (e.g., Account 580 for Operation Supervision and Engineering - Transmission).
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts for Public Utilities; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: SAP Functional Area code used to classify costs by business function (e.g., Generation, Transmission, Distribution, Customer Service, Administration) for cost-of-service studies and FERC Form 1 functional reporting requirements.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Functional Area; FERC Form 1 Functional Classification

attributes.name: group_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the cost center group (hierarchy node) to which this cost center belongs in the SAP CO standard hierarchy. Supports hierarchical OPEX reporting, departmental budgeting roll-ups, and organizational cost aggregation for rate case filings.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Cost Center Group / Standard Hierarchy

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level of this cost center within the SAP CO standard hierarchy (e.g., 1=Corporate, 2=Division, 3=Department, 4=Work Group). Supports hierarchical roll-up reporting for OPEX budgeting and rate case cost-of-service studies.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Standard Hierarchy; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: is_capital_project
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center (or internal order) is used as a capital project cost collector for CAPEX tracking. When True, costs are subject to capitalization rules under FASB ASC 360 and are tracked for inclusion in the Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) for rate case filings.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; FASB ASC 980; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: is_regulatory_asset
attributes.description: Indicates whether costs accumulated in this cost center qualify as a regulatory asset under FASB ASC 980 (Regulated Operations). When True, deferred costs are expected to be recovered through future rate cases and are tracked for RAB valuation and ROE calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations; State PUC Rate Case Requirements

attributes.name: is_storm_restoration
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is designated for storm restoration cost capture. When True, costs posted here are tracked separately for regulatory recovery filings with state PUCs, FEMA reimbursement claims, and storm cost deferral accounting under FASB ASC 980.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 Regulatory Assets; State PUC Storm Cost Recovery Filings

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this cost center master record in the source system. Used for change detection in ETL pipelines, audit trail maintenance, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Audit Trail; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Physical location or facility code associated with this cost center (e.g., generation plant site code, substation identifier, district office code). Links cost center to a geographic or facility location for asset management integration and GIS-based cost reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Cost Center Master (Location); Esri ArcGIS GIS Reference

attributes.name: lock_indicator
attributes.description: SAP CO lock indicator controlling which types of postings are permitted. 'locked_actual' prevents actual cost postings; 'locked_plan' prevents planning entries; 'locked_all' blocks all postings. Used during period-end close, audits, and cost center decommissioning.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Cost Center Lock Indicator

attributes.name: overhead_rate
attributes.description: Overhead allocation rate applied to this cost center, expressed as a percentage or fixed amount per activity unit. Used in SAP CO overhead costing sheets to allocate indirect costs (e.g., administrative overhead, facilities costs) to production orders, maintenance orders, and capital projects.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Overhead Costing Sheet; Activity-Based Costing (ABC)

attributes.name: overhead_rate_type
attributes.description: Specifies whether the overhead rate is applied as a percentage of direct costs, a fixed monetary amount, or an activity-based rate per unit of activity (e.g., per labor hour, per kWh generated). Determines the overhead calculation method in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Overhead Costing Sheet Configuration

attributes.name: parent_cost_center_code
attributes.description: Code of the parent cost center in the organizational hierarchy, enabling hierarchical cost roll-up reporting. Supports the construction of cost center trees for budget consolidation, OPEX allocation, and management reporting.

attributes.name: rate_case_classification
attributes.description: Functional classification of this cost center for rate case cost-of-service studies filed with state PUCs or FERC. Determines how costs are allocated across customer classes and rate schedules. Aligns with FERC Uniform System of Accounts functional categories. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: generation|transmission|distribution|gas_distribution|customer_service|administrative|common — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; State PUC General Rate Case (GRC) Requirements; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated name of the cost center used in SAP CO reports, budget line items, and dashboard displays where space is constrained. Typically up to 20 characters per SAP standard.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational source system from which this cost center record was ingested (e.g., 'SAP_CO_PROD', 'SAP_CO_QA'). Supports data lineage, multi-system reconciliation, and Silver Layer provenance tracking in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance Policy; NIST Smart Grid Framework

attributes.name: utility_segment
attributes.description: Identifies whether this cost center belongs to the electric utility segment, gas utility segment, common/shared services, or other. Critical for regulatory cost separation, rate case cost-of-service studies, and FERC jurisdictional reporting. Drives allocation of shared costs between electric and gas rate bases.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; State PUC Rate Case Requirements; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: work_center_code
attributes.description: SAP Work Center code linked to this cost center for activity-based costing. Work centers define the capacity and activity rates used to allocate labor and equipment costs to maintenance orders, production orders, and internal orders. Critical for O&M cost tracking.
attributes.references: SAP PM/PP Work Center; Activity-Based Costing (ABC)

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: The date from which this cost center is valid and open for financial postings in SAP CO. Defines the start of the cost center's active period. Used to enforce time-dependent master data validity and support historical cost reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Cost Center Time-Dependent Master Data

attributes.name: valid_to
attributes.description: The date until which this cost center is valid for financial postings in SAP CO. A far-future date (e.g., 9999-12-31) indicates an open-ended cost center. When set to a past date, the cost center is effectively closed for new postings.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Cost Center Time-Dependent Master Data

products.name: gl_account
products.description: Master repository and control record for all general ledger accounts, encompassing the chart of accounts structure (account classes, groups, FERC USoA alignment), individual account properties (account type, balance sheet/P&L indicator, tax category, reconciliation account flag, posting controls), and period-end account balances by reporting entity. Serves as the foundational reference for all financial postings across SAP FI/CO, financial statement preparation, rate case cost-of-service studies, and FERC Form 1 reporting. Organized by account class (assets, liabilities, equity, revenues, expenses, O&M) aligned with FASB ASC 980 regulated operations classifications.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each general ledger account record in the Power and Utilities chart of accounts. Serves as the primary key for all financial posting references across SAP FI/CO, rate case studies, and FERC Form 1 reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Chart of Accounts; FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: GL Account must reference its Chart of Accounts for proper hierarchy and reporting; replace code with FK.

attributes.name: account_class
attributes.description: Utility-specific classification grouping accounts into functional categories aligned with FERC USoA and FASB ASC 980 regulated operations. Supports rate case cost-of-service studies, RAB valuation, and FERC Form 1 schedule mapping. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: utility_plant|accumulated_depreciation|regulatory_asset|regulatory_liability|current_asset|current_liability|long_term_debt|equity|operating_revenue|om_expense|depreciation_expense|tax_expense — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC USoA 18 CFR Part 101; FASB ASC 980-340; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: account_group
attributes.description: The SAP account group (SKA1-KTOKS) that controls the number range and field selection for the GL account master. Groups accounts by functional area (e.g., electric plant, gas plant, O&M, regulatory assets) to enforce consistent master data governance and number range assignments.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO SKA1; FERC USoA 18 CFR Part 101

attributes.name: account_hierarchy_level
attributes.description: The numeric level of this GL account within the financial statement hierarchy (e.g., 1=total, 2=major class, 3=subclass, 4=individual account). Supports hierarchical financial reporting, drill-down analysis in management dashboards, and structured presentation in FERC Form 1 schedules and rate case exhibits.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Financial Statement Versions; FERC Form 1 Schedule Structure

attributes.name: account_long_name
attributes.description: The full descriptive name of the GL account (SAP SKB1-TXT50). Provides extended context for the account purpose, used in detailed financial reporting, audit documentation, and regulatory filings where full account descriptions are required.

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: The short descriptive name of the GL account as maintained in SAP (SKB1-TXT20). Used in financial statements, trial balance reports, and rate case cost-of-service studies. Provides the human-readable label for the account number.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO SKB1; FERC Form 1 Schedule

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The externally-known alphanumeric account number as defined in the SAP chart of accounts (SKB1-SAKNR). This is the primary business identifier used in all financial postings, journal entries, trial balances, and FERC Form 1 schedules. Typically a 6–10 digit numeric code aligned with the FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA).
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO SKB1; FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) 18 CFR Part 101

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the GL account master record (SAP SKB1 posting block indicators). Determines whether the account is available for financial postings. 'active' permits normal posting; 'blocked' prevents new postings; 'marked_for_deletion' flags the account for archival pending period-end processing.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: The fundamental financial classification of the GL account (SAP SKA1-KTOKS mapped to balance sheet vs. P&L). Determines whether the account represents an asset, liability, equity, revenue, or expense. Drives financial statement presentation, normal balance (debit/credit), and period-end closing behavior. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: asset|liability|equity|revenue|expense|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO SKA1; FASB ASC 980; FERC USoA 18 CFR Part 101

attributes.name: afudc_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is eligible for AFUDC (Allowance for Funds Used During Construction) capitalization. AFUDC represents the cost of debt and equity funds used to finance construction of utility plant. Eligible accounts are typically construction work in progress (CWIP) accounts under FERC Account 107. AFUDC rates are set by FERC and state PUCs.
attributes.references: FERC USoA Account 107; FASB ASC 980-835 AFUDC; FERC Form 1 Schedule

attributes.name: balance_sheet_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Balance Sheet / Profit and Loss (P&L) Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the GL account is a balance sheet account (carries forward period-end balance) or a profit and loss account (closed to retained earnings at fiscal year-end). Drives SAP period-end closing, financial statement version assignment, and FERC Form 1 balance sheet vs. income statement classification.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO SKA1; FASB ASC 230; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: capex_opex_indicator
attributes.description: Classifies the GL account as a capital expenditure (CAPEX) account for asset additions and infrastructure investment, or an operating expenditure (OPEX) account for period costs. Drives rate case cost-of-service classification, RAB inclusion/exclusion, depreciation treatment, and FERC Form 1 plant vs. expense reporting. Critical for IRP financial modeling and regulatory rate base determination.
attributes.references: FERC USoA 18 CFR Part 101; FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; FASB ASC 980; State PUC Rate Case Guidelines

attributes.name: commodity_type
attributes.description: Identifies whether the GL account pertains to electric operations, natural gas operations, both commodities, or is not commodity-specific. Supports jurisdictional separation of electric and gas operations for separate rate case filings, FERC Form 1 vs. FERC Form 2 reporting, and state PUC jurisdictional cost allocation.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1 (Electric); FERC Form 2 (Gas); State PUC Jurisdictional Separation Rules

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The SAP company code (SKB1-BUKRS) representing the legal entity or reporting unit for which this GL account master record is maintained. Supports multi-entity financial reporting, consolidated FERC Form 1 filings, and separate regulatory jurisdictional reporting (electric vs. gas).
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO SKB1; FERC Form 1; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: cost_element_category
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is also defined as a SAP CO cost element and its category (primary cost element for external costs, secondary for internal allocations). Primary cost elements link P&L accounts to CO for cost center accounting, internal orders, and project systems. Critical for O&M cost tracking and CAPEX/OPEX classification in rate cases.
attributes.references: SAP CO-OM; FERC USoA O&M Accounts; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this GL account master record was first created in the system of record (SAP FI/CO). Provides audit trail for chart of accounts governance, SOX Section 404 internal control documentation, and regulatory examination support.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO; SOX Section 404; FERC Audit Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the account currency (SAP SKB1-WAERS). Specifies the currency in which account balances are maintained. For US utility operations, typically USD. Foreign currency accounts may be maintained for international power purchase agreements or cross-border energy trading.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO SKB1; ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: depreciation_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is used to record depreciation expense or accumulated depreciation for utility plant assets. Depreciation accounts are subject to FERC-prescribed depreciation rates, state PUC depreciation studies, and FASB ASC 980 regulatory accounting treatment. Supports depreciation expense tracking for rate case cost-of-service studies.
attributes.references: FERC USoA Accounts 403-404; FASB ASC 360; State PUC Depreciation Studies

attributes.name: ebitda_component
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) Component
attributes.description: Classifies the GL account's contribution to EBITDA calculation by identifying which EBITDA component the account feeds (earnings/operating income, interest expense, income taxes, depreciation, or amortization). Supports management reporting, investor relations disclosures, and credit rating agency financial analysis for the utility.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 230; SEC Regulation G Non-GAAP Financial Measures; EIA Financial Reporting

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this GL account became effective and available for financial postings. Supports temporal validity tracking for chart of accounts changes, regulatory account restructuring, and historical financial analysis. Accounts created during FERC USoA updates or rate case restructuring carry the date of regulatory approval.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO; FERC USoA Change Management; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The date on which this GL account ceases to be effective for new financial postings. Null for currently active accounts. Populated when an account is retired, merged, or replaced as part of chart of accounts restructuring, FERC USoA updates, or regulatory account reclassification.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO; FERC USoA Change Management; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: ferc_account_description
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Description
attributes.description: The official FERC USoA account description corresponding to the mapped FERC account number. Provides regulatory context for the account classification and supports FERC Form 1 schedule preparation and rate case documentation.
attributes.references: FERC USoA 18 CFR Part 101; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: ferc_account_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) Account Number
attributes.description: The FERC Uniform System of Accounts account number to which this GL account maps. Required for FERC Form 1 annual reporting, rate case cost-of-service studies, and regulatory compliance. Enables direct mapping between internal SAP account numbers and FERC-prescribed account classifications (e.g., Account 101 Steam Production Plant, Account 303 Transmission Plant).
attributes.references: FERC USoA 18 CFR Part 101; FERC Form 1 Instructions

attributes.name: field_status_group
attributes.description: The SAP field status group (SKB1-FSTAG) assigned to this GL account, controlling which fields are required, optional, or suppressed during document entry. Enforces data quality and completeness rules for financial postings, ensuring cost center, profit center, and project assignments are captured where required.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO SKB1; SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: financial_statement_item
attributes.description: The SAP financial statement version item code (FSV item) that maps this GL account to a specific line in the published financial statements (balance sheet, income statement, statement of cash flows). Drives automated financial statement generation, SEC filing preparation, and FERC Form 1 schedule population.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Financial Statement Versions; FASB ASC 230; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: The SAP functional area (SKB1-FUNC_AREA) assigned to this GL account for segment reporting and cost-of-service studies. Classifies accounts by business function (e.g., generation, transmission, distribution, customer service, administration) to support FERC Form 1 functional cost allocation and rate case cost-of-service analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: generation|transmission|distribution|customer_service|administration|gas_operations|corporate — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO; FERC Form 1 Functional Classification; FERC USoA 18 CFR Part 101

attributes.name: house_bank_account
attributes.description: The SAP house bank account identifier (SKB1-HBKID/HKTID) linked to this GL account for bank reconciliation purposes. Populated only for bank GL accounts to enable automatic bank statement processing, electronic bank reconciliation, and cash management reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI-TR; FASB ASC 230 Cash Flow Statements

attributes.name: interest_calculation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic interest calculation is activated for this GL account (SAP SKB1-XINTB). Relevant for regulatory asset/liability accounts where carrying costs or AFUDC (Allowance for Funds Used During Construction) interest accruals are computed under FASB ASC 980 and FERC accounting rules.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO SKB1; FASB ASC 980-835; FERC USoA Account 107

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this GL account master record was most recently modified in the system of record (SAP FI/CO). Supports change management tracking, audit trail maintenance, and data lineage for financial reporting integrity under SOX and FERC audit requirements.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO; SOX Section 404; FERC Audit Requirements

attributes.name: line_item_display_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual line item display is activated for this GL account (SAP SKB1-XKRES). When enabled, all individual posting line items are stored and retrievable for detailed audit trail and drill-down analysis. Required for accounts subject to regulatory audit, SOX compliance, and FERC examination.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO SKB1; SOX Section 404; FERC Audit Requirements

attributes.name: normal_balance
attributes.description: The expected normal balance side (debit or credit) for this GL account based on its account type. Assets and expenses carry a normal debit balance; liabilities, equity, and revenues carry a normal credit balance. Used for variance analysis, trial balance validation, and automated anomaly detection in financial postings.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 230; GAAP Double-Entry Accounting Principles

attributes.name: only_balances_in_local_currency_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Balances in Local Currency Only Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account maintains balances only in local (company code) currency (SAP SKB1-XSALH). When true, foreign currency line items are translated to local currency and only the local currency balance is tracked. Relevant for accounts where foreign currency detail is not required for regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO SKB1; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency

attributes.name: open_item_management_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether open item management is activated for this GL account (SAP SKB1-XOPVW). When enabled, individual line items remain open until cleared by an offsetting posting (e.g., payment clearing, goods receipt/invoice receipt clearing). Essential for clearing accounts, suspense accounts, and intercompany accounts.

attributes.name: parent_account_number
attributes.description: The account number of the parent GL account in the chart of accounts hierarchy. Enables hierarchical rollup of account balances for financial statement preparation, management reporting subtotals, and FERC Form 1 schedule aggregations. Null for top-level summary accounts.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Financial Statement Versions; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: planning_block_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether cost planning postings to this GL account are blocked (SAP SKB1-XSPEP). When true, the account is excluded from CO planning activities such as cost center planning, internal order budgeting, and capital project planning. Supports budget governance and CAPEX/OPEX planning controls.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO SKB1; CAPEX/OPEX Planning Governance

attributes.name: plant_function_code
attributes.description: The FERC-defined utility plant function code classifying plant accounts by operational function (e.g., steam production, nuclear production, hydraulic production, transmission, distribution, general plant). Used for FERC Form 1 plant-in-service schedules, depreciation studies, and rate case plant allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: steam_production|nuclear_production|hydraulic_production|other_production|transmission|distribution|general_plant|gas_production|gas_storage|gas_distribution — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC USoA 18 CFR Part 101 Plant Accounts 310-399; FERC Form 1 Pages 204-207

attributes.name: posting_block_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether direct financial postings to this GL account are blocked at the company code level (SAP SKB1-XSPEB). When true, no journal entries or document postings can be made to this account, typically applied during period-end close, account restructuring, or regulatory review periods.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO SKB1; SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: The default SAP profit center (SKB1-PRCTR) assigned to this GL account for segment profitability reporting. Enables automatic profit center derivation during financial postings, supporting electric vs. gas segment reporting, regulatory jurisdictional separation, and management reporting by business unit.
attributes.references: SAP CO-PCA; FERC Jurisdictional Separation; FASB ASC 280 Segment Reporting

attributes.name: reconciliation_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is a reconciliation account (SAP SKA1-XBILK) that is automatically updated by postings to subsidiary ledger accounts (accounts receivable, accounts payable, fixed assets). Reconciliation accounts cannot be posted to directly; they are updated via subledger transactions. Critical for AR/AP and asset accounting integrity.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO SKA1; FASB ASC 310; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: reconciliation_account_type
attributes.description: Specifies the subledger type for reconciliation accounts (SAP SKA1-MITKZ). Identifies whether the reconciliation account is linked to accounts receivable (customers), accounts payable (vendors), or fixed assets. Only populated when reconciliation_account_flag is true.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO SKA1; FASB ASC 310; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: regulatory_asset_liability_type
attributes.description: Classifies the GL account as a regulatory asset, regulatory liability, or not applicable under FASB ASC 980 regulated operations accounting. Regulatory assets represent costs deferred for future recovery in rates (e.g., storm restoration costs, deferred fuel costs). Regulatory liabilities represent obligations to return amounts to customers through future rates (e.g., excess deferred income taxes, over-collected fuel costs). Critical for RAB valuation and rate case filings.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980-340 Regulatory Assets and Liabilities; FERC USoA; State PUC Rate Case Requirements

attributes.name: roe_component_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is included in the Return on Equity (ROE) calculation used in rate case proceedings. ROE-relevant accounts include equity components of the capital structure, net income accounts, and rate base accounts. Supports FERC and state PUC rate of return analysis and allowed ROE determination.
attributes.references: FERC Rate Case ROE Methodology; State PUC Rate Case Guidelines; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: sort_key
attributes.description: The SAP sort key (SKB1-ZUAWA) that determines the assignment field populated in line items posted to this account. Controls how line items are sorted and displayed in account balance reports. Common sort keys include document date (001), posting date (002), and external document number (012).

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: The SAP tax category (SKB1-MWSKZ) assigned to the GL account, controlling whether tax codes are required, optional, or not allowed on postings to this account. Relevant for sales tax, use tax, and excise tax compliance on utility revenues and purchases. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: input_tax_required|output_tax_required|tax_optional|no_tax|not_applicable — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO SKB1; IRS Tax Code; State PUC Tax Regulations

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: Complete general ledger journal entry record including header and line-item detail for all financial postings — manual journal entries, system-generated postings from billing/procurement/payroll, accruals, reversals, and period-end closing entries. Header captures posting date, fiscal period, document type, company code, and originating transaction reference. Each line item specifies the GL account, cost center, profit center, WBS element, debit/credit amount in transaction and local currency, tax code, and assignment field. Provides the atomic-level audit trail for all financial postings required for FERC Form 1 and regulatory cost-of-service studies.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each journal entry record in the general ledger. Serves as the primary key for the journal_entry data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Document Model; FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Journal Entry records belong to a single GL Account, Cost Center, Profit Center, WBS Element and Internal Order. Converting string codes to proper FK enforces referential integrity and eliminates redu

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: The chart of accounts GL account number to which this journal entry line item is posted. Aligned with the FERC Uniform System of Accounts (e.g., Account 101 for Electric Plant in Service, Account 403 for Depreciation Expense). Corresponds to BSEG-HKONT in SAP.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts 18 CFR Part 101; SAP FI/CO Chart of Accounts; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: Journal Entry records belong to a single GL Account, Cost Center, Profit Center, WBS Element and Internal Order. Converting string codes to proper FK enforces referential integrity and eliminates redu

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Journal Entry records belong to a single GL Account, Cost Center, Profit Center, WBS Element and Internal Order. Converting string codes to proper FK enforces referential integrity and eliminates redu

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Journal Entry records belong to a single GL Account, Cost Center, Profit Center, WBS Element and Internal Order. Converting string codes to proper FK enforces referential integrity and eliminates redu

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: SAP account type indicator for the line item: A=Asset, D=Customer (Debtor), K=Vendor (Creditor), M=Material, S=General Ledger. Determines which sub-ledger the posting affects and is used for balance sheet classification in FERC Form 1 reporting. Corresponds to BSEG-KOART in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Account Type Configuration; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; FASB ASC 210

attributes.name: accrual_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the journal entry is an accrual posting (estimated expense or revenue recognized before cash settlement). True for period-end accruals such as unbilled revenue, fuel cost accruals, and O&M expense accruals. Supports accrual reversal tracking.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 420 Accruals; SAP FI/CO Accrual Engine; FERC Form 1 Accrued Liabilities

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the journal entry was approved through the SAP workflow process. Provides the approval audit trail required for SOX Section 404 internal controls and external audit documentation.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Workflow; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: approved_by_user
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the approver who authorized the journal entry through the workflow approval process. Required for SOX Section 404 segregation of duties controls, particularly for manual journal entries above materiality thresholds.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Workflow; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; PCAOB Auditing Standards

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: SAP Asset Accounting (FI-AA) asset number for journal entries related to fixed asset acquisitions, retirements, depreciation, or transfers. Links GL postings to the RAB (Regulatory Asset Base) for rate case and FERC Form 1 plant-in-service reporting. Corresponds to BSEG-ANLN1 in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Accounting; FERC Form 1 Electric Plant Accounts; FASB ASC 360 Property Plant Equipment; ISO 55000

attributes.name: assignment_field
attributes.description: Free-form assignment field used to carry cross-reference information such as billing document number, meter reading order, payment reference, or asset number. Enables drill-through from GL postings to originating operational transactions. Corresponds to BSEG-ZUONR in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO BSEG Table; FERC Form 1 Cross-Reference; Oracle CC&B Integration

attributes.name: capex_opex_indicator
attributes.description: Classifies the journal entry as a capital expenditure (CAPEX) or operating expenditure (OPEX). CAPEX entries are capitalized to plant accounts and included in the RAB; OPEX entries flow through the income statement. Critical for rate case cost-of-service studies and IRP financial modeling.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; FASB ASC 360 Property Plant Equipment; PUC Rate Case CAPEX/OPEX Classification; IRP Filing Standards

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity or organizational unit for which the journal entry is posted. Used to segregate financial postings by regulated entity for FERC Form 1 and state PUC rate case filings. Corresponds to BKPF-BUKRS in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Organizational Structure; FERC Uniform System of Accounts 18 CFR Part 101

attributes.name: debit_credit_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the journal entry line item is a debit (D) or credit (C) posting. Fundamental to double-entry bookkeeping and GL balance verification. Corresponds to BSEG-SHKZG in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO BSEG Table; GAAP Double-Entry Accounting; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: depreciation_area
attributes.description: SAP FI-AA depreciation area code indicating the valuation basis for asset-related journal entries (e.g., 01=Book Depreciation, 15=Tax Depreciation, 20=FERC Regulatory Depreciation). Supports parallel valuation for GAAP, tax, and regulatory reporting. Corresponds to BSEG-BZDAT area in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Depreciation Areas; FERC Form 1 Depreciation Schedules; FASB ASC 980; IRS MACRS

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date of the originating source document (invoice date, contract date, payroll date, etc.) that triggered the journal entry. May differ from posting_date for accruals and late postings. Corresponds to BKPF-BLDAT in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO BKPF Table; GAAP ASC 420; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known SAP FI document number assigned to the journal entry at posting time. Serves as the primary business identifier for the posting document, used in audit trails, FERC Form 1 reconciliation, and regulatory cost-of-service studies. Corresponds to BKPF-BELNR in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO BKPF Table; FERC Form 1 Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: SAP FI document type code that classifies the nature of the journal entry (e.g., SA=General Ledger, KR=Vendor Invoice, DR=Customer Invoice, AB=Accounting Document, ZP=Payment Posting, AA=Asset Posting). Drives number range assignment and account type determination. Corresponds to BKPF-BLART in SAP. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SA|KR|DR|AB|ZP|AA|RE|RV|WA|WE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Document Type Configuration; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: entered_by_user
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person or system process that created the journal entry. Required for SOX Section 404 internal controls, segregation of duties monitoring, and audit trail documentation. Corresponds to BKPF-USNAM in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO BKPF Table; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; NERC CIP-004 Personnel Security

attributes.name: entry_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the journal entry in the general ledger workflow. 'posted' = fully committed to GL; 'parked' = saved but not yet posted (BKPF-XBLNR workflow); 'held' = incomplete entry; 'reversed' = offset entry created; 'simulated' = test posting not committed.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Document Lifecycle; FASB ASC 250; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: entry_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the journal entry record was created in the SAP FI system. Provides the audit trail creation timestamp for SOX compliance and internal controls. Corresponds to BKPF-CPUDT and BKPF-CPUTM in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO BKPF Table; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; FERC CIP Standards

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts account code mapped to the GL account for this journal entry line item. Required for FERC Form 1 annual report filing and regulatory cost-of-service studies. Examples: 101 (Electric Plant in Service), 403 (Depreciation Expense), 500 (Operation Expense). Distinct from the internal GL account.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts 18 CFR Part 101; FERC Form 1 Annual Report; DOE EIA Reporting

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (1–16) within the fiscal year in which the journal entry is posted. Periods 1–12 represent calendar months; periods 13–16 are special closing periods used for year-end adjustments and audit corrections. Corresponds to BKPF-MONAT in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Period Management; FERC Form 1; FASB ASC 250 Accounting Changes

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the journal entry is recorded. Used for annual financial close, FERC Form 1 annual reporting, and regulatory rate case cost-of-service period alignment. Corresponds to BKPF-GJAHR in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Fiscal Year Variant; FERC Form 1 Annual Report; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: SAP CO functional area classifying the expense by business function (e.g., Generation, Transmission, Distribution, Customer Service, Administration) for FERC Form 1 functional cost reporting and regulatory cost-of-service studies. Corresponds to BSEG-FKBER in SAP.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1 Functional Classification; SAP CO Functional Area; FERC 18 CFR Part 101

attributes.name: header_text
attributes.description: Free-text description at the journal entry header level explaining the business purpose of the posting (e.g., 'Q3 Fuel Cost Accrual', 'Storm Restoration Capitalization', 'FERC Account 403 Depreciation Run'). Supports audit review and regulatory cost-of-service documentation. Corresponds to BKPF-BKTXT in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO BKPF Table; SOX Section 404 Documentation; FERC Form 1 Narrative

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the journal entry involves a transaction between affiliated entities within the utility holding company. True triggers intercompany elimination processing in consolidated reporting and FERC affiliate transaction disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: FERC Standards of Conduct 18 CFR Part 358; FASB ASC 810; SAP FI/CO Intercompany Processing

attributes.name: last_changed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the journal entry record was last modified in the source SAP FI system. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Change Document; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404

attributes.name: line_item_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the journal entry document, starting at 1. Uniquely identifies each debit or credit posting line within a multi-line journal entry. Corresponds to BSEG-BUZEI in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO BSEG Table; FERC Form 1 Line Item Detail

attributes.name: line_item_text
attributes.description: Free-text description at the journal entry line item level providing additional detail about the specific debit or credit posting (e.g., 'Transmission line maintenance labor', 'Nuclear fuel amortization'). Supports granular audit trail and FERC cost-of-service line item documentation. Corresponds to BSEG-SGTXT in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO BSEG Table; FERC Form 1 Line Item Detail; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: local_currency_amount
attributes.description: The journal entry line item amount converted to the company code local currency (typically USD). Used for consolidated financial reporting, EBITDA calculation, and FERC Form 1 reporting where all amounts must be in USD. Corresponds to BSEG-DMBTR in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO BSEG Table; FERC Form 1; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the company code local currency (typically USD for US utilities). Used when transaction currency differs from local currency to support multi-currency financial reporting. Corresponds to BKPF-HWAER in SAP.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP FI/CO Company Code Currency; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry is posted to the general ledger. Determines the fiscal period assignment and is the principal real-world event date for the financial transaction. Used for period-end close, accrual cutoff, and regulatory reporting. Corresponds to BKPF-BUDAT in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO BKPF Table; GAAP ASC 250; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: SAP two-digit posting key that determines the account type, debit/credit indicator, and field selection for the line item (e.g., 40=GL Debit, 50=GL Credit, 01=Customer Invoice, 31=Vendor Invoice). Drives the accounting logic for each line. Corresponds to BSEG-BSCHL in SAP. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 01|31|40|50|70|75|80|90 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Posting Key Configuration; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: recurring_entry_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the journal entry was generated from a SAP recurring entry template (FBD1). True for fixed monthly postings such as lease payments, depreciation runs, and regulatory amortization entries. Supports automated posting audit trails.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Recurring Entry Processing; FASB ASC 840 Leases; FERC Regulatory Amortization

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference number from the originating source system (e.g., Oracle CC&B billing document number, Maximo work order number, Allegro trade confirmation number, SAP MM purchase order number). Provides the cross-system audit trail for the journal entry. Corresponds to BKPF-XBLNR in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO BKPF Table; Oracle CC&B Integration; Maximo EAM Integration; Allegro ETRM Integration

attributes.name: regulatory_asset_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the journal entry relates to a FASB ASC 980 regulatory asset or regulatory liability. True for deferred costs or revenues that are recoverable through future rate cases (e.g., storm restoration costs, deferred fuel costs, pension regulatory assets). Critical for RAB valuation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations; FERC Form 1 Regulatory Assets Schedule; State PUC Rate Case

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry is a reversal of a previously posted document. True when the entry was created via the SAP reversal transaction (FB08/FBR2). Used to identify offsetting entries in audit trails and period-end reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Reversal Processing; GAAP ASC 250 Error Corrections

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: SAP-defined reason code explaining why the journal entry was reversed (e.g., 01=Reversal in current period, 02=Reversal in prior period, 03=Accrual reversal). Required for audit documentation and SOX internal controls. Corresponds to BKPF-STGRD in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Reversal Reason Configuration; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The original SAP FI document number that this entry reverses, if reversal_indicator is True. Enables traceability between reversal entries and their originating documents for audit and regulatory cost-of-service studies. Corresponds to BKPF-STBLG in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO BKPF Table; SOX Section 404; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: source_transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the originating business process that generated the journal entry. Enables segregation of manual entries from system-generated postings for SOX controls, and supports FERC Form 1 functional cost analysis by transaction origin. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: manual|billing|procurement|payroll|asset|accrual|reversal|period_close|intercompany|energy_trading — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Document Origin; SOX Section 404 Manual Journal Entry Controls; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: special_gl_indicator
attributes.description: SAP special GL indicator for down payments, guarantees, bills of exchange, or regulatory asset/liability postings (e.g., A=Down Payment, E=Security Deposit, F=Regulatory Asset). Critical for FASB ASC 980 regulatory asset and liability accounting. Corresponds to BSEG-UMSKZ in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Special GL Configuration; FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax amount in local currency associated with the journal entry line item. Supports tax liability reporting, regulatory tax normalization adjustments in rate cases, and FERC Form 1 tax expense schedules. Corresponds to BSEG-WMWST in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Tax Reporting; FERC Form 1 Schedule; IRS Tax Reporting; State PUC Rate Case

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: SAP tax code identifying the applicable tax condition (e.g., sales tax, use tax, excise tax) for the journal entry line item. Used for tax reporting, regulatory surcharge tracking, and state PUC tax normalization in rate cases. Corresponds to BSEG-MWSKZ in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Tax Configuration; IRS Tax Code; State PUC Tax Normalization Rules

attributes.name: trading_partner
attributes.description: SAP trading partner company code for intercompany journal entries between affiliated entities within the utility holding company structure. Used for intercompany elimination in consolidated financial statements and FERC affiliate transaction reporting. Corresponds to BSEG-VBUND in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Intercompany Configuration; FERC Standards of Conduct; FASB ASC 810 Consolidation

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: The gross monetary amount of the journal entry line item in the transaction currency. Represents the raw financial value before any local currency conversion. Positive for debits, negative for credits per SAP sign convention. Corresponds to BSEG-WRBTR in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO BSEG Table; FERC Form 1; FASB ASC 980 Regulatory Assets

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the original transaction currency in which the journal entry amount was recorded (e.g., USD for US Dollar). Used for multi-currency postings involving PPAs, energy trading, or international vendor transactions. Corresponds to BKPF-WAERS in SAP.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP FI/CO Currency Configuration; FERC Form 1

products.name: journal_entry_line
products.description: Individual debit and credit line items within a SAP FI journal entry, each specifying the GL account, cost center, profit center, WBS element, amount in transaction and local currency, tax code, and assignment field. Provides the atomic-level audit trail for all financial postings required for FERC Form 1 and regulatory cost-of-service studies.

attributes.name: journal_entry_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual debit or credit line item within a SAP FI journal entry. Serves as the primary key for this atomic-level financial posting record in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module; FASB ASC 980; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Surrogate identifier referencing the SAP CO cost center responsible for this financial posting. Used for departmental cost allocation, Operations and Maintenance (O&M) tracking, and rate case cost-of-service studies.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module; FERC Form 1; GRC Cost-of-Service Study

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Surrogate identifier referencing the General Ledger account (chart of accounts entry) to which this line item is posted. Drives FERC Form 1 account mapping and regulatory cost-of-service classification.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Module; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Surrogate identifier referencing the SAP CO internal order used for collecting costs on specific jobs, maintenance activities, or short-term projects not managed via WBS. Supports Operations and Maintenance (O&M) cost tracking and Maximo work order integration.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module; Maximo EAM Integration

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Surrogate identifier referencing the parent journal entry header (TRANSACTION_HEADER) to which this line item belongs. Establishes the header-detail relationship for all debit/credit line items within a single SAP FI posting document.

attributes.name: trade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trading.trade. Business justification: Required for Trade Accounting Reconciliation Report linking each journal entry line to its originating trade for audit and financial reporting.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Surrogate identifier referencing the SAP PS Work Breakdown Structure element for capital project cost tracking. Supports Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) project accounting, asset capitalization, and Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) valuation.
attributes.references: SAP PS/CO Module; FASB ASC 360; FERC Form 1 Plant Accounts

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: SAP FI account type (KOART) indicating the subledger category: A=Asset, D=Customer (Debtor), K=Vendor (Creditor), M=Material, S=General Ledger. Drives subledger reconciliation and FERC account classification.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: SAP Asset Accounting asset number (ANLN1) for line items related to fixed asset transactions such as acquisitions, retirements, depreciation, and transfers. Supports Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) valuation and FERC Form 1 utility plant account reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Module; FASB ASC 360; FERC Form 1 Plant Accounts; ISO 55000

attributes.name: asset_subnumber
attributes.description: SAP Asset Accounting asset sub-number (ANLN2) identifying a specific component or sub-asset within the main asset record. Used for component-level depreciation tracking and capital project asset capitalization under FASB ASC 360.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Module; FASB ASC 360; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: assignment
attributes.description: SAP FI assignment field (ZUONR) used for sorting and grouping line items in account statements and open item management. Typically populated with a reference number such as a meter number, work order number, or billing document number for cross-system traceability.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module; FERC Form 1 Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: The baseline date (ZFBDT) used for payment terms calculation on vendor and customer line items. Determines due dates for accounts payable and accounts receivable aging analysis and cash flow forecasting.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: SAP FI business area (GSBER) representing an organizational unit for which balance sheets and P&L statements can be drawn up independently. Used for segment reporting across Electric, Gas, and other utility business lines per FASB ASC 280.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module; FASB ASC 280 Segment Reporting

attributes.name: capex_opex_indicator
attributes.description: Classifies this line item as a Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) or Operating Expenditure (OPEX) posting. Critical for rate case cost-of-service studies, Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) valuation, FERC Form 1 plant account reporting, and EBITDA calculation.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; FASB ASC 360; GRC Cost-of-Service Study; IRP Financial Analysis

attributes.name: changed_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this journal entry line item in SAP FI. Supports change data capture (CDC) for the Databricks Silver Layer ingestion pipeline and SOX Section 404 change audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module; SOX Section 404; NIST SP 800-92 Log Management

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date (AUGDT) on which this open line item was cleared (matched against a payment or offsetting entry) in SAP FI. Null for uncleared items. Used for accounts payable/receivable reconciliation and cash application tracking.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP FI document number (AUGBL) of the clearing transaction that offset this open item. Links payment documents to original invoices or debit memos for accounts payable/receivable reconciliation and audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module; FASB ASC 230; FERC Form 1 Audit Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this journal entry line item record was first created in the SAP FI system. Provides the audit trail creation timestamp required for SOX Section 404 internal controls and FERC audit documentation.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module; SOX Section 404; FERC Audit Requirements

attributes.name: debit_credit_indicator
attributes.description: SAP FI debit/credit indicator (SHKZG) specifying whether this line item is a debit (D) or credit (C) posting. Fundamental to double-entry bookkeeping and ensures balanced journal entries for FERC Form 1 and FASB compliance.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module; FASB ASC 230; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The original document date (BLDAT) of the source business transaction, such as the invoice date or contract date. May differ from the posting date and is used for aging analysis, payment terms, and audit trail documentation.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module; FASB ASC 450; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: dunning_block
attributes.description: SAP FI dunning block indicator (MANSP) that prevents automated dunning (payment reminder) notices for this line item. Used for disputed invoices, regulatory-ordered payment holds, or items under PUC complaint review.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module; State PUC Customer Protection Regulations

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: The FERC Uniform System of Accounts code mapped to this GL line item, used for FERC Form 1 annual report filing. Classifies utility plant, operating revenues, operating expenses, and other accounts per FERC regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101); FERC Form 1

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The SAP fiscal period (MONAT) within the fiscal year, typically 1–12 for monthly periods plus special periods 13–16 for year-end adjustments. Drives monthly financial close and period-over-period variance reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The SAP fiscal year (GJAHR) in which this journal entry line is posted. Used for annual financial close, FERC Form 1 annual reporting, and year-over-year budget variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module; FERC Form 1; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: SAP CO functional area (FKBER) classifying the business function of this posting, such as Generation, Transmission, Distribution, Customer Service, or Administration. Supports cost-of-service studies and FERC Form 1 functional classification of expenses.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module; FERC Form 1; GRC Cost-of-Service Study

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this line item represents an intercompany transaction between affiliated entities within the utility holding company structure (True). Required for intercompany elimination in consolidated financial statements and FERC Form 1 affiliated transaction disclosure.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module; FASB ASC 810 Consolidation; FERC Form 1 Affiliated Transactions

attributes.name: line_item_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number (BUZEI) within the parent journal entry document, ordering debit and credit postings. Ensures the complete audit trail of all line items within a single SAP FI posting document.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module; FERC Form 1 Audit Requirements

attributes.name: line_item_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of this journal entry line item in the financial workflow. 'open' indicates an uncleared item; 'cleared' indicates matched/settled; 'parked' indicates a provisional posting pending approval; 'reversed' indicates a correcting reversal; 'in_dispute' indicates a contested amount under review.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module; SOX Section 404; FERC Audit Requirements

attributes.name: line_item_text
attributes.description: Free-text description (SGTXT) entered at the line item level in SAP FI, providing narrative context for the posting such as 'Monthly depreciation - Transmission Lines' or 'PPA settlement - Wind Farm Q1'. Supports audit trail and FERC Form 1 explanatory notes.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module; FERC Form 1; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: local_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount of this line item translated into the company code local currency (DMBTR), typically USD for US utility operations. Used for consolidated financial reporting, FERC Form 1, and FASB ASC 980 regulatory accounting.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module; FASB ASC 830; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: local_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the company code local currency (HWAER), typically USD. Distinguishes local currency amounts from transaction currency amounts in multi-currency SAP environments.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP FI Module; FASB ASC 830

attributes.name: payment_block
attributes.description: SAP FI payment block indicator (ZLSPR) that prevents automated payment processing for this line item. Used for invoice verification holds, disputed vendor payments, or regulatory compliance holds pending PUC or FERC review.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module; SOX Section 404; FERC Audit Requirements

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: SAP FI payment terms key (ZTERM) applicable to this line item for vendor or customer accounts, defining due dates and early payment discount conditions. Used for cash flow forecasting and accounts payable/receivable management.

attributes.name: plant
attributes.description: SAP logistics plant code (WERKS) associated with this line item, representing a generation facility, service center, or operational location. Links financial postings to physical utility infrastructure for asset accounting and FERC plant account reporting.
attributes.references: SAP MM/PM Module; FERC Form 1 Utility Plant Accounts; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The SAP FI posting date (BUDAT) on which this line item is recorded in the General Ledger. Determines the fiscal period assignment and is the primary date for period-end close, FERC Form 1 reporting, and FASB ASC 980 regulatory accounting.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module; FERC Form 1; FASB ASC 980; FASB ASC 250

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: SAP FI posting key (BSCHL) that determines the debit/credit indicator, account type, and field selection for this line item. Standard values include 40 (GL debit), 50 (GL credit), 01 (customer invoice), 31 (vendor invoice), etc. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 01|11|21|31|40|50|70|75|80|90 — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: Surrogate identifier referencing the SAP CO profit center associated with this line item. Enables segment-level profitability reporting across business units such as Electric Distribution, Gas Distribution, and Generation.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module; FASB ASC 280 Segment Reporting

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity (MENGE) associated with this line item, representing physical units such as kWh, MWh, MCF, or Therms for energy commodity postings. Supports energy volume reconciliation between financial postings and operational metering data.
attributes.references: SAP FI/MM Module; EIA Reporting; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference document number (XBLNR) from the source transaction, such as a vendor invoice number, purchase order number, or billing document number. Enables cross-system traceability between SAP FI and source systems like Oracle CC&B, Maximo, or Allegro ETRM.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module; FERC Form 1 Audit Trail; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: regulatory_asset_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this line item relates to a FASB ASC 980 regulatory asset or regulatory liability (True) as approved by a state PUC or FERC rate order. Regulatory assets represent costs deferred for future recovery in customer rates; regulatory liabilities represent obligations to refund customers.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations; FERC Form 1; State PUC Rate Orders

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this line item is part of a reversal posting (True) or an original posting (False). Reversal postings are used to correct erroneous entries and are required to be disclosed in FERC Form 1 audit trails and SOX Section 404 internal controls documentation.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module; SOX Section 404; FERC Form 1 Audit Trail

attributes.name: second_local_amount
attributes.description: Amount in the SAP company code second local currency (parallel currency), used for group reporting or regulatory reporting in a secondary currency. Supports consolidated EBITDA and Return on Equity (ROE) calculations at the enterprise level.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module; FASB ASC 830; SEC Reporting

attributes.name: special_gl_indicator
attributes.description: SAP FI special GL indicator (UMSKZ) for down payments, guarantees, bills of exchange, or other special transactions that post to alternative reconciliation accounts. Used for regulatory asset/liability tracking under FASB ASC 980.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module; FASB ASC 980 Regulatory Assets and Liabilities

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax amount (WMWST) associated with this journal entry line item in transaction currency. Captures sales/use tax, excise tax, or other tax components posted to the GL for regulatory and tax compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module; IRS Tax Code; State PUC Tax Regulations

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: SAP FI tax code (MWSKZ) assigned to this line item, determining the applicable tax rate and tax account determination. Used for sales/use tax compliance, state PUC tax filings, and IRS reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module; IRS Publication 535; State PUC Tax Regulations

attributes.name: trading_partner
attributes.description: SAP FI trading partner company code (VBUND) identifying the affiliated entity in intercompany transactions. Required for intercompany elimination in consolidated financial statements and FERC Form 1 intercompany transaction disclosure.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module; FASB ASC 810 Consolidation; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount of this line item in the transaction currency (WRBTR) as posted in SAP FI. Represents the raw debit or credit value before currency translation. Positive value; sign determined by debit_credit_indicator.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: transaction_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction currency (WAERS) of this line item, e.g., USD. Required for multi-currency postings such as Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) settlements or international energy trading transactions.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP FI Module; FASB ASC 830

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure (MEINS) for the quantity field, using SAP internal unit codes. Energy-specific values include KWH (Kilowatt-Hour), MWH (Megawatt-Hour), MCF (Thousand Cubic Feet), and THERM for gas and electric commodity postings. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KWH|MWH|MCF|THERM|MW|KW|M3|GAL|BBL|EA|HR — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP MM Module; EIA Reporting Standards; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The value date (VALUT) for this line item, representing the date on which the financial transaction takes economic effect for cash management and liquidity planning purposes. Relevant for energy trading settlements and Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) payments.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module; FASB ASC 230 Cash Flow Statements

products.name: finance_capex_project
products.description: SAP PS/IM capital expenditure project master representing individual capital investment projects (e.g., substation upgrades, AMI deployment, pipeline replacement) including their hierarchical Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) elements for granular cost tracking. Tracks project authorization, CAPEX budget, actual spend by WBS element, AFUDC (Allowance for Funds Used During Construction) accruals, and in-service date for asset capitalization. WBS elements map to specific scopes of work and accumulate costs that settle to fixed assets upon project completion. Supports CPCN filings and IRP capital planning.
products.reference: SAP PS Project / IM Investment Program

attributes.name: finance_capex_project_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the capital expenditure project record in the finance lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: SAP PS/IM Module; FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations

attributes.name: asset_capex_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent project definition entity, linking this CAPEX project record to its master project record in the project hierarchy.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the responsible cost center that owns and is accountable for this capital project's expenditures, used for cost allocation and reporting.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Cost Center Accounting (CCA); FERC Form 1 Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.parcel. Business justification: Capital projects (e.g., substation build) must be linked to the land parcel they occupy for regulatory reporting and project budgeting.

attributes.name: tech_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to technology.tech_project. Business justification: Capital project financial tracking must be linked to the corresponding technology project for integrated reporting and project governance.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the specific Work Breakdown Structure element within the project hierarchy that this cost record is associated with, enabling granular cost tracking by scope of work.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — WBS Element (PRPS); PMI PMBOK WBS Standard

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which all project work was completed. Null until project is physically complete. Used for schedule variance analysis and triggers the capitalization/in-service process.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — Actual Dates; PMI PMBOK; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: actual_spend_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative actual costs incurred and posted to the project to date, in USD. Sourced from SAP PS actual cost postings (COSP). Used for budget variance analysis and FERC Form 1 CWIP reporting.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — Actual Costs (COSP); FERC Form 1 Account 107 CWIP; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which construction or project execution activities commenced. Used for schedule variance analysis and AFUDC accrual start. Null until project activities begin.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — Actual Dates; PMI PMBOK; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: afudc_accrual_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC) Accrual Amount
attributes.description: Cumulative Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC) accrued on this project to date, in USD. AFUDC capitalizes the cost of debt and equity financing during the construction period, increasing the project's capitalized cost and rate base. Governed by FERC regulations and FASB ASC 980-835.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts Accounts 419/432 AFUDC; FASB ASC 980-835-25; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: afudc_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC) Rate
attributes.description: The AFUDC capitalization rate applied to this project, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.075000 = 7.5%). Set annually by the utility's regulatory accounting team per FERC guidelines and approved in rate cases. Used to calculate AFUDC accruals on CWIP balances.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; FASB ASC 980-835; FERC Form 1; State PUC Rate Case

attributes.name: approved_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total authorized CAPEX budget for the project as approved by the capital budgeting committee, in USD. Represents the spending ceiling for the project. Corresponds to SAP IM Appropriation Request approved budget value.
attributes.references: SAP IM Module — Appropriation Request Budget; FASB ASC 360; FERC Form 1; Internal Capital Authorization Policy

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: FERC/regulatory asset class to which the completed project will be capitalized upon in-service (e.g., 'Electric Plant in Service', 'Gas Plant in Service', 'Intangible Plant', 'Construction Work in Progress'). Drives depreciation rates and rate base inclusion. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: electric_plant_in_service|gas_plant_in_service|intangible_plant|cwip|general_plant|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101); FASB ASC 980-360; SAP Asset Accounting (AA) Asset Class

attributes.name: authorization_date
attributes.description: Date on which the capital project received formal management or board authorization to proceed. Marks the transition from proposed to authorized status and enables CAPEX commitment in SAP IM.
attributes.references: SAP IM Module — Appropriation Request Approval; Internal Capital Authorization Policy; State PUC GRC

attributes.name: authorization_number
attributes.description: Formal capital authorization or Appropriation Request (AR) number issued by the capital budgeting committee or board upon project approval. Required for CAPEX commitment and spend initiation in SAP IM.
attributes.references: SAP IM Module — Appropriation Request (IMPR); Internal Capital Authorization Policy; State PUC CPCN

attributes.name: budget_fiscal_year
attributes.description: The primary fiscal year in which this capital project's budget was authorized and is being tracked. Multi-year projects may span multiple fiscal years; this field identifies the originating or primary budget year for capital planning and annual reporting.
attributes.references: SAP IM Module — Investment Program Fiscal Year; Internal Capital Budgeting Process; FERC Form 1 Annual Report

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: Date on which project costs were settled from the SAP PS project to fixed assets in SAP Asset Accounting (AA), creating the asset under construction (AuC) or final asset records. May differ from in_service_date due to accounting close cycles.
attributes.references: SAP PS/AA Module — Settlement (CJ88); FASB ASC 360; FERC Form 1 Account 101
