attributes.name: capitalized_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost amount settled and capitalized to fixed assets upon project completion, in USD. Includes all direct project costs plus AFUDC accruals. Represents the initial carrying value of the resulting fixed assets on the balance sheet.
attributes.references: SAP PS/AA Module — Settlement (CJ88); FASB ASC 360; FERC Form 1 Account 101; State PUC Rate Base

attributes.name: committed_amount
attributes.description: Total value of open purchase orders and contracts committed against this project but not yet invoiced or posted as actual costs, in USD. Sourced from SAP MM commitment management. Committed + Actual = Total Exposure.
attributes.references: SAP PS/MM Module — Commitment Management (COOI); Internal CAPEX Governance Policy

attributes.name: cpcn_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity (CPCN) Number
attributes.description: Regulatory certificate number issued by the State Public Utility Commission (PUC) authorizing construction of major utility infrastructure. Required for large capital projects above regulatory thresholds. Null if project does not require CPCN.
attributes.references: State PUC CPCN Filing Requirements; FERC Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity (18 CFR Part 157)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capital project record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Sourced from SAP PS project creation date/time. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — Project Creation Date; FASB ASC 980 Audit Requirements; NERC CIP-007 Audit Logging

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this project record (e.g., 'USD'). Power and Utilities operates primarily in USD; this field supports multi-currency reporting for international projects or PPAs.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP FI Currency Configuration; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: estimated_useful_life_years
attributes.description: Estimated useful life of the resulting capital assets in years, used to determine depreciation rates and rate base amortization schedules. Set per FERC depreciation study and state PUC-approved depreciation rates.
attributes.references: FERC Depreciation Study; FASB ASC 360-10-35; State PUC Approved Depreciation Rates; SAP AA Asset Life

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts account code to which the completed project assets will be classified upon capitalization (e.g., '353' for Station Equipment, '376' for Distribution Mains). Required for FERC Form 1 reporting and rate base determination.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101); FERC Form 1; SAP FI-AA Asset Class to FERC Account Mapping

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic service territory or region where the capital project is physically located or will deliver service (e.g., 'Northeast District', 'Western Transmission Zone'). Used for regional capital planning and regulatory jurisdiction assignment.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS GIS Service Territory; State PUC Service Territory Definition; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: in_service_date
attributes.description: Date on which the completed capital project assets were formally placed in service and transferred from Construction Work in Progress (CWIP) to Plant in Service on the balance sheet. Triggers depreciation commencement and rate base inclusion. Critical for FERC Form 1 and rate case filings.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts Account 101/107; FASB ASC 360-10; FASB ASC 980; FERC Form 1; State PUC Rate Base Determination

attributes.name: irp_program_code
attributes.description: Code linking this capital project to the Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) capital investment program or portfolio under which it was authorized. Enables IRP-level capital tracking and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP IM Investment Program (IMPR); IRP Capital Planning; State PUC IRP Filing Requirements

attributes.name: is_afudc_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC) Eligibility Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this project qualifies for AFUDC accrual (True) or not (False). Projects must meet FERC and FASB ASC 980-835 criteria for AFUDC eligibility, typically requiring a construction period exceeding one year and costs above a materiality threshold.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts Accounts 419/432; FASB ASC 980-835-25; State PUC Rate Case

attributes.name: is_cwip_in_rate_base
attributes.business_glossary_term: Construction Work in Progress (CWIP) in Rate Base Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Construction Work in Progress (CWIP) balances for this project are currently included in the utility's rate base for rate recovery prior to in-service (True) or not (False). CWIP rate base treatment is jurisdiction-specific and requires PUC approval.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1 Account 107; FASB ASC 980; State PUC CWIP Rate Base Policy; GRC Rate Case Filing

attributes.name: is_rate_base_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the completed project assets are eligible for inclusion in the Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) for rate recovery purposes (True) or not (False). Non-eligible projects include those disallowed by regulators or used for non-regulated activities.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations; FERC Form 1; State PUC Rate Case Cost-of-Service Study; RAB Valuation

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capital project record was most recently modified in the source system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for incremental data loading, change detection, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — Change Documents; FASB ASC 980 Audit Requirements; NERC CIP-007 Audit Logging

attributes.name: planned_end_date
attributes.description: Planned date on which all project work is scheduled to be completed and the asset placed in service. Drives AFUDC accrual period and capitalization timeline. Corresponds to SAP PS Basic Finish Date.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — Project Dates (PROJ-PLSEZ); PMI PMBOK; FERC Form 1 CWIP Reporting

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Planned date on which construction or project execution activities are scheduled to begin. Used for capital planning, resource scheduling, and AFUDC accrual start determination. Corresponds to SAP PS Basic Start Date.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — Project Dates (PROJ-PLFAZ); PMI PMBOK; IRP Capital Planning

attributes.name: ppa_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the associated Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) if this capital project is related to a renewable energy or generation procurement contract. Null for projects not associated with a PPA. Links capital investment to contracted energy supply.
attributes.references: FERC Power Purchase Agreement Regulations; Allegro ETRM PPA Module; State PUC IRP Filing

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority classification of the capital project used in IRP capital planning and portfolio management. Critical projects are typically regulatory-mandated or safety-driven; high are strategic; medium are operational improvements; low are discretionary.
attributes.references: IRP Capital Planning; SAP IM Investment Program Priority; State PUC GRC Filing

attributes.name: project_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the capital project scope, objectives, and justification. Supports CPCN filings, IRP documentation, and rate case cost-of-service studies.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — Project Definition; FERC Form 1; State PUC CPCN Filing Requirements

attributes.name: project_manager
attributes.description: Name of the employee designated as the responsible project manager for this capital project. Accountable for schedule, budget, and scope delivery. Sourced from SAP PS Responsible Person field.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — Project Definition Responsible Person; PMI PMBOK Project Manager Role

attributes.name: project_name
attributes.description: Descriptive human-readable name of the capital project (e.g., 'Substation 47 Transformer Upgrade', 'AMI Phase 2 Deployment', 'Pipeline Segment 8 Replacement'). Used in management reporting and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — Project Definition; FERC Form 1 Schedule

attributes.name: project_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric project identifier assigned by SAP PS/IM at project creation. Used in CPCN filings, IRP capital planning documents, and cross-system references. Corresponds to the SAP Project Definition number (PROJ-PSPNR).
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — Project Definition; FERC Form 1; CPCN Filing Requirements

attributes.name: project_sponsor
attributes.description: Name of the executive or senior manager sponsoring and accountable for the capital project at the business unit level. Responsible for project authorization and escalation decisions.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — Project Definition; PMI PMBOK Project Sponsor Role; Internal Capital Governance Policy

attributes.name: project_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the capital project: proposed (under evaluation), authorized (board/management approved), active (construction/implementation in progress), on_hold (temporarily suspended), completed (work finished, pending capitalization), cancelled (project terminated), closed (fully capitalized and settled to fixed assets). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: proposed|authorized|active|on_hold|completed|cancelled|closed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — Project Status Profile; SAP IM Investment Management; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: project_type
attributes.description: Classification of the capital project by investment type: new_construction (greenfield infrastructure), replacement (like-for-like asset replacement), upgrade (capacity or capability enhancement), maintenance (major maintenance capitalized), compliance (regulatory-mandated investment), technology (IT/OT systems). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new_construction|replacement|upgrade|maintenance|compliance|technology — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Form 1 Uniform System of Accounts; FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; SAP IM Investment Program

attributes.name: rec_program_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) program associated with this capital project, applicable for renewable generation projects (solar, wind, hydro). Used for REC tracking, compliance reporting, and state renewable portfolio standard (RPS) obligations.
attributes.references: State PUC Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS); DOE REC Tracking Systems; NERC E-TAGG; EIA Form 923

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Regulatory jurisdiction governing this capital project for rate recovery and reporting purposes: ferc (FERC-jurisdictional transmission), state_puc (state-regulated distribution/generation), both (dual jurisdiction), exempt (non-regulated or exempt project).
attributes.references: FERC (18 CFR); State PUC Regulations; FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations

attributes.name: revised_budget_amount
attributes.description: Most recent revised total CAPEX budget after approved budget amendments or scope changes, in USD. Null if no revisions have been made. Used to track budget overruns and variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP IM Module — Budget Supplement/Return; FASB ASC 360; Internal Capital Authorization Policy

attributes.name: utility_division
attributes.description: Utility business division responsible for this capital project, used for regulatory cost allocation between electric and gas operations and T&D functional separation in rate cases and FERC Form 1 reporting.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1 Uniform System of Accounts; State PUC Rate Case Cost-of-Service Study; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: wbs_level
attributes.description: Numeric level of this record within the WBS hierarchy (e.g., 1 = project root, 2 = phase, 3 = work package, 4 = activity). Enables hierarchical cost roll-up and reporting from activity level to total project level.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — WBS Element Hierarchy; PMI PMBOK WBS Standard

products.name: wbs_element
products.description: SAP PS Work Breakdown Structure element representing a hierarchical subdivision of a capital project used for granular cost tracking, budget control, and asset capitalization. Each WBS element maps to a specific scope of work within a CAPEX project and accumulates costs that are eventually settled to fixed assets upon project completion.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the WBS element record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key generated by the lakehouse ingestion pipeline from SAP PS.
attributes.references: SAP PS (Project System) Module; FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP CO cost center responsible for this WBS element. Drives cost allocation, budget ownership, and departmental CAPEX reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Module — Cost Center (CSKS); FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP FI-AA Asset Under Construction (AuC) record to which costs from this WBS element are periodically transferred during the construction phase. The AuC is the balance sheet representation of in-progress capital work.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Module — Asset Under Construction (ANLA); FASB ASC 360; FERC Account 107

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary General Ledger account to which costs accumulated on this WBS element are posted. Aligns with the FERC Uniform System of Accounts for electric and gas plant.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module — GL Account (SKA1); FERC Uniform System of Accounts; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: parent_wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the immediate parent WBS element in the hierarchical project structure. Null for top-level (Level 1) WBS elements. Enables traversal of the full WBS hierarchy for roll-up cost reporting.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — WBS Element Hierarchy (PRPS); PMI PMBOK Work Breakdown Structure

attributes.name: primary_wbs_responsible_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee (project manager or WBS element owner) accountable for cost control and delivery of this WBS element scope. Sourced from SAP HR.
attributes.references: SAP HR Module — Employee Master; PMI PMBOK Responsibility Assignment Matrix

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.profit_center

attributes.name: account_assignment_element_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this WBS element can be used as an account assignment object on purchase orders, time confirmations, and journal entries in SAP. True = direct cost postings allowed; False = summary/header level only.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — Account Assignment Indicator (PRPS.XKONT); SAP MM/FI Integration

attributes.name: actual_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total actual costs posted to this WBS element to date in US dollars, including labor, materials, equipment, and contractor charges. Sourced from SAP CO actual cost line items. Used for CAPEX spend tracking and budget variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Actual Costs (COEP); FASB ASC 360; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: actual_finish_date
attributes.description: The date on which work on this WBS element was actually completed. Triggers technical completion status and initiates the asset settlement process to fixed assets.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — Actual Dates (PRPS.IENDE); FASB ASC 360 In-Service Date

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which work on this WBS element actually commenced. Compared against planned start date for schedule variance analysis and project performance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — Actual Dates (PRPS.ISTRZ); PMI PMBOK Earned Value Management

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: SAP Asset Accounting asset class to which costs on this WBS element will be settled upon project completion (e.g., 'transmission_line', 'substation_equipment', 'distribution_transformer', 'gas_pipeline', 'metering_equipment', 'building'). Determines depreciation rules and FERC plant account. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: transmission_line|substation_equipment|distribution_transformer|gas_pipeline|metering_equipment|building|land|vehicle — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Module — Asset Class (ANKL); FERC Uniform System of Accounts; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: authorization_date
attributes.description: The date on which the capital expenditure for this WBS element was formally authorized by management per the company's Capital Authorization Policy (CAP). Required for CAPEX governance audit trails.
attributes.references: Internal Capital Authorization Policy; FASB ASC 360; State PUC CAPEX Approval Requirements

attributes.name: billing_element_flag

attributes.name: budget_amount

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which costs accumulated on this WBS element were capitalized and settled to a fixed asset record in SAP FI-AA. May differ from in-service date due to accounting close cycles.

attributes.name: committed_cost_amount

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Four-character SAP FI company code identifying the legal entity responsible for this WBS element. Enables multi-entity financial reporting and intercompany cost allocation for utilities with multiple regulated subsidiaries.

attributes.name: controlling_area_code

attributes.name: cpcn_number

attributes.description: The regulatory permit number (Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity) issued by the State PUC authorizing construction of the facility associated with this WBS element. Required for major transmission and generation projects. Null if no CPCN is required.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this WBS element record was first created in SAP PS. Provides the audit trail start point for the WBS element lifecycle. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: driver_category

'safety' = OSHA/PHMSA compliance; 'reliability' = SAIDI/SAIFI improvement; 'regulatory' = FERC/NERC/PUC mandate. attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts plant account code associated with this WBS element (e.g., '353' for Station Equipment, '365' for Transmission Lines, '374' for Distribution Plant). Required for FERC Form 1 reporting and rate base determination.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101); FERC Form 1

attributes.name: forecast_cost_amount
attributes.description: Project manager's current estimate of total cost at completion for this WBS element, incorporating actuals to date plus remaining work estimate. Used for EAC (Estimate at Completion) reporting and CAPEX forecast submissions to regulators.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — Cost Forecast; PMI PMBOK Earned Value Management; State PUC CAPEX Reporting

attributes.name: forecast_finish_date
attributes.description: Project manager's current estimate of the completion date for this WBS element, updated periodically during project execution. Used for CAPEX in-service date forecasting submitted to regulators and for IRP planning.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — Forecast Dates; State PUC CAPEX Reporting; IRP (Integrated Resource Plan) Guidelines

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level of this WBS element within the project hierarchy (1 = top-level project summary, 2 = major deliverable, 3 = work package, 4+ = activity/task). Drives roll-up logic in CAPEX reporting.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — WBS Element (PRPS.STUFE); PMI PMBOK

attributes.name: in_service_date
attributes.description: The date on which the asset constructed under this WBS element was placed in service and began depreciating. This is the FASB ASC 360 and FERC-defined date that triggers inclusion in the Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) and commencement of depreciation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: last_changed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this WBS element record was most recently modified in SAP PS. Used for change detection in incremental data loads and audit trail compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — Changed On (PRPS.AEDAT/AEUHR); Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: long_description
attributes.description: Extended narrative description of the WBS element scope, deliverables, and technical specifications. Supports detailed project documentation and regulatory cost-of-service study narratives.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module; FERC Form 1 Supplemental Schedules

attributes.name: original_budget_amount
attributes.description: The initial approved budget for this WBS element at the time of project authorization, before any budget supplements or transfers. Enables tracking of budget changes over the project lifecycle for governance and audit purposes.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — Original Budget; Internal Capital Authorization Policy; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: planned_finish_date
attributes.description: The scheduled completion date for work on this WBS element as defined in the project plan. Drives CAPEX in-service date forecasting and depreciation commencement planning.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — Basic Dates (PRPS.PLSEZ); PMI PMBOK Schedule Management

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: The scheduled start date for work on this WBS element as defined in the project plan. Used for project scheduling, resource planning, and CAPEX spend phasing in financial forecasts.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — Basic Dates (PRPS.PLFAZ); PMI PMBOK Schedule Management

attributes.name: planning_element_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this WBS element is designated as a planning element in SAP PS, allowing cost planning and budget assignment at this level. True = planning element; False = cost collection only without direct budget assignment.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — WBS Element Planning Indicator (PRPS.PLAKZ)

attributes.name: plant_type
attributes.description: Classification of the utility plant type for this WBS element per FERC Uniform System of Accounts. Drives rate base inclusion, depreciation rate assignment, and cost-of-service study allocation.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101); FERC Form 1 Schedule F1_308

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to this WBS element, reflecting urgency and strategic importance (e.g., safety-critical infrastructure, regulatory mandate, reliability improvement, growth). Drives capital allocation decisions during budget constrained periods.
attributes.references: Internal Capital Planning Policy; NERC CIP Standards (for critical infrastructure); State PUC Rate Case Prioritization

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent capital project (SAP PS Project Definition) under which this WBS element is organized. Every WBS element belongs to exactly one project.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — Project Definition (PROJ); FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: project_type
attributes.description: Classification of the capital project type associated with this WBS element. Drives CAPEX vs OPEX accounting treatment, regulatory rate base inclusion, and FERC account mapping. 'regulatory' covers rate case and compliance-driven projects; 'environmental' covers EPA/OSHA mandated remediation.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: settled_amount
attributes.description: Total costs that have been settled from this WBS element to fixed assets (AuC — Asset under Construction) or other receivers upon project completion. Represents the capitalized value transferred to the Regulatory Asset Base (RAB).
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Module — Settlement (KO88/CJ88); FASB ASC 360; FERC Form 1 Schedule F1_204

attributes.name: settlement_rule
attributes.description: Defines how costs accumulated on this WBS element are to be settled to receivers (fixed assets, cost centers, or other WBS elements). 'full_settlement' = 100% to one receiver; 'partial_settlement' = split across multiple receivers; 'periodic_settlement' = settled on a recurring schedule; 'no_settlement' = costs remain on WBS (e.g., expensed OPEX).
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Settlement Rule (COBRA); FASB ASC 360; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: statistical_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this WBS element is statistical in SAP CO, meaning costs are posted for reporting purposes only and do not affect the primary cost object. Used for management reporting overlays without impacting financial accounting.

attributes.name: user_status
attributes.description: Business-defined user status applied to the WBS element beyond the SAP system status (e.g., 'APPR' = Approved, 'PEND' = Pending Approval, 'HOLD' = On Hold, 'CANC' = Cancelled). Configured per company-specific status profiles in SAP PS. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: approved|pending_approval|on_hold|cancelled|in_review|deferred — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — User Status (JEST); Internal Capital Project Governance Policy

attributes.name: utility_type
attributes.description: Identifies whether this WBS element relates to electric operations, natural gas operations, common/shared infrastructure, or other utility services. Critical for regulatory ring-fencing, rate case cost allocation, and FERC/PUC reporting separation.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; State PUC Rate Case Guidelines; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: wbs_element_code
attributes.description: The externally-known alphanumeric code assigned to the WBS element in SAP PS (e.g., 'PROJ-2024-001.1.2'). This is the business-facing identifier used in project documentation, purchase orders, and cost reports. Conforms to the SAP WBS element coding convention.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — WBS Element (PRPS); FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: wbs_element_description
attributes.description: Short descriptive text explaining the scope of work represented by this WBS element (e.g., 'Substation 12kV Bus Replacement — Civil Works'). Used in project status reports and CAPEX tracking dashboards.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — WBS Element (PRPS); FERC Form 1

attributes.name: wbs_element_status
attributes.description: Current system status of the WBS element in SAP PS lifecycle. 'created' = defined but not yet approved for spending; 'released' = approved and open for cost postings; 'technically_complete' = work done, pending financial close; 'closed' = fully settled and closed; 'locked' = temporarily blocked for postings; 'deleted' = logically removed.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — System Status (JEST/TJ02); FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: work_category
attributes.description: Functional category of work performed under this WBS element (e.g., 'new_construction', 'replacement', 'upgrade', 'relocation', 'decommission', 'study', 'land_acquisition'). Used for asset capitalization classification and rate base analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new_construction|replacement|upgrade|relocation|decommission|study|land_acquisition|emergency — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; FASB ASC 360; State PUC Rate Case Guidelines

products.name: internal_order
products.description: SAP CO internal order used to collect and monitor costs for short-term operational activities, maintenance jobs, and overhead cost pools that do not warrant a full project structure. Supports OPEX tracking for O&M activities, storm restoration cost capture for regulatory recovery, and overhead allocation to cost centers.

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the SAP CO internal order record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this data product.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Internal Order Object

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Surrogate reference to the primary fixed asset or infrastructure asset associated with this internal order. Used when the order collects maintenance or capital costs attributable to a specific T&D asset, generation unit, or facility tracked in the asset management system.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Module — Asset Master; Maximo EAM; ISO 55000 Asset Management; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Surrogate reference to the primary fixed asset or infrastructure asset associated with this internal order. Used when the order collects maintenance or capital costs attributable to a specific T&D asset, generation unit, or facility tracked in the asset management system.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Module — Asset Master; Maximo EAM; ISO 55000 Asset Management; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Surrogate reference to the SAP CO cost center responsible for this internal order. The responsible cost center is the organizational unit accountable for the costs collected on the order and is used for overhead allocation, budget ownership, and regulatory cost-of-service studies.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Internal Order Master Data (Responsible Cost Center); FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Surrogate reference to the primary General Ledger account associated with this internal order for cost posting and settlement. Supports chart of accounts alignment and FERC Uniform System of Accounts mapping for regulatory financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module — Chart of Accounts; FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101); FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Surrogate reference to the SAP plant (Werk) associated with this internal order, representing the operational facility, service territory, or generation site where the work is performed. Used for geographic cost allocation and asset-level regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP PM/MM Module — Plant Configuration; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Surrogate reference to the SAP PS Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element to which this internal order is subordinate, when the order is used within a larger capital project structure. Applicable for CAPEX-adjacent overhead orders that support project cost collection.
attributes.references: SAP PS Module — WBS Element; FASB ASC 980 Regulatory Assets; FERC Form 1 CWIP Reporting

attributes.name: actual_total_cost
attributes.description: Total actual costs posted to this internal order to date, in the controlling area currency. Represents the sum of all cost postings (labor, materials, services, overhead) accumulated on the order. Used for OPEX tracking, regulatory cost recovery, and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Actual Cost Postings; FERC Form 1; FASB ASC 980; State PUC Rate Case Filings

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: Total approved budget amount allocated to this internal order for the planning period, in the controlling area currency. Represents the authorized spending limit for the work activity or cost pool. Used for budget availability control and variance analysis in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Internal Order Budgeting (KO22); FASB ASC 980; State PUC Rate Case Cost Justification

attributes.name: budget_profile
attributes.description: SAP CO budget profile (Budgetprofil) assigned to this internal order, defining the rules for budget availability control including tolerance limits, warning thresholds, and error actions when actual or committed costs exceed the approved budget.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Budget Profile Configuration (OKO4); Internal Financial Controls

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: SAP FI business area (Geschäftsbereich) associated with this internal order, representing a distinct segment of the utility's operations (e.g., electric generation, electric distribution, gas distribution, corporate). Used for segment-level financial reporting and FERC jurisdictional cost separation.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module — Business Area; FERC Form 1 Jurisdictional Separation; FASB ASC 280

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the internal order was fully settled and closed in SAP CO, indicating all costs have been allocated to receivers and the order is archived. Used for financial period-end close management and audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Order Closing (KO88); FASB ASC 980; Financial Audit Requirements

attributes.name: committed_cost
attributes.description: Total committed costs on this internal order representing purchase orders and contracts issued but not yet invoiced or posted as actual costs. Used for budget availability control and forecasting remaining spend in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Commitment Management; SAP MM Purchase Order Integration

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP FI company code (Buchungskreis) to which this internal order belongs, representing the legal entity or regulated utility subsidiary. Used to segregate costs by legal entity for FERC Form 1, state PUC rate case filings, and consolidated financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI Module — Company Code Configuration; FERC Form 1; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: SAP CO controlling area (Kostenrechnungskreis) within which this internal order is defined. The controlling area establishes the organizational boundary for management accounting, cost allocation, and internal reporting. Typically maps to a regulated utility entity or holding company segment.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Controlling Area Configuration (OKKP)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this internal order record was first created in SAP CO. Provides the audit trail creation timestamp for data lineage, SOX compliance, and financial record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Order Creation Timestamp; Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 404; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this internal order (budget, planned, actual, committed costs). Typically 'USD' for US-based utility operations. Supports multi-currency controlling area configurations for utilities with international operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP CO Controlling Area Currency; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The planned or actual end date of the internal order, after which no further cost postings are expected. Used for work activity scheduling, budget period closure, and determining when the order should be technically completed and settled.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Internal Order Master Data (End Date); FERC Form 1 Period Reporting

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USofA) account code associated with the primary cost type collected on this internal order. Enables direct mapping of internal order costs to FERC Form 1 reporting lines for electric and gas utility regulatory filings. Examples: '588' (Maintenance of Overhead Lines), '878' (Gas Transmission and Distribution).
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts for Public Utilities and Licensees (18 CFR Part 101); FERC Form 1

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which this internal order is primarily active and its costs are planned and reported. Used for annual budget cycle management, period-end settlement, and year-over-year cost trend analysis in regulatory rate case filings.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Fiscal Year; FERC Form 1 Annual Reporting; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: SAP functional area (Funktionsbereich) assigned to the internal order, used to classify costs by business function for funds management and government/regulatory reporting. Common values in utilities include operations, maintenance, administration, and customer service.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Module — Functional Area; FERC Uniform System of Accounts — Functional Classification

attributes.name: last_settled_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent period-end settlement run that allocated costs from this internal order to its settlement receivers. Used to confirm that period-end close processes have been completed and to identify orders with outstanding unsettled costs.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Settlement Run (KO88/KO8G); FASB ASC 980; Period-End Close Procedures

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this internal order record was most recently modified in SAP CO or the Silver Layer. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change tracking, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Change Document; SOX Section 404; Databricks Silver Layer Audit Requirements

attributes.name: long_description
attributes.description: Extended narrative description of the internal order providing full context for the work activity, maintenance job, storm event, or overhead pool. Supports regulatory cost justification in rate case filings and FERC Form 1 reporting.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Internal Order Long Text; FERC Form 1 Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: object_class
attributes.description: SAP CO object class (Objektklasse) of the internal order, which determines how costs are treated in profitability analysis and overhead accounting. 'overhead' = indirect cost pool; 'investment' = capital expenditure collection; 'profitability' = revenue-bearing order; 'accrual' = accrual accounting order.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Object Class (Field: SCOPE); FASB ASC 980; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: opex_capex_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether costs collected on this internal order are classified as Operating Expenditure (OPEX), Capital Expenditure (CAPEX), or a mixed allocation. Critical for regulatory cost-of-service studies, rate case filings, and FERC Form 1 reporting. OPEX orders are expensed in the period; CAPEX orders are capitalized to the Regulatory Asset Base (RAB).
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations; State PUC Rate Case Guidelines; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: order_category
attributes.description: SAP CO internal order category that determines the fundamental accounting treatment. 'overhead_order' = collects overhead costs for allocation to cost centers; 'investment_order' = collects CAPEX costs for capitalization to fixed assets; 'accrual_order' = supports accrual postings; 'order_with_revenues' = collects both costs and revenues for profitability analysis.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Order Category (Field: AUTYP); FASB ASC 980; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: The externally-known SAP CO internal order number (Auftragsnummer) assigned by the system at creation. Used as the primary business identifier when referencing the order in financial reports, rate case filings, and cross-system integrations. Typically a numeric string (e.g., '700012345').
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Internal Order (KO01/KO02); FERC Form 1 Cost Reporting

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SAP CO internal order, reflecting its workflow state. 'created' = order defined but not yet approved for cost collection; 'released' = active and accepting cost postings; 'technically_complete' = operational work done, no further postings allowed but order not yet settled; 'closed' = fully settled and archived; 'deleted' = logically removed.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Order Status Management (BS22); FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: SAP CO order type (Auftragsart) that classifies the internal order by its business purpose and controls default parameters such as settlement profile, planning profile, and budget profile. Common utility examples include O&M maintenance orders, storm restoration orders, overhead cost orders, and environmental compliance orders. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: om_maintenance|storm_restoration|overhead_allocation|environmental_compliance|capital_overhead|regulatory_study|safety_compliance — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Order Type Configuration (KOT2); FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: overhead_order_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this internal order functions as an overhead cost pool for collecting and subsequently allocating indirect costs (e.g., fleet overhead, administrative overhead, safety program costs) to cost centers or other orders via SAP CO overhead allocation cycles.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Overhead Cost Controlling; FERC Uniform System of Accounts — Overhead Allocation

attributes.name: planned_total_cost
attributes.description: Total planned (estimated) cost for this internal order as entered in SAP CO cost planning. Represents the expected cost to complete the work activity or fill the overhead pool. Used for budget-to-actual variance analysis and rate case cost-of-service studies.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Internal Order Planning (KPF6); FERC Form 1 Cost Reporting

attributes.name: planning_profile
attributes.description: SAP CO planning profile assigned to this internal order, controlling the cost planning methodology (e.g., overall planning, annual planning, detailed planning by cost element). Used to standardize cost estimation approaches across O&M and overhead orders.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Planning Profile Configuration; FERC Form 1 Cost Estimation

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: Surrogate reference to the SAP CO profit center associated with this internal order. Enables profitability analysis by business segment (e.g., electric distribution, gas distribution, generation) and supports segment reporting under FASB ASC 280 and FERC jurisdictional cost separation.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Profit Center Accounting (EC-PCA); FASB ASC 280 Segment Reporting; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: regulatory_recovery_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the costs collected on this internal order are eligible for regulatory cost recovery through rates approved by the PUC or FERC. True = costs are recoverable in rates (e.g., storm restoration, mandated compliance work); False = costs are not recoverable or are subject to disallowance review. Supports regulatory asset/liability accounting under FASB ASC 980.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations; State PUC Rate Case Proceedings; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: requesting_cost_center
attributes.description: SAP CO cost center code of the organizational unit that requested the creation of this internal order. Distinct from the responsible cost center; used to track which department initiated the work activity or cost collection requirement.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Internal Order Master Data

attributes.name: responsible_person
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the person responsible for managing and monitoring this internal order, as recorded in SAP CO master data. Used for cost accountability, budget ownership, and audit trail purposes in financial and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Internal Order Master Data (Responsible Person Field)

attributes.name: settlement_receiver_type
attributes.description: Type of SAP CO settlement receiver to which costs accumulated on this internal order are settled at period-end. Determines the downstream accounting treatment: 'cost_center' = OPEX allocation; 'fixed_asset' = CAPEX capitalization; 'gl_account' = direct G/L posting; 'wbs_element' = project cost roll-up.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Settlement Rule (KO02); FASB ASC 360; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: settlement_rule_profile
attributes.description: SAP CO settlement profile (Abrechnungsprofil) assigned to the internal order, defining the rules for how accumulated costs are settled (allocated) to receivers such as cost centers, G/L accounts, fixed assets, or other orders at period-end. Critical for OPEX vs. CAPEX cost classification and regulatory asset capitalization.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Settlement Profile Configuration (OKO7); FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: short_description
attributes.description: Brief human-readable description of the internal order's business purpose, as entered in SAP CO (Kurztext field, up to 40 characters). Used in financial reports, cost center allocations, and regulatory filings to identify the nature of the work or cost pool being tracked.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Internal Order Master Data (KO01)

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational source system from which this internal order record was extracted (e.g., 'SAP_CO_PRD' for the SAP CO production client). Supports data lineage tracking and multi-source reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage Standards; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the internal order becomes effective and cost postings are permitted to begin. Represents the planned or actual start of the work activity, maintenance job, or overhead collection period. Used for scheduling, budget period alignment, and regulatory cost period attribution.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Internal Order Master Data (Start Date); FERC Form 1 Period Reporting

attributes.name: statistical_order_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this internal order is a statistical order in SAP CO. True = statistical order used for reporting and analysis purposes only; costs are posted in parallel to a real cost object (cost center or WBS element) and do not affect actual cost flows. False = real order that carries actual costs for settlement.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Statistical Internal Orders; FERC Form 1 Supplemental Reporting

attributes.name: storm_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this internal order was created specifically to capture costs associated with a storm restoration event. True = storm restoration order eligible for separate regulatory cost recovery tracking and potential extraordinary cost treatment. Supports SAIDI/SAIFI reporting and storm cost deferral accounting.
attributes.references: State PUC Storm Cost Recovery Proceedings; FASB ASC 980; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: technically_complete_date
attributes.description: The date on which the internal order was set to 'Technically Complete' status in SAP CO, indicating that the operational work is finished and no further cost postings should occur. Triggers the settlement process and is used for regulatory cost period cut-off in rate case filings.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module — Order Technical Completion (KO02); FERC Form 1 Cost Period Attribution

attributes.name: work_order_reference
attributes.description: Reference number linking this SAP CO internal order to a corresponding Maximo Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) work order or SAP PM maintenance order. Enables cross-system traceability between financial cost collection and physical asset maintenance activities.
attributes.references: SAP PM Module — Maintenance Order; Maximo EAM Work Order; ISO 55000 Asset Management

products.name: budget
products.description: Annual and multi-year financial budget records including header-level plan metadata and granular line items for cost centers, profit centers, and capital projects covering both OPEX and CAPEX. Header stores budget version (initial plan, revised forecast, final approved), approval status, and planning horizon. Line items specify GL account, cost center or WBS element, fiscal period, budget category (OPEX/CAPEX), and planned amount. attributes.references: FASB ASC 360-10-45 Impairment and Disposal; FERC Form 1; SAP FI-AA Asset Status

attributes.name: asset_subnumber
attributes.description: SAP FI-AA sub-number that identifies a component or sub-asset under the main asset number, enabling component-level depreciation tracking (e.g., turbine blades vs. turbine frame). Null for assets without sub-components.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Master Sub-Number; FASB ASC 360-10 Component Accounting

attributes.name: asset_type
attributes.description: Accounting classification distinguishing tangible utility plant, intangible plant (e.g., software, franchises), right-of-use assets under ASC 842 operating leases, and finance lease assets. Determines balance sheet presentation and applicable accounting standard.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; FASB ASC 842 Leases; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: bonus_depreciation_taken
attributes.description: Indicates whether federal bonus depreciation (100% first-year expensing under Tax Cuts and Jobs Act or prior bonus depreciation provisions) was claimed for this asset. Affects deferred tax calculations and normalization requirements under FASB ASC 980-740 for regulated utilities.
attributes.references: IRS Section 168(k) Bonus Depreciation; Tax Cuts and Jobs Act 2017; FASB ASC 980-740 Normalization; FERC Normalization Rules

attributes.name: book_depreciation_method
attributes.description: Depreciation method applied for GAAP (book) financial reporting purposes. Regulated utilities predominantly use straight-line or group straight-line methods as approved by the PUC in depreciation studies. Corresponds to SAP FI-AA depreciation key for depreciation area 01.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360-10-35; SAP FI-AA Depreciation Key; State PUC Depreciation Study Orders

attributes.name: book_depreciation_rate
attributes.description: Annual depreciation rate applied for GAAP book purposes, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.025000 = 2.5% per year). Derived from useful life and net salvage percentage. Used to compute annual book depreciation expense.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360-10-35; SAP FI-AA Depreciation Key; State PUC Depreciation Study

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: SAP FI business area representing the utility segment (electric vs. gas) or functional division. Used for segment reporting, separate electric and gas rate case filings, and FERC Form 1 functional classification.
attributes.references: SAP FI Business Area; FERC Form 1 Functional Classification; State PUC Jurisdictional Separation

attributes.name: capitalized_interest
attributes.description: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC) or capitalized interest included in the original cost of the asset. For regulated utilities, AFUDC represents the cost of financing construction and is capitalized per FASB ASC 980-835 and FERC regulations. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 835-20 Capitalization of Interest; FASB ASC 980-835 AFUDC; FERC Uniform System of Accounts Account 107; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP FI company code identifying the legal entity that owns the asset. For multi-state utilities, different company codes may represent different regulated operating companies with separate rate cases and FERC filings.
attributes.references: SAP FI Company Code Configuration; FERC Form 1 Respondent Identification

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fixed asset record was first created in the source system (SAP FI-AA). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and record age analysis.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Master Creation Date; FASB ASC 360; Internal Audit Requirements

attributes.name: current_period_depreciation
attributes.description: Depreciation expense charged for the current accounting period (month or year) for book purposes. Represents the periodic allocation of the depreciable base over the asset's useful life. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360-10-35; SAP FI-AA Planned Depreciation; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: depreciable_base
attributes.description: The amount subject to depreciation, calculated as original cost minus net salvage value (salvage value minus removal cost estimate). This is the base used to compute periodic depreciation expense. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360-10-35; State PUC Depreciation Study; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: depreciation_area_01_amount
attributes.description: Accumulated depreciation in SAP FI-AA Depreciation Area 01, representing the GAAP book depreciation basis. This is the primary depreciation area used for financial statement reporting and FERC Form 1. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Depreciation Area 01; FASB ASC 360; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: depreciation_area_15_amount
attributes.description: Accumulated depreciation in SAP FI-AA Depreciation Area 15, representing the federal income tax (MACRS) depreciation basis. The difference between Area 15 and Area 01 drives the deferred income tax liability calculation under FASB ASC 740. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Depreciation Area 15; IRS MACRS; FASB ASC 740; FASB ASC 980-740

attributes.name: depreciation_area_30_amount
attributes.description: Accumulated depreciation in SAP FI-AA Depreciation Area 30, representing the PUC-approved regulatory depreciation basis. Differences from Area 01 create regulatory assets or liabilities under FASB ASC 980. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Depreciation Area 30; FASB ASC 980-360; State PUC Rate Case Orders

attributes.name: depreciation_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which depreciation began being calculated for this asset. Typically equals the in-service date but may differ for assets with deferred depreciation start (e.g., regulatory lag assets or assets with PUC-approved deferred depreciation treatment under FASB ASC 980).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360-10-35; FASB ASC 980-360; SAP FI-AA Depreciation Start Date; State PUC Orders

attributes.name: disposal_proceeds
attributes.description: Actual proceeds received from the sale or salvage of the retired asset. Used to compute gain or loss on retirement and to update depreciation reserve accounts. Compared against salvage value estimate for depreciation study calibration. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360-10-40; FERC Uniform System of Accounts Account 108; SAP FI-AA Asset Retirement

attributes.name: ferc_jurisdictional
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Jurisdictional Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the asset is subject to FERC jurisdiction (True) for transmission assets under FERC's Open Access Transmission Tariff (OATT) or wholesale rate regulation, versus state PUC jurisdiction only (False). Determines applicable regulatory accounting requirements and rate case venue.
attributes.references: FERC Jurisdiction 18 CFR; FERC Form 1; FERC OATT; Federal Power Act

attributes.name: ferc_plant_account
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Plant Account
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts plant account number classifying the asset (e.g., Account 311 - Steam Production Land, Account 353 - Station Equipment, Account 376 - Distribution Mains, Account 376.1 - Gas Transmission Lines). Mandatory for FERC Form 1 reporting and rate case cost-of-service studies.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts for Public Utilities and Licensees (18 CFR Part 101); FERC Form 1

attributes.name: gis_feature_reference
attributes.description: Cross-reference identifier linking this fixed asset to its spatial feature record in Esri ArcGIS. Enables geographic rate base analysis, storm damage assessment, and regulatory reporting by geographic area.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; FERC Form 1 Geographic Reporting; State PUC Service Territory Filings

attributes.name: impairment_loss
attributes.description: Cumulative impairment loss recognized on the asset when its carrying amount exceeds its recoverable amount. For regulated utilities, impairment may be deferred as a regulatory asset if recovery through future rates is probable under FASB ASC 980. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360-10-35 Impairment; FASB ASC 980-360 Regulatory Deferral; State PUC Impairment Orders

attributes.name: in_service_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was placed in service and depreciation commenced. This is the capitalization date used for depreciation calculation start, rate base inclusion, and FERC Form 1 reporting. Corresponds to SAP FI-AA 'Capitalization Date'.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360-10-35 Depreciation; FERC Form 1; SAP FI-AA Capitalization Date

attributes.name: last_depreciation_run_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent depreciation calculation run executed in SAP FI-AA for this asset. Used to verify depreciation currency and identify assets that may have missed a depreciation posting period.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Depreciation Run (AFAB); FASB ASC 360-10-35

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the fixed asset master record in the source system. Used for change detection in ETL processes and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Master Change Log; Internal Audit Requirements; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: macrs_property_class
attributes.business_glossary_term: Modified Accelerated Cost Recovery System (MACRS) Property Class
attributes.description: IRS MACRS property class determining the tax depreciation recovery period (e.g., 5-year, 7-year, 15-year, 20-year). Utility transmission and distribution assets typically fall in the 15-year or 20-year MACRS class. Drives deferred income tax calculations under FASB ASC 740.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 946 MACRS Property Classes; FASB ASC 740; Revenue Procedure 87-56

attributes.name: maximo_asset_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximo Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) Asset ID
attributes.description: Cross-reference identifier linking this financial fixed asset record to the corresponding physical asset record in Maximo Enterprise Asset Management (EAM). Enables reconciliation between financial accounting (SAP FI-AA) and physical asset management (Maximo) for O&M cost allocation and maintenance history.
attributes.references: Maximo EAM Asset Master; ISO 55000 Asset Management; SAP-Maximo Integration

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: Current net book value of the asset computed as original cost minus accumulated depreciation (book basis). Represents the carrying amount on the balance sheet and is a key input to rate base (RAB) valuation. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360-10-35; FERC Form 1; State PUC Rate Case Cost-of-Service Studies

attributes.name: original_cost
attributes.description: Original cost of the asset at the time of acquisition or construction completion, representing the gross plant investment recorded in the utility plant accounts. Basis for FERC Form 1 gross plant reporting, rate base (RAB) calculation, and depreciation base. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; FASB ASC 360-10-30 Initial Measurement; FERC Form 1 Schedule of Utility Plant

attributes.name: plant_location
attributes.description: Physical location or facility where the asset is installed or operated (e.g., 'Riverside Generating Station', 'Substation 47 - North District', 'Gas Compressor Station 12'). Used for geographic rate base allocation and GIS integration with Esri ArcGIS.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Location; Esri ArcGIS Geospatial Asset Registry; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: SAP MM purchase order number associated with the procurement of this asset. Provides traceability from the capitalized asset back to the original procurement transaction for audit and CAPEX tracking purposes.
attributes.references: SAP MM Purchase Order; CAPEX Procurement Process; FASB ASC 360 Capitalization

attributes.name: rab_exclusion_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the asset is excluded from the Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) when rab_included is False. Used in rate case testimony and PUC filings to document plant disallowances or exclusions.
attributes.references: State PUC Rate Case Orders; FASB ASC 980-360; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: rab_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether this asset is included in the Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) for rate case cost-of-service studies. Assets excluded from RAB (e.g., assets not used and useful, excess capacity, or disallowed plant) do not earn a return in rates. Critical for rate case preparation and PUC filings.
attributes.references: State PUC Rate Case Orders; FASB ASC 980; FERC Form 1; IRP Regulatory Asset Base Definition

attributes.name: regulatory_accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: Total depreciation accumulated using the PUC-approved regulatory depreciation rate from in-service date through current period. Differences between regulatory and book accumulated depreciation create regulatory assets or liabilities under FASB ASC 980. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980-360; State PUC Rate Case Orders; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: regulatory_depreciation_method
attributes.description: Depreciation method approved by the state PUC or FERC for regulatory ratemaking purposes. May differ from book depreciation method, creating regulatory assets or liabilities under FASB ASC 980. Used in rate case cost-of-service studies and FERC Form 1 regulatory depreciation schedules.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980-360 Regulated Operations Plant; State PUC Depreciation Study Orders; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: regulatory_depreciation_rate
attributes.description: Annual depreciation rate approved by the state PUC or FERC for ratemaking purposes, expressed as a decimal. May differ from book depreciation rate, creating regulatory timing differences. Filed in rate case depreciation studies and FERC Form 1.
attributes.references: State PUC Depreciation Study Orders; FERC Form 1; FASB ASC 980-360

attributes.name: remaining_useful_life_years
attributes.description: Estimated remaining service life of the asset in years as of the last depreciation study or reporting period. Used in remaining-life depreciation method calculations and impairment assessments. Key input for rate case depreciation expense projections.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360-10-35 Remaining Life Method; State PUC Depreciation Studies; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: removal_cost_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated cost of removing or retiring the asset at end of useful life (cost of removal). For regulated utilities, net salvage (salvage value minus removal cost) is used in depreciation rate calculations filed with the PUC. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 410-20 Asset Retirement Obligations; State PUC Depreciation Studies; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: retirement_cost
attributes.description: Actual cost incurred to retire and remove the asset from service, including demolition, dismantling, and site remediation costs. Compared against the removal cost estimate for depreciation study accuracy assessment. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 410-20 Asset Retirement Obligations; FERC Uniform System of Accounts Account 108.1; State PUC Depreciation Studies

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was retired or removed from service. Triggers cessation of depreciation and initiates retirement accounting entries including removal of original cost and accumulated depreciation from plant accounts. Null for active assets.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360-10-40 Derecognition; FERC Uniform System of Accounts Account 108; SAP FI-AA Retirement

attributes.name: retirement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the asset retirement event. Normal retirements occur at end of useful life; abnormal retirements occur prematurely due to storm damage, obsolescence, or regulatory disallowance. Abandonment may trigger regulatory asset treatment under FASB ASC 980.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360-10-40; FASB ASC 980-360 Abandonment; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; State PUC Orders

attributes.name: salvage_value
attributes.description: Estimated residual or salvage value of the asset at the end of its useful life, used to determine the depreciable base (original cost minus salvage value). Established through depreciation studies filed with state PUCs. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360-10-35; State PUC Depreciation Study Requirements; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: state_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code identifying the regulatory jurisdiction under which this asset is rate-based. Determines which state PUC has authority over the asset's inclusion in rates. Critical for multi-state utilities performing jurisdictional cost allocation.
attributes.references: State PUC Jurisdictional Allocation; FERC Form 1; NARUC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: tax_accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: Total depreciation accumulated for federal income tax purposes (MACRS basis) from in-service date through current period. The difference between tax and book accumulated depreciation represents the temporary timing difference driving deferred income tax balances under FASB ASC 740 and ASC 980. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 946; FASB ASC 740; FASB ASC 980-740; SAP FI-AA Depreciation Area 15

attributes.name: tax_depreciation_method
attributes.description: Depreciation method applied for federal income tax purposes. Most utility assets use Modified Accelerated Cost Recovery System (MACRS) per IRS guidelines, creating timing differences between book and tax depreciation that generate deferred income tax liabilities tracked under FASB ASC 980. Corresponds to SAP FI-AA depreciation area 15.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 946 MACRS; FASB ASC 740 Income Taxes; FASB ASC 980-740 Regulated Operations Tax; SAP FI-AA Depreciation Area 15

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Estimated useful service life of the asset in years as established by the PUC-approved depreciation study. Drives the straight-line depreciation rate. For group depreciation, this represents the average service life of the asset group. Corresponds to SAP FI-AA 'Useful Life' field.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360-10-35; State PUC Depreciation Study; SAP FI-AA Useful Life; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: vendor_number
attributes.description: SAP MM vendor number identifying the supplier from whom the asset was procured. Used for procurement analytics, vendor performance tracking, and supply chain cost analysis for capital projects.
attributes.references: SAP MM Vendor Master; SAP FI-AA Asset Procurement; Supply Chain Management

products.name: depreciation_run
products.description: SAP FI-AA periodic depreciation calculation run records capturing planned and posted depreciation amounts by asset, depreciation area (book, tax, regulatory), fiscal period, and depreciation method. Supports FASB ASC 980 regulatory depreciation studies, rate case depreciation expense justification, and FERC Form 1 accumulated depreciation reporting.

attributes.name: depreciation_run_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each depreciation run record in the SAP FI-AA periodic depreciation calculation. Serves as the primary key for this data product.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Accounting; FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fixed asset record in SAP FI-AA for which depreciation is being calculated. Links to the asset master data including asset class, useful life, and acquisition value.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Master; FERC Form 1 Plant in Service Schedule; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fixed asset record in SAP FI-AA for which depreciation is being calculated. Links to the asset master data including asset class, useful life, and acquisition value.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Master; FERC Form 1 Plant in Service Schedule; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: depreciation_area_id
attributes.description: Reference to the depreciation area definition record. SAP FI-AA supports multiple parallel depreciation areas (e.g., book/GAAP, tax, regulatory/FERC) for the same asset.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Depreciation Areas; FASB ASC 980; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person who initiated and executed the depreciation run. Required for SOX internal controls, audit trail documentation, and segregation of duties compliance in the financial close process.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA AFAB Execution Log; Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; FERC Form 1 Audit Requirements

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation_amount
attributes.description: Total accumulated depreciation for the asset in the specified depreciation area as of the end of the fiscal period, including all prior period depreciation plus the current period posted amount. Key metric for FERC Form 1 balance sheet reporting and RAB valuation.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1 Schedule of Accumulated Depreciation; FASB ASC 360; FASB ASC 980 Regulatory Asset Base (RAB)

attributes.name: acquisition_value_amount
attributes.description: Original acquisition cost (gross plant value) of the asset in the specified depreciation area as of the depreciation run date. Serves as the depreciable base for depreciation calculations and FERC Form 1 plant-in-service reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Acquisition Value; FERC Form 1 Plant in Service; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: asset_class_code
attributes.description: SAP FI-AA asset class code grouping assets by type for depreciation policy application (e.g., transmission lines, distribution transformers, generation equipment, gas mains, meters). Drives default depreciation parameters and FERC plant account mapping.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Classes; FERC Uniform System of Accounts Accounts 301-399; ISO 55000

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: The SAP FI-AA asset number (main asset number) identifying the specific fixed asset. Used as the externally visible business identifier for cross-referencing with Maximo EAM and FERC plant account schedules.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Master; FERC Form 1 Schedule of Plant in Service; ISO 55000

attributes.name: asset_subnumber
attributes.description: SAP FI-AA asset sub-number identifying a component or sub-asset within the main asset record. Supports component-level depreciation tracking for complex utility infrastructure assets.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Master; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP FI company code identifying the legal entity for which the depreciation run is executed. Aligns with the regulated utility legal entity structure for FERC and state PUC reporting purposes.
attributes.references: SAP FI Organizational Structure; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP CO cost center to which the depreciation expense is allocated. Supports CAPEX/OPEX tracking, rate case cost-of-service studies, and departmental financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Accounting; FERC Cost-of-Service Study Guidelines; State PUC Rate Case Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this depreciation run record was first created in the source system (SAP FI-AA). Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Audit Log; FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this depreciation run record (e.g., 'USD'). Power and Utilities operates primarily in USD; this field supports multi-currency consolidation for holding company structures.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP FI Currency Configuration; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: deferred_tax_amount
attributes.description: Deferred income tax amount arising from the temporary difference between book depreciation and tax depreciation for the period. Calculated as the difference between tax and book depreciation multiplied by the applicable tax rate. Required for FASB ASC 740 and FERC Form 1 deferred tax reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740 Income Taxes; FERC Form 1 Deferred Income Tax Schedule; FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations

attributes.name: depreciation_area_code
attributes.description: SAP FI-AA depreciation area code identifying the valuation basis for this depreciation calculation. Common utility values include '01' (book/GAAP), '10' (federal tax/MACRS), '15' (state tax), '20' (regulatory/FERC), '30' (cost-of-service/rate case). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 01|10|15|20|30|31|40 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Depreciation Areas; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; FASB ASC 980; IRS Publication 946 MACRS

attributes.name: depreciation_area_type
attributes.description: Business classification of the depreciation area indicating the accounting basis. 'book' is GAAP/FASB basis; 'tax_federal' is IRS MACRS basis; 'tax_state' is state tax basis; 'regulatory' is FERC/PUC regulatory basis per ASC 980; 'cost_of_service' is rate case study basis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; IRS Publication 946; State PUC Rate Case Guidelines

attributes.name: depreciation_end_date
attributes.description: The planned end date of depreciation for the asset, representing the date when the asset will be fully depreciated based on its useful life and depreciation start date. Used for asset retirement planning and long-range financial forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Useful Life; FASB ASC 360; FERC Depreciation Study Guidelines

attributes.name: depreciation_method_code
attributes.description: SAP FI-AA depreciation key/method code defining the calculation algorithm applied (e.g., LINA for straight-line, DEGD for declining balance, MACS for MACRS, REGU for regulatory straight-line). Determines how the depreciable base is allocated over the asset useful life.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Depreciation Keys; FASB ASC 360; IRS Publication 946 MACRS; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: depreciation_method_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the depreciation method applied in this run (e.g., 'Straight-Line', 'Declining Balance', 'MACRS 5-Year', 'Regulatory Straight-Line', 'Sum-of-Years-Digits'). Supports rate case documentation and FERC Form 1 narrative disclosures.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; IRS Publication 946

attributes.name: depreciation_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which depreciation commenced for the asset in the specified depreciation area. Typically the asset capitalization date or in-service date. Critical for calculating elapsed depreciation and verifying compliance with FERC capitalization policies.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Capitalization Date; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: SAP FI accounting document number generated when depreciation amounts are posted to the general ledger. Provides the audit trail link between the depreciation run and the corresponding journal entry in the financial ledger.
attributes.references: SAP FI Document Principle; FASB ASC 250; FERC Form 1 Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: error_message
attributes.description: System-generated error or warning message from SAP FI-AA when the depreciation run encounters processing issues. Populated only when run_status is 'error'. Used for operational troubleshooting and period-close exception management.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA AFAB Error Log; SAP Application Log (SLG1)

attributes.name: execution_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the depreciation run was initiated and executed in SAP FI-AA. This is the principal business event timestamp representing when the periodic depreciation calculation was performed.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA AFAB Transaction; FASB ASC 250 Accounting Changes

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts plant account code associated with the asset (e.g., 311 for Steam Production, 353 for Transmission Lines, 364 for Distribution Poles, 374 for Gas Mains). Required for FERC Form 1 accumulated depreciation schedule reporting.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts 18 CFR Part 101; FERC Form 1 Schedule of Accumulated Depreciation

attributes.name: fiscal_period
