attributes.description: The fiscal period (accounting period, typically 1–12 for monthly) within the fiscal year for which depreciation is calculated and posted. Aligns with SAP FI posting period control.
attributes.references: SAP FI Posting Period; FERC Form 1 Monthly Reporting; FASB ASC 250

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the depreciation run is executed and posted. Used for annual FERC Form 1 reporting, FASB ASC 980 regulatory asset/liability reconciliation, and rate case cost-of-service studies.
attributes.references: SAP FI Fiscal Year Variant; FERC Form 1; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: SAP FI general ledger account code to which the depreciation expense is posted (e.g., depreciation expense account or accumulated depreciation contra-asset account). Links the depreciation run to the chart of accounts for financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI Chart of Accounts; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: is_catch_up_run
attributes.description: Indicates whether this run includes catch-up depreciation for prior periods that were not previously posted (True). Catch-up runs occur when assets are capitalized retroactively or when depreciation parameters are corrected, requiring prior-period adjustments per FASB ASC 250.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Repeat Run; FASB ASC 250 Accounting Changes and Error Corrections; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: is_test_run
attributes.description: Indicates whether this depreciation run was executed in simulation/test mode (True) without posting to the general ledger, or as a live posting run (False). Test runs are used for period-close validation and rate case depreciation projections.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA AFAB Test Run; FASB ASC 250; State PUC Rate Case Depreciation Study

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this depreciation run record was last modified in the source system. Tracks status changes, reversals, or corrections applied after initial creation.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Audit Log; FASB ASC 250 Accounting Changes

attributes.name: net_book_value_amount
attributes.description: Net book value of the asset as of the end of the fiscal period, calculated as acquisition cost less accumulated depreciation in the specified depreciation area. Used for RAB valuation, rate case cost-of-service studies, and balance sheet reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; FERC Form 1; State PUC Rate Case Cost-of-Service Study

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the fiscal period covered by this depreciation run. Defines the as-of date for accumulated depreciation balances and net book value calculations.
attributes.references: SAP FI Fiscal Year Variant; FERC Form 1 Reporting Periods; FASB ASC 250

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the fiscal period covered by this depreciation run. Used for period-over-period depreciation analysis and FERC Form 1 monthly reporting alignment.
attributes.references: SAP FI Fiscal Year Variant; FERC Form 1 Reporting Periods

attributes.name: planned_depreciation_amount
attributes.description: The calculated planned depreciation amount for the asset in the specified fiscal period and depreciation area, expressed in the company currency. Represents the depreciation expense as computed by the SAP FI-AA depreciation engine before posting.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA AFAB Depreciation Simulation; FASB ASC 360; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: posted_depreciation_amount
attributes.description: The actual depreciation amount posted to the general ledger for the asset in the fiscal period. May differ from planned amount due to manual adjustments, partial period calculations, or catch-up depreciation. Core field for FERC Form 1 accumulated depreciation reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA AFBP Posting Run; FASB ASC 360; FERC Form 1 Schedule of Accumulated Depreciation

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the depreciation amounts were posted to the SAP FI general ledger. May differ from the period end date in cases of late postings or period-close adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP FI Posting Date; FASB ASC 250 Accounting Changes; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: regulatory_depreciation_rate
attributes.description: The PUC/FERC-approved annual depreciation rate applied to the asset for regulatory cost-of-service purposes, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.033333 for 3.33% straight-line over 30 years). Used in rate case depreciation expense justification and FERC Form 1 reporting.
attributes.references: FERC Depreciation Study Guidelines; State PUC Depreciation Rate Orders; FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations

attributes.name: remaining_useful_life_years
attributes.description: Remaining useful life of the asset in years as of the depreciation run date, calculated as total useful life minus elapsed service life. Used in regulatory depreciation studies, IRP planning, and asset retirement obligation (ARO) calculations per FASB ASC 410.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; FASB ASC 410 Asset Retirement Obligations; FERC Depreciation Study; State PUC Rate Case

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: SAP FI accounting document number of the reversal entry if this depreciation run has been reversed. Populated only when run_status is 'reversed'. Provides the audit trail for depreciation corrections and period-close adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP FI Document Reversal; FASB ASC 250 Error Corrections; FERC Form 1 Audit Trail

attributes.name: run_number
attributes.description: SAP FI-AA externally visible run identifier assigned by the system when the depreciation posting run is executed (e.g., DEPR-2024-001). Used as the business-facing reference number for audit trails and rate case documentation.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA AFAB Transaction; FERC Form 1 Schedule of Accumulated Depreciation

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the depreciation run. 'planned' indicates scheduled but not yet executed; 'test' indicates a simulation run without posting; 'posted' indicates depreciation amounts have been posted to the general ledger; 'reversed' indicates the run has been reversed; 'error' indicates the run failed during processing.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA AFAB/AFBP Transaction; FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Classification of the depreciation run execution type as defined in SAP FI-AA. 'planned' is the standard periodic run; 'unplanned' covers out-of-cycle depreciation; 'repeat' re-executes a prior period run; 'restart' continues an interrupted run.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA AFAB Transaction; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: salvage_value_amount
attributes.description: Estimated residual/salvage value of the asset at the end of its useful life, used to reduce the depreciable base. Relevant for regulatory depreciation studies and rate case justification of depreciation rates.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; FERC Depreciation Study Guidelines; State PUC Depreciation Rate Approval

attributes.name: tax_depreciation_method
attributes.description: IRS tax depreciation method applied in the federal tax depreciation area (e.g., MACRS for Modified Accelerated Cost Recovery System, ADS for Alternative Depreciation System, SL for Straight-Line). Drives deferred income tax calculations and FASB ASC 740 income tax accounting.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 946 MACRS; FASB ASC 740 Income Taxes; FERC Form 1 Deferred Income Tax Schedule

attributes.name: unplanned_depreciation_amount
attributes.description: Additional unplanned (extraordinary) depreciation amount posted outside the standard periodic run, such as impairment write-downs, accelerated depreciation for regulatory purposes, or asset retirement adjustments per FASB ASC 410.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Unplanned Depreciation; FASB ASC 360 Impairment; FASB ASC 410 Asset Retirement Obligations; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: The total estimated useful life of the asset in years as configured in SAP FI-AA for this depreciation area. Drives the straight-line depreciation rate and is a key input to regulatory depreciation studies and rate case filings.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Useful Life; FERC Depreciation Study Guidelines; FASB ASC 360; State PUC Depreciation Rate Orders

attributes.name: wbs_element_code
attributes.description: SAP PS Work Breakdown Structure element code linking the depreciation to a capital project. Supports CAPEX tracking and project-level depreciation analysis for infrastructure investment programs.
attributes.references: SAP PS Project System; FASB ASC 360 Capitalization; FERC Form 1 Construction Work in Progress

products.name: regulatory_asset
products.description: FASB ASC 980 regulatory asset and regulatory liability records representing costs or obligations that regulators have authorized for future recovery or refund through rates. Tracks the regulatory asset/liability balance, amortization schedule, authorizing rate order, PUC docket reference, and recovery period. Essential for regulated utility financial reporting and rate base calculations.

attributes.name: regulatory_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each regulatory asset or regulatory liability record in the FASB ASC 980 ledger. Primary key for this data product.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Regulatory Asset needs direct link to Cost Center for allocation tracking.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Regulatory Asset needs direct links to GL Account and Cost Center for regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: related_capital_project_finance_capex_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the capital project in the capital project accounting system (SAP PS) that originated the costs deferred into this regulatory asset. Enables traceability from the regulatory asset balance back to the underlying CAPEX project for rate base and depreciation analysis.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Project System (PS); FERC Form 1 CWIP Schedule

attributes.name: related_finance_capex_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the capital project in the capital project accounting system (SAP PS) that originated the costs deferred into this regulatory asset. Enables traceability from the regulatory asset balance back to the underlying CAPEX project for rate base and depreciation analysis.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Project System (PS); FERC Form 1 CWIP Schedule

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: The fiscal accounting period (YYYY-MM) to which the current balance and amortization figures apply. Used for period-end close reporting, FERC Form 1 annual filing, and SAP FI/CO period-end postings.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980; FERC Form 1; SAP FI/CO Period-End Close

attributes.name: accrued_carrying_charges
attributes.description: The cumulative carrying charges (interest on the deferred balance) accrued on this regulatory asset or liability to date (in USD). Included in the total balance subject to recovery or refund through rates.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980; State PUC Rate Orders; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: amortization_method
attributes.description: The method prescribed by the authorizing rate order for amortizing this regulatory asset or liability. 'straight_line' is most common; 'regulatory_prescribed' indicates a custom schedule mandated by the regulator; 'units_of_production' may apply to fuel-related deferrals.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980-340-35; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; State PUC Rate Orders

attributes.name: annual_amortization_amount
attributes.description: The annual dollar amount authorized for amortization (recovery or refund) of this regulatory asset or liability through customer rates (in USD). Derived from the approved amortization schedule in the rate order. Used for budgeting and CAPEX/OPEX tracking.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980-340-35; State PUC Rate Orders; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the finance officer or regulatory accounting manager who approved the creation or material modification of this regulatory asset record. Required for SOX Section 302/404 internal controls over financial reporting.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 302 and 404; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: asset_name
attributes.description: Descriptive human-readable name of the regulatory asset or liability (e.g., 'Deferred Storm Restoration Costs', 'Pension Regulatory Asset', 'Fuel Adjustment Clause Deferral'). Used in financial statements and rate case testimony.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980; FERC Form 1 Schedule of Regulatory Assets and Liabilities

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned by the finance or regulatory accounting team to uniquely reference this regulatory asset or liability in rate case filings, FERC Form 1 schedules, and SAP FI/CO postings. Serves as the business-facing key across systems.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; FASB ASC 980; SAP FI/CO

attributes.name: asset_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents a regulatory asset (costs deferred for future recovery from ratepayers) or a regulatory liability (obligations deferred for future refund to ratepayers) under FASB ASC 980.

attributes.name: authorization_date
attributes.description: The date on which the regulatory commission issued the rate order or decision authorizing the creation of this regulatory asset or liability. Establishes the FASB ASC 980 recognition date and the legal basis for deferral accounting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980-340-25; State PUC Rate Orders; FERC Orders

attributes.name: authorizing_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The regulatory jurisdiction that authorized this regulatory asset or liability — Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) for interstate transmission, state Public Utility Commission (PUC) or Public Service Commission (PSC) for distribution, or both for dual-jurisdiction items.

attributes.name: beginning_balance
attributes.description: The opening balance of the regulatory asset or liability at the start of the current accounting period (in USD). Used as the baseline for amortization calculations and period-over-period variance analysis in FERC Form 1 and rate case filings.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980; FERC Form 1 Schedule of Regulatory Assets; FASB ASC 230

attributes.name: capitalization_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this regulatory asset is classified as a capital expenditure (CAPEX) item on the balance sheet (True) or an operating expenditure (OPEX) deferral (False). Affects rate base inclusion, depreciation treatment, and EBITDA reporting under FASB ASC 980 and FASB ASC 360.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980; FASB ASC 360 — Property Plant and Equipment; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: carrying_charge_rate
attributes.description: The authorized carrying charge (interest) rate applied to the unamortized balance of this regulatory asset or liability between the deferral date and the recovery start date, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.060000 for 6.0%). Compensates the utility for the time value of money on deferred costs.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980; State PUC Rate Orders; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this regulatory asset record was first created in the system (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit trail creation event for SOX compliance and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980; Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 404; SAP FI/CO Audit Log

attributes.name: cumulative_amortization
attributes.description: Total amortization recognized to date against this regulatory asset or liability since its inception (in USD). Represents the portion already recovered from or refunded to ratepayers through rates. Used to reconcile the original authorized amount to the current balance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980-340-35; FERC Form 1; SAP FI/CO Asset Accounting

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: The current outstanding balance of the regulatory asset or liability as of the most recent accounting period close (in USD). Represents the net unamortized amount remaining for future recovery or refund through rates. Core field for RAB valuation and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980; FERC Form 1; SAP FI/CO Balance Sheet

attributes.name: deferral_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which costs or obligations began to be deferred into this regulatory asset or liability account. May differ from the authorization date if the regulator authorized retroactive deferral. Used for amortization period calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980; State PUC Rate Orders

attributes.name: disallowance_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this regulatory asset carries a risk of partial or full disallowance by the regulator (True = at risk; False = recovery considered probable). Under FASB ASC 980, if recovery is no longer probable, the asset must be written off. Used for financial risk management and disclosure.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980-340-35-1; SEC Disclosure Requirements; State PUC Proceedings

attributes.name: ferc_account_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Number
attributes.description: The FERC Uniform System of Accounts account number to which this regulatory asset or liability is classified (e.g., Account 182.3 for Other Regulatory Assets, Account 254 for Other Regulatory Liabilities, Account 283 for Deferred Income Taxes). Required for FERC Form 1 reporting.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101); FERC Form 1

attributes.name: ferc_form1_schedule
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Form 1 Schedule
attributes.description: The specific FERC Form 1 schedule or page reference where this regulatory asset or liability is reported (e.g., 'Schedule 232 — Regulatory Assets', 'Schedule 278 — Regulatory Liabilities'). Supports automated FERC Form 1 report generation.

attributes.name: income_tax_effect
attributes.description: The deferred income tax amount associated with this regulatory asset or liability (in USD), arising from temporary differences between book and tax treatment of the deferred costs. Required for FASB ASC 740 and ASC 980 interaction disclosures and FERC Form 1 tax normalization schedules.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980; FASB ASC 740 — Income Taxes; FERC Form 1 Tax Normalization

attributes.name: last_regulatory_review_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent regulatory commission review, audit, or order affecting this regulatory asset or liability. Used to track compliance with ongoing regulatory reporting obligations and to identify assets due for re-authorization.
attributes.references: State PUC Audit Requirements; FERC Compliance Filings

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this regulatory asset record (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, SOX audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 404; SAP FI/CO Change Log; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: next_regulatory_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date of the next regulatory commission review or rate case proceeding in which this regulatory asset or liability will be examined. Used for proactive regulatory compliance planning and rate case preparation.
attributes.references: State PUC Rate Case Schedules; FERC Compliance Calendar

attributes.name: original_authorized_amount
attributes.description: The total dollar amount of costs or obligations originally authorized by the regulator for deferral and future recovery or refund (in USD). Establishes the ceiling for the regulatory asset or liability as approved in the rate order.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980; State PUC Rate Orders; FERC Orders

attributes.name: originating_event_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the business event or circumstance that gave rise to this regulatory asset or liability (e.g., 'Hurricane Ida storm restoration costs incurred Q3 2021', 'Pension obligation increase due to actuarial assumption change', 'Nuclear decommissioning cost deferral per Order No. 2023-14'). Supports audit trails and rate case testimony.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980; State PUC Rate Orders

attributes.name: plant_function
attributes.description: The utility plant function to which this regulatory asset or liability is associated, used for jurisdictional allocation and rate class assignment in cost-of-service studies. Aligns with FERC functional classification for T&D separation.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; FERC Form 1; State PUC Cost-of-Service Study

attributes.name: probability_of_recovery
attributes.description: Management's assessment of the probability that this regulatory asset will be recovered through future rates, using the FASB ASC 450 contingency framework. 'probable' supports continued recognition; 'reasonably_possible' or 'remote' may trigger impairment or write-off under ASC 980.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980-340-35; FASB ASC 450 — Contingencies; SEC MD&A Disclosure

attributes.name: puc_docket_number
attributes.description: The official docket or case number assigned by the state Public Utility Commission (PUC) or Public Service Commission (PSC) authorizing the deferral or recovery of this regulatory asset or liability. Essential for regulatory compliance tracking and rate case filings.
attributes.references: State PUC/PSC Rate Orders; FERC Docket System

attributes.name: rate_base_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this regulatory asset is included in the Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) for rate-of-return calculations. True if the asset earns a return on investment in the rate base; False if it is a non-earning deferral. Critical for Return on Equity (ROE) and rate case calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980; FERC Form 1; GRC Rate Base Schedule

attributes.name: rate_case_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the General Rate Case (GRC) or rate proceeding in which this regulatory asset or liability was established or most recently reviewed. Used to link financial records to the regulatory proceeding for cost-of-service study support and rate case testimony.
attributes.references: State PUC GRC Filing Requirements; FERC Rate Case Procedures

attributes.name: rate_order_number
attributes.description: The specific rate order or commission order number issued by the PUC, PSC, or FERC that authorizes the creation, recovery, or refund of this regulatory asset or liability. Provides the legal basis for FASB ASC 980 recognition.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980-340-25-1; State PUC Rate Orders; FERC Orders

attributes.name: recovery_end_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date on which full amortization (recovery or refund) of this regulatory asset or liability is expected to be completed. Defines the end of the authorized recovery period. Nullable for open-ended or indefinite-term regulatory assets.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980-340-35; State PUC Rate Orders; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: recovery_mechanism
attributes.description: The rate mechanism through which this regulatory asset is recovered from customers or the regulatory liability is refunded to customers. Examples include base rate inclusion, a specific rate rider, a surcharge, or a Fuel Adjustment Clause (FAC). Critical for revenue management and rate design.
attributes.references: State PUC Tariff Filings; FERC Form 1; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: recovery_period_years
attributes.description: The total authorized recovery or refund period in years as specified in the rate order. Used for straight-line amortization calculations and for projecting future rate impacts in Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) and rate case cost-of-service studies.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980; State PUC Rate Orders; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: recovery_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which amortization (recovery from customers or refund to customers) of this regulatory asset or liability commenced through rates. Marks the beginning of the authorized recovery period.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980-340-35; State PUC Rate Orders; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: regulatory_asset_category
attributes.description: Business classification grouping the regulatory asset into a standard category such as deferred fuel costs, storm damage costs, pension and OPEB, income taxes recoverable, environmental remediation, asset retirement obligations, or demand-side management program costs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: deferred_fuel_costs|storm_damage|pension_opeb|income_tax_recoverable|environmental_remediation|asset_retirement_obligation|demand_side_management|rate_case_costs|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; EIA Form 861

attributes.name: regulatory_asset_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the regulatory asset or liability record. 'active' indicates balance is being accumulated; 'amortizing' indicates recovery or refund is in progress; 'fully_amortized' indicates the balance has been fully recovered or refunded; 'pending_approval' indicates awaiting regulatory authorization; 'suspended' indicates recovery temporarily halted by order; 'written_off' indicates disallowed by regulator.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980; State PUC Rate Orders

attributes.name: return_on_equity_rate
attributes.description: The authorized Return on Equity (ROE) rate applied to this regulatory asset when it is included in the rate base. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.095000 for 9.5%). Set by the authorizing rate order. Applicable only when rate_base_eligible is True.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; State PUC Rate Orders; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this regulatory asset record was sourced (e.g., SAP FI/CO for automated postings, manual_entry for regulatory accounting team adjustments). Supports data lineage and Silver Layer reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO; Databricks Data Lakehouse Architecture

attributes.name: utility_service_type
attributes.description: Identifies whether this regulatory asset or liability relates to the electric utility operations, natural gas utility operations, or both. Required for jurisdictional separation in rate case cost-of-service studies and FERC Form 1 vs. FERC Form 2 reporting.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; FERC Form 2; State PUC Rate Case Filing Requirements

products.name: rate_base
products.description: Regulatory rate base (RAB) calculation records supporting GRC and rate case filings. Captures the components of rate base including net utility plant, working capital allowance, regulatory assets/liabilities, accumulated deferred income taxes (ADIT), and customer deposits. Tracks rate base by jurisdiction, rate class, and test year for PUC cost-of-service studies and ROE calculations.

attributes.name: rate_base_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each rate base record in the regulatory asset base (RAB) calculation dataset. Primary key for the rate_base data product.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: regulatory_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.regulatory_asset. Business justification: Rate Base calculations depend on regulatory asset data; linking provides direct access.

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation_amt
attributes.description: Total accumulated depreciation on utility plant in service as of the test year end date. Subtracted from gross plant in service to arrive at net utility plant in the rate base calculation. Sourced from SAP FI/CO asset accounting module.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: adit_amt
attributes.description: Accumulated Deferred Income Taxes (ADIT) balance that reduces the rate base. ADIT represents the cumulative timing differences between book and tax depreciation, which are treated as a cost-free source of capital that offsets the rate base per IRS normalization rules and FERC/PUC requirements.
attributes.references: IRS Normalization Rules (IRC Section 168); FERC Uniform System of Accounts; FASB ASC 740 Income Taxes; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: afudc_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC) Rate
attributes.description: The Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC) rate applied to Construction Work in Progress (CWIP) balances, expressed as a decimal. AFUDC represents the cost of financing capital projects during construction and is capitalized to the plant account per FERC Uniform System of Accounts.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; FASB ASC 980; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: allowed_roe_rate
attributes.description: The authorized Return on Equity (ROE) rate approved by the regulatory commission for this rate case, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0950 for 9.50%). Used to calculate the equity return component of the revenue requirement in cost-of-service studies.
attributes.references: State PUC Commission Order; FERC Order 679; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: commission_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the regulatory commission issued its final order approving the rate base for tariff purposes. Nullable until the commission issues its decision following the rate case proceeding.
attributes.references: State PUC Commission Order; FERC Order

attributes.name: cost_of_debt_rate
attributes.description: The embedded cost of long-term debt used in the capital structure for rate base return calculations, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0450 for 4.50%). Calculated from the utility's outstanding long-term debt instruments as filed with the regulatory commission.
attributes.references: State PUC General Rate Case (GRC) Cost-of-Capital Study; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this rate base record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for record origination in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this rate base record. Typically USD for U.S. utility operations. Supports multi-currency reporting for utilities with cross-border operations.

attributes.name: customer_deposits_amt
attributes.description: Total customer deposit balances that reduce the rate base. Customer deposits are treated as a cost-free source of capital provided by customers, which offsets the utility's rate base investment in cost-of-service studies.
attributes.references: State PUC General Rate Case (GRC) Cost-of-Service Study Methodology; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: cwip_amt
attributes.description: Dollar value of capital projects currently under construction that are included in the rate base per regulatory authorization. CWIP inclusion in rate base is subject to PUC approval and AFUDC (Allowance for Funds Used During Construction) accounting treatment under FASB ASC 980.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations; FERC Uniform System of Accounts Account 107; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: debt_ratio
attributes.description: The proportion of long-term debt in the approved or proposed capital structure used for rate base return calculations, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.5000 for 50%). Together with equity ratio, defines the capital structure for revenue requirement calculations.
attributes.references: State PUC General Rate Case (GRC) Capital Structure Determination; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: depreciation_rate
attributes.description: The composite depreciation rate applied to utility plant in service for rate base and revenue requirement calculations, expressed as a decimal. Established through a depreciation study approved by the regulatory commission.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; State PUC Depreciation Study Approval; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the approved rate base becomes effective for tariff and rate-setting purposes. Established by commission order following a General Rate Case (GRC) proceeding.
attributes.references: State PUC Commission Order; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: equity_ratio
attributes.description: The proportion of equity in the approved or proposed capital structure used for rate base return calculations, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.5000 for 50%). Determined by the regulatory commission in the rate case proceeding.
attributes.references: State PUC General Rate Case (GRC) Capital Structure Determination; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the approved rate base record expires or is superseded by a new rate case determination. Nullable for open-ended rate base records that remain in effect until a new rate case is filed.
attributes.references: State PUC Commission Order; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: The FERC Uniform System of Accounts code associated with the primary plant account category driving this rate base record. Used for FERC Form 1 reporting and regulatory cost allocation studies.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101); FERC Form 1

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the rate base data was formally filed with the regulatory commission (PUC or FERC) as part of the rate case application. Establishes the official record date for regulatory proceedings.
attributes.references: State PUC General Rate Case (GRC) Filing Requirements; FERC Form 1 Annual Filing Deadline

attributes.name: fuel_type_code
attributes.description: Identifies the fuel or energy source type associated with generation plant assets included in this rate base record. Used for Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) reporting, Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) tracking, and environmental compliance cost allocation.
attributes.references: EIA Form 860; FERC Form 1; State PUC Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) Filing Requirements

attributes.name: gross_plant_in_service_amt
attributes.description: Total gross value of utility plant in service (before accumulated depreciation) included in the rate base calculation. Represents the original cost of all depreciable utility assets used and useful in providing regulated service, per FERC Uniform System of Accounts.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; FASB ASC 980; FERC Form 1 Schedule of Utility Plant

attributes.name: is_cwip_included
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Construction Work in Progress (CWIP) Included
attributes.description: Indicates whether Construction Work in Progress (CWIP) is included in the rate base (True) per regulatory authorization, or excluded (False) with AFUDC capitalized instead. CWIP inclusion requires specific PUC or FERC authorization.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; State PUC CWIP Authorization Orders

attributes.name: is_ferc_jurisdictional
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Jurisdictional
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate base record falls under FERC jurisdiction (True) for interstate transmission and wholesale power sales, or under state PUC jurisdiction (False) for retail distribution and local gas distribution. Determines applicable regulatory accounting and reporting requirements.
attributes.references: Federal Power Act Section 205/206; FERC Form 1; Natural Gas Act

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the regulatory jurisdiction (state or federal) under which this rate base record is filed. Used to segregate rate base components by PUC or FERC jurisdiction for cost-of-service studies and rate case filings.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; State Public Utility Commission (PUC) Filing Requirements

attributes.name: net_utility_plant_amt
attributes.description: Net book value of utility plant in service, calculated as gross plant in service minus accumulated depreciation. Represents the primary component of the regulatory asset base (RAB) used in cost-of-service studies and Return on Equity (ROE) calculations.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; FASB ASC 980; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for regulatory analysts and financial planners to document material adjustments, commission-ordered modifications, stipulations, or other explanatory notes associated with this rate base record. Supports audit trail and regulatory proceeding documentation.
attributes.references: State PUC General Rate Case (GRC) Filing Requirements

attributes.name: plant_function_code
attributes.description: Functional classification of the utility plant included in this rate base record per FERC Uniform System of Accounts. Distinguishes between generation, transmission, distribution, general plant, and intangible plant for cost allocation and rate design purposes.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101); FERC Form 1

attributes.name: plant_in_service_date
attributes.description: The date as of which the utility plant in service balance is measured for inclusion in the rate base. Typically the last day of the test year or a specific date established by the regulatory commission for the cost-of-service study.
attributes.references: State PUC General Rate Case (GRC) Test Year Definition; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: rate_base_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the rate base record, used in regulatory filings, cost-of-service studies, and rate case submissions to the Public Utility Commission (PUC). Typically formatted as a combination of jurisdiction code, rate class, and test year (e.g., CA-RES-2024).
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; State PUC General Rate Case (GRC) Filing Requirements

attributes.name: rate_base_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rate base record within the regulatory filing process. Tracks progression from internal draft preparation through regulatory filing, commission approval, and potential supersession by a subsequent rate case.
attributes.references: State PUC General Rate Case (GRC) Procedural Rules; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: rate_case_docket_number
attributes.description: Official docket or case number assigned by the regulatory commission (PUC or FERC) to the rate case proceeding in which this rate base record is submitted. Used for regulatory tracking and cross-referencing with commission orders.
attributes.references: State PUC General Rate Case (GRC) Filing Requirements; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: rate_class_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the customer rate class (e.g., residential, commercial, industrial, agricultural) to which this rate base component is allocated. Supports cost-of-service allocation studies and rate design for General Rate Case (GRC) filings.
attributes.references: State PUC Rate Schedule Tariffs; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: regulatory_assets_amt
attributes.description: Total value of regulatory assets included in the rate base. Regulatory assets represent costs deferred for future recovery in rates as authorized by the PUC under FASB ASC 980, including deferred storm costs, deferred pension costs, and other commission-approved deferrals.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations; State PUC Regulatory Asset Authorization Orders

attributes.name: regulatory_liabilities_amt
attributes.description: Total value of regulatory liabilities that reduce the rate base. Regulatory liabilities represent obligations to return amounts to customers in future rates, such as excess deferred income taxes from tax reform or over-collected revenues, as authorized under FASB ASC 980.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations; IRS Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA) Normalization Rules; State PUC Orders

attributes.name: return_on_rate_base_amt
attributes.description: The dollar amount of authorized return on the rate base, calculated as total rate base multiplied by the weighted average cost of capital (WACC). Represents the equity and debt return component of the revenue requirement.
attributes.references: State PUC General Rate Case (GRC) Cost-of-Service Study; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: revenue_requirement_amt
attributes.description: The total annual revenue requirement associated with this rate base record, representing the amount the utility is authorized to collect from customers to recover its costs and earn a fair return. Calculated as return on rate base plus operating expenses plus depreciation plus taxes.
attributes.references: State PUC General Rate Case (GRC) Revenue Requirement Study; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: sap_cost_center_code
attributes.description: The SAP FI/CO cost center code associated with this rate base record, enabling linkage to the SAP ERP general ledger for financial reconciliation and cost-of-service allocation. Sourced from SAP Controlling (CO) module.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Controlling Module; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: sap_wbs_element
attributes.description: The SAP Project System Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element code associated with capital projects contributing to this rate base record. Used to track CAPEX project costs from SAP PS module through to rate base inclusion.
attributes.references: SAP Project System (PS) Module; FERC Uniform System of Accounts Account 107 CWIP

attributes.name: service_territory_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the geographic service territory or operating division to which this rate base record applies. Used for multi-territory utilities to allocate rate base components by service area for cost-of-service studies.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; State PUC Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity (CPCN)

attributes.name: test_year
attributes.description: The calendar or fiscal year used as the basis for the rate case cost-of-service study. The test year establishes the period for which rate base, revenues, and expenses are measured to determine revenue requirements in a General Rate Case (GRC) filing.
attributes.references: State PUC General Rate Case (GRC) Procedural Rules; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: test_year_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the test year is based on historical actuals, a projected future period, or a hybrid combination of both. Regulatory commissions may require different test year types depending on jurisdiction rules.
attributes.references: State PUC General Rate Case (GRC) Procedural Rules

attributes.name: total_rate_base_amt
attributes.description: Total regulatory asset base (RAB) amount, representing the net investment on which the utility is entitled to earn a return. Calculated as net utility plant plus CWIP plus working capital allowance plus regulatory assets minus regulatory liabilities minus ADIT minus customer deposits. Used as the basis for ROE and revenue requirement calculations in rate cases.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; FASB ASC 980; State PUC General Rate Case (GRC) Filing Requirements; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this rate base record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Tracks the last update for data lineage, audit compliance, and change management in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: utility_type
attributes.description: Identifies whether the rate base record pertains to the electric utility operations, natural gas utility operations, or a combined electric and gas utility. Supports separate rate base tracking for electric and gas jurisdictions.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; State PUC Tariff Filing Requirements

attributes.name: weighted_avg_cost_of_capital_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC) Rate
attributes.description: The overall weighted average cost of capital (WACC) approved or proposed for this rate base, blending the cost of debt and equity weighted by their respective proportions in the capital structure. Used to calculate the total return on rate base in revenue requirement studies.
attributes.references: State PUC General Rate Case (GRC) Cost-of-Service Study; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: working_capital_allowance_amt
attributes.description: Allowance for working capital included in the rate base, representing the utility's investment in cash and materials needed to operate between billing cycles. Typically calculated using the lead-lag method or a fixed percentage of operating expenses as approved by the PUC.
attributes.references: State PUC General Rate Case (GRC) Cost-of-Service Study Methodology; FERC Form 1

products.name: cost_allocation
products.description: SAP CO cost allocation and assessment cycle records distributing shared costs (e.g., corporate overhead, shared services, common plant) from sender cost centers to receiver cost centers, profit centers, or WBS elements. Supports fully-allocated cost-of-service studies for rate cases and inter-company cost allocation for multi-jurisdictional utilities.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each SAP CO cost allocation or assessment cycle record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this data product.

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trading.trading_portfolio. Business justification: Enables Cost Allocation process to allocate costs directly to trading portfolios, required for portfolio profitability analysis.

attributes.name: primary_sender_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Surrogate identifier referencing the cost center from which costs are being distributed (the sender/source in the SAP CO allocation). Typically represents corporate overhead, shared services, or common plant cost centers.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: The gross monetary amount of cost allocated from the sender to the receiver in the company code currency. This is the primary financial fact of the allocation record, used in cost-of-service studies, CAPEX/OPEX tracking, and FERC Form 1 reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980; FERC Form 1; SAP FI/CO

attributes.name: allocated_amount_usd
attributes.description: The allocated cost amount translated to US Dollars (USD) using the exchange rate applicable at the time of posting. Enables consistent cross-currency financial reporting and FERC Form 1 submissions which require USD denomination.

attributes.name: allocation_basis_type
attributes.description: The method or driver used to determine the proportion of costs allocated to each receiver. Common bases include statistical key figures (e.g., kWh consumed), headcount, square footage, revenue, direct cost ratios, or fixed percentages. Critical for rate case cost-of-service justification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: statistical_key_figure|headcount|square_footage|revenue|direct_cost|fixed_percentage|machine_hours|mwh_generated — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; SAP CO Module; PUC Rate Case Standards

attributes.name: allocation_basis_value
attributes.description: The numeric value of the allocation driver/basis for this receiver (e.g., 1,500 kWh, 45 headcount, 2,000 square feet). Used to verify the proportional split of costs and to support rate case cost-of-service documentation.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: allocation_doc_number
attributes.description: The externally-known SAP CO document number uniquely identifying the allocation posting (e.g., assessment cycle run document). Serves as the business identifier traceable back to the source system.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module; FERC Form 1 Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: allocation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by the cost accountant or financial analyst describing the rationale for the allocation, any manual adjustments, or regulatory compliance notes. Supports audit and rate case documentation.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module; PUC Rate Case Standards

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the sender cost center's total cost allocated to this specific receiver, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.125000 = 12.5%). Derived from the allocation basis but stored for audit and rate case transparency.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; PUC Rate Case Standards

attributes.name: allocation_run_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the SAP CO assessment or distribution cycle was executed to generate this allocation record. Distinguishes between multiple runs of the same cycle within a period (e.g., preliminary vs. final close runs).

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the allocation record. 'posted' indicates the allocation has been finalized in SAP CO; 'reversed' indicates a reversal document exists; 'simulated' indicates a test run not yet posted; 'blocked' indicates held for review; 'error' indicates a processing failure.

attributes.name: allocation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the SAP CO allocation method used: assessment (allocates cost using statistical key figures), distribution (reallocates primary costs), indirect activity allocation, manual reposting, or settlement from internal orders/WBS elements.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: SAP FI business area code representing the organizational segment (e.g., Electric Distribution, Gas Transmission, Corporate) to which the allocated cost belongs. Supports multi-jurisdictional cost separation required by state PUC filings.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO; FERC Form 1; PUC Rate Case Standards

attributes.name: capex_opex_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the allocated cost is classified as Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) or Operating Expenditure (OPEX). Critical for regulatory asset base (RAB) valuation, rate case cost-of-service studies, and FERC Form 1 reporting under FASB ASC 980.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980; FERC Form 1; PUC Rate Case Standards

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP FI company code identifying the legal entity within which the allocation is posted. Essential for inter-company cost allocation in multi-jurisdictional utility holding structures and for FERC Form 1 entity-level reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO; FASB ASC 980; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: SAP CO controlling area code that defines the organizational scope of cost management. A single controlling area may span multiple company codes in a utility holding company structure.

attributes.name: cost_element_code
attributes.description: SAP CO cost element code representing the nature of the cost being allocated (e.g., labor, depreciation, overhead). Maps to the GL account in SAP FI and is used for cost-of-service studies in rate cases.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: cost_element_name
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the SAP CO cost element (e.g., 'Salaries and Wages', 'IT Infrastructure Depreciation', 'Fleet O&M'). Supports self-service reporting without requiring a join.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost allocation record was first captured in the SAP CO system. Used for audit trail and data lineage in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the allocated_amount (e.g., 'USD'). Supports multi-currency reporting for utilities operating across jurisdictions.

attributes.name: cycle_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the SAP CO assessment or distribution cycle (e.g., 'Corporate Overhead Allocation', 'Shared Services Assessment', 'Common Plant Distribution'). Supports reporting and audit without requiring a join.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date of the originating allocation document as recorded in SAP CO. May differ from posting_date when allocations are backdated or adjusted for prior periods.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (1–12 for monthly, or 13–16 for special periods) within the fiscal year in which this allocation was posted. Aligns with SAP FI/CO period-end close cycles.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (e.g., 2024) in which this cost allocation was executed. Used for period-end close, annual CAPEX/OPEX reporting, and FERC Form 1 filing alignment.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980; FERC Form 1; SAP FI/CO

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: SAP CO functional area code classifying the nature of the cost (e.g., production, administration, sales, R&D). Used for income statement reporting by function and FERC Form 1 functional classification of utility costs.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The SAP FI general ledger account code to which the allocated cost is posted. Aligns with the FERC Uniform System of Accounts (e.g., Account 920 for administrative and general salaries, Account 921 for office supplies). Critical for FERC Form 1 reporting.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; SAP FI/CO; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: intercompany_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation crosses legal entity boundaries (True = inter-company allocation between affiliates in a utility holding company). Inter-company allocations require additional regulatory scrutiny under FERC affiliate transaction rules and state PUC standards.
attributes.references: FERC Affiliate Transaction Rules; SAP FI/CO; PUC Rate Case Standards

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the regulatory jurisdiction (e.g., state abbreviation or FERC) to which the allocated cost is attributable. Critical for multi-jurisdictional utilities to separate costs for individual state PUC rate cases and FERC wholesale rate filings.
attributes.references: FERC; State PUC Rate Case Standards; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this cost allocation record, including reversals, corrections, or status changes. Supports incremental data loading and change tracking in the lakehouse.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the cost allocation was posted to the SAP CO ledger. This is the principal business event date used for period assignment and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO; FASB ASC 980; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: rate_case_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the General Rate Case (GRC) or FERC rate proceeding for which this allocation is being tracked. Enables direct linkage of cost allocation records to specific regulatory filings and cost-of-service studies.

attributes.name: receiver_profit_center_code
attributes.description: SAP CO profit center code receiving the allocated costs when receiver_type is 'profit_center'. Used for segment-level profitability reporting and inter-company allocations in multi-jurisdictional utility structures.

attributes.name: receiver_type
attributes.description: Discriminator indicating the type of SAP CO object receiving the allocated costs: cost_center (another cost center), profit_center (a profit center for segment reporting), wbs_element (a capital project WBS element for CAPEX tracking), or internal_order.

attributes.name: receiver_wbs_element_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Receiver Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) Element Code
attributes.description: SAP PS Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element code receiving allocated costs when receiver_type is 'wbs_element'. Used for CAPEX project cost tracking, regulatory asset base (RAB) valuation, and CPCN project accounting.
attributes.references: SAP CO/PS Module; FASB ASC 980; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: regulatory_asset_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the allocated cost contributes to a regulatory asset or liability as defined under FASB ASC 980 (Regulated Operations). True when the allocation feeds a deferred cost that is recoverable through future rates approved by the PUC or FERC.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980; FERC Form 1; PUC Rate Case Standards

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reversal of this allocation was posted in SAP CO. Null when no reversal exists. Used for period-end close reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: reversal_doc_number
attributes.description: SAP CO document number of the reversal posting if this allocation has been reversed. Null when no reversal exists. Used for audit trail and period-end reconciliation.

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the allocation was executed against actual costs, planned/budget costs, or as a simulation. 'actual' postings feed financial statements; 'plan' allocations support budgeting and CAPEX/OPEX planning; 'simulation' records are not posted to the ledger.

attributes.name: sender_total_cost
attributes.description: The total cost balance of the sender cost center prior to allocation for the fiscal period. Used to verify that the sum of all allocated_amount values equals the sender's total cost, ensuring full cost recovery in the allocation cycle.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module; FASB ASC 980; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: utility_function
attributes.description: Classifies the allocated cost by utility function per FERC Uniform System of Accounts: generation, transmission, distribution, gas distribution, common (shared across functions), or corporate. Directly supports cost-of-service studies and rate case filings.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; PUC Rate Case Standards; FASB ASC 980

products.name: ap_invoice
products.description: Accounts payable full lifecycle record covering vendor invoice receipt, validation (three-way match with PO/GR/IR), approval, payment execution, and batch payment run processing. Tracks invoice details (vendor, amount, tax, payment terms, due date), payment processing (payment method, payment date, bank account, check/ACH reference, batch payment run parameters), and settlement status. Covers fuel procurement, materials, contractor services, equipment purchases, and employee expense reimbursements. Includes automatic payment program run records for batch disbursement execution. Supports OPEX/CAPEX expenditure tracking, cash flow management, and bank reconciliation.

attributes.name: ap_invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the accounts payable invoice record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Module — RBKP/RSEG Invoice Document

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the company bank account from which payment was disbursed. Corresponds to the SAP house bank and account ID (HBKID/HKTID) used in the F110 payment run. Supports bank reconciliation and treasury cash position management.
attributes.references: SAP FI T012/T012K House Bank Configuration; FASB ASC 230

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP CO cost center (KOSTL) to which the invoice expenditure is allocated. Enables OPEX tracking by organizational unit, department, or functional area for rate case cost-of-service studies and internal management reporting.
attributes.references: SAP CO CSKS.KOSTL; FERC Form 1 Operating Expense Accounts

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.facility. Business justification: AP invoices for facility upgrades or maintenance need facility reference for cost allocation and audit.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP FI general ledger account (HKONT/SAKNR) to which the invoice expense is posted. Determines FERC Uniform System of Accounts classification, CAPEX vs. OPEX treatment, and regulatory asset/liability designation under FASB ASC 980.
attributes.references: SAP FI SKA1.SAKNR; FERC Form 1 USOA; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP MM goods receipt document (MBLNR) confirming physical receipt of materials or services. Required for three-way match (PO/GR/IR) validation before invoice approval and payment release.
attributes.references: SAP MM MKPF.MBLNR; SOX Section 302/404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.parcel. Business justification: AP invoices for property improvements must be tied to the parcel receiving the work for cost tracking and audit.

attributes.name: payment_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP F110 Automatic Payment Program batch run (identified by run date + run ID) that processed this invoice for payment. Links the invoice to the batch disbursement execution record for bank reconciliation and payment audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP FI F110 Automatic Payment Program (REGUH/REGUP); FASB ASC 230

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating SAP MM purchase order (EBELN) against which this invoice is matched. Supports three-way match validation (PO / Goods Receipt / Invoice Receipt) for procurement controls and CAPEX/OPEX authorization.
attributes.references: SAP MM EKKO.EBELN; SOX Section 302/404 Procurement Controls

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor (supplier) master record who issued this invoice. Corresponds to the SAP vendor account (LIFNR). Covers fuel suppliers, materials vendors, contractors, equipment providers, and employee expense reimbursement accounts.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP PS Work Breakdown Structure element (POSID) for capital project cost assignment. Used for CAPEX tracking, regulatory asset base (RAB) valuation, and plant-in-service accounting under FERC Uniform System of Accounts.
attributes.references: SAP PS PRPS.POSID; FERC Form 1 USOA; FASB ASC 980 Regulatory Assets

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current status of the invoice in the approval workflow (SAP FI workflow or external approval system). Tracks whether the invoice has been reviewed and approved by the designated cost center owner or project manager before payment release. Supports SOX internal control compliance.
attributes.references: SAP FI Workflow (SWI); SOX Section 302/404 AP Authorization Controls

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the invoice was approved for payment in the workflow system. Used for cycle time analysis (invoice receipt to approval), SLA monitoring, and SOX audit trail documentation.
attributes.references: SAP FI Workflow; SOX Section 302/404; FASB ASC 420

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The SAP user ID or employee identifier of the person who approved the invoice for payment. Provides audit trail for SOX compliance and internal control documentation. Null if invoice is pending approval or auto-approved within tolerance.
attributes.references: SAP FI Workflow Approval Log; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: check_ach_reference
attributes.description: The check number (for paper check payments) or ACH/EFT transaction reference number assigned by the bank or SAP payment program. Used for bank statement reconciliation, payment tracing, and stop-payment processing.
attributes.references: SAP FI PAYR.CHECT (Check Number); NACHA ACH Rules; FASB ASC 230

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The SAP FI company code (BUKRS) representing the legal entity or regulated utility subsidiary that owns this invoice. Supports multi-entity financial consolidation, separate regulatory filings per utility operating company, and FERC jurisdictional reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI T001.BUKRS; FERC Form 1; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this AP invoice record was first created in the source system (SAP FI). Provides the audit trail creation marker for data lineage, SOX compliance, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: SAP FI RBKP.CPUDT; SOX Section 302/404 Audit Trail; FASB ASC 420

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the invoice (WAERS in SAP). Typically USD for domestic utility operations but may be foreign currency for international equipment purchases, PPA agreements with foreign counterparties, or LNG fuel procurement contracts.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP FI RBKP.WAERS; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The cash discount amount available if payment is made within the early payment discount period (SKFBT in SAP). Supports working capital optimization by identifying invoices eligible for early payment discounts (e.g., 2/10 net 30 terms).
attributes.references: SAP FI RBKP.SKFBT; FASB ASC 420 Payment Terms

attributes.name: discount_due_date
attributes.description: The last date by which payment must be made to qualify for the early payment cash discount (SKFDT in SAP). Used by treasury to prioritize payments and capture available discounts for working capital optimization.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment must be made to the vendor to avoid late payment penalties (FAEDT in SAP). Calculated from the invoice date and payment terms. Critical for cash flow management, AP aging analysis, and avoiding late payment interest charges.
attributes.references: SAP FI BSIK.FAEDT; FASB ASC 420; State PUC Vendor Payment Regulations

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate applied to convert the invoice currency to the company's functional currency (USD) at the time of posting (KURSF in SAP). Applicable for foreign currency invoices (e.g., international equipment, LNG procurement). Null for USD-denominated invoices.
attributes.references: SAP FI RBKP.KURSF; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency Matters

attributes.name: expenditure_category
attributes.description: Designates whether the invoice expenditure is capitalized (CAPEX — added to the regulatory asset base and plant-in-service) or expensed (OPEX — charged to the income statement in the current period). Critical for rate case cost-of-service studies, RAB valuation, and FERC Form 1 reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations; FERC Form 1 USOA; IRP Capital Planning

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Uniform System of Accounts Code
attributes.description: The FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USOA) account code to which this invoice expenditure is classified (e.g., Account 501 for fuel, Account 920 for administrative salaries, Account 107 for construction work in progress). Mandatory for FERC Form 1 annual report filing and rate case cost-of-service studies.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101); FERC Form 1

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (MONAT, 1–16 including special periods) within the fiscal year in which the invoice is posted in SAP FI. Used for monthly close, period-end accruals, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (GJAHR) in which this invoice is recorded in SAP FI. Used for annual financial reporting, FERC Form 1 submissions, rate case cost-of-service studies, and CAPEX/OPEX budget tracking.
attributes.references: SAP FI RBKP.GJAHR; FERC Form 1; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The total gross amount of the invoice before tax deductions or discounts, as stated on the vendor's invoice (WRBTR in SAP). Represents the base amount for payment terms calculation, CAPEX/OPEX budget consumption, and cash flow planning.
attributes.references: SAP FI RBKP.WRBTR; FASB ASC 420; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: invoice_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the goods or services invoiced, as entered in the SAP invoice header text (SGTXT). Provides context for the expenditure, supports spend analytics, and aids in dispute resolution and audit inquiries.
attributes.references: SAP FI RBKP.SGTXT; FERC Form 1 Expense Documentation

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The externally-assigned invoice document number as provided by the vendor or generated by SAP FI (BELNR field). Serves as the primary business identifier for cross-referencing with vendor remittance and payment advice documents.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO RBKP.BELNR; FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations

attributes.name: invoice_receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the vendor invoice was received and entered into SAP (CPUDT/CPUTM in RBKP). Marks the start of the AP invoice lifecycle. Used for cycle time measurement (receipt to payment), early payment discount eligibility, and accrual management.
attributes.references: SAP FI RBKP.CPUDT/CPUTM; FASB ASC 420; SOX AP Controls

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the AP invoice through its full lifecycle: received (entered into SAP), under_review (three-way match or approval in progress), approved (cleared for payment), blocked (payment block set — e.g., price variance, quantity discrepancy), paid (payment executed), cancelled (voided). Drives AP aging, cash flow forecasting, and audit trails.
attributes.references: SAP FI RBKP.RBSTAT; SOX Section 302/404; FASB ASC 420

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice document type in SAP FI (BLART). Distinguishes standard vendor invoices, credit memos (vendor returns/adjustments), debit memos, recurring invoices (e.g., lease payments), prepayments, and employee expense reimbursements. Drives accounting treatment and payment processing logic.
attributes.references: SAP FI T003.BLART; FASB ASC 420; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: is_intercompany
attributes.description: Indicates whether this invoice represents a transaction between two legal entities within the same utility holding company group (e.g., shared services charges, intercompany fuel transfers, corporate allocations). True = intercompany invoice requiring elimination in consolidated financial statements.
attributes.references: SAP FI Intercompany Processing (OBYA); FASB ASC 810 Consolidation; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: is_recurring
attributes.description: Indicates whether this invoice is part of a recurring payment schedule (e.g., monthly lease payments, standing purchase orders for O&M services, recurring software subscriptions). True = recurring invoice generated from an SAP recurring document template. Supports cash flow forecasting and accrual automation.
attributes.references: SAP FI Recurring Document (FBD1); FASB ASC 420

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this AP invoice record in the source system. Tracks changes such as payment block updates, approval status changes, or payment clearing. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP FI Change Document Log; SOX Section 302/404 Audit Trail

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The net payable amount after tax and any applicable discounts (gross_amount minus discounts, plus tax where applicable). Represents the actual cash outflow obligation to the vendor. Used for payment execution, cash flow management, and bank reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP FI RBKP; FASB ASC 420; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: payment_block_code
attributes.description: SAP payment block indicator (ZLSPR) that prevents the invoice from being selected in the automatic payment program run. Common block reasons: price variance exceeds tolerance, quantity discrepancy, missing goods receipt, manual hold pending approval, disputed invoice. Null if no block is set. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: price_variance|quantity_discrepancy|missing_gr|manual_hold|disputed|duplicate_check — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP FI BSIK.ZLSPR; SOX Section 302/404 AP Controls

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which payment was executed and the invoice was cleared in SAP FI (AUGDT). Used for cash flow reporting, bank reconciliation, days payable outstanding (DPO) calculation, and FERC Form 1 cash disbursement reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI BSAK.AUGDT; FASB ASC 230; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: payment_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP FI accounting document number generated upon payment execution (clearing document AUGBL). Used to link the open AP invoice item to its clearing payment entry in the general ledger for bank reconciliation and audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP FI BSAK.AUGBL; FASB ASC 230 Cash Flow Statements

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method used to disburse payment to the vendor (ZLSCH in SAP Automatic Payment Program): ACH (Automated Clearing House electronic transfer), check (paper check), wire (domestic/international wire transfer), virtual_card (single-use virtual procurement card), eft (electronic funds transfer). Drives bank reconciliation and payment run configuration.
attributes.references: SAP FI F110 Automatic Payment Program (ZLSCH); NACHA ACH Rules; FASB ASC 230 Cash Flow

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: The SAP payment terms key (ZTERM) defining the payment due date calculation, early payment discount periods, and installment schedules (e.g., NT30 = net 30 days, 2/10NT30 = 2% discount if paid within 10 days, net 30). Drives due date calculation and cash flow forecasting.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the invoice was posted to the SAP general ledger (BUDAT). Determines the fiscal period and year for CAPEX/OPEX recognition, regulatory asset accounting under FASB ASC 980, and FERC Form 1 period reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI RBKP.BUDAT; FASB ASC 980; FERC Form 1 Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: procurement_category
attributes.description: Business category of goods or services procured, aligned to the utility's spend taxonomy: fuel procurement (coal, gas, nuclear fuel), T&D materials, contractor/construction services, equipment purchases, IT services, professional services, O&M supplies, etc. Supports spend analytics, supplier management, and regulatory cost allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fuel|materials|contractor_services|equipment|it_services|professional_services|om_supplies|employee_expense — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP MM Material Group (MARA.MATKL); FERC Form 1 Operating Expense Classification

attributes.name: sap_document_number
attributes.description: The internal SAP FI accounting document number (BELNR) assigned upon invoice posting in the general ledger. Used for reconciliation between the AP subledger and the general ledger in SAP FI/CO.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO RBKP.BELNR; FERC Form 1 Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The total tax amount (sales tax, use tax, VAT) calculated on the invoice (WMWST in SAP). Tracked separately for tax compliance reporting, recoverable vs. non-recoverable tax treatment, and regulatory cost allocation in rate cases.
attributes.references: SAP FI RBKP.WMWST; IRS Tax Compliance; State PUC Tax Treatment Rules

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The SAP tax code (MWSKZ) applied to the invoice for sales/use tax calculation. Determines the applicable tax rate, tax jurisdiction, and whether the tax is recoverable or non-recoverable. Relevant for state and local tax compliance in utility operations.
attributes.references: SAP FI T007A.MWSKZ; IRS Tax Compliance; State PUC Tax Regulations

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Result of the three-way match validation between the Purchase Order (PO), Goods Receipt (GR), and Invoice Receipt (IR) in SAP MM/FI. Indicates whether the invoice quantity and price align within tolerance to the PO and GR. Drives automatic payment release or block assignment. 'not_applicable' for non-PO invoices (e.g., utilities, rent, employee expenses).
attributes.references: SAP MM/FI Invoice Verification (MIRO/MIR7); SOX Section 302/404 Procurement Controls

attributes.name: vendor_invoice_date
attributes.description: The date printed on the vendor's invoice document (BLDAT in SAP). Represents the principal real-world business event date — when the vendor issued the invoice. Used for payment terms calculation and aging analysis.
attributes.references: SAP FI RBKP.BLDAT; FASB ASC 420; FERC Form 1

products.name: ar_transaction
products.description: Accounts receivable transaction records for non-retail-billing receivables including inter-company charges, wholesale energy sales settlements, REC sales proceeds, transmission service revenues, FERC-jurisdictional wheeling charges, and miscellaneous revenue.
