Tracks counterparty, invoice amount, due date, collection status, aging bucket, and write-off history. Complements the billing domain's customer AR for non-retail revenue streams.

attributes.name: ar_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each accounts receivable transaction record in the finance domain. Primary key for the ar_transaction data product.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310 – Receivables; SAP FI-AR Module

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying commercial contract, Power Purchase Agreement (PPA), transmission service agreement, or inter-company agreement that governs this AR transaction. Links to the contract master for terms and pricing validation.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; Allegro ETRM Contract Module; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP CO cost center responsible for the revenue stream associated with this AR transaction. Used for internal cost-of-service allocation and rate case studies.

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the counterparty (customer, wholesale buyer, inter-company entity, or transmission service customer) that owes the receivable. Maps to the SAP FI-AR customer account (KUNNR) for non-retail revenue streams including wholesale energy, REC sales, and FERC-jurisdictional wheeling charges.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.facility. Business justification: Revenue from customers served by a specific facility is tracked per facility for performance reporting.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the general ledger account to which this AR transaction is posted. Determines the revenue or receivable classification in the chart of accounts for FERC Form 1 reporting and FASB ASC 980 regulatory accounting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980; FERC Form 1; SAP FI-GL

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.parcel. Business justification: Revenue transactions are associated with service parcels to support revenue analysis and rate‑case filings.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Net value of credits, discounts, or billing corrections applied to this AR transaction after initial invoicing. Negative values represent credits issued to the counterparty; positive values represent additional charges. Supports dispute resolution and revenue true-up processes.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; SAP FI-AR Credit Memo

attributes.name: aging_bucket
attributes.description: Aging classification of the outstanding AR balance based on the number of days past the due date. Used for bad debt provisioning, collection prioritization, and AR aging reports required for FERC Form 1 and internal financial reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310-10-50; FERC Form 1; SAP FI-AR Aging Report

attributes.name: business_unit_code
attributes.description: SAP organizational unit code identifying the business unit (e.g., Electric Transmission, Gas Distribution, Generation) responsible for the revenue stream associated with this AR transaction. Used for segment reporting and FERC Form 1 functional classification.
attributes.references: SAP FI Organizational Structure; FERC Form 1; FASB ASC 280 – Segment Reporting

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: SAP FI-AR clearing document number assigned when this AR transaction is fully or partially settled against an incoming payment. Enables reconciliation between the AR open item and the corresponding bank receipt or inter-company settlement.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: External contract or agreement reference number (e.g., PPA number, transmission service agreement number, FERC tariff rate schedule reference) associated with this AR transaction. Used for counterparty reconciliation without requiring a join to the contract master.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; Allegro ETRM; FASB ASC 606

attributes.name: counterparty_type
attributes.description: Classification of the counterparty category for this AR transaction. Distinguishes wholesale energy buyers, inter-company entities, RTO/ISO settlement parties, transmission service customers, REC buyers, and miscellaneous non-retail receivables. Drives reporting segmentation for FERC Form 1 and rate case cost-of-service studies.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; FASB ASC 980; SAP FI-AR

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this AR transaction record was first created in the system of record (SAP FI-AR). Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; SAP FI Audit Log

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this AR transaction (e.g., USD for US Dollar). Supports multi-currency reporting for cross-border wholesale energy transactions and PPA settlements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 – Foreign Currency

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: Number of calendar days elapsed since the payment due date for overdue AR transactions. Zero or negative values indicate the transaction is current. Used for collection escalation triggers and bad debt reserve calculations.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the counterparty has formally disputed this AR transaction. True = active dispute in progress; False = no dispute. Triggers dispute management workflow and suspends dunning activity in SAP FI-AR.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Dispute Management; FASB ASC 310

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Categorized reason code for the counterparty dispute on this AR transaction. Used for dispute root cause analysis and resolution tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: billing_error|quantity_dispute|price_dispute|service_not_rendered|contract_terms|duplicate_invoice|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR Dispute Management; FASB ASC 310

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Contractual date by which the counterparty is required to remit payment for this AR transaction. Basis for aging bucket assignment, overdue status determination, and late payment interest calculations per contract terms.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; SAP FI-AR Payment Terms (ZTERM)

attributes.name: dunning_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent dunning (collection notice) was issued to the counterparty for this AR transaction. Used to enforce dunning intervals and track collection activity history.

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Current dunning (collection notice) level assigned to this AR transaction in SAP FI-AR, ranging from 0 (no dunning) to the maximum configured level. Higher levels indicate escalating collection actions. Used to track collection effort intensity.

attributes.name: energy_volume_mwh
attributes.description: Quantity of electrical energy in Megawatt-Hours (MWh) associated with this AR transaction for wholesale energy sales, RTO/ISO settlements, or PPA deliveries. Null for non-energy revenue streams such as REC sales or inter-company charges.

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts code applicable to this AR transaction for regulatory financial reporting. Required for FERC Form 1 electric and gas revenue classification (e.g., Account 440 – Sales of Electricity, Account 456 – Other Electric Revenues).
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101); FERC Form 1

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal accounting period (1–12 for monthly, or 1–4 for quarterly) within the fiscal year in which this AR transaction is posted. Aligns with SAP FI posting period (MONAT) for period-end close and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; FERC Form 1; SAP FI MONAT

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which this AR transaction is recognized for financial reporting purposes. Used for period-end close, FERC Form 1 annual reporting, and EBITDA analysis. Aligns with the SAP FI posting period (GJAHR).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; FERC Form 1; SAP FI GJAHR

attributes.name: intercompany_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this AR transaction represents an inter-company charge between affiliated entities within the utility holding company structure. True = inter-company; False = third-party. Required for inter-company elimination in consolidated financial statements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810 – Consolidation; SAP FI Inter-Company Reconciliation

attributes.name: invoice_amount
attributes.description: Gross billed amount on the AR invoice before any adjustments, credits, or taxes. Represents the total amount owed by the counterparty at the time of invoice issuance. Denominated in the currency specified by currency_code.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; FASB ASC 310; SAP FI-AR

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Externally-known invoice document number assigned to this AR transaction, used for counterparty reconciliation and audit trail. Corresponds to the SAP FI-AR document number (BELNR) for non-retail receivables such as wholesale energy sales, FERC wheeling charges, and inter-company settlements.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AR BELNR; FERC Form 1; FASB ASC 310

attributes.name: lmp_price
attributes.description: Locational Marginal Price (LMP) in $/MWh used to value wholesale energy transactions settled through the RTO/ISO Day-Ahead Market (DAM) or Real-Time Market (RTM). Sourced from the applicable RTO/ISO settlement statement.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2000; RTO/ISO Settlement Statements; Allegro ETRM

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Net receivable amount after applying all adjustments and taxes to the invoice amount (invoice_amount + tax_amount + adjustment_amount). Represents the actual amount expected to be collected from the counterparty. Used for aging analysis and collection reporting.

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Remaining unpaid balance on this AR transaction (net_amount minus paid_amount). Represents the current exposure for collection management and bad debt provisioning. Refreshed upon each payment or adjustment posting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; SAP FI-AR Open Item Management

attributes.name: paid_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative amount received from the counterparty against this AR transaction to date. Used to calculate the outstanding balance and determine partial payment status. Updated upon each payment posting in SAP FI-AR.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; SAP FI-AR Payment Posting

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which full or final payment was received and posted for this AR transaction. Null if the transaction remains open or partially paid. Used for cash flow reporting and days sales outstanding (DSO) analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; SAP FI-AR Clearing Date

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP payment terms key (e.g., NT30, NT45, NT60) defining the contractual payment schedule, discount periods, and due date calculation rules for this AR transaction. Drives automated due date computation in SAP FI-AR.

attributes.name: rate_case_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the applicable General Rate Case (GRC) or FERC rate case docket number under which the revenue rate for this AR transaction was authorized. Used for cost-of-service study support and regulatory compliance documentation.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; State PUC GRC Filings; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: rec_quantity
attributes.description: Number of Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) sold and invoiced in this AR transaction. One REC represents one MWh of electricity generated from a qualifying renewable source. Applicable only to REC sales revenue streams.
attributes.references: EPA Green Power Partnership; State RPS Requirements; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: regulatory_asset_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this AR transaction is associated with a FERC or state PUC-approved regulatory asset or deferred revenue mechanism under FASB ASC 980. True = subject to regulatory accounting treatment; False = standard commercial receivable.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 – Regulated Operations; FERC Form 1; State PUC Orders

attributes.name: revenue_category
attributes.description: Business classification of the revenue type driving this AR transaction. Supports segmented revenue reporting for FERC Form 1, rate case cost-of-service studies, and EBITDA analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: wholesale_energy_sales|transmission_wheeling|rec_sales|intercompany_charge|ppa_settlement|ancillary_services|miscellaneous — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; FASB ASC 606; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: service_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the billing period or service delivery period covered by this AR transaction. Paired with service_period_start to define the revenue recognition window under FASB ASC 606.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; FERC Form 1; SAP FI-AR

attributes.name: service_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the billing period or service delivery period covered by this AR transaction. For wholesale energy sales, this is the start of the energy delivery interval. For transmission wheeling, it is the start of the reservation period. Required for revenue recognition under FASB ASC 606.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606; FERC Form 1; SAP FI-AR

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax charges applied to this AR transaction, including applicable state and federal taxes on wholesale energy sales or transmission services. Part of the monetary triplet supporting net amount calculation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740; SAP FI-AR Tax Determination

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The principal business event date on which the AR transaction was originated — i.e., the date the revenue was earned or the invoice was issued. Used as the basis for aging calculations and revenue recognition under FASB ASC 606.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606 – Revenue Recognition; SAP FI-AR Posting Date

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the AR transaction indicating collection progress. Open = unpaid and within terms; partially_paid = partial payment received; paid = fully settled; overdue = past due date; disputed = counterparty has raised a formal dispute; written_off = deemed uncollectible and removed from active AR.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; SAP FI-AR Status Management

attributes.name: transmission_zone
attributes.description: RTO/ISO transmission pricing zone or load zone associated with this AR transaction for wheeling charges and transmission service revenues. Used for FERC-jurisdictional revenue allocation and FERC Form 1 reporting.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this AR transaction record, including status changes, payment postings, dispute updates, or write-off actions. Supports change data capture in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310; SAP FI Audit Log

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: Amount written off as uncollectible for this AR transaction. May be less than the full outstanding balance if a partial write-off was applied. Used for bad debt reserve reconciliation and FERC Form 1 reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310-10; FERC Form 1; SAP FI-AR

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: Date on which this AR transaction was written off as uncollectible and the bad debt expense was recognized. Null if the transaction has not been written off. Required for FASB ASC 310 impairment disclosure.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310-10; SAP FI-AR Write-Off Posting

attributes.name: write_off_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this AR transaction has been written off as uncollectible. True = written off and removed from active AR; False = still active. Triggers bad debt expense recognition under FASB ASC 310-10.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 310-10 – Receivables Impairment; SAP FI-AR Write-Off

products.name: payment_run
products.description: SAP FI automatic payment program run records capturing batch payment executions for vendor invoices and employee expense reimbursements. Tracks payment run date, payment method (ACH, check, wire), total payment amount, bank account, and individual payment documents generated. Supports treasury cash management and bank reconciliation.

attributes.name: payment_run_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each SAP FI automatic payment program run record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: SAP FI Payment Program (F110); FASB ASC 230 Statement of Cash Flows

attributes.name: approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the supervisor or treasury manager who approved the payment proposal before posting. Enforces dual-control requirements for disbursements above threshold amounts per internal controls policy.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Dual Control; SAP FI Authorization Objects; Internal AP Controls Policy

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: SAP FI bank account identifier (account ID within the house bank) from which disbursements are made. Identifies the specific checking or disbursement account used for this payment run. Classified confidential due to financial account sensitivity.
attributes.references: SAP FI House Bank Account Configuration; PCI DSS; Treasury Cash Management

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary SAP CO cost center associated with this payment run, used for OPEX allocation and cost-of-service studies. Relevant for payment runs covering operational expenditures such as fuel procurement, O&M vendor payments, and workforce expenses.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Accounting; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; Rate Case Cost-of-Service Studies

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the AP/treasury staff member who initiated (scheduled or executed) the payment run in SAP F110. Required for segregation-of-duties controls and SOX audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP FI F110 User Log; SOX Section 404 Segregation of Duties; NERC CIP-004 Personnel

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary GL clearing account used for this payment run's disbursements (e.g., bank clearing account, outgoing payment account). Supports general ledger reconciliation and FERC account mapping.
attributes.references: SAP FI Chart of Accounts; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; FASB ASC 230

attributes.name: house_bank_bank_account_id
attributes.description: SAP FI house bank identifier representing the utility's internal bank master record from which payments are disbursed. Links to the specific bank account used for this payment run, supporting bank reconciliation and cash position reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI House Bank Configuration (FI12); Treasury Cash Management

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trading.trading_portfolio. Business justification: Supports Payment Run Settlement Report linking payments to the trading portfolio that generated the settlement obligations.

attributes.name: reversed_run_payment_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original payment_run_id that this run reverses, if reversal_flag is True. Enables traceability between reversal runs and their originating payment runs for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: SAP FI Payment Reversal; FASB ASC 230; Internal Audit Trail

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment proposal was approved by the authorized approver. Supports segregation-of-duties audit trail and turnaround time analysis for AP processing efficiency.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP FI Workflow Approval Log; Internal AP Controls

attributes.name: bank_account_number_masked
attributes.description: Masked representation of the utility's disbursement bank account number, showing only the last four digits for identification and reconciliation purposes without exposing the full account number. Used in audit reports and bank reconciliation statements.
attributes.references: PCI DSS Requirement 3.4; SAP FI Bank Master Data; FASB ASC 230

attributes.name: bank_file_generated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payment medium file (e.g., ACH NACHA file, SWIFT MT103, check print file) was successfully generated and transmitted to the bank for this payment run. False indicates a file generation failure requiring investigation.
attributes.references: SAP FI Payment Medium Workbench (PMW); NACHA ACH File Format; SWIFT Standards

attributes.name: bank_file_transmission_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment medium file was transmitted to the bank or payment processor. Used for bank reconciliation cutoff determination and exception investigation when payments are not reflected in bank statements.
attributes.references: SAP FI Payment Medium Workbench; NACHA ACH Transmission Rules; Treasury Operations

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: American Bankers Association (ABA) routing transit number of the utility's disbursement bank. Required for ACH and wire payment file generation and bank reconciliation. Nine-digit numeric code.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Operating Rules; Federal Reserve Regulation J; ABA Routing Number Standard

attributes.name: capex_opex_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the disbursements in this payment run are classified as capital expenditures (CAPEX), operating expenditures (OPEX), or a mix of both. Critical for regulatory asset base (RAB) valuation, rate case cost-of-service studies, and FERC Form 1 plant account reporting.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; FASB ASC 360 Property Plant and Equipment; FASB ASC 980; Rate Case Cost-of-Service Studies

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payment run record was first captured in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and record management.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 230; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail Requirements; NIST SP 800-53 Audit and Accountability

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this payment run (e.g., 'USD'). Utility operations are predominantly USD; this field supports multi-currency scenarios for cross-border energy trading settlements or foreign vendor payments.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FERC Form 1; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total cash discount amount captured across all payment documents in this run, representing early payment discounts (e.g., 2/10 net 30 terms) taken from vendor invoices. Reduces the net payment amount and is posted to a discount revenue GL account.
attributes.references: SAP FI Cash Discount Processing; FASB ASC 835 Interest; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: docs_entered_up_to_date
attributes.description: SAP F110 parameter specifying the latest document entry date for invoices to be considered in this payment run. Ensures only invoices entered into SAP by this cutoff date are included, supporting period-close controls.
attributes.references: SAP FI F110 Selection Parameters; Period-Close Controls

attributes.name: document_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual payment documents (FI payment postings) generated by this payment run. Each document represents a payment to a single vendor or employee. Used for run validation, exception monitoring, and audit completeness checks.
attributes.references: SAP FI F110 Payment Run Log; Internal Audit Controls

attributes.name: exception_count
attributes.description: Number of vendor invoices or payment items that were excluded from this payment run due to exceptions (e.g., payment block, missing bank details, duplicate invoice flag, credit hold). Drives AP exception resolution workflow.
attributes.references: SAP FI F110 Exception Log; Accounts Payable Controls; Internal Audit

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts code associated with the primary expenditure category of this payment run (e.g., Account 920 for administrative salaries, Account 151 for fuel stock). Supports FERC Form 1 regulatory reporting and rate case cost allocation.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101); FERC Form 1; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: SAP FI fiscal period (1–12 for monthly, or 1–13 for 13-period calendars) within the fiscal year in which this payment run is posted. Supports period-close cash disbursement reporting and budget-to-actual variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP FI Fiscal Period Configuration; FERC Form 1 Monthly Reporting

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: SAP FI fiscal year in which this payment run's disbursements are recorded. Used for annual financial reporting, FERC Form 1 filing, and CAPEX/OPEX budget variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP FI Fiscal Year Configuration; FERC Form 1; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: gross_payment_amount
attributes.description: Total gross disbursement amount for all payment documents included in this payment run before application of discounts or deductions. Represents the sum of all vendor invoice and expense reimbursement amounts selected for payment. Used for cash flow forecasting and bank reconciliation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 230 Statement of Cash Flows; FERC Form 1 Disbursements; SAP FI F110

attributes.name: invoice_count
attributes.description: Total number of vendor invoices and expense reimbursement line items cleared (paid) by this payment run. A single payment document may clear multiple invoices; this count reflects the total open items settled.
attributes.references: SAP FI Open Item Management; Accounts Payable Controls; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this payment run record in the Silver Layer. Tracks status changes, corrections, and reversals for audit and data quality monitoring.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NIST SP 800-53; SAP FI Change Document Log

attributes.name: net_payment_amount
attributes.description: Net total amount actually disbursed in this payment run after deducting cash discounts and other adjustments from the gross payment amount. This is the actual cash outflow recorded in the treasury cash position and bank statement.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 230 Statement of Cash Flows; SAP FI F110 Payment Run Summary; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: next_payment_date
attributes.description: The 'next payment date' parameter used in the SAP F110 payment proposal to determine which open invoices are due for payment. Invoices with a due date on or before this date are selected for inclusion in the run.
attributes.references: SAP FI F110 Selection Parameters; Accounts Payable Payment Terms

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the AP/treasury team describing special circumstances, exceptions, or instructions for this payment run (e.g., 'Emergency payment for critical grid equipment supplier', 'Held pending PO approval'). Supports operational communication and audit documentation.
attributes.references: SAP FI F110 Notes Field; Internal AP Controls

attributes.name: paying_company_code
attributes.description: SAP FI company code of the legal entity initiating the payment run. For a utility with multiple regulated subsidiaries (electric vs. gas), this identifies which legal entity's bank account and chart of accounts are used. Aligns with FERC jurisdictional entity reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI Company Code Configuration; FERC Form 1 Entity Identification; FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations

attributes.name: payment_method_code
attributes.description: SAP FI payment method code indicating the instrument used to disburse funds (e.g., ACH for Automated Clearing House, CHECK for paper check, WIRE for wire transfer, EFT for electronic funds transfer). Drives bank file format generation and clearing account determination.
attributes.references: SAP FI Payment Method Configuration (FBZP); NACHA ACH Rules; Federal Reserve Wire Transfer Regulations

attributes.name: payment_posted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment documents were posted in SAP FI, creating the actual accounting entries and clearing the open vendor items. This is the principal business event timestamp for the payment run lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP FI F110 Payment Posting Log; FASB ASC 230; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: payment_program_variant
attributes.description: SAP FI F110 program variant name that defines the selection parameters for this payment run (e.g., company codes, payment methods, next payment date, vendor selection criteria). Stored for audit traceability and run reproducibility.
attributes.references: SAP FI F110 Variant Configuration; Internal AP Controls

attributes.name: payment_run_category
attributes.description: Business category of the payables being settled in this run. Distinguishes vendor invoice payments (CAPEX/OPEX procurement), employee expense reimbursements, intercompany settlements, tax remittances, and regulatory fee payments (e.g., FERC filing fees, PUC assessments).
attributes.references: SAP FI Document Type Configuration; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: payment_run_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment run by its business purpose. 'regular' denotes scheduled weekly/bi-weekly AP runs; 'off_cycle' denotes ad-hoc runs outside the standard schedule; 'emergency' denotes urgent disbursements; 'reversal' denotes runs created to reverse prior payments.
attributes.references: SAP FI F110 Configuration; Treasury Cash Management Policy; Internal AP Controls

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: SAP FI accounting posting date for the payment documents generated by this run. Determines the fiscal period in which the cash disbursement is recorded in the general ledger. May differ from run_date for period-end processing.
attributes.references: SAP FI Posting Date Rules; FASB ASC 230; FERC Form 1 Period Reporting

attributes.name: proposal_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the SAP F110 payment proposal was generated. The proposal lists all invoices selected for payment before final posting. Supports audit trail and approval workflow timing.
attributes.references: SAP FI F110 Payment Proposal Log; Internal AP Controls; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment run has been reversed (voided) in SAP FI. A reversal cancels the original payment postings and reopens the cleared vendor invoices. Critical for bank reconciliation and fraud detection.
attributes.references: SAP FI Payment Reversal (FBRA); FASB ASC 230; Internal Controls

attributes.name: run_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the SAP FI automatic payment program (F110) was executed. This is the principal business event date used for treasury cash management, bank reconciliation, and period-close reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI Transaction F110; FASB ASC 230; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: run_identification_key
attributes.description: SAP FI run identification key (Identification field in F110) that, together with run_date, uniquely identifies the payment run within SAP. Typically a short alphanumeric code assigned by the AP/treasury team (e.g., 'AP01', 'WIRE1').
attributes.references: SAP FI Transaction F110 Parameter Screen

attributes.name: run_number
attributes.description: Externally-known SAP FI payment run identifier, typically composed of the run date and run identification key (e.g., '20240115-AP01'). Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trail references.
attributes.references: SAP FI Transaction F110; FERC Form 1 Cash Disbursements

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment run, tracking progression from scheduling through proposal creation, approval, posting, and completion. Supports treasury workflow monitoring and exception management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|proposal_created|proposal_approved|payment_posted|payment_completed|cancelled|error — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP FI F110 Payment Run Lifecycle; FASB ASC 230

attributes.name: utility_type
attributes.description: Identifies whether this payment run relates to the electric utility operations, gas utility operations, or combined operations. Supports jurisdictional cost separation required for separate electric and gas rate cases filed with state PUCs and FERC.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1 (Electric); FERC Form 2 (Gas); State PUC Rate Case Filing Requirements; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: Bank value date (settlement date) on which funds are expected to be debited from the utility's bank account. Used for cash position management and bank reconciliation. For ACH, typically one business day after run_date; for wire, same day.
attributes.references: SAP FI Bank Value Date; NACHA ACH Settlement Rules; Federal Reserve Regulation CC

attributes.name: vendor_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct vendors (and/or employees for expense reimbursements) included in this payment run. Used for payment run sizing analysis, bank file validation, and AP workload reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI Vendor Master; Accounts Payable Operations

products.name: financial_statement
products.description: Periodic financial statement records (balance sheet, income statement, statement of cash flows) prepared for internal management reporting, board reporting, SEC filings, and regulatory submissions including FERC Form 1 and state PUC annual reports. Captures statement type, reporting period, entity/segment, and GAAP vs. regulatory basis indicators.

attributes.name: financial_statement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each financial statement record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this financial statement was formally approved by management or the board of directors. Marks the transition from under_review to approved status and is required for SOX audit trail documentation.

attributes.name: auditor_opinion_type
attributes.description: The type of independent auditor opinion issued on this financial statement: unqualified (clean opinion), qualified (with exceptions), adverse (materially misstated), disclaimer (auditor unable to form opinion), or not_yet_audited (interim statements). Required for SEC annual filings and FERC Form 1.
attributes.references: PCAOB AS 3101, SEC Regulation S-X Rule 2-02, FERC Form 1

attributes.name: capex_amt
attributes.description: Total capital expenditures for the reporting period as reported in the statement of cash flows (investing activities). Includes additions to utility plant in service, Construction Work in Progress (CWIP), and capital project spending. Critical for CAPEX tracking against approved capital budgets and rate case plant additions.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 230, FERC Form 1, State PUC CAPEX Filings

attributes.name: comparative_period_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this statement record represents a comparative prior-period presentation (True) or the current reporting period (False). GAAP and FERC require prior-period comparatives in annual filings; this flag enables correct pairing of current and comparative records.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 205, SEC Regulation S-X Rule 3-02, FERC Form 1

attributes.name: consolidation_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the statement presents consolidated financials (all subsidiaries included with intercompany eliminations), standalone entity financials, combined financials (multiple entities without full consolidation), or a business segment view. Critical for multi-entity utility holding company structures.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810 Consolidation, FERC Form 1, SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this financial statement record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Supports audit trail, data lineage tracking, and SOX internal control documentation.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 404, NIST SP 800-53 Audit and Accountability

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts reported in this financial statement (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency reporting for utilities with international operations or cross-border energy trading activities.

attributes.name: depreciation_amortization_amt
attributes.description: Total depreciation and amortization expense for the reporting period as reported on the income statement. Includes depreciation of utility plant in service and amortization of regulatory assets. Critical component of EBITDA calculation and rate case depreciation studies.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360, FERC Form 1, State PUC Depreciation Studies

attributes.name: ebitda_amt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) Amount
attributes.description: Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization (EBITDA) for the reporting period. Derived from operating income plus depreciation and amortization. Key performance metric for management reporting, board presentations, and credit rating agency analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 220, SEC Non-GAAP Disclosure Guidance, Internal Management Reporting

attributes.name: ferc_form_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Form Number
attributes.description: Identifies the FERC annual report form associated with this financial statement filing: Form 1 (major electric utilities), Form 2 (major natural gas companies), Form 3 (non-major natural gas companies), Form 6 (oil pipeline companies), Form 60 (centralized service companies). Null for non-FERC filings.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1, FERC Form 2, 18 CFR Part 141

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: The date on which this financial statement was filed with the applicable regulatory body (FERC, state PUC, or SEC). Used to confirm compliance with statutory filing deadlines (e.g., FERC Form 1 due April 18, SEC Form 10-K due 60/75/90 days after fiscal year end).
attributes.references: FERC Form 1 Filing Deadline, SEC Regulation S-X, State PUC Annual Report Requirements

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month number 1–12) within the fiscal year for interim statements. Null for annual statements. Supports monthly and quarterly management reporting cycles.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 270 Interim Reporting, SAP FI/CO

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter (1–4) to which this statement pertains. Populated for quarterly filings (e.g., SEC Form 10-Q). Null for monthly or annual statements.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this financial statement pertains (e.g., 2024). For utilities, the fiscal year typically aligns with the calendar year per FERC reporting requirements.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1, FASB ASC 270, SAP FI/CO

attributes.name: income_tax_expense_amt
attributes.description: Total income tax expense (current and deferred) for the reporting period. Includes Accumulated Deferred Income Taxes (ADIT) movements relevant to rate base calculations under FASB ASC 980 regulatory accounting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740, FASB ASC 980, FERC Form 1

attributes.name: interest_expense_amt
attributes.description: Total interest and debt service expense for the reporting period, including interest on long-term debt, short-term borrowings, and Allowance for Funds Used During Construction (AFUDC) offsets. Used in EBITDA reconciliation and Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC) calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 835, FERC Form 1, State PUC Rate Case Filings

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the regulatory jurisdiction under which this statement is filed (e.g., FERC for federal, or state abbreviation such as CA, TX, NY for state PUC filings). Enables jurisdiction-specific regulatory accounting treatment and rate case cost-of-service allocation.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1, State PUC Annual Reports, FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: long_term_debt_amt
attributes.description: Total long-term debt outstanding as reported on the balance sheet, including first mortgage bonds, senior notes, and other long-term borrowings. Used in capital structure analysis for rate case WACC and debt ratio calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 470, FERC Form 1, State PUC Rate Case Filings

attributes.name: net_income_amt
attributes.description: Net income (loss) for the reporting period as reported on the income statement after all revenues, expenses, taxes, and non-operating items. Key metric for board reporting, SEC filings, and ROE calculations in rate case proceedings.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 220, FERC Form 1, SEC Form 10-K

attributes.name: operating_cash_flow_amt
attributes.description: Net cash provided by (used in) operating activities as reported on the statement of cash flows. Reflects the utility's ability to generate cash from core operations to fund capital investment and debt service.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 230, FERC Form 1, SEC Form 10-K

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the reporting period covered by this financial statement (e.g., 2024-12-31 for an annual statement). For balance sheets, this is the as-of date for all reported balances.

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the reporting period covered by this financial statement (e.g., 2024-01-01 for an annual statement). Used to define the precise time window for income statement and cash flow statement line items.

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Specifies the duration and aggregation type of the reporting period covered by this statement. Distinguishes between periodic snapshots (monthly, quarterly, annual) and cumulative views (year-to-date, trailing twelve months) used in management reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 270, FERC Form 1, SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: prepared_by
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the financial analyst or accountant who prepared this financial statement. Supports audit trail and SOX internal control documentation requirements.

attributes.name: rate_case_docket_number
attributes.description: The regulatory docket or case number assigned by the PUC or FERC to the rate case proceeding for which this financial statement serves as supporting evidence. Links the financial statement to a specific General Rate Case (GRC) or rate case filing. Null if not associated with a rate case.
attributes.references: State PUC Rate Case Filings, FERC Docket Management, FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: regulatory_assets_amt
attributes.description: Total regulatory assets recognized on the balance sheet under FASB ASC 980 rate-regulated accounting. Represents costs deferred for future recovery in rates (e.g., deferred storm costs, pension regulatory assets, unamortized debt issuance costs). Key component of the Regulatory Asset Base (RAB).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations, FERC Form 1, State PUC Rate Case Filings

attributes.name: regulatory_liabilities_amt
attributes.description: Total regulatory liabilities recognized on the balance sheet under FASB ASC 980, representing amounts collected in rates that are owed back to customers (e.g., excess deferred income taxes from Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, over-collected fuel costs). Offsets rate base in regulatory proceedings.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations, FERC Form 1, State PUC Rate Case Filings

attributes.name: reporting_basis
attributes.description: Indicates the accounting basis under which the statement is prepared. GAAP = U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles; regulatory = rate-regulated basis per FASB ASC 980 (includes regulatory assets/liabilities); IFRS = International Financial Reporting Standards; management = internal management reporting basis. Critical for distinguishing FERC regulatory filings from SEC GAAP filings.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations, FERC Form 1, SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: reporting_unit
attributes.description: Specifies the unit in which monetary amounts are expressed in this statement (e.g., dollars, thousands, millions). FERC Form 1 requires reporting in thousands of dollars; SEC filings may use millions. Prevents misinterpretation of reported figures.

attributes.name: restatement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this financial statement is a restatement of a previously filed statement (True) due to a material error correction or accounting change. Triggers additional disclosure requirements under FASB ASC 250 and SEC restatement reporting rules.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 250 Accounting Changes and Error Corrections, SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: restatement_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the reason for restatement when restatement_flag is True (e.g., correction of regulatory asset classification error, change in depreciation method, prior period adjustment). Required for FASB ASC 250 disclosure and SEC restatement filings. Null when restatement_flag is False.

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the controller, CFO, or designated reviewer who reviewed and approved this financial statement. Required for SOX Section 302 CEO/CFO certification and internal control documentation.

attributes.name: sap_company_code
attributes.description: The SAP FI/CO company code corresponding to the legal entity for which this financial statement is prepared. Enables direct traceability from the lakehouse silver layer back to the SAP general ledger source system.

attributes.name: statement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the financial statement, typically assigned by the financial reporting system (e.g., SAP FI document number or reporting package reference). Used for traceability across reporting cycles.

attributes.name: statement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the financial statement. Draft = in preparation; under_review = submitted for internal review; approved = signed off by management/board; filed = submitted to regulatory body (FERC, PUC, SEC); restated = previously filed statement that has been corrected; superseded = replaced by a newer version.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 250 Accounting Changes, SEC Regulation S-X, FERC Form 1

attributes.name: statement_type
attributes.description: Classifies the financial statement as one of the four primary financial statement types: balance sheet (statement of financial position), income statement (statement of operations), statement of cash flows, or statement of changes in equity. Drives downstream report formatting and validation rules.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 205, FERC Form 1, SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: total_assets_amt
attributes.description: Total assets as reported on the balance sheet for this entity and period. Represents the sum of all utility plant (net), current assets, regulatory assets, and other assets. Key metric for Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) valuation and rate case filings.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 210, FERC Form 1 Schedule of Utility Plant, FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: total_equity_amt
attributes.description: Total shareholders equity (common equity plus preferred equity) as reported on the balance sheet. Used in Return on Equity (ROE) calculations for rate case filings and board financial reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 505, FERC Form 1, State PUC Rate Case Filings

attributes.name: total_liabilities_amt
attributes.description: Total liabilities as reported on the balance sheet, including long-term debt, current liabilities, regulatory liabilities, deferred income taxes (ADIT), and other obligations. Used in capital structure analysis for rate case ROE and WACC calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 210, FERC Form 1, FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: total_opex_amt
attributes.description: Total operating and maintenance (O&M) expenses as reported on the income statement, including fuel costs, purchased power, transmission, distribution, customer service, and administrative expenses. Key input for OPEX tracking and rate case cost-of-service studies.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360, FERC Form 1, State PUC Rate Case Filings

attributes.name: total_revenue_amt
attributes.description: Total operating revenues as reported on the income statement, including electric revenues, gas revenues, and other operating revenues. Primary top-line metric for EBITDA reporting, rate case revenue requirement studies, and FERC Form 1 Schedule of Revenues.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 606, FERC Form 1, State PUC Annual Reports

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this financial statement record was last modified in the lakehouse silver layer. Tracks revisions during the review and approval workflow and supports incremental data pipeline processing.

attributes.name: utility_plant_net_amt
attributes.description: Net utility plant in service (gross plant less accumulated depreciation) as reported on the balance sheet. The largest asset category for a regulated utility and the primary driver of the Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) and rate base calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360, FERC Form 1 Schedule of Utility Plant, State PUC Rate Case Filings

attributes.name: utility_type
attributes.description: Identifies the utility service type covered by this financial statement: electric, gas, combined electric and gas, or other. Supports FERC Form 1 (electric) vs. FERC Form 2 (gas) filing segregation and state PUC rate case cost-of-service studies by utility segment.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1, FERC Form 2, State PUC Annual Reports

products.name: tax_provision
products.description: Income tax provision and deferred tax records capturing current tax expense, deferred tax expense, effective tax rate reconciliation, and accumulated deferred income taxes (ADIT) by jurisdiction and legal entity. Tracks IRS normalization requirements for regulated utilities, excess ADIT balances subject to ARAM (Average Rate Assumption Method) amortization per Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, state/federal tax apportionment factors, and PUC-ordered rate base ADIT offsets. Essential for rate case revenue requirement calculations and FERC Form 1 tax reporting.

attributes.name: tax_provision_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each income tax provision record in the lakehouse Silver layer. Primary key for the tax_provision data product.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740 Income Taxes; SAP FI/CO Tax Ledger

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Tax Provision references GL Account for tax calculations; FK replaces code.

attributes.name: adit_beginning_balance_amt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Accumulated Deferred Income Tax (ADIT) Beginning Balance Amount
attributes.description: Opening balance of accumulated deferred income taxes (ADIT) for the period. ADIT is a regulatory liability/asset on the rate base that offsets the utility's rate base per PUC orders. Critical for rate case revenue requirement and FERC Form 1 reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740; FASB ASC 980; FERC Form 1 Account 190/281/282/283; IRS Normalization Rules IRC §168(i)(9)

attributes.name: adit_ending_balance_amt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Accumulated Deferred Income Tax (ADIT) Ending Balance Amount
attributes.description: Closing balance of accumulated deferred income taxes (ADIT) for the period after current-period deferred tax expense/benefit and ARAM amortization. Used directly in rate base calculations as a rate base offset per PUC-ordered treatment.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740; FASB ASC 980; FERC Form 1 Account 190/281/282/283; State PUC Rate Case Orders

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the tax department manager or controller who approved this tax provision record. Required for SOX Section 404 internal control documentation and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; FASB ASC 740; SAP FI/CO Workflow Approval

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tax provision record received final approval from the authorized approver. Part of the SOX-compliant review and approval workflow for income tax accounting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; FASB ASC 740; SAP FI/CO Document Approval Date

attributes.name: aram_amortization_amt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Rate Assumption Method (ARAM) Amortization Amount
attributes.description: The period amortization of excess ADIT under the Average Rate Assumption Method (ARAM) as required by IRS normalization rules and FERC Order 849. Represents the amount of excess ADIT returned to customers through rate reductions in the current period.
attributes.references: IRS Notice 2018-59; IRC §168(i)(9); FERC Order 849; Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA) 2017; State PUC TCJA Compliance Orders

attributes.name: bonus_depreciation_amt
attributes.description: Additional first-year bonus depreciation claimed under IRC §168(k) for qualifying utility property placed in service during the period. Creates large temporary differences and accelerates ADIT accumulation. Subject to IRS normalization rules for regulated utilities.
attributes.references: IRS IRC §168(k); Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA) 2017; IRS Normalization Rules IRC §168(i)(9); FERC Order 849

attributes.name: book_depreciation_amt
attributes.description: Total GAAP straight-line depreciation for the period as recorded in SAP FI/CO asset accounting. Compared against tax depreciation to compute the accelerated depreciation temporary difference driving the deferred tax liability.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 360; FERC Uniform System of Accounts; SAP FI/CO Asset Accounting (AA)

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: The accounting method used to compute the income tax provision: asset_liability (balance sheet approach per ASC 740), deferred (income statement approach, legacy), or flow_through (used for certain regulatory assets per ASC 980-740). Regulated utilities may use flow-through for specific items per PUC order.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740-10-25; FASB ASC 980-740; State PUC Normalization Orders

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP FI/CO cost center code to which the income tax expense is allocated. Used for segment-level tax expense reporting and rate case cost-of-service allocation by utility function (electric, gas, common).
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Controlling (CO-CCA); FERC Form 1 Functional Classification

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this tax provision record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX internal control requirements. Sourced from SAP FI/CO document creation timestamp.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 740; SAP FI/CO Document Header

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this record (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency consolidation for entities with foreign operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency; SAP FI/CO Currency Configuration

attributes.name: current_tax_expense_amt
attributes.description: The portion of total income tax expense attributable to taxes currently payable or refundable for the period. Represents the estimated tax liability on the current-year tax return before deferred items.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740-10-30; IRS Form 1120; FERC Form 1 Schedule of Taxes

attributes.name: deferred_tax_asset_amt
attributes.description: Gross deferred tax asset balance representing future tax benefits from deductible temporary differences (e.g., pension obligations, asset retirement obligations, regulatory liabilities). Before valuation allowance offset.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740-10-30; FERC Form 1 Account 190; SAP FI/CO Deferred Tax Balance Sheet Account

attributes.name: deferred_tax_expense_amt
attributes.description: The portion of total income tax expense attributable to temporary differences between book and tax basis of assets and liabilities. Positive value indicates deferred tax expense; negative indicates deferred tax benefit.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740-10-30; FERC Form 1 Schedule of Taxes; IRS Normalization Rules IRC §168(i)(9)

attributes.name: deferred_tax_liability_amt
attributes.description: Gross deferred tax liability balance representing future tax obligations from taxable temporary differences (e.g., accelerated MACRS depreciation on utility plant, AFUDC equity). Primary driver of ADIT balance for regulated utilities.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740-10-30; FERC Form 1 Account 281/282/283; IRS MACRS Depreciation; IRC §168

attributes.name: effective_tax_rate
attributes.description: The ratio of total income tax expense to pre-tax book income, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2100 for 21%). Used in rate case cost-of-service studies and investor reporting. Computed as total_tax_expense_amt / pretax_income_amt.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740-10-50; FERC Form 1; State PUC Rate Case Filings

attributes.name: excess_adit_amt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Excess Accumulated Deferred Income Tax (Excess ADIT) Amount
attributes.description: The excess ADIT balance arising from the reduction in the federal corporate tax rate under the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA) of 2017. Subject to ARAM (Average Rate Assumption Method) amortization and must be returned to customers per IRS normalization rules and PUC orders.
attributes.references: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA) 2017; IRS Notice 2018-59; IRC §168(i)(9); FERC Order 849; State PUC TCJA Compliance Orders

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts code associated with this tax provision record (e.g., Account 190 for deferred income taxes — other, Account 281/282/283 for accumulated deferred income taxes). Required for FERC Form 1 annual report filing.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts 18 CFR Part 101; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (1–12 for monthly, or 1–4 for quarterly) within the fiscal year to which this provision record applies. Supports interim period tax accounting per FASB ASC 740-270.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740-270 Interim Reporting; SAP FI/CO Posting Period

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (e.g., 2024) to which this tax provision record applies. Used for period-over-period comparison, rate case cost-of-service studies, and FERC Form 1 annual reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740; FERC Form 1; SAP FI/CO Fiscal Year Variant

attributes.name: interest_on_utp_amt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Interest on Uncertain Tax Position (UTP) Amount
attributes.description: Accrued interest expense on uncertain tax position reserves. Classified as income tax expense or interest expense per the entity's accounting policy election under ASC 740-10-45-25.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740-10-45-25; IRS IRC §6601 Interest on Underpayments

attributes.name: investment_tax_credit_amt
attributes.description: Deferred investment tax credit balance for regulated utilities that defer and amortize ITC over the life of the related asset per the deferral method (FASB ASC 980-740). Distinct from current-period ITC flow-through. Tracked separately for normalization compliance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980-740; IRS IRC §48; FERC Form 1 Account 255; IRS Normalization Rules

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the taxing jurisdiction (e.g., US-FED for federal, US-CA for California, US-TX for Texas). Drives apportionment factor application and state/federal tax rate differentiation.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 542; State PUC Filings; FERC Form 1 Tax Schedule

attributes.name: jurisdiction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the taxing authority level: federal (IRS), state (state revenue department), local (municipal), or foreign. Determines applicable tax code, rate schedules, and regulatory reporting requirements.
attributes.references: IRS Internal Revenue Code; FASB ASC 740-10; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this tax provision record was most recently modified. Tracks revisions to provision calculations, true-up adjustments, and amended filings. Essential for Silver layer incremental load processing and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 740; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

attributes.name: legal_entity_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the legal entity (subsidiary or consolidated parent) for which the tax provision is computed. Aligns with SAP company code structure and FERC Form 1 respondent entity.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Company Code; FERC Form 1; FASB ASC 740-10-15

attributes.name: net_operating_loss_carryforward_amt
attributes.description: Cumulative net operating loss carryforward balance available to offset future taxable income. Post-TCJA, federal NOLs are carried forward indefinitely but limited to 80% of taxable income. Generates a deferred tax asset subject to valuation allowance assessment.
attributes.references: IRS IRC §172; Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA) 2017; FASB ASC 740-10-30

attributes.name: normalization_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax provision record is in compliance with IRS normalization requirements for regulated utilities (IRC §168(i)(9)). Non-compliance can result in loss of accelerated depreciation benefits. Monitored for FERC and PUC regulatory filings.
attributes.references: IRS IRC §168(i)(9); IRS Notice 2018-59; FERC Order 849; State PUC Normalization Orders

attributes.name: penalties_on_utp_amt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Penalties on Uncertain Tax Position (UTP) Amount
attributes.description: Accrued tax penalties associated with uncertain tax positions. Classified as income tax expense per the entity's accounting policy election. Monitored for rate case disallowance risk.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740-10-45-25; IRS IRC §6662 Accuracy-Related Penalties

attributes.name: permanent_difference_amt
attributes.description: Net permanent differences between book income and taxable income that never reverse (e.g., tax-exempt interest, non-deductible penalties, AFUDC equity component). Key reconciling item in the effective tax rate reconciliation schedule.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740-10-50-12; IRS Internal Revenue Code; FERC Form 1 ETR Reconciliation

attributes.name: pretax_income_amt
attributes.description: Total book income (GAAP) before income tax expense for the period and jurisdiction. Starting point for the effective tax rate reconciliation and current/deferred tax expense computation. Sourced from SAP FI/CO profit center reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740-10-30; FERC Form 1 Income Statement; SAP FI/CO Profit Center Ledger

attributes.name: provision_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the income tax provision was calculated and recorded. Represents the principal business event date for this transaction record. Typically the last day of the fiscal period.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740; SAP FI/CO Posting Date

attributes.name: provision_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the tax provision record, typically sourced from SAP FI/CO tax calculation run (e.g., TP-2024-FED-Q4). Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP FI/CO Tax Module; FERC Form 1 Schedule; FASB ASC 740

attributes.name: provision_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the tax provision record: draft (initial calculation), under_review (tax department review), approved (CFO/controller sign-off), filed (included in tax return), amended (restated), or closed (finalized and archived).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740; SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; SAP FI/CO Document Status

attributes.name: provision_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the provision calculation: annual (year-end), interim quarterly or monthly (ASC 740-270 estimated annual effective tax rate), true-up (post-filing adjustment), or amended (restated provision). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: annual|interim_quarterly|interim_monthly|true_up|amended — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740-270; SAP FI/CO Tax Calculation Run Type

attributes.name: rate_case_docket_number
attributes.description: The PUC or FERC docket number of the rate case in which this tax provision data is used as supporting evidence for the revenue requirement calculation. Links tax provision to the regulatory proceeding.
attributes.references: State PUC Rate Case Rules; FERC Rate Case Procedures; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: regulatory_liability_tax_effect_amt
attributes.description: The income tax effect of regulatory liabilities (e.g., excess ADIT returned to customers, over-recovered revenues) recognized under FASB ASC 980. Represents the deferred tax component of regulatory liabilities on the balance sheet.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 980-740; FASB ASC 740; FERC Form 1; State PUC Rate Orders

attributes.name: state_apportionment_factor
attributes.description: The blended apportionment factor (sales/receipts, payroll, property — weighted per state formula) used to allocate multi-state income to a specific state jurisdiction. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.4523 for 45.23%). Required for state income tax provision calculations.
attributes.references: Multistate Tax Compact; State Revenue Codes; FERC Form 1; Uniform Division of Income for Tax Purposes Act (UDITPA)

attributes.name: statutory_tax_rate
attributes.description: The enacted statutory income tax rate applicable to the legal entity for the jurisdiction and fiscal year (e.g., 0.2100 for 21% federal corporate rate post-TCJA). Used as the baseline for effective tax rate reconciliation.
attributes.references: IRC §11 (Federal Corporate Tax Rate); Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA) 2017; State Revenue Codes

attributes.name: tax_credit_amt
attributes.description: Total income tax credits recognized in the period, including production tax credits (PTC) for wind/solar generation, investment tax credits (ITC) for renewable energy assets, and R&D credits. Reduces current tax expense dollar-for-dollar.
attributes.references: IRS IRC §45 (PTC); IRS IRC §48 (ITC); Inflation Reduction Act 2022; FASB ASC 740-10; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: tax_depreciation_amt
attributes.description: Total tax depreciation claimed for the period under IRS Modified Accelerated Cost Recovery System (MACRS). Typically exceeds book depreciation for utility plant, creating the primary taxable temporary difference and deferred tax liability for regulated utilities.
attributes.references: IRS IRC §168 MACRS; IRS Publication 946; FERC Form 1 Depreciation Schedule

attributes.name: tax_return_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provision is computed on a consolidated federal return, separate company basis, combined state return, or unitary state return. Critical for apportionment factor allocation and intercompany tax sharing agreement calculations.
attributes.references: IRS Reg. 1.1502; State Unitary/Combined Reporting Rules; FASB ASC 740-10-30

attributes.name: temporary_difference_amt
attributes.description: Net aggregate temporary difference between book and tax basis of assets and liabilities for the period and jurisdiction. Drives the deferred tax expense/benefit calculation. Includes accelerated depreciation, regulatory assets/liabilities, and pension timing differences.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740-10-25; IRS MACRS; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: total_tax_expense_amt
attributes.description: Sum of current and deferred income tax expense for the period. Equals the total provision for income taxes reported on the GAAP income statement. Used in EBITDA reconciliation and rate case revenue requirement calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740-10-30; FERC Form 1; FASB ASC 980 Regulated Operations

attributes.name: uncertain_tax_position_amt
attributes.description: Reserve for uncertain tax positions (UTPs) under the more-likely-than-not recognition threshold. Represents the cumulative liability for tax positions that may not be sustained upon IRS or state examination. Disclosed in financial statement footnotes.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740-10-25 (FIN 48); IRS Schedule UTP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: utility_service_type
attributes.description: The regulated utility service type to which this tax provision is attributed: electric, gas, common (shared), water, or steam. Required for functional separation in rate case cost-of-service studies and FERC Form 1 reporting.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; State PUC Functional Separation Rules; FASB ASC 980

attributes.name: valuation_allowance_amt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Deferred Tax Asset Valuation Allowance Amount
attributes.description: Valuation allowance recorded against gross deferred tax assets when it is more likely than not that some portion will not be realized. Reduces net deferred tax asset on the balance sheet per ASC 740 realizability assessment.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 740-10-30-5; SAP FI/CO Valuation Allowance Account

products.name: opportunity
products.description: Commercial opportunity record tracking sales and program enrollment opportunities for C&I customers through the full pipeline lifecycle from prospecting through close. Captures opportunity name, type (new service, rate change, DR enrollment, DER program, VPP participation, energy efficiency upgrade, NEM application, TOU migration), stage (prospecting, qualification, proposal, negotiation, closed-won, closed-lost), estimated annual revenue impact, estimated load impact (kW/kWh), probability of close, expected close date, opportunity source, assigned KAM, and external system opportunity identifier. metric_views.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `power_and_utilities_v2`.`_metrics`.`asset_capex_project`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Financial and schedule health of capital projects"
  source: "`power_and_utilities_v2`.`asset`.`asset_capex_project`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "project_status"
      expr: project_status
      comment: "Current status of the project"
    - name: "project_type"
      expr: project_type
      comment: "Category or type of the project"
    - name: "geographic_region"
      expr: geographic_region
      comment: "Geographic region where the project is located"
    - name: "in_service_year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', in_service_date_actual)
      comment: "Year the asset entered service"
  measures:
    - name: "total_actual_spend"
      expr: SUM(CAST(actual_spend_to_date_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Cumulative actual spend to date for capital projects"
    - name: "total_budget_variance"
      expr: SUM(CAST(budget_variance_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of budget variance amounts across projects"
    - name: "average_forecast_at_completion"
      expr: AVG(CAST(forecast_at_completion_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average forecasted cost at completion for projects"
    - name: "project_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Number of capital projects"
$$
metric_views.description: Financial and schedule health of capital projects

metric_views.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `power_and_utilities_v2`.`_metrics`.`asset_depreciation_schedule`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Depreciation accounting metrics for asset portfolio"
  source: "`power_and_utilities_v2`.`asset`.`depreciation_schedule`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "asset_category"
      expr: asset_category
      comment: "High‑level category of the asset"
    - name: "asset_class_code"
      expr: asset_class_code
      comment: "Asset class code used for accounting"
    - name: "depreciation_method"
      expr: depreciation_method
      comment: "Method used to calculate depreciation"
    - name: "schedule_year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', schedule_effective_date)
      comment: "Fiscal year of the depreciation schedule"
  measures:
    - name: "total_annual_depreciation_expense"
      expr: SUM(CAST(annual_depreciation_expense AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total annual depreciation expense for assets"
    - name: "total_accumulated_depreciation"
      expr: SUM(CAST(accumulated_depreciation AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Cumulative depreciation recorded to date"
    - name: "average_book_reserve_percentage"
      expr: AVG(CAST(book_reserve_percentage AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average reserve percentage applied to book values"
    - name: "asset_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Number of asset depreciation records"
$$
metric_views.description: Depreciation accounting metrics for asset portfolio

metric_views.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `power_and_utilities_v2`.`_metrics`.`asset_failure_event`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Reliability and outage impact metrics for asset failures"
  source: "`power_and_utilities_v2`.`asset`.`failure_event`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "failure_severity"
      expr: failure_severity
      comment: "Severity rating of the failure"
    - name: "failure_type"
      expr: failure_type
      comment: "Type/category of the failure"
    - name: "asset_criticality_tier"
      expr: asset_criticality_tier
      comment: "Criticality tier of the affected asset"
    - name: "failure_year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', failure_date)
      comment: "Year the failure occurred"
  measures:
    - name: "total_energy_not_supplied_mwh"
      expr: SUM(CAST(energy_not_supplied_mwh AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total megawatt‑hours of energy not supplied due to failures"
    - name: "total_load_lost_mw"
      expr: SUM(CAST(load_lost_mw AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total megawatt load lost across failure events"
    - name: "average_outage_duration_minutes"
      expr: AVG(CAST(outage_duration_minutes AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average outage duration in minutes per failure event"
    - name: "failure_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Number of recorded failure events"
$$
metric_views.description: Reliability and outage impact metrics for asset failures

metric_views.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `power_and_utilities_v2`.`_metrics`.`asset_risk_assessment`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Strategic risk assessment metrics for asset portfolio"
  source: "`power_and_utilities_v2`.`asset`.`risk_assessment`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "risk_tier"
      expr: risk_tier
      comment: "Risk tier classification (e.g., High, Medium, Low)"
    - name: "risk_driver_primary"
      expr: risk_driver_primary
      comment: "Primary driver influencing the risk"
    - name: "assessment_method"
      expr: assessment_method
      comment: "Methodology used for the risk assessment"
    - name: "assessment_year"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('year', assessment_date)
      comment: "Year the risk assessment was performed"
  measures:
    - name: "average_composite_risk_index"
      expr: AVG(CAST(composite_risk_index AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average composite risk index across assessments"
    - name: "total_estimated_failure_cost_usd"
      expr: SUM(CAST(estimated_failure_cost_usd AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total estimated cost of potential failures in USD"
    - name: "high_risk_assessment_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN risk_tier = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of assessments classified as high risk"
    - name: "assessment_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of risk assessments"
$$
metric_views.description: Strategic risk assessment metrics for asset portfolio
